(* expr implies locally closed at term level *)
Lemma expr_lc_strong : forall n,
  (forall e, exp_size e < n -> expr e -> lc_at 0 e) /\
  (forall r, rec_size r < n -> record_comp r -> lc_at_rec 0 r).
Proof.
  induction n as [| n IH].
  - split; intros; lia.
  - destruct IH as [IHe IHr]. split.
    + intros e Hsize Hexpr.
      destruct e as [m | y | T e1 | e1 e2 | T e1 | e1 T | e1 e2 | e1 | e1 | e1 e2 | l | e1 | r | e1 a | e1 a e2]; simpl in *.
      * inversion Hexpr.
      * auto.
      * destruct (expr_abs_inv T e1 Hexpr) as [Hty [L Hbody]].
        destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx].
        apply (lc_at_open_ee_inv e1 0 x).
        assert (Hsz : exp_size (open_ee e1 (exp_fvar x)) < n).
        { pose proof (exp_size_open_ee e1 x). assert (typ_size T + exp_size e1 < n) by lia. lia. }
        apply IHe; [exact Hsz | apply Hbody; exact Hx].
      * destruct (expr_app_inv e1 e2 Hexpr) as [H1 H2]; split.
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact H1].
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact H2].
      * destruct (expr_tabs_inv T e1 Hexpr) as [Hty [L Hbody]].
        destruct (atom_fresh L) as [X HX].
        apply (proj2 (lc_at_open_te e1 0 (typ_fvar X) 0)).
        assert (Hsz : exp_size (open_te e1 (typ_fvar X)) < n).
        { pose proof (exp_size_open_te e1 X). assert (typ_size T + exp_size e1 < n) by lia. lia. }
        apply IHe; [exact Hsz | apply Hbody; exact HX].
      * destruct (expr_tapp_inv e1 T Hexpr) as [H1 H2].
        apply IHe; [lia | exact H1].
      * destruct (expr_let_inv e1 e2 Hexpr) as [H1 Hbody]. split.
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact H1].
        -- destruct Hbody as [L Hbody]. destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx].
           apply (lc_at_open_ee_inv e2 0 x).
           assert (Hsz : exp_size (open_ee e2 (exp_fvar x)) < n).
           { pose proof (exp_size_open_ee e2 x). lia. }
           apply IHe; [exact Hsz | apply Hbody; exact Hx].
      * apply IHe; [lia | apply (expr_box_inv e1); exact Hexpr].
      * apply IHe; [lia | apply (expr_unbox_inv e1); exact Hexpr].
      * destruct (expr_set_box_inv e1 e2 Hexpr) as [H1 H2]; split.
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact H1].
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact H2].
      * auto.
      * apply IHe; [lia | apply (expr_seal_inv e1); exact Hexpr].
      * apply IHr; [lia | apply (expr_record_inv r); exact Hexpr].
      * apply IHe; [lia | apply (expr_record_read_inv e1 a); exact Hexpr].
      * destruct (expr_record_write_inv e1 a e2 Hexpr) as [H1 H2]; split.
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact H1].
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact H2].
    + intros r Hsize Hrc.
      destruct r as [ | a e1 r1 | a l r1]; simpl in *.
      * auto.
      * destruct (record_comp_exp_inv a e1 r1 Hrc) as [He Hr]; split.
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact He].
        -- apply IHr; [lia | exact Hr].
      * apply IHr; [lia | apply (record_comp_ref_inv a l r1); exact Hrc].
Qed.

Lemma expr_lc : forall e, expr e -> lc_at 0 e.
Proof.
  intros e H. apply (proj1 (expr_lc_strong (S (exp_size e)))); [lia | exact H].
Qed.

Lemma record_comp_lc : forall r, record_comp r -> lc_at_rec 0 r.
Proof.
  intros r H. apply (proj2 (expr_lc_strong (S (rec_size r)))); [lia | exact H].
Qed.

(* ================= type-level locally-closed predicate ================= *)
Fixpoint tlc_at (k : nat) (T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_bvar i => i < k
  | typ_fvar _ => True
  | typ_arrow A B => tlc_at k A /\ tlc_at k B
  | typ_all A B => tlc_at k A /\ tlc_at (S k) B
  | typ_box T => tlc_at k T
  | typ_mut _ T => tlc_at k T
  | typ_int A B => tlc_at k A /\ tlc_at k B
  | typ_record _ T => tlc_at k T
  end.

Lemma tlc_at_open_tt_inv : forall T k V,
  tlc_at k (open_tt_rec k V T) -> tlc_at (S k) T.
Proof.
  induction T; intros k V H; simpl in *.
  - auto.
  - destruct (k == n); simpl in *; [lia | lia].
  - auto.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [apply (IHT1 k V) | apply (IHT2 k V)]; assumption.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]; split.
    + apply (IHT1 k V); exact H1.
    + apply (IHT2 (S k) V); exact H2.
  - apply (IHT k V); exact H.
  - apply (IHT k V); exact H.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [apply (IHT1 k V) | apply (IHT2 k V)]; assumption.
  - apply (IHT k V); exact H.
Qed.

Lemma type_tlc : forall T, type T -> tlc_at 0 T.
Proof.
  intros T H. induction H; simpl.
  - auto.
  - auto.
  - split; assumption.
  - split; [assumption |].
    destruct (atom_fresh L) as [X HX].
    apply tlc_at_open_tt_inv with (V:=typ_fvar X).
    apply H1; exact HX.
  - apply IHtype.
  - apply IHtype.
  - split; assumption.
  - apply IHtype.
Qed.

(* type-level closedness of all annotations in an expression *)
Fixpoint tlc_e (kty : nat) (e : exp) : Prop :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar _ => True
  | exp_fvar _ => True
  | exp_abs T e1 => tlc_at kty T /\ tlc_e kty e1
  | exp_app e1 e2 => tlc_e kty e1 /\ tlc_e kty e2
  | exp_tabs T e1 => tlc_at kty T /\ tlc_e (S kty) e1
  | exp_tapp e1 T => tlc_e kty e1 /\ tlc_at kty T
  | exp_let e1 e2 => tlc_e kty e1 /\ tlc_e kty e2
  | exp_box e1 => tlc_e kty e1
  | exp_unbox e1 => tlc_e kty e1
  | exp_set_box e1 e2 => tlc_e kty e1 /\ tlc_e kty e2
  | exp_ref _ => True
  | exp_seal e1 => tlc_e kty e1
  | exp_record r => tlc_r kty r
  | exp_record_read e1 _ => tlc_e kty e1
  | exp_record_write e1 _ e2 => tlc_e kty e1 /\ tlc_e kty e2
  end
with tlc_r (kty : nat) (r : rec_comp) : Prop :=
  match r with
  | rec_empty => True
  | rec_exp _ e r1 => tlc_e kty e /\ tlc_r kty r1
  | rec_ref _ _ r1 => tlc_r kty r1
  end.

Fixpoint tlc_e_open_ee (e : exp) :
    forall kty K (x : atom), tlc_e kty (open_ee_rec K (exp_fvar x) e) <-> tlc_e kty e
with tlc_r_open_ee (r : rec_comp) :
    forall kty K (x : atom), tlc_r kty (open_ee_record_rec K (exp_fvar x) r) <-> tlc_r kty r.
Proof.
  - intros kty K x.
    destruct e as [n | y | T e | e1 e2 | T e | e1 T | e1 e2 | e | e | e1 e2 | l | e | r | e a | e1 a e2]; simpl.
    + destruct (K == n); simpl; tauto.
    + tauto.
    + destruct (tlc_e_open_ee e kty (S K) x) as [A B]; tauto.
    + destruct (tlc_e_open_ee e1 kty K x) as [A B]; destruct (tlc_e_open_ee e2 kty K x) as [C D]; tauto.
    + destruct (tlc_e_open_ee e (S kty) K x) as [A B]; tauto.
    + destruct (tlc_e_open_ee e1 kty K x) as [A B]; tauto.
    + destruct (tlc_e_open_ee e1 kty K x) as [A B]; destruct (tlc_e_open_ee e2 kty (S K) x) as [C D]; tauto.
    + apply tlc_e_open_ee.
    + apply tlc_e_open_ee.
    + destruct (tlc_e_open_ee e1 kty K x) as [A B]; destruct (tlc_e_open_ee e2 kty K x) as [C D]; tauto.
    + tauto.
    + apply tlc_e_open_ee.
    + apply tlc_r_open_ee.
    + apply tlc_e_open_ee.
    + destruct (tlc_e_open_ee e1 kty K x) as [A B]; destruct (tlc_e_open_ee e2 kty K x) as [C D]; tauto.
  - intros kty K x.
    destruct r as [ | a e r | a l r]; simpl.
    + tauto.
    + destruct (tlc_e_open_ee e kty K x) as [A B]; destruct (tlc_r_open_ee r kty K x) as [C D]; tauto.
    + apply tlc_r_open_ee.
Qed.

(* monotonicity of tlc predicates *)
Lemma tlc_at_weaken : forall T k k', k <= k' -> tlc_at k T -> tlc_at k' T.
Proof.
  induction T; intros k k' Hle H; simpl in *.
  - auto.
  - lia.
  - auto.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [exact (IHT1 k k' Hle H1) | exact (IHT2 k k' Hle H2)].
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [exact (IHT1 k k' Hle H1) | exact (IHT2 (S k) (S k') (le_n_S _ _ Hle) H2)].
  - exact (IHT k k' Hle H).
  - exact (IHT k k' Hle H).
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [exact (IHT1 k k' Hle H1) | exact (IHT2 k k' Hle H2)].
  - exact (IHT k k' Hle H).
Qed.

Fixpoint tlc_e_weaken (e : exp) :
    forall k k', k <= k' -> tlc_e k e -> tlc_e k' e
with tlc_r_weaken (r : rec_comp) :
    forall k k', k <= k' -> tlc_r k r -> tlc_r k' r.
Proof.
  - intros k k' Hle H.
    destruct e as [n | y | T e | e1 e2 | T e | e1 T | e1 e2 | e | e | e1 e2 | l | e | r | e a | e1 a e2]; simpl in *; try tauto.
    + destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [apply tlc_at_weaken with k | apply tlc_e_weaken with k]; auto.
    + destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [apply tlc_e_weaken with k | apply tlc_e_weaken with k]; auto.
    + destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [apply tlc_at_weaken with k | apply tlc_e_weaken with (S k)]; auto; lia.
    + destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [apply tlc_e_weaken with k | apply tlc_at_weaken with k]; auto.
    + destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [apply tlc_e_weaken with k | apply tlc_e_weaken with k]; auto.
    + apply tlc_e_weaken with k; auto.
    + apply tlc_e_weaken with k; auto.
    + destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [apply tlc_e_weaken with k | apply tlc_e_weaken with k]; auto.
    + apply tlc_e_weaken with k; auto.
    + apply tlc_r_weaken with k; auto.
    + apply tlc_e_weaken with k; auto.
    + destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [apply tlc_e_weaken with k | apply tlc_e_weaken with k]; auto.
  - intros k k' Hle H.
    destruct r as [ | a e r | a l r]; simpl in *; try tauto.
    + destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [apply tlc_e_weaken with k | apply tlc_r_weaken with k]; auto.
    + apply tlc_r_weaken with k; auto.
Qed.

(* tlc terms are unaffected by type opening *)
Lemma tlc_at_open_id : forall T k K V, tlc_at k T -> k <= K -> open_tt_rec K V T = T.
Proof.
  induction T; intros k K V H Hle; simpl in *.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (K == n); [lia | reflexivity].
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. rewrite (IHT1 k K V H1 Hle). rewrite (IHT2 k K V H2 Hle). reflexivity.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. rewrite (IHT1 k K V H1 Hle).
    rewrite (IHT2 (S k) (S K) V H2 (le_n_S _ _ Hle)). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHT k K V H Hle). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHT k K V H Hle). reflexivity.
  - destruct H as [H1 H2]. rewrite (IHT1 k K V H1 Hle). rewrite (IHT2 k K V H2 Hle). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (IHT k K V H Hle). reflexivity.
Qed.

Fixpoint tlc_e_open_te_id (e : exp) :
    forall k K V, tlc_e k e -> k <= K -> open_te_rec K V e = e
with tlc_r_open_te_id (r : rec_comp) :
    forall k K V, tlc_r k r -> k <= K -> open_te_record_rec K V r = r.
Proof.
  - intros k K V H Hle.
    destruct e as [n | y | T e | e1 e2 | T e | e1 T | e1 e2 | e | e | e1 e2 | l | e | r | e a | e1 a e2]; simpl in *.
    + reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
    + destruct H as [H1 H2].
      rewrite tlc_at_open_id with (k:=k) (K:=K) (V:=V); [| exact H1 | exact Hle].
      rewrite tlc_e_open_te_id with (k:=k) (K:=K) (V:=V); [reflexivity | exact H2 | exact Hle].
    + destruct H as [H1 H2].
      rewrite tlc_e_open_te_id with (k:=k) (K:=K) (V:=V); [| exact H1 | exact Hle].
      rewrite tlc_e_open_te_id with (k:=k) (K:=K) (V:=V); [reflexivity | exact H2 | exact Hle].
    + destruct H as [H1 H2].
      rewrite tlc_at_open_id with (k:=k) (K:=K) (V:=V); [| exact H1 | exact Hle].
      rewrite tlc_e_open_te_id with (k:=S k) (K:=S K) (V:=V); [reflexivity | exact H2 | lia].
    + destruct H as [H1 H2].
      rewrite tlc_e_open_te_id with (k:=k) (K:=K) (V:=V); [| exact H1 | exact Hle].
      rewrite tlc_at_open_id with (k:=k) (K:=K) (V:=V); [reflexivity | exact H2 | exact Hle].
    + destruct H as [H1 H2].
      rewrite tlc_e_open_te_id with (k:=k) (K:=K) (V:=V); [| exact H1 | exact Hle].
      rewrite tlc_e_open_te_id with (k:=k) (K:=K) (V:=V); [reflexivity | exact H2 | exact Hle].
    + rewrite (tlc_e_open_te_id e k K V H Hle); reflexivity.
    + rewrite (tlc_e_open_te_id e k K V H Hle); reflexivity.
    + destruct H as [H1 H2].
      rewrite tlc_e_open_te_id with (k:=k) (K:=K) (V:=V); [| exact H1 | exact Hle].
      rewrite tlc_e_open_te_id with (k:=k) (K:=K) (V:=V); [reflexivity | exact H2 | exact Hle].
    + reflexivity.
    + rewrite (tlc_e_open_te_id e k K V H Hle); reflexivity.
    + rewrite (tlc_r_open_te_id r k K V H Hle); reflexivity.
    + rewrite (tlc_e_open_te_id e k K V H Hle); reflexivity.
    + destruct H as [H1 H2].
      rewrite tlc_e_open_te_id with (k:=k) (K:=K) (V:=V); [| exact H1 | exact Hle].
      rewrite tlc_e_open_te_id with (k:=k) (K:=K) (V:=V); [reflexivity | exact H2 | exact Hle].
  - intros k K V H Hle.
    destruct r as [ | a e r | a l r]; simpl in *.
    + reflexivity.
    + destruct H as [H1 H2].
      rewrite tlc_e_open_te_id with (k:=k) (K:=K) (V:=V); [| exact H1 | exact Hle].
      rewrite tlc_r_open_te_id with (k:=k) (K:=K) (V:=V); [reflexivity | exact H2 | exact Hle].
    + rewrite (tlc_r_open_te_id r k K V H Hle); reflexivity.
Qed.

Fixpoint tlc_e_open_te_inv (e : exp) :
    forall k V, tlc_e k (open_te_rec k V e) -> tlc_e (S k) e
with tlc_r_open_te_inv (r : rec_comp) :
    forall k V, tlc_r k (open_te_record_rec k V r) -> tlc_r (S k) r.
Proof.
  - intros k V H.
    destruct e as [n | y | T e | e1 e2 | T e | e1 T | e1 e2 | e | e | e1 e2 | l | e | r | e a | e1 a e2]; simpl in *.
    + auto.
    + auto.
    + destruct H as [H1 H2]; split.
      * apply tlc_at_open_tt_inv with (V:=V); exact H1.
      * apply tlc_e_open_te_inv with (V:=V); exact H2.
    + destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [apply tlc_e_open_te_inv with (V:=V) | apply tlc_e_open_te_inv with (V:=V)]; assumption.
    + destruct H as [H1 H2]; split.
      * apply tlc_at_open_tt_inv with (V:=V); exact H1.
      * apply tlc_e_open_te_inv with (V:=V); exact H2.
    + destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [apply tlc_e_open_te_inv with (V:=V) | apply tlc_at_open_tt_inv with (V:=V)]; assumption.
    + destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [apply tlc_e_open_te_inv with (V:=V) | apply tlc_e_open_te_inv with (V:=V)]; assumption.
    + apply tlc_e_open_te_inv with (V:=V); exact H.
    + apply tlc_e_open_te_inv with (V:=V); exact H.
    + destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [apply tlc_e_open_te_inv with (V:=V) | apply tlc_e_open_te_inv with (V:=V)]; assumption.
    + auto.
    + apply tlc_e_open_te_inv with (V:=V); exact H.
    + apply tlc_r_open_te_inv with (V:=V); exact H.
    + apply tlc_e_open_te_inv with (V:=V); exact H.
    + destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [apply tlc_e_open_te_inv with (V:=V) | apply tlc_e_open_te_inv with (V:=V)]; assumption.
  - intros k V H.
    destruct r as [ | a e r | a l r]; simpl in *.
    + auto.
    + destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [apply tlc_e_open_te_inv with (V:=V) | apply tlc_r_open_te_inv with (V:=V)]; assumption.
    + apply tlc_r_open_te_inv with (V:=V); exact H.
Qed.

Lemma expr_tlc_strong : forall n,
  (forall e, exp_size e < n -> expr e -> tlc_e 0 e) /\
  (forall r, rec_size r < n -> record_comp r -> tlc_r 0 r).
Proof.
  induction n as [| n IH].
  - split; intros; lia.
  - destruct IH as [IHe IHr]. split.
    + intros e Hsize Hexpr.
      destruct e as [m | y | T e1 | e1 e2 | T e1 | e1 T | e1 e2 | e1 | e1 | e1 e2 | l | e1 | r | e1 a | e1 a e2]; simpl in *.
      * inversion Hexpr.
      * auto.
      * destruct (expr_abs_inv T e1 Hexpr) as [Hty [L Hbody]].
        split.
        -- apply type_tlc; exact Hty.
        -- destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx].
           apply (proj1 (tlc_e_open_ee e1 0 0 x)).
           apply IHe; [| apply Hbody; exact Hx].
           assert (He : exp_size (open_ee_rec 0 (exp_fvar x) e1) <= exp_size e1).
           { unfold open_ee. apply exp_size_open_ee_rec. simpl. lia. }
           assert (typ_size T + exp_size e1 < n) by lia. lia.
      * destruct (expr_app_inv e1 e2 Hexpr) as [H1 H2]; split.
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact H1].
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact H2].
      * destruct (expr_tabs_inv T e1 Hexpr) as [Hty [L Hbody]].
        split.
        -- apply type_tlc; exact Hty.
        -- destruct (atom_fresh L) as [X HX].
           apply (tlc_e_open_te_inv e1 0 (typ_fvar X)).
           apply IHe; [| apply Hbody; exact HX].
           assert (He : exp_size (open_te_rec 0 (typ_fvar X) e1) <= exp_size e1).
           { unfold open_te. apply exp_size_open_te_rec. simpl. lia. }
           assert (typ_size T + exp_size e1 < n) by lia. lia.
      * destruct (expr_tapp_inv e1 T Hexpr) as [H1 H2]; split.
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact H1].
        -- apply type_tlc; exact H2.
      * destruct (expr_let_inv e1 e2 Hexpr) as [H1 Hbody]. split.
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact H1].
        -- destruct Hbody as [L Hbody]. destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx].
           apply (proj1 (tlc_e_open_ee e2 0 0 x)).
           apply IHe; [| apply Hbody; exact Hx].
           assert (He : exp_size (open_ee_rec 0 (exp_fvar x) e2) <= exp_size e2).
           { unfold open_ee. apply exp_size_open_ee_rec. simpl. lia. }
           lia.
      * apply IHe; [lia | apply (expr_box_inv e1); exact Hexpr].
      * apply IHe; [lia | apply (expr_unbox_inv e1); exact Hexpr].
      * destruct (expr_set_box_inv e1 e2 Hexpr) as [H1 H2]; split.
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact H1].
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact H2].
      * auto.
      * apply IHe; [lia | apply (expr_seal_inv e1); exact Hexpr].
      * apply IHr; [lia | apply (expr_record_inv r); exact Hexpr].
      * apply IHe; [lia | apply (expr_record_read_inv e1 a); exact Hexpr].
      * destruct (expr_record_write_inv e1 a e2 Hexpr) as [H1 H2]; split.
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact H1].
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact H2].
    + intros r Hsize Hrc.
      destruct r as [ | a e1 r1 | a l r1]; simpl in *.
      * auto.
      * destruct (record_comp_exp_inv a e1 r1 Hrc) as [He Hr]; split.
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact He].
        -- apply IHr; [lia | exact Hr].
      * apply IHr; [lia | apply (record_comp_ref_inv a l r1); exact Hrc].
Qed.

Lemma expr_tlc : forall e, expr e -> tlc_e 0 e.
Proof.
  intros e H. apply (proj1 (expr_tlc_strong (S (exp_size e)))); [lia | exact H].
Qed.

Lemma record_comp_tlc : forall r, record_comp r -> tlc_r 0 r.
Proof.
  intros r H. apply (proj2 (expr_tlc_strong (S (rec_size r)))); [lia | exact H].
Qed.

(* ================= free term-variable substitution ================= *)
Definition aeq (x y : atom) : {x = y} + {x <> y} := KeySetFacts.eq_dec x y.

Fixpoint subst_fvar_e (x : atom) (u : exp) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar y => if aeq x y then u else exp_fvar y
  | exp_abs T e1 => exp_abs T (subst_fvar_e x u e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (subst_fvar_e x u e1) (subst_fvar_e x u e2)
  | exp_tabs T e1 => exp_tabs T (subst_fvar_e x u e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 T => exp_tapp (subst_fvar_e x u e1) T
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (subst_fvar_e x u e1) (subst_fvar_e x u e2)
  | exp_box e1 => exp_box (subst_fvar_e x u e1)
  | exp_unbox e1 => exp_unbox (subst_fvar_e x u e1)
  | exp_set_box e1 e2 => exp_set_box (subst_fvar_e x u e1) (subst_fvar_e x u e2)
  | exp_ref l => exp_ref l
  | exp_seal e1 => exp_seal (subst_fvar_e x u e1)
  | exp_record r => exp_record (subst_fvar_r x u r)
  | exp_record_read e1 a => exp_record_read (subst_fvar_e x u e1) a
  | exp_record_write e1 a e2 => exp_record_write (subst_fvar_e x u e1) a (subst_fvar_e x u e2)
  end
with subst_fvar_r (x : atom) (u : exp) (r : rec_comp) {struct r} : rec_comp :=
  match r with
  | rec_empty => rec_empty
  | rec_exp a e r1 => rec_exp a (subst_fvar_e x u e) (subst_fvar_r x u r1)
  | rec_ref a l r1 => rec_ref a l (subst_fvar_r x u r1)
  end.

(* commute substitution with type opening *)
Fixpoint subst_fvar_open_te (e : exp) :
    forall x u K V, (forall d, tlc_e d u) ->
      subst_fvar_e x u (open_te_rec K V e) = open_te_rec K V (subst_fvar_e x u e)
with subst_fvar_r_open_te (r : rec_comp) :
    forall x u K V, (forall d, tlc_e d u) ->
      subst_fvar_r x u (open_te_record_rec K V r) = open_te_record_rec K V (subst_fvar_r x u r).
Proof.
  - intros x u K V Hu.
    destruct e as [n | y | T e | e1 e2 | T e | e1 T | e1 e2 | e | e | e1 e2 | l | e | r | e a | e1 a e2]; simpl.
    + reflexivity.
    + destruct (aeq x y); simpl.
      * symmetry. apply tlc_e_open_te_id with (k:=K); [apply Hu | lia].
      * reflexivity.
    + rewrite subst_fvar_open_te; [reflexivity | exact Hu].
    + rewrite subst_fvar_open_te, subst_fvar_open_te; [reflexivity | exact Hu | exact Hu].
    + rewrite subst_fvar_open_te; [reflexivity | exact Hu].
    + rewrite subst_fvar_open_te; [reflexivity | exact Hu].
    + rewrite subst_fvar_open_te, subst_fvar_open_te; [reflexivity | exact Hu | exact Hu].
    + rewrite subst_fvar_open_te; [reflexivity | exact Hu].
    + rewrite subst_fvar_open_te; [reflexivity | exact Hu].
    + rewrite subst_fvar_open_te, subst_fvar_open_te; [reflexivity | exact Hu | exact Hu].
    + reflexivity.
    + rewrite subst_fvar_open_te; [reflexivity | exact Hu].
    + rewrite subst_fvar_r_open_te; [reflexivity | exact Hu].
    + rewrite subst_fvar_open_te; [reflexivity | exact Hu].
    + rewrite subst_fvar_open_te, subst_fvar_open_te; [reflexivity | exact Hu | exact Hu].
  - intros x u K V Hu.
    destruct r as [ | a e r | a l r]; simpl.
    + reflexivity.
    + rewrite subst_fvar_open_te, subst_fvar_r_open_te; [reflexivity | exact Hu | exact Hu].
    + rewrite subst_fvar_r_open_te; [reflexivity | exact Hu].
Qed.

(* commute substitution with term opening at a fresh variable *)
Fixpoint subst_fvar_open_ee (e : exp) :
    forall k x u y, lc_at 0 u -> x <> y ->
      open_ee_rec k (exp_fvar y) (subst_fvar_e x u e)
      = subst_fvar_e x u (open_ee_rec k (exp_fvar y) e)
with subst_fvar_r_open_ee (r : rec_comp) :
    forall k x u y, lc_at 0 u -> x <> y ->
      open_ee_record_rec k (exp_fvar y) (subst_fvar_r x u r)
      = subst_fvar_r x u (open_ee_record_rec k (exp_fvar y) r).
Proof.
  - intros k x u y Hlc Hne.
    destruct e as [n | z | T e | e1 e2 | T e | e1 T | e1 e2 | e | e | e1 e2 | l | e | r | e a | e1 a e2]; simpl.
    + destruct (k == n); simpl; [destruct (aeq x y); [exfalso; auto | reflexivity] | reflexivity].
    + destruct (aeq x z); simpl.
      * apply open_ee_lc0_id with (K:=k) (v:=exp_fvar y); exact Hlc.
      * reflexivity.
    + rewrite subst_fvar_open_ee; [reflexivity | exact Hlc | exact Hne].
    + rewrite subst_fvar_open_ee, subst_fvar_open_ee; [reflexivity | exact Hlc | exact Hne | exact Hlc | exact Hne].
    + rewrite subst_fvar_open_ee; [reflexivity | exact Hlc | exact Hne].
    + rewrite subst_fvar_open_ee; [reflexivity | exact Hlc | exact Hne].
    + rewrite subst_fvar_open_ee, subst_fvar_open_ee; [reflexivity | exact Hlc | exact Hne | exact Hlc | exact Hne].
    + rewrite subst_fvar_open_ee; [reflexivity | exact Hlc | exact Hne].
    + rewrite subst_fvar_open_ee; [reflexivity | exact Hlc | exact Hne].
    + rewrite subst_fvar_open_ee, subst_fvar_open_ee; [reflexivity | exact Hlc | exact Hne | exact Hlc | exact Hne].
    + reflexivity.
    + rewrite subst_fvar_open_ee; [reflexivity | exact Hlc | exact Hne].
    + rewrite subst_fvar_r_open_ee; [reflexivity | exact Hlc | exact Hne].
    + rewrite subst_fvar_open_ee; [reflexivity | exact Hlc | exact Hne].
    + rewrite subst_fvar_open_ee, subst_fvar_open_ee; [reflexivity | exact Hlc | exact Hne | exact Hlc | exact Hne].
  - intros k x u y Hlc Hne.
    destruct r as [ | a e r | a l r]; simpl.
    + reflexivity.
    + rewrite subst_fvar_open_ee, subst_fvar_r_open_ee; [reflexivity | exact Hlc | exact Hne | exact Hlc | exact Hne].
    + rewrite subst_fvar_r_open_ee; [reflexivity | exact Hlc | exact Hne].
Qed.

Lemma expr_tlc_all : forall u, expr u -> forall d, tlc_e d u.
Proof.
  intros u H d. apply tlc_e_weaken with 0; [lia | apply expr_tlc; exact H].
Qed.

Lemma expr_subst_fvar_strong : forall n,
  (forall e, exp_size e < n -> expr e -> forall x u, expr u -> expr (subst_fvar_e x u e)) /\
  (forall r, rec_size r < n -> record_comp r -> forall x u, expr u -> record_comp (subst_fvar_r x u r)).
Proof.
  induction n as [| n IH].
  - split; intros; lia.
  - destruct IH as [IHe IHr]. split.
    + intros e Hsize Hexpr x u Hu.
      destruct e as [m | z | T e1 | e1 e2 | T e1 | e1 T | e1 e2 | e1 | e1 | e1 e2 | l | e1 | r | e1 a | e1 a e2]; simpl in *.
      * inversion Hexpr.
      * destruct (aeq x z); [exact Hu | apply expr_var].
      * destruct (expr_abs_inv T e1 Hexpr) as [Hty [L Hbody]].
        apply expr_abs with (L := union L (singleton x)).
        -- exact Hty.
        -- intros y Hy.
           pose proof Hy as HyL. apply notin_union_1 in HyL.
           pose proof Hy as HyS. apply notin_union_2 in HyS.
           pose proof (notin_singleton_1 x y HyS) as Hne.
           pose proof (expr_lc u Hu) as Hlc.
           unfold open_ee.
           rewrite (subst_fvar_open_ee e1 0 x u y Hlc Hne).
           assert (Hsz : exp_size (open_ee_rec 0 (exp_fvar y) e1) < n).
           { assert (He : exp_size (open_ee_rec 0 (exp_fvar y) e1) <= exp_size e1).
             { apply exp_size_open_ee_rec. simpl. lia. }
             assert (typ_size T + exp_size e1 < n) by lia. lia. }
           apply IHe; [exact Hsz | apply Hbody; exact HyL | exact Hu].
      * destruct (expr_app_inv e1 e2 Hexpr) as [H1 H2].
        apply expr_app.
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact H1 | exact Hu].
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact H2 | exact Hu].
      * destruct (expr_tabs_inv T e1 Hexpr) as [Hty [L Hbody]].
        apply expr_tabs with (L := L).
        -- exact Hty.
        -- intros X HX.
           unfold open_te.
           rewrite <- (subst_fvar_open_te e1 x u 0 (typ_fvar X) (expr_tlc_all u Hu)).
           assert (Hsz : exp_size (open_te_rec 0 (typ_fvar X) e1) < n).
           { assert (He : exp_size (open_te_rec 0 (typ_fvar X) e1) <= exp_size e1).
             { apply exp_size_open_te_rec. simpl. lia. }
             assert (typ_size T + exp_size e1 < n) by lia. lia. }
           apply IHe; [exact Hsz | apply Hbody; exact HX | exact Hu].
      * destruct (expr_tapp_inv e1 T Hexpr) as [H1 H2].
        apply expr_tapp; [apply IHe; [lia | exact H1 | exact Hu] | exact H2].
      * destruct (expr_let_inv e1 e2 Hexpr) as [H1 [L Hbody]].
        apply expr_let with (L := union L (singleton x)).
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact H1 | exact Hu].
        -- intros y Hy.
           pose proof Hy as HyL. apply notin_union_1 in HyL.
           pose proof Hy as HyS. apply notin_union_2 in HyS.
           pose proof (notin_singleton_1 x y HyS) as Hne.
           pose proof (expr_lc u Hu) as Hlc.
           unfold open_ee.
           rewrite (subst_fvar_open_ee e2 0 x u y Hlc Hne).
           assert (Hsz : exp_size (open_ee_rec 0 (exp_fvar y) e2) < n).
           { assert (He : exp_size (open_ee_rec 0 (exp_fvar y) e2) <= exp_size e2).
             { apply exp_size_open_ee_rec. simpl. lia. }
             lia. }
           apply IHe; [exact Hsz | apply Hbody; exact HyL | exact Hu].
      * apply expr_box. apply IHe; [lia | apply (expr_box_inv e1); exact Hexpr | exact Hu].
      * apply expr_unbox. apply IHe; [lia | apply (expr_unbox_inv e1); exact Hexpr | exact Hu].
      * destruct (expr_set_box_inv e1 e2 Hexpr) as [H1 H2].
        apply expr_set_box.
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact H1 | exact Hu].
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact H2 | exact Hu].
      * apply expr_ref.
      * apply expr_seal. apply IHe; [lia | apply (expr_seal_inv e1); exact Hexpr | exact Hu].
      * apply expr_record. apply IHr; [lia | apply (expr_record_inv r); exact Hexpr | exact Hu].
      * apply expr_record_read. apply IHe; [lia | apply (expr_record_read_inv e1 a); exact Hexpr | exact Hu].
      * destruct (expr_record_write_inv e1 a e2 Hexpr) as [H1 H2].
        apply expr_record_write.
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact H1 | exact Hu].
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact H2 | exact Hu].
    + intros r Hsize Hrc x u Hu.
      destruct r as [ | a e1 r1 | a l r1]; simpl in *.
      * apply record_comp_empty.
      * destruct (record_comp_exp_inv a e1 r1 Hrc) as [He Hr].
        apply record_comp_exp.
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact He | exact Hu].
        -- apply IHr; [lia | exact Hr | exact Hu].
      * apply record_comp_ref. apply IHr; [lia | apply (record_comp_ref_inv a l r1); exact Hrc | exact Hu].
Qed.

Lemma expr_subst_fvar : forall e x u, expr e -> expr u -> expr (subst_fvar_e x u e).
Proof.
  intros. apply (proj1 (expr_subst_fvar_strong (S (exp_size e)))); [lia | exact H | exact H0].
Qed.

(* ================= free term variables ================= *)
Fixpoint fv_e (e : exp) : atoms :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar _ => AtomSetImpl.empty
  | exp_fvar y => AtomSetImpl.singleton y
  | exp_abs T e1 => fv_e e1
  | exp_app e1 e2 => AtomSetImpl.union (fv_e e1) (fv_e e2)
  | exp_tabs T e1 => fv_e e1
  | exp_tapp e1 T => fv_e e1
  | exp_let e1 e2 => AtomSetImpl.union (fv_e e1) (fv_e e2)
  | exp_box e1 => fv_e e1
  | exp_unbox e1 => fv_e e1
  | exp_set_box e1 e2 => AtomSetImpl.union (fv_e e1) (fv_e e2)
  | exp_ref _ => AtomSetImpl.empty
  | exp_seal e1 => fv_e e1
  | exp_record r => fv_r r
  | exp_record_read e1 _ => fv_e e1
  | exp_record_write e1 _ e2 => AtomSetImpl.union (fv_e e1) (fv_e e2)
  end
with fv_r (r : rec_comp) : atoms :=
  match r with
  | rec_empty => AtomSetImpl.empty
  | rec_exp _ e r1 => AtomSetImpl.union (fv_e e) (fv_r r1)
  | rec_ref _ _ r1 => fv_r r1
  end.

Fixpoint subst_fvar_open_ee_eq (e : exp) :
    forall k x u, x `notin` fv_e e ->
      open_ee_rec k u e = subst_fvar_e x u (open_ee_rec k (exp_fvar x) e)
with subst_fvar_open_ee_eq_r (r : rec_comp) :
    forall k x u, x `notin` fv_r r ->
      open_ee_record_rec k u r = subst_fvar_r x u (open_ee_record_rec k (exp_fvar x) r).
Proof.
  - intros k x u Hfv.
    destruct e as [n | y | T e1 | e1 e2 | T e1 | e1 T | e1 e2 | e1 | e1 | e1 e2 | l | e1 | r | e1 a | e1 a e2]; simpl in *.
    + destruct (k == n); simpl.
      * destruct (aeq x x); [reflexivity | exfalso; auto].
      * reflexivity.
    + pose proof (notin_singleton_1 y x Hfv) as Hne.
      destruct (aeq x y); [exfalso; apply Hne; symmetry; assumption | reflexivity].
    + rewrite (subst_fvar_open_ee_eq e1 (S k) x u Hfv). reflexivity.
    + pose proof Hfv as HfvL. apply notin_union_1 in HfvL.
      pose proof Hfv as HfvR. apply notin_union_2 in HfvR.
      rewrite (subst_fvar_open_ee_eq e1 k x u HfvL). rewrite (subst_fvar_open_ee_eq e2 k x u HfvR). reflexivity.
    + rewrite (subst_fvar_open_ee_eq e1 k x u Hfv). reflexivity.
    + rewrite (subst_fvar_open_ee_eq e1 k x u Hfv). reflexivity.
    + pose proof Hfv as HfvL. apply notin_union_1 in HfvL.
      pose proof Hfv as HfvR. apply notin_union_2 in HfvR.
      rewrite (subst_fvar_open_ee_eq e1 k x u HfvL). rewrite (subst_fvar_open_ee_eq e2 (S k) x u HfvR). reflexivity.
    + rewrite (subst_fvar_open_ee_eq e1 k x u Hfv). reflexivity.
    + rewrite (subst_fvar_open_ee_eq e1 k x u Hfv). reflexivity.
    + pose proof Hfv as HfvL. apply notin_union_1 in HfvL.
      pose proof Hfv as HfvR. apply notin_union_2 in HfvR.
      rewrite (subst_fvar_open_ee_eq e1 k x u HfvL). rewrite (subst_fvar_open_ee_eq e2 k x u HfvR). reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
    + rewrite (subst_fvar_open_ee_eq e1 k x u Hfv). reflexivity.
    + rewrite (subst_fvar_open_ee_eq_r r k x u Hfv). reflexivity.
    + rewrite (subst_fvar_open_ee_eq e1 k x u Hfv). reflexivity.
    + pose proof Hfv as HfvL. apply notin_union_1 in HfvL.
      pose proof Hfv as HfvR. apply notin_union_2 in HfvR.
      rewrite (subst_fvar_open_ee_eq e1 k x u HfvL). rewrite (subst_fvar_open_ee_eq e2 k x u HfvR). reflexivity.
  - intros k x u Hfv.
    destruct r as [ | a e1 r1 | a l r1]; simpl in *.
    + reflexivity.
    + pose proof Hfv as HfvL. apply notin_union_1 in HfvL.
      pose proof Hfv as HfvR. apply notin_union_2 in HfvR.
      rewrite (subst_fvar_open_ee_eq e1 k x u HfvL). rewrite (subst_fvar_open_ee_eq_r r1 k x u HfvR). reflexivity.
    + rewrite (subst_fvar_open_ee_eq_r r1 k x u Hfv). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma body_e_open_expr : forall e, body_e e -> forall u, expr u -> expr (open_ee e u).
Proof.
  intros e [L H] u Hu.
  destruct (atom_fresh (AtomSetImpl.union L (fv_e e))) as [x Hx].
  pose proof Hx as HL. apply notin_union_1 in HL.
  pose proof Hx as Hf. apply notin_union_2 in Hf.
  unfold open_ee.
  rewrite (subst_fvar_open_ee_eq e 0 x u Hf).
  apply expr_subst_fvar.
  - apply H; exact HL.
  - exact Hu.
Qed.

Fixpoint value_record_comp_record_comp (r : rec_comp) (H : value_record_comp r) {struct H} : record_comp r :=
  match H with
  | value_rec_empty => record_comp_empty
  | value_rec_ref a l r1 Hr => record_comp_ref a l r1 (value_record_comp_record_comp r1 Hr)
  end.

Lemma value_expr : forall e, value e -> expr e.
Proof with auto.
  intros e H. induction H.
  - assumption.
  - assumption.
  - apply expr_ref.
  - apply expr_seal. apply expr_ref.
  - apply expr_record. apply value_record_comp_record_comp. assumption.
  - apply expr_seal. apply expr_record. apply value_record_comp_record_comp. assumption.
Qed.

(* ================= free type variables ================= *)
Fixpoint ftv_t (T : typ) : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => AtomSetImpl.empty
  | typ_bvar _ => AtomSetImpl.empty
  | typ_fvar X => AtomSetImpl.singleton X
  | typ_arrow A B => AtomSetImpl.union (ftv_t A) (ftv_t B)
  | typ_all A B => AtomSetImpl.union (ftv_t A) (ftv_t B)
  | typ_box T => ftv_t T
  | typ_mut _ T => ftv_t T
  | typ_int A B => AtomSetImpl.union (ftv_t A) (ftv_t B)
  | typ_record _ T => ftv_t T
  end.

Fixpoint ftv_e (e : exp) : atoms :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar _ => AtomSetImpl.empty
  | exp_fvar _ => AtomSetImpl.empty
  | exp_abs T e1 => AtomSetImpl.union (ftv_t T) (ftv_e e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => AtomSetImpl.union (ftv_e e1) (ftv_e e2)
  | exp_tabs T e1 => AtomSetImpl.union (ftv_t T) (ftv_e e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 T => AtomSetImpl.union (ftv_e e1) (ftv_t T)
  | exp_let e1 e2 => AtomSetImpl.union (ftv_e e1) (ftv_e e2)
  | exp_box e1 => ftv_e e1
  | exp_unbox e1 => ftv_e e1
  | exp_set_box e1 e2 => AtomSetImpl.union (ftv_e e1) (ftv_e e2)
  | exp_ref _ => AtomSetImpl.empty
  | exp_seal e1 => ftv_e e1
  | exp_record r => ftv_r r
  | exp_record_read e1 _ => ftv_e e1
  | exp_record_write e1 _ e2 => AtomSetImpl.union (ftv_e e1) (ftv_e e2)
  end
with ftv_r (r : rec_comp) : atoms :=
  match r with
  | rec_empty => AtomSetImpl.empty
  | rec_exp _ e r1 => AtomSetImpl.union (ftv_e e) (ftv_r r1)
  | rec_ref _ _ r1 => ftv_r r1
  end.

Fixpoint subst_tvar_t (X : atom) (U : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_bvar n => typ_bvar n
  | typ_fvar Y => if aeq X Y then U else typ_fvar Y
  | typ_arrow A B => typ_arrow (subst_tvar_t X U A) (subst_tvar_t X U B)
  | typ_all A B => typ_all (subst_tvar_t X U A) (subst_tvar_t X U B)
  | typ_box T => typ_box (subst_tvar_t X U T)
  | typ_mut m T => typ_mut m (subst_tvar_t X U T)
  | typ_int A B => typ_int (subst_tvar_t X U A) (subst_tvar_t X U B)
  | typ_record a T => typ_record a (subst_tvar_t X U T)
  end.

Fixpoint subst_tvar_e (X : atom) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar y => exp_fvar y
  | exp_abs T e1 => exp_abs (subst_tvar_t X U T) (subst_tvar_e X U e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (subst_tvar_e X U e1) (subst_tvar_e X U e2)
  | exp_tabs T e1 => exp_tabs (subst_tvar_t X U T) (subst_tvar_e X U e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 T => exp_tapp (subst_tvar_e X U e1) (subst_tvar_t X U T)
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (subst_tvar_e X U e1) (subst_tvar_e X U e2)
  | exp_box e1 => exp_box (subst_tvar_e X U e1)
  | exp_unbox e1 => exp_unbox (subst_tvar_e X U e1)
  | exp_set_box e1 e2 => exp_set_box (subst_tvar_e X U e1) (subst_tvar_e X U e2)
  | exp_ref l => exp_ref l
  | exp_seal e1 => exp_seal (subst_tvar_e X U e1)
  | exp_record r => exp_record (subst_tvar_r X U r)
  | exp_record_read e1 a => exp_record_read (subst_tvar_e X U e1) a
  | exp_record_write e1 a e2 => exp_record_write (subst_tvar_e X U e1) a (subst_tvar_e X U e2)
  end
with subst_tvar_r (X : atom) (U : typ) (r : rec_comp) {struct r} : rec_comp :=
  match r with
  | rec_empty => rec_empty
  | rec_exp a e r1 => rec_exp a (subst_tvar_e X U e) (subst_tvar_r X U r1)
  | rec_ref a l r1 => rec_ref a l (subst_tvar_r X U r1)
  end.

(* substituting the opened type variable *)
Fixpoint open_tt_tsubst_eq (T : typ) :
    forall K X U, X `notin` ftv_t T ->
      open_tt_rec K U T = subst_tvar_t X U (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) T).
Proof.
  destruct T as [|n|Y|A B|A B|A|m A|A B|a A]; intros K X U Hfv; simpl in *.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (K == n); simpl.
    + destruct (aeq X X); [reflexivity | exfalso; auto].
    + reflexivity.
  - pose proof (notin_singleton_1 Y X Hfv) as Hne.
    destruct (aeq X Y); [exfalso; apply Hne; symmetry; assumption | reflexivity].
  - pose proof Hfv as H1. apply notin_union_1 in H1.
    pose proof Hfv as H2. apply notin_union_2 in H2.
    rewrite (open_tt_tsubst_eq A K X U H1). rewrite (open_tt_tsubst_eq B K X U H2). reflexivity.
  - pose proof Hfv as H1. apply notin_union_1 in H1.
    pose proof Hfv as H2. apply notin_union_2 in H2.
    rewrite (open_tt_tsubst_eq A K X U H1). rewrite (open_tt_tsubst_eq B (S K) X U H2). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (open_tt_tsubst_eq A K X U Hfv). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (open_tt_tsubst_eq A K X U Hfv). reflexivity.
  - pose proof Hfv as H1. apply notin_union_1 in H1.
    pose proof Hfv as H2. apply notin_union_2 in H2.
    rewrite (open_tt_tsubst_eq A K X U H1). rewrite (open_tt_tsubst_eq B K X U H2). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (open_tt_tsubst_eq A K X U Hfv). reflexivity.
Qed.

Fixpoint open_te_tsubst_eq (e : exp) :
    forall K X U, X `notin` ftv_e e ->
      open_te_rec K U e = subst_tvar_e X U (open_te_rec K (typ_fvar X) e)
with open_te_tsubst_eq_r (r : rec_comp) :
    forall K X U, X `notin` ftv_r r ->
      open_te_record_rec K U r = subst_tvar_r X U (open_te_record_rec K (typ_fvar X) r).
Proof.
  - intros K X U Hfv.
    destruct e as [n | y | T e1 | e1 e2 | T e1 | e1 T | e1 e2 | e1 | e1 | e1 e2 | l | e1 | r | e1 a | e1 a e2]; simpl in *.
    + reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
    + pose proof Hfv as H1. apply notin_union_1 in H1.
      pose proof Hfv as H2. apply notin_union_2 in H2.
      rewrite (open_tt_tsubst_eq T K X U H1).
      rewrite (open_te_tsubst_eq e1 K X U H2). reflexivity.
    + pose proof Hfv as H1. apply notin_union_1 in H1.
      pose proof Hfv as H2. apply notin_union_2 in H2.
      rewrite (open_te_tsubst_eq e1 K X U H1).
      rewrite (open_te_tsubst_eq e2 K X U H2). reflexivity.
    + pose proof Hfv as H1. apply notin_union_1 in H1.
      pose proof Hfv as H2. apply notin_union_2 in H2.
      rewrite (open_tt_tsubst_eq T K X U H1).
      rewrite (open_te_tsubst_eq e1 (S K) X U H2). reflexivity.
    + pose proof Hfv as H1. apply notin_union_1 in H1.
      pose proof Hfv as H2. apply notin_union_2 in H2.
      rewrite (open_te_tsubst_eq e1 K X U H1).
      rewrite (open_tt_tsubst_eq T K X U H2). reflexivity.
    + pose proof Hfv as H1. apply notin_union_1 in H1.
      pose proof Hfv as H2. apply notin_union_2 in H2.
      rewrite (open_te_tsubst_eq e1 K X U H1).
      rewrite (open_te_tsubst_eq e2 K X U H2). reflexivity.
    + rewrite (open_te_tsubst_eq e1 K X U Hfv). reflexivity.
    + rewrite (open_te_tsubst_eq e1 K X U Hfv). reflexivity.
    + pose proof Hfv as H1. apply notin_union_1 in H1.
      pose proof Hfv as H2. apply notin_union_2 in H2.
      rewrite (open_te_tsubst_eq e1 K X U H1).
      rewrite (open_te_tsubst_eq e2 K X U H2). reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
    + rewrite (open_te_tsubst_eq e1 K X U Hfv). reflexivity.
    + rewrite (open_te_tsubst_eq_r r K X U Hfv). reflexivity.
    + rewrite (open_te_tsubst_eq e1 K X U Hfv). reflexivity.
    + pose proof Hfv as H1. apply notin_union_1 in H1.
      pose proof Hfv as H2. apply notin_union_2 in H2.
      rewrite (open_te_tsubst_eq e1 K X U H1).
      rewrite (open_te_tsubst_eq e2 K X U H2). reflexivity.
  - intros K X U Hfv.
    destruct r as [ | a e1 r1 | a l r1]; simpl in *.
    + reflexivity.
    + pose proof Hfv as H1. apply notin_union_1 in H1.
      pose proof Hfv as H2. apply notin_union_2 in H2.
      rewrite (open_te_tsubst_eq e1 K X U H1).
      rewrite (open_te_tsubst_eq_r r1 K X U H2). reflexivity.
    + rewrite (open_te_tsubst_eq_r r1 K X U Hfv). reflexivity.
Qed.

Fixpoint subst_tvar_t_id (T : typ) : forall X U, X `notin` ftv_t T -> subst_tvar_t X U T = T.
Proof.
  destruct T as [|n|Y|A B|A B|A|m A|A B|a A]; intros X U Hfv; simpl in *; try reflexivity.
  - pose proof (notin_singleton_1 Y X Hfv) as Hne.
    destruct (aeq X Y); [exfalso; apply Hne; symmetry; assumption | reflexivity].
  - pose proof Hfv as H1. apply notin_union_1 in H1.
    pose proof Hfv as H2. apply notin_union_2 in H2.
    rewrite (subst_tvar_t_id A X U H1). rewrite (subst_tvar_t_id B X U H2). reflexivity.
  - pose proof Hfv as H1. apply notin_union_1 in H1.
    pose proof Hfv as H2. apply notin_union_2 in H2.
    rewrite (subst_tvar_t_id A X U H1). rewrite (subst_tvar_t_id B X U H2). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (subst_tvar_t_id A X U Hfv). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (subst_tvar_t_id A X U Hfv). reflexivity.
  - pose proof Hfv as H1. apply notin_union_1 in H1.
    pose proof Hfv as H2. apply notin_union_2 in H2.
    rewrite (subst_tvar_t_id A X U H1). rewrite (subst_tvar_t_id B X U H2). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (subst_tvar_t_id A X U Hfv). reflexivity.
Qed.

Fixpoint subst_tvar_t_open_tt_comm (T : typ) :
    forall X U K V, tlc_at 0 U -> X `notin` ftv_t V ->
      subst_tvar_t X U (open_tt_rec K V T) = open_tt_rec K V (subst_tvar_t X U T).
Proof.
  destruct T as [|n|Y|A B|A B|A|m A|A B|a A]; intros X U K V HU Hfv; simpl in *.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (K == n); simpl.
    + rewrite subst_tvar_t_id; [reflexivity | exact Hfv].
    + reflexivity.
  - destruct (aeq X Y); simpl.
    + rewrite tlc_at_open_id with (k:=0) (K:=K) (V:=V); [reflexivity | exact HU | lia].
    + reflexivity.
  - rewrite (subst_tvar_t_open_tt_comm A X U K V HU Hfv).
    rewrite (subst_tvar_t_open_tt_comm B X U K V HU Hfv). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (subst_tvar_t_open_tt_comm A X U K V HU Hfv).
    rewrite (subst_tvar_t_open_tt_comm B X U (S K) V HU Hfv). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (subst_tvar_t_open_tt_comm A X U K V HU Hfv). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (subst_tvar_t_open_tt_comm A X U K V HU Hfv). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (subst_tvar_t_open_tt_comm A X U K V HU Hfv).
    rewrite (subst_tvar_t_open_tt_comm B X U K V HU Hfv). reflexivity.
  - rewrite (subst_tvar_t_open_tt_comm A X U K V HU Hfv). reflexivity.
Qed.

Fixpoint subst_tvar_e_open_te_comm (e : exp) :
    forall X U K V, tlc_at 0 U -> X `notin` ftv_t V ->
      subst_tvar_e X U (open_te_rec K V e) = open_te_rec K V (subst_tvar_e X U e)
with subst_tvar_r_open_te_comm (r : rec_comp) :
    forall X U K V, tlc_at 0 U -> X `notin` ftv_t V ->
      subst_tvar_r X U (open_te_record_rec K V r) = open_te_record_rec K V (subst_tvar_r X U r).
Proof.
  - intros X U K V HU Hfv.
    destruct e as [n | y | T e1 | e1 e2 | T e1 | e1 T | e1 e2 | e1 | e1 | e1 e2 | l | e1 | r | e1 a | e1 a e2]; simpl.
    + reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
    + rewrite (subst_tvar_t_open_tt_comm T X U K V HU Hfv).
      rewrite (subst_tvar_e_open_te_comm e1 X U K V HU Hfv). reflexivity.
    + rewrite (subst_tvar_e_open_te_comm e1 X U K V HU Hfv).
      rewrite (subst_tvar_e_open_te_comm e2 X U K V HU Hfv). reflexivity.
    + rewrite (subst_tvar_t_open_tt_comm T X U K V HU Hfv).
      rewrite (subst_tvar_e_open_te_comm e1 X U (S K) V HU Hfv). reflexivity.
    + rewrite (subst_tvar_e_open_te_comm e1 X U K V HU Hfv).
      rewrite (subst_tvar_t_open_tt_comm T X U K V HU Hfv). reflexivity.
    + rewrite (subst_tvar_e_open_te_comm e1 X U K V HU Hfv).
      rewrite (subst_tvar_e_open_te_comm e2 X U K V HU Hfv). reflexivity.
    + rewrite (subst_tvar_e_open_te_comm e1 X U K V HU Hfv). reflexivity.
    + rewrite (subst_tvar_e_open_te_comm e1 X U K V HU Hfv). reflexivity.
    + rewrite (subst_tvar_e_open_te_comm e1 X U K V HU Hfv).
      rewrite (subst_tvar_e_open_te_comm e2 X U K V HU Hfv). reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
    + rewrite (subst_tvar_e_open_te_comm e1 X U K V HU Hfv). reflexivity.
    + rewrite (subst_tvar_r_open_te_comm r X U K V HU Hfv). reflexivity.
    + rewrite (subst_tvar_e_open_te_comm e1 X U K V HU Hfv). reflexivity.
    + rewrite (subst_tvar_e_open_te_comm e1 X U K V HU Hfv).
      rewrite (subst_tvar_e_open_te_comm e2 X U K V HU Hfv). reflexivity.
  - intros X U K V HU Hfv.
    destruct r as [ | a e1 r1 | a l r1]; simpl.
    + reflexivity.
    + rewrite (subst_tvar_e_open_te_comm e1 X U K V HU Hfv).
      rewrite (subst_tvar_r_open_te_comm r1 X U K V HU Hfv). reflexivity.
    + rewrite (subst_tvar_r_open_te_comm r1 X U K V HU Hfv). reflexivity.
Qed.

Fixpoint subst_tvar_e_open_ee_comm (e : exp) :
    forall X U k (x : atom),
      subst_tvar_e X U (open_ee_rec k (exp_fvar x) e)
      = open_ee_rec k (exp_fvar x) (subst_tvar_e X U e)
with subst_tvar_r_open_ee_comm (r : rec_comp) :
    forall X U k (x : atom),
      subst_tvar_r X U (open_ee_record_rec k (exp_fvar x) r)
      = open_ee_record_rec k (exp_fvar x) (subst_tvar_r X U r).
Proof.
  - intros X U k x.
    destruct e as [n | y | T e1 | e1 e2 | T e1 | e1 T | e1 e2 | e1 | e1 | e1 e2 | l | e1 | r | e1 a | e1 a e2]; simpl.
    + destruct (k == n); simpl; reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
    + rewrite subst_tvar_e_open_ee_comm; reflexivity.
    + rewrite subst_tvar_e_open_ee_comm, subst_tvar_e_open_ee_comm; reflexivity.
    + rewrite subst_tvar_e_open_ee_comm; reflexivity.
    + rewrite subst_tvar_e_open_ee_comm; reflexivity.
    + rewrite subst_tvar_e_open_ee_comm, subst_tvar_e_open_ee_comm; reflexivity.
    + rewrite subst_tvar_e_open_ee_comm; reflexivity.
    + rewrite subst_tvar_e_open_ee_comm; reflexivity.
    + rewrite subst_tvar_e_open_ee_comm, subst_tvar_e_open_ee_comm; reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
    + rewrite subst_tvar_e_open_ee_comm; reflexivity.
    + rewrite subst_tvar_r_open_ee_comm; reflexivity.
    + rewrite subst_tvar_e_open_ee_comm; reflexivity.
    + rewrite subst_tvar_e_open_ee_comm, subst_tvar_e_open_ee_comm; reflexivity.
  - intros X U k x.
    destruct r as [ | a e1 r1 | a l r1]; simpl.
    + reflexivity.
    + rewrite subst_tvar_e_open_ee_comm, subst_tvar_r_open_ee_comm; reflexivity.
    + rewrite subst_tvar_r_open_ee_comm; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma type_subst_tvar : forall X U T, type U -> type T -> type (subst_tvar_t X U T).
Proof.
  intros X U T HU H. induction H; simpl.
  - apply type_top.
  - destruct (aeq X X0); [exact HU | apply type_var].
  - apply type_arrow; assumption.
  - apply type_all with (L := AtomSetImpl.union L (AtomSetImpl.singleton X)).
    + exact IHtype.
    + intros Y HY.
      pose proof HY as HL. apply notin_union_1 in HL.
      pose proof HY as Hs. apply notin_union_2 in Hs.
      pose proof (notin_singleton_1 X Y Hs) as Hne.
      assert (Hnv : X `notin` ftv_t (typ_fvar Y)).
      { simpl. apply notin_singleton_2. symmetry. exact Hne. }
      unfold open_tt.
      rewrite <- (subst_tvar_t_open_tt_comm T2 X U 0 (typ_fvar Y) (type_tlc U HU) Hnv).
      apply H1; exact HL.
  - apply type_box; assumption.
  - apply type_readonly; assumption.
  - apply type_intersect; assumption.
  - apply type_record; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma expr_subst_tvar_strong : forall n,
  (forall e, exp_size e < n -> expr e -> forall X U, type U -> expr (subst_tvar_e X U e)) /\
  (forall r, rec_size r < n -> record_comp r -> forall X U, type U -> record_comp (subst_tvar_r X U r)).
Proof.
  induction n as [| n IH].
  - split; intros; lia.
  - destruct IH as [IHe IHr]. split.
    + intros e Hsize Hexpr X U HU.
      destruct e as [m | z | T e1 | e1 e2 | T e1 | e1 T | e1 e2 | e1 | e1 | e1 e2 | l | e1 | r | e1 a | e1 a e2]; simpl in *.
      * inversion Hexpr.
      * apply expr_var.
      * destruct (expr_abs_inv T e1 Hexpr) as [Hty [L Hbody]].
        apply expr_abs with (L := L).
        -- apply type_subst_tvar; [exact HU | exact Hty].
        -- intros y Hy.
           unfold open_ee.
           rewrite <- (subst_tvar_e_open_ee_comm e1 X U 0 y).
           assert (Hsz : exp_size (open_ee_rec 0 (exp_fvar y) e1) < n).
           { assert (He : exp_size (open_ee_rec 0 (exp_fvar y) e1) <= exp_size e1).
             { apply exp_size_open_ee_rec. simpl. lia. }
             assert (typ_size T + exp_size e1 < n) by lia. lia. }
           apply IHe; [exact Hsz | apply Hbody; exact Hy | exact HU].
      * destruct (expr_app_inv e1 e2 Hexpr) as [H1 H2].
        apply expr_app.
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact H1 | exact HU].
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact H2 | exact HU].
      * destruct (expr_tabs_inv T e1 Hexpr) as [Hty [L Hbody]].
        apply expr_tabs with (L := AtomSetImpl.union L (AtomSetImpl.singleton X)).
        -- apply type_subst_tvar; [exact HU | exact Hty].
        -- intros Y HY.
           pose proof HY as HL. apply notin_union_1 in HL.
           pose proof HY as Hs. apply notin_union_2 in Hs.
           pose proof (notin_singleton_1 X Y Hs) as Hne.
           unfold open_te.
           rewrite <- (subst_tvar_e_open_te_comm e1 X U 0 (typ_fvar Y) (type_tlc U HU)).
           ++ assert (Hsz : exp_size (open_te_rec 0 (typ_fvar Y) e1) < n).
              { assert (He : exp_size (open_te_rec 0 (typ_fvar Y) e1) <= exp_size e1).
                { apply exp_size_open_te_rec. simpl. lia. }
                assert (typ_size T + exp_size e1 < n) by lia. lia. }
              apply IHe; [exact Hsz | apply Hbody; exact HL | exact HU].
           ++ apply notin_singleton_2; symmetry; exact Hne.
      * destruct (expr_tapp_inv e1 T Hexpr) as [H1 H2].
        apply expr_tapp.
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact H1 | exact HU].
        -- apply type_subst_tvar; [exact HU | exact H2].
      * destruct (expr_let_inv e1 e2 Hexpr) as [H1 [L Hbody]].
        apply expr_let with (L := L).
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact H1 | exact HU].
        -- intros y Hy.
           unfold open_ee.
           rewrite <- (subst_tvar_e_open_ee_comm e2 X U 0 y).
           assert (Hsz : exp_size (open_ee_rec 0 (exp_fvar y) e2) < n).
           { assert (He : exp_size (open_ee_rec 0 (exp_fvar y) e2) <= exp_size e2).
             { apply exp_size_open_ee_rec. simpl. lia. }
             lia. }
           apply IHe; [exact Hsz | apply Hbody; exact Hy | exact HU].
      * apply expr_box. apply IHe; [lia | apply (expr_box_inv e1); exact Hexpr | exact HU].
      * apply expr_unbox. apply IHe; [lia | apply (expr_unbox_inv e1); exact Hexpr | exact HU].
      * destruct (expr_set_box_inv e1 e2 Hexpr) as [H1 H2].
        apply expr_set_box.
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact H1 | exact HU].
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact H2 | exact HU].
      * apply expr_ref.
      * apply expr_seal. apply IHe; [lia | apply (expr_seal_inv e1); exact Hexpr | exact HU].
      * apply expr_record. apply IHr; [lia | apply (expr_record_inv r); exact Hexpr | exact HU].
      * apply expr_record_read. apply IHe; [lia | apply (expr_record_read_inv e1 a); exact Hexpr | exact HU].
      * destruct (expr_record_write_inv e1 a e2 Hexpr) as [H1 H2].
        apply expr_record_write.
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact H1 | exact HU].
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact H2 | exact HU].
    + intros r Hsize Hrc X U HU.
      destruct r as [ | a e1 r1 | a l r1]; simpl in *.
      * apply record_comp_empty.
      * destruct (record_comp_exp_inv a e1 r1 Hrc) as [He Hr].
        apply record_comp_exp.
        -- apply IHe; [lia | exact He | exact HU].
        -- apply IHr; [lia | exact Hr | exact HU].
      * apply record_comp_ref. apply IHr; [lia | apply (record_comp_ref_inv a l r1); exact Hrc | exact HU].
Qed.

Lemma expr_subst_tvar : forall e X U, expr e -> type U -> expr (subst_tvar_e X U e).
Proof.
  intros. apply (proj1 (expr_subst_tvar_strong (S (exp_size e)))); [lia | exact H | exact H0].
Qed.

Lemma body_te_open_expr : forall e, body_te e -> forall U, type U -> expr (open_te e U).
Proof.
  intros e [L H] U HU.
  destruct (atom_fresh (AtomSetImpl.union L (ftv_e e))) as [X HX].
  pose proof HX as HL. apply notin_union_1 in HL.
  pose proof HX as Hf. apply notin_union_2 in Hf.
  unfold open_te.
  rewrite (open_te_tsubst_eq e 0 X U Hf).
  apply expr_subst_tvar.
  - apply H; exact HL.
  - exact HU.
Qed.

(* ================= expressionhood is preserved by reduction ================= *)
Fixpoint red_expr (e:exp) (s:store) (e':exp) (s':store) (H : red e s e' s') {struct H} : expr e -> expr e'
with red_record_comp_expr (r:rec_comp) (s:store) (r':rec_comp) (s':store) (H : red_record_comp r s r' s') {struct H} :
    record_comp r -> record_comp r'.
Proof.
  - intros Hexpr.
    destruct H as
      [ e1 e1' s1 s1' e2 Hed Hstep
      | e1 e2 s2 e2' s2' Hv Hstep
      | e1 e1' s1 s1' V Hty Hstep
      | T e1 s1 v2 Hwf Hab Hv
      | T1 e1 s1 T2 Hwf Hab Hty
      | e1 e1' s1 s1' e2 Hstep Hbody
      | v1 e2 s2 Hwf Hv Hbody
      | e1 e1' s1 s1' Hstep
      | v1 l s1 Hwf Hv Hfresh
      | e1 e1' s1 s1' Hstep
      | l v1 s1 Hwf Hv Hmap
      | l v1 s1 Hwf Hv Hmap
      | e1 s1 e1' s1' e2 Hed Hstep
      | v1 e2 s2 e2' s2' Hv Hstep
      | l v1 v2 s1 Hwf Hv1 Hv2 Hmap
      | e1 s1 e1' s1' Hstep
      | T e1 s1 Hwf Hab
      | T e1 s1 Hwf Hab
      | l s1 Hwf
      | r s1 Hwf Hvrc
      | r1 s1 r1' s1' Hstep
      | a e1 e1' s1 s1' Hstep
      | r a l v1 s1 Hwf Hvrc Hlook Hv Hmap
      | r a l v1 s1 Hwf Hvrc Hlook Hv Hmap
      | a e1 s1 e1' s1' e2 Hed Hstep
      | a v1 e2 s2 e2' s2' Hv Hstep
      | a l r v1 v2 s1 Hwf Hvrc Hlook Hv1 Hv2 Hmap ].
    + destruct (expr_app_inv e1 e2 Hexpr) as [He1 He2].
      apply expr_app; [apply (red_expr _ _ _ _ Hstep); exact He1 | exact He2].
    + destruct (expr_app_inv e1 e2 Hexpr) as [He1 He2].
      apply expr_app; [apply value_expr; exact Hv | apply (red_expr _ _ _ _ Hstep); exact He2].
    + destruct (expr_tapp_inv e1 V Hexpr) as [He1 HtyV].
      apply expr_tapp; [apply (red_expr _ _ _ _ Hstep); exact He1 | exact HtyV].
    + destruct (expr_app_inv (exp_abs T e1) v2 Hexpr) as [Hab2 Hv2].
      destruct (expr_abs_inv T e1 Hab2) as [HtyT Hbody].
      apply body_e_open_expr with (u:=v2); [exact Hbody | apply value_expr; exact Hv].
    + destruct (expr_tapp_inv (exp_tabs T1 e1) T2 Hexpr) as [Habs Hty2].
      destruct (expr_tabs_inv T1 e1 Habs) as [Hty1 Hbody].
      apply body_te_open_expr with (U:=T2); [exact Hbody | exact Hty2].
    + destruct (expr_let_inv e1 e2 Hexpr) as [He1 Hbody2].
      destruct Hbody2 as [L Hbody2].
      apply expr_let with (L:=L).
      * apply (red_expr _ _ _ _ Hstep); exact He1.
      * exact Hbody2.
    + destruct (expr_let_inv v1 e2 Hexpr) as [Hv1 Hbody2].
      apply body_e_open_expr with (u:=v1); [exact Hbody2 | exact Hv1].
    + pose proof (expr_box_inv e1 Hexpr) as He1.
      apply expr_box. apply (red_expr _ _ _ _ Hstep); exact He1.
    + apply expr_ref.
    + pose proof (expr_unbox_inv e1 Hexpr) as He1.
      apply expr_unbox. apply (red_expr _ _ _ _ Hstep); exact He1.
    + apply value_expr; exact Hv.
    + apply expr_seal. apply value_expr; exact Hv.
    + destruct (expr_set_box_inv e1 e2 Hexpr) as [He1 He2].
      apply expr_set_box.
      * apply (red_expr _ _ _ _ Hstep); exact He1.
      * exact He2.
    + destruct (expr_set_box_inv v1 e2 Hexpr) as [He1 He2].
      apply expr_set_box.
      * apply value_expr; exact Hv.
      * apply (red_expr _ _ _ _ Hstep); exact He2.
    + apply value_expr; exact Hv1.
    + pose proof (expr_seal_inv e1 Hexpr) as He1.
      apply expr_seal. apply (red_expr _ _ _ _ Hstep); exact He1.
    + exact Hab.
    + exact Hab.
    + apply expr_seal. apply expr_ref.
    + apply expr_seal. apply expr_record. apply value_record_comp_record_comp. exact Hvrc.
    + apply expr_record. apply (red_record_comp_expr _ _ _ _ Hstep). apply expr_record_inv; exact Hexpr.
    + pose proof (expr_record_read_inv e1 a Hexpr) as He1.
      apply expr_record_read. apply (red_expr _ _ _ _ Hstep); exact He1.
    + apply value_expr; exact Hv.
    + apply expr_seal. apply value_expr; exact Hv.
    + destruct (expr_record_write_inv e1 a e2 Hexpr) as [He1 He2].
      apply expr_record_write.
      * apply (red_expr _ _ _ _ Hstep); exact He1.
      * exact He2.
    + destruct (expr_record_write_inv v1 a e2 Hexpr) as [He1 He2].
      apply expr_record_write.
      * apply value_expr; exact Hv.
      * apply (red_expr _ _ _ _ Hstep); exact He2.
    + apply value_expr; exact Hv1.
  - intros Hrc.
    destruct H as
      [ a e1 s1 e1' s1' r1 Hrc1 Hstep
      | a v r1 s1 l Hwf Hrc1 Hv Hfresh
      | a l r1 s1 r1' s1' Hstep ].
    + destruct (record_comp_exp_inv a e1 r1 Hrc) as [He1 Hr1].
      apply record_comp_exp.
      * apply (red_expr _ _ _ _ Hstep); exact He1.
      * exact Hr1.
    + destruct (record_comp_exp_inv a v r1 Hrc) as [Hv1 Hr1].
      apply record_comp_ref. exact Hr1.
    + pose proof (record_comp_ref_inv a l r1 Hrc) as Hr1.
      apply record_comp_ref. apply (red_record_comp_expr _ _ _ _ Hstep); exact Hr1.
Qed.

Lemma wf_store_add : forall s l v,
  well_formed_store s -> value v -> well_formed_store (LabelMapImpl.add l v s).
Proof.
  intros s l v Hwf Hv l0 v0 Hmap.
  destruct (Label.eq_dec l0 l) as [Heq | Hneq].
  - subst l0.
    pose proof (@LabelMapImpl.add_1 exp s l l v eq_refl) as Hadd.
    pose proof (@LabelMapFacts.MapsTo_fun exp (LabelMapImpl.add l v s) l v0 v Hmap Hadd) as Heq.
    rewrite Heq. exact Hv.
  - apply (Hwf l0 v0). apply (@LabelMapImpl.add_3 exp s l l0 v0 v); [symmetry; exact Hneq | exact Hmap].
Qed.

with red_record_comp_wf_store (r:rec_comp) (s:store) (r':rec_comp) (s':store) (H : red_record_comp r s r' s') {struct H} :
    well_formed_store s -> well_formed_store s'.
Proof.
  - intros Hwf.
    destruct H as
      [ e1 e1' s1 s1' e2 Hed Hstep
      | e1 e2 s2 e2' s2' Hv Hstep
      | e1 e1' s1 s1' V Hty Hstep
      | T e1 s1 v2 Hwf0 Hab Hv
      | T1 e1 s1 T2 Hwf0 Hab Hty
      | e1 e1' s1 s1' e2 Hstep Hbody
      | v1 e2 s2 Hwf0 Hv Hbody
      | e1 e1' s1 s1' Hstep
      | v1 l s1 Hwf0 Hv Hfresh
      | e1 e1' s1 s1' Hstep
      | l v1 s1 Hwf0 Hv Hmap
      | l v1 s1 Hwf0 Hv Hmap
      | e1 s1 e1' s1' e2 Hed Hstep
      | v1 e2 s2 e2' s2' Hv Hstep
      | l v1 v2 s1 Hwf0 Hv1 Hv2 Hmap
      | e1 s1 e1' s1' Hstep
      | T e1 s1 Hwf0 Hab
      | T e1 s1 Hwf0 Hab
      | l s1 Hwf0
      | r s1 Hwf0 Hvrc
      | r1 s1 r1' s1' Hstep
      | a e1 e1' s1 s1' Hstep
      | r a l v1 s1 Hwf0 Hvrc Hlook Hv Hmap
      | r a l v1 s1 Hwf0 Hvrc Hlook Hv Hmap
      | a e1 s1 e1' s1' e2 Hed Hstep
      | a v1 e2 s2 e2' s2' Hv Hstep
      | a l r v1 v2 s1 Hwf0 Hvrc Hlook Hv1 Hv2 Hmap ].
    + apply (red_wf_store _ _ _ _ Hstep); exact Hwf.
    + apply (red_wf_store _ _ _ _ Hstep); exact Hwf.
    + apply (red_wf_store _ _ _ _ Hstep); exact Hwf.
    + exact Hwf.
    + exact Hwf.
    + apply (red_wf_store _ _ _ _ Hstep); exact Hwf.
    + exact Hwf.
    + apply (red_wf_store _ _ _ _ Hstep); exact Hwf.
    + apply wf_store_add; assumption.
    + apply (red_wf_store _ _ _ _ Hstep); exact Hwf.
    + exact Hwf.
    + exact Hwf.
    + apply (red_wf_store _ _ _ _ Hstep); exact Hwf.
    + apply (red_wf_store _ _ _ _ Hstep); exact Hwf.
    + apply wf_store_add; assumption.
    + apply (red_wf_store _ _ _ _ Hstep); exact Hwf.
    + exact Hwf.
    + exact Hwf.
    + exact Hwf.
    + exact Hwf.
    + apply (red_record_comp_wf_store _ _ _ _ Hstep); exact Hwf.
    + apply (red_wf_store _ _ _ _ Hstep); exact Hwf.
    + exact Hwf.
    + exact Hwf.
    + apply (red_wf_store _ _ _ _ Hstep); exact Hwf.
    + apply (red_wf_store _ _ _ _ Hstep); exact Hwf.
    + apply wf_store_add; assumption.
  - intros Hwf.
    destruct H as
      [ a e1 s1 e1' s1' r1 Hrc1 Hstep
      | a v r1 s1 l Hwf0 Hrc1 Hv Hfresh
      | a l r1 s1 r1' s1' Hstep ].
    + apply (red_wf_store _ _ _ _ Hstep); exact Hwf.
    + apply wf_store_add; assumption.
    + apply (red_record_comp_wf_store _ _ _ _ Hstep); exact Hwf.
Qed.

Lemma redm_expr : forall e s e' s', redm e s e' s' -> expr e -> expr e'.
Proof.
  intros e s e' s' H. induction H; intros Hexpr.
  - subst. exact Hexpr.
  - apply IHredm. apply (red_expr _ _ _ _ H); exact Hexpr.
Qed.

Lemma redm_wf_store : forall e s e' s', redm e s e' s' -> well_formed_store s -> well_formed_store s'.
Proof.
  intros e s e' s' H. induction H; intros Hwf.
  - subst. exact Hwf.
  - apply IHredm. apply (red_wf_store _ _ _ _ H); exact Hwf.
Qed.

(* ================= basic seal compilation lemmas ================= *)
Fixpoint sealcomp_refl (e : exp) : sealcomp e e
with sealcomp_rec_refl (r : rec_comp) : sealcomp_rec_comp r r.
Proof.
  - destruct e; try constructor; auto;
      try apply sealcomp_refl; try apply sealcomp_rec_refl.
  - destruct r; try constructor; auto;
      try apply sealcomp_refl; try apply sealcomp_rec_refl.
Qed.

Lemma sealcomp_abs_inv : forall e T e2, sealcomp e (exp_abs T e2) ->
  exists e1, e = exp_abs T e1 /\ sealcomp e1 e2.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

  exists e1 e2, e = exp_app e1 e2 /\ sealcomp e1 e1' /\ sealcomp e2 e2'.

Lemma sealcomp_ref_inv : forall e l, sealcomp e (exp_ref l) -> e = exp_ref l.

Lemma sealcomp_record_inv : forall e r2, sealcomp e (exp_record r2) ->

Lemma record_lookup_ref_sealcomp : forall a r1 r2,
  sealcomp_rec_comp r1 r2 -> record_lookup_ref a r1 = record_lookup_ref a r2.
Proof.
  intros a r1 r2 H. induction H.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (a === a0); [reflexivity | exact IHsealcomp_rec_comp].
Qed.

Fixpoint value_record_comp_sealcomp_down (r1 r2 : rec_comp) (H : sealcomp_rec_comp r1 r2) {struct H} :
    value_record_comp r2 -> value_record_comp r1.
Proof.
  intros Hv. destruct H as [ | a e1 e2 r1' r2' Hrec Hsc | a l r1' r2' Hrec].
  - exact value_rec_empty.
  - inversion Hv.
  - inversion Hv; subst. apply value_rec_ref.
    apply (value_record_comp_sealcomp_down _ _ Hrec); assumption.
Qed.

Fixpoint value_sealcomp_down (e f : exp) (H : sealcomp e f) {struct H} :
    value f -> expr e -> value e.
Proof.
  intros Hv Hexpr.
  destruct H as
    [ x
    | n
    | T e1 e2 Hsc
    | e1 e2 f1 f2 Hsc1 Hsc2
    | T e1 e2 Hsc
    | T e1 e2 Hsc
    | e1 e2 f1 f2 Hsc1 Hsc2
    | e1 e2 Hsc
    | e1 e2 Hsc
    | e1 e2 f1 f2 Hsc1 Hsc2
    | l
    | e1 e2 Hsc
    | r1 r2 Hsc
    | e1 e2 y Hsc
    | e1 f1 y e2 f2 Hsc1 Hsc2
    | e1 e2 Hsc ].
  - inversion Hv.
  - inversion Hv.
  - apply value_abs; exact Hexpr.
  - inversion Hv.
  - apply value_tabs; exact Hexpr.
  - inversion Hv.
  - inversion Hv.
  - inversion Hv.
  - inversion Hv.
  - inversion Hv.
  - apply value_ref.
  - inversion Hv; subst.
    + apply sealcomp_ref_inv in Hsc. subst. apply value_sealed_ref.
    + destruct (sealcomp_record_inv _ _ Hsc) as [r1 [Heq Hrc]]. subst.
      apply value_sealed_record. eapply value_record_comp_sealcomp_down; eauto.
  - inversion Hv; subst.
    apply value_record. eapply value_record_comp_sealcomp_down; eauto.
  - inversion Hv.
  - inversion Hv.
  - inversion Hv; subst.
    + apply sealcomp_ref_inv in Hsc. subst. apply value_ref.
    + destruct (sealcomp_record_inv _ _ Hsc) as [r1 [Heq Hrc]]. subst.
      apply value_record. eapply value_record_comp_sealcomp_down; eauto.
Qed.

Fixpoint sealcomp_open_ee (e1 f1 : exp) (H : sealcomp e1 f1) {struct H} :
    forall k u v, sealcomp u v ->
      sealcomp (open_ee_rec k u e1) (open_ee_rec k v f1)
with sealcomp_rec_open_ee (r1 r2 : rec_comp) (H : sealcomp_rec_comp r1 r2) {struct H} :
    forall k u v, sealcomp u v ->
      sealcomp_rec_comp (open_ee_record_rec k u r1) (open_ee_record_rec k v r2).
Proof.
  - intros k u v Huv.
    destruct H as
      [ x
      | n
      | T e1 e2 Hsc
      | e1 e2 f1 f2 Hsc1 Hsc2
      | T e1 e2 Hsc
      | T e1 e2 Hsc
      | e1 e2 f1 f2 Hsc1 Hsc2
      | e1 e2 Hsc
      | e1 e2 Hsc
      | e1 e2 f1 f2 Hsc1 Hsc2
      | l
      | e1 e2 Hsc
      | r1 r2 Hsc
      | e1 e2 y Hsc
      | e1 f1 y e2 f2 Hsc1 Hsc2
      | e1 e2 Hsc ].
    + apply sealcomp_fvar.
    + simpl. destruct (k == n); [exact Huv | apply sealcomp_bvar].
    + apply sealcomp_abs. apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc (S k) u v Huv).
    + apply sealcomp_app.
      * apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc1 k u v Huv).
      * apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc2 k u v Huv).
    + apply sealcomp_tabs. apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc k u v Huv).
    + apply sealcomp_tapp. apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc k u v Huv).
    + apply sealcomp_let.
      * apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc1 k u v Huv).
      * apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc2 (S k) u v Huv).
    + apply sealcomp_box. apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc k u v Huv).
    + apply sealcomp_unbox. apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc k u v Huv).
    + apply sealcomp_set_box.
      * apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc1 k u v Huv).
      * apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc2 k u v Huv).
    + apply sealcomp_ref.
    + apply sealcomp_seal. apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc k u v Huv).
    + apply sealcomp_record. apply (sealcomp_rec_open_ee _ _ Hsc k u v Huv).
    + apply sealcomp_record_read. apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc k u v Huv).
    + apply sealcomp_record_write.
      * apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc1 k u v Huv).
      * apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc2 k u v Huv).
    + apply sealcomp_multiple_seal. apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc k u v Huv).
  - intros k u v Huv.
    destruct H as [ | a e1 e2 r1 r2 Hrec Hsc | a l r1 r2 Hrec ].
    + apply sealcomp_rec_empty.
    + apply sealcomp_rec_exp.
      * apply (sealcomp_rec_open_ee _ _ Hrec k u v Huv).
      * apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc k u v Huv).
    + apply sealcomp_rec_ref. apply (sealcomp_rec_open_ee _ _ Hrec k u v Huv).
Qed.

Fixpoint sealcomp_open_te (e1 f1 : exp) (H : sealcomp e1 f1) {struct H} :

with sealcomp_rec_open_te (r1 r2 : rec_comp) (H : sealcomp_rec_comp r1 r2) {struct H} :

  - intros k U.

      [ x

      | e1 e2 f1 f2 Hsc1 Hsc2
      | T e1 e2 Hsc
      | T e1 e2 Hsc
      | e1 e2 f1 f2 Hsc1 Hsc2
      | e1 e2 Hsc
      | e1 e2 Hsc
      | e1 e2 f1 f2 Hsc1 Hsc2
      | l
      | e1 e2 Hsc
      | r1 r2 Hsc
      | e1 e2 y Hsc
      | e1 f1 y e2 f2 Hsc1 Hsc2
      | e1 e2 Hsc ].
    + apply sealcomp_fvar.
    + apply sealcomp_bvar.
    + apply sealcomp_abs. apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc k U).
    + apply sealcomp_app.
      * apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc1 k U).
      * apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc2 k U).
    + apply sealcomp_tabs. apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc (S k) U).
    + apply sealcomp_tapp. apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc k U).
    + apply sealcomp_let.
      * apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc1 k U).
      * apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc2 k U).
    + apply sealcomp_box. apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc k U).
    + apply sealcomp_unbox. apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc k U).
    + apply sealcomp_set_box.
      * apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc1 k U).
      * apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc2 k U).
    + apply sealcomp_ref.
    + apply sealcomp_seal. apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc k U).

    + apply sealcomp_record_read. apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc k U).
    + apply sealcomp_record_write.
      * apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc1 k U).
      * apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc2 k U).
    + apply sealcomp_multiple_seal. apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc k U).
  - intros k U.
    destruct H as [ | a e1 e2 r1 r2 Hrec Hsc | a l r1 r2 Hrec ].
    + apply sealcomp_rec_empty.
    + apply sealcomp_rec_exp.
      * apply (sealcomp_rec_open_te _ _ Hrec k U).
      * apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc k U).

Fixpoint seal_pow (k : nat) (e : exp) {struct k} : exp :=
  match k with
  | 0 => e
  | S k' => exp_seal (seal_pow k' e)
  end.
Arguments seal_pow k e /.

Lemma seal_pow_add : forall a b e, seal_pow (a + b) e = seal_pow a (seal_pow b e).
Proof.
  induction a; intros b e; simpl; [reflexivity | rewrite IHa; reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma seal_pow_expr_inv : forall k e, expr (seal_pow k e) -> expr e.
Proof.
  induction k; intros e H; simpl in *.
  - exact H.
  - apply IHk. apply expr_seal_inv. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma sealcomp_pow_right : forall e f, sealcomp e f -> forall k, sealcomp e (seal_pow k f).
Proof.
  intros e f H. induction k; simpl.
  - exact H.
  - apply sealcomp_multiple_seal. exact IHk.
Qed.

Lemma sealcomp_seal_pow_left : forall e f, sealcomp e f -> forall k, sealcomp (seal_pow k e) (seal_pow k f).
Proof.
  intros e f H. induction k; simpl.
  - exact H.
  - apply sealcomp_seal. exact IHk.
Qed.

Lemma redm_trans : forall e s e' s' e'' s'', redm e s e' s' -> redm e' s' e'' s'' -> redm e s e'' s''.
Proof.
  intros e s e' s' e'' s'' H1. induction H1; intros H2.
  - subst. exact H2.
  - apply redm_step with (e'':=e''0) (s'':=s''0); [exact H | apply IHredm; exact H2].
Qed.

Lemma redm_seal : forall e s e' s', redm e s e' s' -> redm (exp_seal e) s (exp_seal e') s'.
Proof.
  intros e s e' s' H. induction H.
  - subst. apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
  - apply redm_step with (e'':=exp_seal e'') (s'':=s'').
    + apply red_seal_1. exact H.
    + exact IHredm.
Qed.

Definition min1 (k : nat) : nat := match k with 0 => 0 | S _ => 1 end.

Lemma abs_strip : forall s k T e1,
  well_formed_store s -> expr (exp_abs T e1) ->
  redm (seal_pow k (exp_abs T e1)) s (exp_abs T e1) s.
Proof.
  intros s k T e1 Hwf Hexpr. induction k as [|k IH]; simpl.
  - apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
  - apply redm_trans with (e':=exp_seal (exp_abs T e1)) (s':=s).
    + apply redm_seal. exact IH.
    + apply redm_step with (e'':=exp_abs T e1) (s'':=s).
      * apply red_seal_abs; assumption.
      * apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma tabs_strip : forall s k T e1,
  well_formed_store s -> expr (exp_tabs T e1) ->
  redm (seal_pow k (exp_tabs T e1)) s (exp_tabs T e1) s.
Proof.
  intros s k T e1 Hwf Hexpr. induction k as [|k IH]; simpl.
  - apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
  - apply redm_trans with (e':=exp_seal (exp_tabs T e1)) (s':=s).
    + apply redm_seal. exact IH.
    + apply redm_step with (e'':=exp_tabs T e1) (s'':=s).
      * apply red_seal_tabs; assumption.
      * apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ref_strip : forall s k l,
  well_formed_store s ->
  redm (seal_pow k (exp_ref l)) s (seal_pow (min1 k) (exp_ref l)) s.
Proof.
  intros s k l Hwf. induction k as [|k IH]; simpl.
  - apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
  - destruct k as [|k'].
    + apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
    + apply redm_trans with (e':=exp_seal (exp_seal (exp_ref l))) (s':=s).
      * apply redm_seal. exact IH.
      * apply redm_step with (e'':=exp_seal (exp_ref l)) (s'':=s).
        -- apply red_seal_sealed_ref; exact Hwf.
        -- apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma record_strip : forall s k r,
  well_formed_store s -> value_record_comp r ->
  redm (seal_pow k (exp_record r)) s (seal_pow (min1 k) (exp_record r)) s.
Proof.
  intros s k r Hwf Hv. induction k as [|k IH]; simpl.
  - apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
  - destruct k as [|k'].
    + apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
    + apply redm_trans with (e':=exp_seal (exp_seal (exp_record r))) (s':=s).
      * apply redm_seal. exact IH.
      * apply redm_step with (e'':=exp_seal (exp_record r)) (s'':=s).
        -- apply red_seal_sealed_record; assumption.
        -- apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma value_seal_redm : forall e f s,
  value e -> sealcomp e f -> expr f -> well_formed_store s ->
  exists f', redm f s f' s /\ value f' /\ sealcomp e f'.
Proof.
  intros e f s Hv Hsc Hexpr Hwf.
  destruct Hv as [T e1 Hexpr1 | T e1 Hexpr1 | l | l | r Hvrc | r Hvrc].
  - destruct (abs_shape T e1 f Hsc) as [k [f1 [Heq Hsc1]]]. subst f.
    pose proof (seal_pow_expr_inv k (exp_abs T f1) Hexpr) as Hcore.
    exists (exp_abs T f1). split; [| split].
    + apply abs_strip; assumption.
    + apply value_abs; exact Hcore.
    + apply sealcomp_abs; exact Hsc1.
  - destruct (tabs_shape T e1 f Hsc) as [k [f1 [Heq Hsc1]]]. subst f.
    pose proof (seal_pow_expr_inv k (exp_tabs T f1) Hexpr) as Hcore.
    exists (exp_tabs T f1). split; [| split].
    + apply tabs_strip; assumption.
    + apply value_tabs; exact Hcore.
    + apply sealcomp_tabs; exact Hsc1.
  - destruct (ref_shape l f Hsc) as [k Heq]. subst f.
    exists (seal_pow (min1 k) (exp_ref l)). split; [| split].
    + apply ref_strip; exact Hwf.
    + destruct k as [|k']; simpl. apply value_ref. apply value_sealed_ref.
    + apply sealcomp_pow_right with (k:=min1 k). apply sealcomp_refl.
  - destruct (seal_lhs_shape (exp_ref l) f Hsc) as [k [f0 [Heq Hsc0]]]. subst f.
    destruct (ref_shape l f0 Hsc0) as [k0 Heq0]. subst f0.
    exists (exp_seal (exp_ref l)). split; [| split].
    + rewrite <- (seal_pow_add (S k) k0 (exp_ref l)). apply ref_strip; exact Hwf.
    + apply value_sealed_ref.
    + apply sealcomp_refl.
  - destruct (record_shape r f Hsc) as [k [r1 [Heq Hsc1]]]. subst f.
    pose proof (value_record_comp_sealcomp_up _ _ Hsc1 Hvrc) as Hvrc1.
    exists (seal_pow (min1 k) (exp_record r1)). split; [| split].
    + apply record_strip; assumption.
    + destruct k as [|k']; simpl. apply value_record; exact Hvrc1. apply value_sealed_record; exact Hvrc1.
    + apply sealcomp_pow_right with (k:=min1 k). apply sealcomp_record; exact Hsc1.
  - destruct (seal_lhs_shape (exp_record r) f Hsc) as [k [f0 [Heq Hsc0]]]. subst f.
    destruct (record_shape r f0 Hsc0) as [k0 [r1 [Heq0 Hsc1]]]. subst f0.
    pose proof (value_record_comp_sealcomp_up _ _ Hsc1 Hvrc) as Hvrc1.
    exists (exp_seal (exp_record r1)). split; [| split].
    + rewrite <- (seal_pow_add (S k) k0 (exp_record r1)). apply record_strip; assumption.
    + apply value_sealed_record; exact Hvrc1.
    + apply sealcomp_seal. apply sealcomp_record; exact Hsc1.
Qed.

Lemma in_dom_elements : forall (s:store) l,
  In l (List.map fst (LabelMapImpl.elements s)) <-> exists v, LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s.
Proof.
  intros s l. split.
  - intros H. apply List.in_map_iff in H. destruct H as [p [Hfst Hin]].
    destruct p as [l' v]. simpl in Hfst. subst l'.
    exists v. apply (@LabelMapImpl.elements_2 exp s l v).
    apply InA_alt. exists (l, v). split.
    * simpl. split; reflexivity.
    * exact Hin.
  - intros [v Hmap].
    pose proof (@LabelMapImpl.elements_1 exp s l v Hmap) as HmapA.
    apply InA_alt in HmapA. destruct HmapA as [y [Heq Hiny]].
    destruct y as [l2 v2]. simpl in Heq. destruct Heq as [Hl Hv]. simpl in Hl, Hv. subst.
    apply List.in_map_iff. exists (l2, v2). split; [reflexivity | exact Hiny].
Qed.

Lemma fresh_label_sealcomp_store : forall s ns,
  s <s= ns -> fresh_label_for_store s = fresh_label_for_store ns.
Proof.
  intros s ns [H1 H2]. unfold fresh_label_for_store.
  apply Label.fresh_permute. intros l.
  rewrite in_dom_elements. rewrite in_dom_elements.
  split; intros [v Hv].
  - destruct (H1 l v Hv) as [v' [Hv' _]]. exists v'. exact Hv'.
  - destruct (H2 l v Hv) as [v' [Hv' _]]. exists v'. exact Hv'.
Qed.

Lemma sealcomp_store_refl : forall s, s <s= s.
Proof.
  intros s. split.
  - intros l v H. exists v. split; [exact H | apply sealcomp_refl].
  - intros l v H. exists v. split; [exact H | apply sealcomp_refl].
Qed.

Lemma sealcomp_store_add : forall s ns l v w,
  s <s= ns -> sealcomp v w ->
  LabelMapImpl.add l v s <s= LabelMapImpl.add l w ns.
Proof.
  intros s ns l v w [H1 H2] Hsc. split.
  - intros l0 v0 Hmap.
    destruct (Label.eq_dec l0 l) as [Heq | Hneq].
    + subst l0.
      pose proof (@LabelMapImpl.add_1 exp ns l l w eq_refl) as Hadd.
      pose proof (@LabelMapImpl.add_1 exp s l l v eq_refl) as Hadds.
      pose proof (@LabelMapFacts.MapsTo_fun exp (LabelMapImpl.add l v s) l v0 v Hmap Hadds) as Heq'.
      rewrite Heq'. exists w. split; [exact Hadd | exact Hsc].
    + destruct (H1 l0 v0) as [w' [Hw' Hsc']].
      * apply (@LabelMapImpl.add_3 exp s l l0 v0 v); [symmetry; exact Hneq | exact Hmap].
      * exists w'. split.
        -- apply (@LabelMapImpl.add_2 exp ns l l0 w' w); [symmetry; exact Hneq | exact Hw'].
        -- exact Hsc'.
  - intros l0 w0 Hmap.
    destruct (Label.eq_dec l0 l) as [Heq | Hneq].
    + subst l0.
      pose proof (@LabelMapImpl.add_1 exp s l l v eq_refl) as Hadd.
      pose proof (@LabelMapImpl.add_1 exp ns l l w eq_refl) as Haddn.
      pose proof (@LabelMapFacts.MapsTo_fun exp (LabelMapImpl.add l w ns) l w0 w Hmap Haddn) as Heq'.
      rewrite Heq'. exists v. split; [exact Hadd | exact Hsc].
    + destruct (H2 l0 w0) as [v' [Hv' Hsc']].
      * apply (@LabelMapImpl.add_3 exp ns l l0 w0 w); [symmetry; exact Hneq | exact Hmap].
      * exists v'. split.
        -- apply (@LabelMapImpl.add_2 exp s l l0 v' v); [symmetry; exact Hneq | exact Hv'].
        -- exact Hsc'.
Qed.
