Lemma sealcomp_two_ref_cases : forall e l,
  sealcomp e (exp_seal (exp_seal (exp_ref l))) ->
  e = exp_seal (exp_seal (exp_ref l)) \/ sealcomp e (exp_seal (exp_ref l)).
Proof.
  intros e l H. remember (exp_seal (exp_seal (exp_ref l))) as f eqn:Heqf.
  revert l Heqf. induction H; intros l0 Heqf; try discriminate.
  - (* sealcomp_seal *) injection Heqf as Heq. subst e2.
    destruct (sealcomp_seal_inv _ _ H) as [[e0 [Heq0 Hsc0]] | Hsc0].
    + left. subst e1. apply sealcomp_ref_inv in Hsc0. subst e0. reflexivity.
    + right. apply sealcomp_ref_inv in Hsc0. subst e1. apply sealcomp_refl.
  - (* multiple_seal *) injection Heqf as Heq. subst e2. right. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma sealcomp_two_record_cases : forall e r,
  sealcomp e (exp_seal (exp_seal (exp_record r))) ->
  (exists r', e = exp_seal (exp_seal (exp_record r')) /\ sealcomp_rec_comp r' r)
  \/ sealcomp e (exp_seal (exp_record r)).
Proof.
  intros e r H. remember (exp_seal (exp_seal (exp_record r))) as f eqn:Heqf.
  revert r Heqf. induction H; intros r0 Heqf; try discriminate.
  - injection Heqf as Heq. subst e2.
    destruct (sealcomp_seal_inv _ _ H) as [[e0 [Heq0 Hsc0]] | Hsc0].
    + left. subst e1.
      destruct (sealcomp_record_inv _ _ Hsc0) as [r' [Heqr Hrc]]. subst e0.
      exists r'. split; [reflexivity | exact Hrc].
    + right. destruct (sealcomp_record_inv _ _ Hsc0) as [r' [Heqr Hrc]]. subst e1.
      apply sealcomp_seal. apply sealcomp_record. exact Hrc.
  - injection Heqf as Heq. subst e2. right. exact H.
Qed.

Definition sim_ok (e : exp) (s : store) (e1 : exp) (s1 : store) (f1 : exp) (ns1 : store) : Prop :=
  redm e s e1 s1 /\ s1 <s= ns1 /\ sealcomp e1 f1 /\
  well_formed_store s1 /\ expr f1 /\ expr e1.

Definition sim_ok_rec (e : rec_comp) (s : store) (e1 : rec_comp) (s1 : store)
  (r1 : rec_comp) (ns1 : store) : Prop :=
  redm_record_comp e s e1 s1 /\ s1 <s= ns1 /\ sealcomp_rec_comp e1 r1 /\
  well_formed_store s1 /\ record_comp r1 /\ record_comp e1.

Ltac sim_split := unfold sim_ok; split; [ | split; [ | split; [ | split; [ | split]]]].
Ltac sim_split_rec := unfold sim_ok_rec; split; [ | split; [ | split; [ | split; [ | split]]]].

Fixpoint sim2_step (f:exp) (ns:store) (f1:exp) (ns1:store) (H : red f ns f1 ns1) {struct H} :
  forall e s, expr f -> expr e -> well_formed_store s -> s <s= ns -> sealcomp e f ->
    exists e1 s1, sim_ok e s e1 s1 f1 ns1
with sim2_step_rec (r:rec_comp) (ns:store) (r1:rec_comp) (ns1:store)
    (H : red_record_comp r ns r1 ns1) {struct H} :
  forall e s, record_comp r -> record_comp e -> well_formed_store s -> s <s= ns ->
    sealcomp_rec_comp e r ->
    exists e1 s1, sim_ok_rec e s e1 s1 r1 ns1.
Proof.
  - intros e s Hexpr_f Hexpr_e Hwf_s Hstore Hsc.
    destruct H as
      [ g1 g1' s1 s1' g2 Hed Hstep
      | g1 g2 s2 g2' s2' Hv Hstep
      | g1 g1' s1 s1' V Hty Hstep
      | T g1 s1 v2 Hwf Hab Hv
      | T1 g1 s1 T2 Hwf Hab Hty
      | g1 g1' s1 s1' g2 Hstep Hbody
      | v1 g2 s2 Hwf Hv Hbody
      | g1 g1' s1 s1' Hstep
      | v1 l s1 Hwf Hv Hfresh
      | g1 g1' s1 s1' Hstep
      | l v1 s1 Hwf Hv Hmap
      | l v1 s1 Hwf Hv Hmap
      | g1 s1 g1' s1' g2 Hed Hstep
      | v1 g2 s2 g2' s2' Hv Hstep
      | l v1 v2 s1 Hwf Hv1 Hv2 Hmap
      | g1 s1 g1' s1' Hstep
      | T g1 s1 Hwf Hab
      | T g1 s1 Hwf Hab
      | l s1 Hwf
      | r s1 Hwf Hvrc
      | r0 s1 r0' s1' Hstep
      | a g1 g1' s1 s1' Hstep
      | r0 a l v1 s1 Hwf Hvrc Hlook Hv Hmap
      | r0 a l v1 s1 Hwf Hvrc Hlook Hv Hmap
      | a g1 s1 g1' s1' g2 Hed Hstep
      | a v1 g2 s2 g2' s2' Hv Hstep
      | a l r0 v1 v2 s1 Hwf Hvrc Hlook Hv1 Hv2 Hmap ].
    + (* red_app_1 *)
      destruct (expr_app_inv g1 g2 Hexpr_f) as [Hfg1 Hfg2].
      destruct (sealcomp_app_inv _ _ _ Hsc) as [e1 [e2 [Heq [Hsc1 Hsc2]]]]. subst e.
      destruct (expr_app_inv e1 e2 Hexpr_e) as [He1 He2].
      destruct (sim2_step g1 s1 g1' s1' Hstep e1 s Hfg1 He1 Hwf_s Hstore Hsc1)
        as [e1' [s1r [Hred [Hst [Hsc1' [Hwf1 [Hf1' He1']]]]]]].
      exists (exp_app e1' e2), s1r. sim_split; try assumption.
      * apply (redm_app_1 e1 s e1' s1r e2); assumption.
      * apply sealcomp_app; assumption.
      * apply expr_app; assumption.
      * apply expr_app; assumption.
    + (* red_app_2 *)
      destruct (expr_app_inv g1 g2 Hexpr_f) as [Hfg1 Hfg2].
      destruct (sealcomp_app_inv _ _ _ Hsc) as [e1 [e2 [Heq [Hsc1 Hsc2]]]]. subst e.
      destruct (expr_app_inv e1 e2 Hexpr_e) as [He1 He2].
      pose proof (value_sealcomp_down e1 g1 Hsc1 Hv He1) as Hv1.
      destruct (sim2_step g2 s2 g2' s2' Hstep e2 s Hfg2 He2 Hwf_s Hstore Hsc2)
        as [e1' [s2r [Hred [Hst [Hsc1' [Hwf1 [Hf1' He1']]]]]]].
      exists (exp_app e1 e1'), s2r. sim_split; try assumption.
      * apply (redm_app_2 e1 e2 s e1' s2r); assumption.
      * apply sealcomp_app; assumption.
      * apply expr_app; assumption.
      * apply expr_app; assumption.
    + (* red_tapp *)
      destruct (expr_tapp_inv g1 V Hexpr_f) as [Hfg1 HfV].
      destruct (sealcomp_tapp_inv _ _ _ Hsc) as [e1 [Heq Hsc1]]. subst e.
      destruct (expr_tapp_inv e1 V Hexpr_e) as [He1 HeV].
      destruct (sim2_step g1 s1 g1' s1' Hstep e1 s Hfg1 He1 Hwf_s Hstore Hsc1)
        as [e1' [s1r [Hred [Hst [Hsc1' [Hwf1 [Hf1' He1']]]]]]].
      exists (exp_tapp e1' V), s1r. sim_split; try assumption.
      * apply (redm_tapp V e1 s e1' s1r); assumption.
      * apply sealcomp_tapp; assumption.
      * apply expr_tapp; assumption.
      * apply expr_tapp; assumption.
    + (* red_abs *)
      destruct (expr_app_inv (exp_abs T g1) v2 Hexpr_f) as [Hfab Hfv2].
      destruct (sealcomp_app_inv _ _ _ Hsc) as [ea [eb [Heq [Hsc1 Hsc2]]]]. subst e.
      destruct (expr_app_inv ea eb Hexpr_e) as [Hea Heb].
      destruct (sealcomp_abs_inv _ _ _ Hsc1) as [ea1 [Heq1 Hsc1']]. subst ea.
      pose proof (value_sealcomp_down eb v2 Hsc2 Hv Heb) as Hv2'.
      destruct (expr_abs_inv T ea1 Hea) as [Hty Heabs].
      exists (open_ee ea1 eb), s. sim_split; try assumption.
      * apply redm_step with (e'':=open_ee ea1 eb) (s'':=s).
        -- apply red_abs; assumption.
        -- apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
      * apply sealcomp_open_ee with (k:=0); assumption.
      * apply body_e_open_expr.
        -- apply (proj2 (expr_abs_inv T g1 Hfab)).
        -- apply value_expr; assumption.
      * apply body_e_open_expr; [exact Heabs | apply value_expr; assumption].
    + (* red_tabs *)
      destruct (expr_tapp_inv (exp_tabs T1 g1) T2 Hexpr_f) as [Hfab Hf2].
      destruct (sealcomp_tapp_inv _ _ _ Hsc) as [e1 [Heq Hsc1]]. subst e.
      destruct (expr_tapp_inv e1 T2 Hexpr_e) as [He1 He2].
      destruct (sealcomp_tabs_inv _ _ _ Hsc1) as [ea1 [Heq1 Hsc1']]. subst e1.
      destruct (expr_tabs_inv T1 ea1 He1) as [Hty1 Heabs].
      exists (open_te ea1 T2), s. sim_split; try assumption.
      * apply redm_step with (e'':=open_te ea1 T2) (s'':=s).
        -- apply red_tabs; assumption.
        -- apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
      * apply sealcomp_open_te with (k:=0) (U:=T2); assumption.
      * apply body_te_open_expr.
        -- apply (proj2 (expr_tabs_inv T1 g1 Hfab)).
        -- exact Hty.
      * apply body_te_open_expr; [exact Heabs | exact Hty].
    + (* red_let_1 *)
      destruct (expr_let_inv g1 g2 Hexpr_f) as [Hfg1 Hfb]. destruct Hfb as [Lf Hfb].
      destruct (sealcomp_let_inv _ _ _ Hsc) as [e1 [e2 [Heq [Hsc1 Hsc2]]]]. subst e.
      destruct (expr_let_inv e1 e2 Hexpr_e) as [He1 Heb]. destruct Heb as [Le Heb].
      destruct (sim2_step g1 s1 g1' s1' Hstep e1 s Hfg1 He1 Hwf_s Hstore Hsc1)
        as [e1' [s1r [Hred [Hst [Hsc1' [Hwf1 [Hf1' He1']]]]]]].
      exists (exp_let e1' e2), s1r. sim_split; try assumption.
      * apply (redm_let_1 e1 s e1' s1r e2); [exact Hred | exists Le; exact Heb].

Lemma sim2_multi : forall f ns f' ns', redm f ns f' ns' -> forall e s,
  expr f -> expr e -> well_formed_store s -> s <s= ns -> sealcomp e f ->
  exists e' s', redm e s e' s' /\ s' <s= ns' /\ sealcomp e' f' /\
  well_formed_store s' /\ expr f' /\ expr e'.
Proof.
  intros f ns f' ns' H. induction H as
    [ f0 s0 f1 s1 Heq Hseq | f0 s0 f2 s2 f1 s1 Hred Hredm IHredm ]; intros e s Hf He Hwf Hst Hsc.
  - subst. exists e, s. split.
    + apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
    + split; [exact Hst | split; [exact Hsc | split; [exact Hwf | split; [exact Hf | exact He]]]].
  - destruct (sim2_step f0 s0 f2 s2 Hred e s Hf He Hwf Hst Hsc)
      as [e1 [s1' [Hred1 [Hst1 [Hsc1 [Hwf1 [Hf1 He1]]]]]]].
    destruct (IHredm e1 s1' Hf1 He1 Hwf1 Hst1 Hsc1)
      as [e' [s' [Hred2 [Hst2 [Hsc2 [Hwf2 [Hf2 He2]]]]]]].
    exists e', s'. split.
    + apply redm_trans with (e':=e1) (s':=s1'); assumption.
    + split; [exact Hst2 | split; [exact Hsc2 | split; [exact Hwf2 | split; [exact Hf2 | exact He2]]]].
Qed.

Lemma safety_value_multistep'_proof : forall e s f ns f' ns',
  expr f ->
  expr e ->
  well_formed_store s ->
  sealcomp_store s ns ->
  sealcomp e f ->
  redm f ns f' ns' ->
  value f' ->
  (exists e' s', redm e s e' s' /\ sealcomp_store s' ns' /\ sealcomp e' f' /\ value e').
Proof.
  intros e s f ns f' ns' Hf He Hwf Hst Hsc Hred Hvf.
  destruct (sim2_multi f ns f' ns' Hred e s Hf He Hwf Hst Hsc)
    as [e' [s' [Hred' [Hst' [Hsc' [Hwf' [Hf' He']]]]]]].
  exists e', s'. split; [exact Hred' | split; [exact Hst' | split; [exact Hsc' | apply value_sealcomp_down with (f:=f'); assumption]]].
Qed.


(* ================= typing inversion (equality-or-sub form) ================= *)
Fixpoint typing_app_inv (E:env) (R:sig) (e1 e2:exp) (T:typ)
  (H : typing E R (exp_app e1 e2) T) {struct H} :
  exists T1 T2, typing E R e1 (typ_arrow T1 T2) /\ typing E R e2 T1 /\
    (T = T2 \/ sub E T2 T).
Proof.
  inversion H; subst.
  - exists T1, T. split; [exact H5 | split; [exact H7 | left; reflexivity]].
  - destruct (typing_app_inv E R e1 e2 S H1) as [T1 [T2 [G1 [G2 [Heq | Hsub]]]]].
    + exists T1, T2. split; [exact G1 | split; [exact G2 |]]. subst S. right. exact H2.
    + exists T1, T2. split; [exact G1 | split; [exact G2 |]]. right. eapply sub_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma wf_sig_wf_env : forall E R, wf_sig E R -> wf_env E.
Proof. intros E R H. induction H; assumption. Qed.
Scheme typing_mut := Induction for typing Sort Prop
  with typing_rc_mut := Induction for typing_record_comp Sort Prop.
Lemma typing_wf_env : forall E R e T, typing E R e T -> wf_env E.
Proof.
  intros E R e T H.
  induction H using typing_mut with (P0 := fun E R r T (h:typing_record_comp E R r T) => wf_env E).
  all: eauto using wf_sig_wf_env.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_weaken_binds : forall E T, wf_typ E T ->
  forall E', (forall X b, binds X b E -> binds X b E') -> wf_typ E' T.
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction H; intros E' Hb.
  - apply wf_typ_top.
  - apply wf_typ_var with (U:=U). apply Hb. exact H.
  - apply wf_typ_arrow; [apply IHwf_typ1 | apply IHwf_typ2]; assumption.
  - apply wf_typ_all with (L:=L).
    + apply IHwf_typ. exact Hb.
    + intros X HX. apply H1 with (E':=X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E'); [exact HX |].
      intros Y b HY. destruct (binds_cons_1 _ _ _ _ _ _ HY) as [[Heq1 Heq2] | HE].
      * subst. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity.
      * apply binds_cons. apply Hb. exact HE.
  - apply wf_typ_box. apply IHwf_typ. exact Hb.
  - apply wf_typ_readonly. apply IHwf_typ. exact Hb.
  - apply wf_typ_intersect; [apply IHwf_typ1 | apply IHwf_typ2]; assumption.
  - apply wf_typ_record. apply IHwf_typ. exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_type : forall E T, wf_typ E T -> type T.
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction H; simpl.
  - apply type_top.
  - apply type_var.
  - apply type_arrow; assumption.
  - apply type_all with (L:=L); [assumption |].
    intros X HX. apply H1; assumption.
  - apply type_box; assumption.
  - apply type_readonly; assumption.
  - apply type_intersect; assumption.
  - apply type_record; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma sub_type : forall E A B, sub E A B -> type A /\ type B.
Proof.
  intros E A B H. induction H.
  - split; [eapply wf_typ_type; eassumption | apply type_top].
  - split; [apply type_var | apply type_var].
  - split; [apply type_var | apply (proj2 IHsub)].
  - split.
    + apply type_arrow; [apply (proj2 IHsub1) | apply (proj1 IHsub2)].
    + apply type_arrow; [apply (proj1 IHsub1) | apply (proj2 IHsub2)].
  - split.
    + apply type_all with (L:=L); [apply (proj2 IHsub) |].
      intros X HX. apply (proj1 (H1 X HX)).
    + apply type_all with (L:=L); [apply (proj1 IHsub) |].
      intros X HX. apply (proj2 (H1 X HX)).
  - split.
    + apply type_box; apply (proj1 IHsub1).
    + apply type_box; apply (proj1 IHsub2).
  - split; [apply type_readonly; apply (proj1 IHsub) | apply type_readonly; apply (proj2 IHsub)].
  - split; [apply (proj1 IHsub) | apply type_readonly; apply (proj2 IHsub)].
  - split; [apply (proj1 IHsub1) | apply (proj2 IHsub2)].
  - split; [apply type_intersect; eapply wf_typ_type; eassumption | eapply wf_typ_type; eassumption].
  - split; [apply type_intersect; eapply wf_typ_type; eassumption | eapply wf_typ_type; eassumption].
  - split; [apply (proj1 IHsub1) | apply type_intersect; [apply (proj2 IHsub1) | apply (proj2 IHsub2)]].
  - split.
    + apply type_record; apply (proj1 IHsub1).
    + apply type_record; apply (proj1 IHsub2).
  - split; [apply type_readonly; apply type_record; apply (proj1 IHsub) |
             apply type_readonly; apply type_record; apply (proj2 IHsub)].
  - split; [eapply wf_typ_type; eassumption | eapply wf_typ_type; eassumption].
Qed.

Lemma typing_expr : forall E R e T, typing E R e T -> expr e.
Proof.
  intros E R e T H.
  induction H using typing_mut with
    (P0 := fun E R r T (h:typing_record_comp E R r T) => record_comp r).
  - apply expr_var.
  - destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx].
    pose proof (typing_wf_env (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) R (open_ee e1 x) T1 (t x Hx)) as HwfE.
    inversion HwfE; subst.
    apply expr_abs with (L:=L).
    + eapply wf_typ_type; eassumption.
    + intros y Hy. apply H; exact Hy.
  - apply expr_app; assumption.
  - destruct (atom_fresh L) as [X HX].
    pose proof (typing_wf_env (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) R (open_te e1 X) (open_tt T1 X) (t X HX)) as HwfE.
    inversion HwfE; subst.
    apply expr_tabs with (L:=L).
    + eapply wf_typ_type; eassumption.
    + intros Y HY. apply H; exact HY.
  - apply expr_tapp; [assumption | apply (proj1 (sub_type E T T1 s))].
  - assumption.
  - destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx].
    apply expr_let with (L:=L); [assumption |].
    intros y Hy. apply H0; exact Hy.
  - apply expr_box; assumption.
  - apply expr_unbox; assumption.
  - apply expr_set_box; assumption.
  - apply expr_ref.
  - apply expr_seal; assumption.
  - apply expr_unbox; assumption.
  - apply expr_record; assumption.
  - apply expr_record_read; assumption.
  - apply expr_record_read; assumption.
  - apply expr_record_write; assumption.
  - apply record_comp_empty.
  - apply record_comp_exp; assumption.
  - apply record_comp_ref; assumption.
Qed.

Fixpoint maybe_box (T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => False
  | typ_bvar _ => False
  | typ_fvar _ => True
  | typ_arrow _ _ => False
  | typ_all _ _ => False
  | typ_box _ => True
  | typ_mut _ _ => False
  | typ_int A B => maybe_box A \/ maybe_box B
  | typ_record _ _ => True
  end.

Lemma maybe_box_merge_false : forall U m, maybe_box (merge_mutability U m) -> False.
Proof.
  induction U as [|n|X|A B|A B|A|m0 A|A B|a A]; intros m H; simpl in *; try exact H.
  - (* int *) destruct H as [H | H]; [apply B in H | apply IHU1 in H]; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma maybe_box_nf : forall T, maybe_box (normal_form_typing T) <-> maybe_box T.
Proof.
  induction T; simpl.
  - tauto.
  - tauto.
  - tauto.
  - tauto.
  - tauto.
  - tauto.
  - split; intros H; [exfalso; eapply maybe_box_merge_false; eauto | destruct H].
  - split; intros [H | H]; [left; apply IHT1 | right; apply IHT2 | left; apply IHT1 | right; apply IHT2]; assumption.
  - tauto.
Qed.

Lemma maybe_box_sub : forall E A B, sub E A B -> maybe_box B -> maybe_box A.
Proof.
  intros E A B H. induction H; intros HB.
  - destruct HB.
  - exact I.
  - exact I.
  - destruct HB.
  - destruct HB.
  - exact I.
  - destruct HB.
  - destruct HB.
  - apply IHsub1. apply IHsub2. exact HB.
  - left. exact HB.
  - right. exact HB.
  - destruct HB as [HB | HB]; [apply IHsub1 in HB | apply IHsub2 in HB]; exact HB.
  - exact I.
  - destruct HB.
  - apply (proj1 (maybe_box_nf T1)). apply IHsub. apply (proj2 (maybe_box_nf T2)). exact HB.
Qed.

Lemma sub_readonly_not_box : forall E S T,
  sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly S) (typ_box T) -> False.
Proof.
  intros E S T H. apply (maybe_box_sub E _ _ H). exact I.
Qed.

Lemma sub_readonly_not_record : forall E S a T,
  sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly S) (typ_record a T) -> False.
Proof.
  intros E S a T H. apply (maybe_box_sub E _ _ H). exact I.
Qed.

Lemma typing_seal_not_box : forall E R e T,
  typing E R (exp_seal e) (typ_box T) -> False.
Proof.
  intros E R e T H.
  destruct (typing_seal_inv E R e (typ_box T) H) as [S [Ht [Heq | Hsub]]].
  - inversion Heq.
  - eapply sub_readonly_not_box; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma typing_seal_not_record : forall E R e a T,
  typing E R (exp_seal e) (typ_record a T) -> False.
Proof.
  intros E R e a T H.
  destruct (typing_seal_inv E R e (typ_record a T) H) as [S [Ht [Heq | Hsub]]].
  - inversion Heq.
  - eapply sub_readonly_not_record; eauto.
Qed.

Fixpoint remove_atom (x : atom) (E : env) {struct E} : env :=
  match E with
  | nil => nil
  | (y,b) :: E' => if aeq x y then E' else (y,b) :: remove_atom x E'
  end.

Lemma remove_atom_cons_neq : forall x y b E, x <> y ->
  remove_atom x ((y,b) :: E) = (y,b) :: remove_atom x E.
Proof.
  intros x y b E Hne. simpl. destruct (aeq x y) as [Heq | Hne2]; [exfalso; auto | reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma remove_atom_cons_eq : forall x b E,
  remove_atom x ((x,b) :: E) = E.
Proof.
  intros. simpl. destruct (aeq x x); [reflexivity | exfalso; auto].
Qed.

Lemma binds_remove_atom_other : forall x y b E,
  x <> y -> binds y b (remove_atom x E) <-> binds y b E.
Proof.
  intros x y b E Hne. induction E as [| [z c] E' IH]; simpl.
  - tauto.
  - destruct (aeq x z) as [Heq | Hneq].
    + subst z. split; intro H.
      * apply binds_cons. exact H.
      * apply binds_cons_iff in H. destruct H as [[Hy Hc] | H].
        -- subst. exfalso; apply Hne; reflexivity.
        -- exact H.
    + split; intro H.
      * apply binds_cons_iff in H. destruct H as [[Hy Hc] | H].
        -- subst. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity.
        -- apply binds_cons. apply (proj1 IH). exact H.
      * apply binds_cons_iff in H. destruct H as [[Hy Hc] | H].
        -- subst. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity.
        -- apply binds_cons. apply (proj2 IH). exact H.
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_binds_fun : forall E, wf_env E ->
  forall z b1 b2, binds z b1 E -> binds z b2 E -> b1 = b2.
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H; intros z b1 b2 K1 K2.
  - apply binds_nil_iff in K1. destruct K1.
  - apply binds_cons_iff in K1. apply binds_cons_iff in K2.
    destruct K1 as [[Heq1 Hb1] | K1]; destruct K2 as [[Heq2 Hb2] | K2].
    + subst. reflexivity.
    + subst. exfalso. eapply binds_dom_contradiction; eauto.
    + subst. exfalso. eapply binds_dom_contradiction; eauto.
    + exact (IHwf_env z b1 b2 K1 K2).
  - apply binds_cons_iff in K1. apply binds_cons_iff in K2.
    destruct K1 as [[Heq1 Hb1] | K1]; destruct K2 as [[Heq2 Hb2] | K2].
    + subst. reflexivity.
    + subst. exfalso. eapply binds_dom_contradiction; eauto.
    + subst. exfalso. eapply binds_dom_contradiction; eauto.
    + exact (IHwf_env z b1 b2 K1 K2).
Qed.

Lemma wf_sig_weaken_binds : forall E R, wf_sig E R ->
  forall E', wf_env E' -> (forall X b, binds X b E -> binds X b E') -> wf_sig E' R.
Proof.
  intros E R H. induction H; intros E' Hwf' Hb.
  - apply wf_sig_empty. exact Hwf'.
  - apply wf_sig_typ.
    + apply IHwf_sig; assumption.
    + apply wf_typ_weaken_binds with (E:=E); assumption.
    + assumption.
Qed.

Lemma typing_wf_sig : forall E R e T, typing E R e T -> wf_sig E R.
Proof.
  intros E R e T H.
  induction H using typing_mut with
    (P0 := fun E R r T (h:typing_record_comp E R r T) => wf_sig E R).
  all: try assumption.
Qed.

Lemma sub_wf_env : forall E A B, sub E A B -> wf_env E.
Proof.
  intros E A B H. induction H; auto.
Qed.

Lemma sub_weaken_binds : forall E A B, sub E A B ->
  forall E', wf_env E' ->
  (forall X b, binds X b E -> binds X b E') ->
  sub E' A B.
Proof.
  intros E A B H.
  induction H; intros E' Hwf' Hb.
  - apply sub_top.
    + exact Hwf'.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; eassumption.
  - apply sub_refl_tvar.
    + exact Hwf'.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; eassumption.
  - apply sub_trans_tvar with (U:=U).
    + apply Hb. exact H.
    + apply IHsub. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
  - apply sub_arrow.
    + apply IHsub1. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
    + apply IHsub2. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
  - (* sub_all *)
    apply sub_all with (L := L `union` dom E').
    + apply IHsub. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
    + intros X HX.
      pose proof HX as HXL. apply notin_union_1 in HXL.
      pose proof HX as HXD. apply notin_union_2 in HXD.
      assert (HwfX : wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E)).
      { eapply sub_wf_env. apply H0. exact HXL. }
      assert (Hwt : wf_typ E T1).
      { inversion HwfX; subst; assumption. }
      assert (Hwt' : wf_typ E' T1).
      { eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; eassumption. }
      assert (HwfEE' : wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E')).
      { apply wf_env_sub; assumption. }
      apply (H1 X HXL (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E') HwfEE').
      intros Y c HY. apply binds_cons_iff in HY.
      destruct HY as [[HYe1 HYe2] | HY].
      * subst. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity.
      * apply binds_cons_3. apply Hb. exact HY.
  - apply sub_box.
    + apply IHsub1. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
    + apply IHsub2. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
  - apply sub_readonly. apply IHsub. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
  - apply sub_readonly_mutable. apply IHsub. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
  - eapply sub_trans.
    + apply IHsub1. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
    + apply IHsub2. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
  - apply sub_inter_left.
    + exact Hwf'.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; eassumption.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; eassumption.
  - apply sub_inter_right.
    + exact Hwf'.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; eassumption.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; eassumption.
  - apply sub_inter.
    + apply IHsub1. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
    + apply IHsub2. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
  - apply sub_record.
    + apply IHsub1. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
    + apply IHsub2. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
  - apply sub_readonly_record. apply IHsub. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
  - apply sub_denormalize.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; eassumption.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; eassumption.
    + apply IHsub. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma typing_weaken_binds_aux : forall E R e T, typing E R e T ->
  forall E', wf_env E' ->
  (forall X b, binds X b E -> binds X b E') ->
  wf_sig E' R -> typing E' R e T.
Proof.
  intros E R e T H.
  induction H using typing_mut with
    (P := fun E R e T (h:typing E R e T) =>
       forall E', wf_env E' ->
       (forall X b, binds X b E -> binds X b E') ->
       wf_sig E' R -> typing E' R e T)
    (P0 := fun E R r T (h:typing_record_comp E R r T) =>
       forall E', wf_env E' ->
       (forall X b, binds X b E -> binds X b E') ->
       wf_sig E' R -> typing_record_comp E' R r T).
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs. apply typing_var; [exact Hwf' | exact Hs | apply Hb; exact b].
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs.
    eapply typing_abs with (L := L `union` dom E').
    + exact Hs.
    + intros x Hx.
      pose proof Hx as HxL. apply notin_union_1 in HxL.
      pose proof Hx as HxD. apply notin_union_2 in HxD.
      pose proof (t x HxL) as Hbody.
      pose proof (typing_wf_env _ _ _ _ Hbody) as Hwfx.
      inversion Hwfx; subst.
      assert (Hwt' : wf_typ E' V).
      { eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; eassumption. }
      assert (Hwfx' : wf_env (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E')).
      { apply wf_env_typ; assumption. }
      assert (Hsx : wf_sig (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E') R).
      { eapply wf_sig_weaken_binds; [exact Hs | exact Hwfx' |].
        intros Y c HY. apply binds_cons_3. exact HY. }
      apply (H x HxL (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E') Hwfx').
      * intros Y c HY. apply binds_cons_iff in HY.
        destruct HY as [[HYe1 HYe2] | HY].
        -- subst. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity.
        -- apply binds_cons_3. apply Hb. exact HY.
      * exact Hsx.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs.
    eapply typing_app.
    + exact Hs.
    + apply IHtyping1; assumption.
    + apply IHtyping2; assumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs.
    eapply typing_tabs with (L := L `union` dom E').
    + exact Hs.
    + intros X HX.
      pose proof HX as HXL. apply notin_union_1 in HXL.
      pose proof HX as HXD. apply notin_union_2 in HXD.
      pose proof (t X HXL) as Hbody.
      pose proof (typing_wf_env _ _ _ _ Hbody) as HwfX.
      inversion HwfX; subst.
      assert (Hwt' : wf_typ E' V).
      { eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; eassumption. }
      assert (HwfX' : wf_env (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E')).
      { apply wf_env_sub; assumption. }
      assert (HsX : wf_sig (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E') R).
      { eapply wf_sig_weaken_binds; [exact Hs | exact HwfX' |].
        intros Y c HY. apply binds_cons_3. exact HY. }
      apply (H X HXL (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E') HwfX').
      * intros Y c HY. apply binds_cons_iff in HY.
        destruct HY as [[HYe1 HYe2] | HY].
        -- subst. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity.
        -- apply binds_cons_3. apply Hb. exact HY.
      * exact HsX.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs.
    apply typing_tapp with (T1:=T1).
    + exact Hs.
    + apply IHtyping; assumption.
    + eapply sub_weaken_binds; eassumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs.
    eapply typing_sub.
    + exact Hs.
    + apply IHtyping; assumption.
    + eapply sub_weaken_binds; eassumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs.
    eapply typing_let with (L := L `union` dom E').
    + exact Hs.
    + apply IHtyping; assumption.
    + intros x Hx.
      pose proof Hx as HxL. apply notin_union_1 in HxL.
      pose proof Hx as HxD. apply notin_union_2 in HxD.
      pose proof (t x HxL) as Hbody.
      pose proof (typing_wf_env _ _ _ _ Hbody) as Hwfx.
      inversion Hwfx; subst.
      assert (Hwt' : wf_typ E' T1).
      { eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; eassumption. }
      assert (Hwfx' : wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E')).
      { apply wf_env_typ; assumption. }
      assert (Hsx : wf_sig (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E') R).
      { eapply wf_sig_weaken_binds; [exact Hs | exact Hwfx' |].
        intros Y c HY. apply binds_cons_3. exact HY. }
      apply (H0 x HxL (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E') Hwfx').
      * intros Y c HY. apply binds_cons_iff in HY.
        destruct HY as [[HYe1 HYe2] | HY].
        -- subst. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity.
        -- apply binds_cons_3. apply Hb. exact HY.
      * exact Hsx.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs. apply typing_box with (T:=T). exact Hs. apply IHtyping; assumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs. apply typing_unbox with (T:=T). exact Hs. apply IHtyping; assumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs. apply typing_set_box with (T:=T).
    + exact Hs.
    + apply IHtyping1; assumption.
    + apply IHtyping2; assumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs. apply typing_ref with (T:=T); assumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs. apply typing_seal with (T:=T). apply IHtyping; assumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs. apply typing_unbox_readonly with (T:=T). apply IHtyping; assumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs. apply typing_record with (T:=T). apply IHtyping; assumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs. apply typing_record_read with (a:=a) (T:=T). apply IHtyping; assumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs. apply typing_record_read_readonly with (a:=a) (T:=T). apply IHtyping; assumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs. apply typing_record_write with (a:=a) (T:=T).
    + apply IHtyping1; assumption.
    + apply IHtyping2; assumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs. apply typing_record_empty; assumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs. apply typing_record_exp with (a:=a) (T:=T).
    + exact n.
    + apply IHtyping; assumption.
    + apply IHtyping0; assumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs. apply typing_record_ref with (a:=a) (T:=T).
    + exact n.
    + apply IHtyping; assumption.
    + exact b.
Qed.

Lemma typing_weaken_binds : forall E R e T, typing E R e T ->
  forall E', wf_env E' ->
  (forall X b, binds X b E -> binds X b E') ->
  typing E' R e T.
Proof.
  intros E R e T H E' Hwf' Hb.
  pose proof (typing_wf_sig _ _ _ _ H) as Hs.
  pose proof (wf_sig_weaken_binds _ _ Hs E' Hwf' Hb) as Hs'.
  eapply typing_weaken_binds_aux; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma record_dom_subst_fvar : forall r z u,
  record_dom (subst_fvar_r z u r) = record_dom r.
Proof.
  intros r. induction r; intros z u; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHr. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHr. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma typing_subst_fvar : forall E R e T, typing E R e T ->
  forall x v V, binds x (bind_typ V) E -> typing E R v V -> expr v ->
    typing E R (subst_fvar_e x v e) T.
Proof.
  intros E R e T H.
  induction H using typing_mut with
    (P := fun E R e T (h:typing E R e T) =>
       forall z u U, binds z (bind_typ U) E ->
         typing E R u U -> expr u -> typing E R (subst_fvar_e z u e) T)
    (P0 := fun E R r T (h:typing_record_comp E R r T) =>
       forall z u U, binds z (bind_typ U) E ->
         typing E R u U -> expr u -> typing_record_comp E R (subst_fvar_r z u r) T).
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve.
    simpl. destruct (aeq z x) as [Heq | Hne].
    + subst. assert (HbEq : bind_typ U = bind_typ T).
      { eapply wf_env_binds_fun; [exact w | exact Hb | exact b]. }
      inversion HbEq; subst. exact Hv.
    + apply typing_var; assumption.
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve.
    simpl.
    eapply typing_abs with (L := L `union` {{z}} `union` dom E).
    + exact w.
    + intros y Hy.
      pose proof Hy as HyL. apply notin_union_1 in HyL.
      pose proof Hy as Hout2. apply notin_union_2 in Hout2.
      pose proof Hout2 as HyS. apply notin_union_1 in HyS.
      pose proof Hout2 as HyD. apply notin_union_2 in HyD.
      pose proof (notin_singleton_1 z y HyS) as Hne.
      pose proof (t y HyL) as Hbody.
      pose proof (typing_wf_env _ _ _ _ Hbody) as Hwfbody.
      inversion Hwfbody; subst.
      assert (Hwfy : wf_env (y ~ bind_typ V ++ E)).
      { apply wf_env_typ; assumption. }
      assert (Hvy : typing (y ~ bind_typ V ++ E) R u U).
      { eapply typing_weaken_binds; [exact Hv | exact Hwfy |].
        intros Y c HY. apply binds_cons_3. exact HY. }
      assert (Hby : binds z (bind_typ U) (y ~ bind_typ V ++ E)).
      { apply binds_cons_3. exact Hb. }
      pose proof (H y HyL z u U Hby Hvy Hve) as Hres.
      change (typing (y ~ bind_typ V ++ E) R
        (open_ee_rec 0 (exp_fvar y) (subst_fvar_e z u e1)) T1).
      rewrite (subst_fvar_open_ee e1 0 z u y (expr_lc u Hve) Hne).
      exact Hres.
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    eapply typing_app.
    + exact w.
    + apply (IHtyping1 z u U Hb Hv Hve).
    + apply (IHtyping2 z u U Hb Hv Hve).
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    eapply typing_tabs with (L := L `union` {{z}} `union` dom E).
    + exact w.
    + intros X HX.
      pose proof HX as HXL. apply notin_union_1 in HXL.
      pose proof HX as Hout2. apply notin_union_2 in Hout2.
      pose proof Hout2 as HXD. apply notin_union_2 in HXD.
      pose proof (t X HXL) as Hbody.
      pose proof (typing_wf_env _ _ _ _ Hbody) as HwfX.
      inversion HwfX; subst.
      assert (HwfX' : wf_env (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E)).
      { apply wf_env_sub; assumption. }
      assert (HvX : typing (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) R u U).
      { eapply typing_weaken_binds; [exact Hv | exact HwfX' |].
        intros Y c HY. apply binds_cons_3. exact HY. }
      assert (HbX : binds z (bind_typ U) (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E)).
      { apply binds_cons_3. exact Hb. }
      pose proof (H X HXL z u U HbX HvX Hve) as Hres.
      change (typing (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) R
        (open_te_rec 0 (typ_fvar X) (subst_fvar_e z u e1)) (open_tt T1 X)).
      rewrite <- (subst_fvar_open_te e1 z u 0 (typ_fvar X) (expr_tlc_all u Hve)).
      exact Hres.
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    eapply typing_tapp with (T1:=T1).
    + exact w.
    + apply (IHtyping z u U Hb Hv Hve).
    + exact s.
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    eapply typing_sub with (S:=S).
    + exact w.
    + apply (IHtyping z u U Hb Hv Hve).
    + exact s.
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    eapply typing_let with (L := L `union` {{z}} `union` dom E).
    + exact w.
    + apply (IHtyping z u U Hb Hv Hve).
    + intros y Hy.
      pose proof Hy as HyL. apply notin_union_1 in HyL.
      pose proof Hy as Hout2. apply notin_union_2 in Hout2.
      pose proof Hout2 as HyS. apply notin_union_1 in HyS.
      pose proof Hout2 as HyD. apply notin_union_2 in HyD.
      pose proof (notin_singleton_1 z y HyS) as Hne.
      pose proof (t y HyL) as Hbody.
      pose proof (typing_wf_env _ _ _ _ Hbody) as Hwfbody.
      inversion Hwfbody; subst.
      assert (Hwfy : wf_env (y ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E)).
      { apply wf_env_typ; assumption. }
      assert (Hvy : typing (y ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E) R u U).
      { eapply typing_weaken_binds; [exact Hv | exact Hwfy |].
        intros Y c HY. apply binds_cons_3. exact HY. }
      assert (Hby : binds z (bind_typ U) (y ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E)).
      { apply binds_cons_3. exact Hb. }
      pose proof (H0 y HyL z u U Hby Hvy Hve) as Hres.
      change (typing (y ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E) R
        (open_ee_rec 0 (exp_fvar y) (subst_fvar_e z u e2)) T2).
      rewrite (subst_fvar_open_ee e2 0 z u y (expr_lc u Hve) Hne).
      exact Hres.
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    apply typing_box with (T:=T).
    + exact w.
    + apply (IHtyping z u U Hb Hv Hve).
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    apply typing_unbox with (T:=T).
    + exact w.
    + apply (IHtyping z u U Hb Hv Hve).
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    eapply typing_set_box with (T:=T).
    + exact w.
    + apply (IHtyping1 z u U Hb Hv Hve).
    + apply (IHtyping2 z u U Hb Hv Hve).
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    apply typing_ref with (T:=T); assumption.
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    apply typing_seal with (T:=T).
    apply (IHtyping z u U Hb Hv Hve).
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    apply typing_unbox_readonly with (T:=T).
    apply (IHtyping z u U Hb Hv Hve).
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    apply typing_record with (T:=T).
    apply (IHtyping z u U Hb Hv Hve).
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    apply typing_record_read with (a:=a) (T:=T).
    apply (IHtyping z u U Hb Hv Hve).
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    apply typing_record_read_readonly with (a:=a) (T:=T).
    apply (IHtyping z u U Hb Hv Hve).
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    eapply typing_record_write with (a:=a) (T:=T).
    + apply (IHtyping1 z u U Hb Hv Hve).
    + apply (IHtyping2 z u U Hb Hv Hve).
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    apply typing_record_empty; assumption.
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    eapply typing_record_exp with (a:=a) (T:=T).
    + rewrite (record_dom_subst_fvar r z u). exact n.
    + apply (IHtyping z u U Hb Hv Hve).
    + apply (IHtyping0 z u U Hb Hv Hve).
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    eapply typing_record_ref with (a:=a) (T:=T).
    + rewrite (record_dom_subst_fvar r z u). exact n.
    + apply (IHtyping z u U Hb Hv Hve).
    + exact b.
Qed.

Definition subst_tvar_binding (X : atom) (U : typ) (b : binding) : binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub T => bind_sub (subst_tvar_t X U T)
  | bind_typ T => bind_typ (subst_tvar_t X U T)
  end.

Definition subst_tvar_env (X : atom) (U : typ) (E : env) : env :=
  List.map (fun p => (fst p, subst_tvar_binding X U (snd p))) E.

Definition subst_tvar_sig_entry (X : atom) (U : typ) (s : signature) : signature :=
  match s with bind_sig T => bind_sig (subst_tvar_t X U T) end.

Definition subst_tvar_sig (X : atom) (U : typ) (R : sig) : sig :=
  List.map (fun p => (fst p, subst_tvar_sig_entry X U (snd p))) R.

Lemma dom_subst_tvar_env : forall X U E, dom (subst_tvar_env X U E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros X U E. induction E as [|[y b] E IH]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma dom_subst_tvar_sig : forall X U R, Signatures.dom (subst_tvar_sig X U R) = Signatures.dom R.
Proof.
  intros X U R. induction R as [|[l s] R IH]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_subst_tvar_env : forall X U E y b,
  binds y b E -> binds y (subst_tvar_binding X U b) (subst_tvar_env X U E).
Proof.
  intros X U E. induction E as [|[y' b'] E IH]; intros y b Hb.
  - apply binds_nil_iff in Hb. destruct Hb.
  - simpl. apply binds_cons_iff in Hb.
    destruct Hb as [[Heq1 Heq2] | Hb].
    + subst. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity.
    + apply binds_cons_3. apply IH. exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma binds_subst_tvar_sig : forall X U R l T,
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig (subst_tvar_t X U T)) (subst_tvar_sig X U R).
Proof.
  intros X U R. induction R as [|[l' s] R IH]; intros l T Hb.
  - inversion Hb.
  - simpl in Hb. destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. simpl. left. reflexivity.
    + simpl. right. apply IH. exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_subst_tvar : forall E T, wf_typ E T ->
  forall X U, type U -> wf_typ (subst_tvar_env X U E) U ->
    wf_typ (subst_tvar_env X U E) (subst_tvar_t X U T).
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction H; intros Xs Us HUs HwtUs; simpl.
  - apply wf_typ_top.
  - destruct (aeq Xs X) as [Heq | Hne].
    + subst. exact HwtUs.
    + apply wf_typ_var with (U:=subst_tvar_t Xs Us U). exact (binds_subst_tvar_env Xs Us E X (bind_sub U) H).
  - apply wf_typ_arrow.
    + apply (IHwf_typ1 Xs Us HUs HwtUs).
    + apply (IHwf_typ2 Xs Us HUs HwtUs).
  - apply wf_typ_all with (L := L `union` {{Xs}}).
    + apply (IHwf_typ Xs Us HUs HwtUs).
    + intros Y HY.
      pose proof HY as HYL. apply notin_union_1 in HYL.
      pose proof HY as HYS. apply notin_union_2 in HYS.
      pose proof (notin_singleton_1 Xs Y HYS) as Hne.
      assert (HfvY : Xs `notin` ftv_t (typ_fvar Y)).
      { simpl. apply notin_singleton. intro Heq. apply Hne. symmetry. exact Heq. }
      assert (HwtUs' : wf_typ (Y ~ bind_sub (subst_tvar_t Xs Us T1) ++ subst_tvar_env Xs Us E) Us).
      { eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; [exact HwtUs |].
        intros Z c HZ. apply binds_cons_3. exact HZ. }
      pose proof (H1 Y HYL Xs Us HUs HwtUs') as Hbody.
      unfold open_tt in Hbody.
      rewrite (subst_tvar_t_open_tt_comm T2 Xs Us 0 (typ_fvar Y) (type_tlc Us HUs) HfvY) in Hbody.
      exact Hbody.
  - apply wf_typ_box. apply (IHwf_typ Xs Us HUs HwtUs).
  - apply wf_typ_readonly. apply (IHwf_typ Xs Us HUs HwtUs).
  - apply wf_typ_intersect.
    + apply (IHwf_typ1 Xs Us HUs HwtUs).
    + apply (IHwf_typ2 Xs Us HUs HwtUs).
  - apply wf_typ_record. apply (IHwf_typ Xs Us HUs HwtUs).
Qed.

Lemma notin_ftv_typ_fvar : forall X Y, X <> Y -> X `notin` ftv_t (typ_fvar Y).
Proof.
  intros X Y Hne. simpl. apply notin_singleton.
  intro HYX. apply Hne. symmetry. exact HYX.
Qed.

Lemma sub_refl_wf : forall E T, wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> sub E T T.
Proof.
  intros E T Hwf Hwt. revert Hwf. induction Hwt; intros Hwf.
  - apply sub_top; [exact Hwf | apply wf_typ_top].
  - apply sub_refl_tvar; [exact Hwf | apply wf_typ_var with (U:=U); exact H].
  - apply sub_arrow; [apply IHHwt1; exact Hwf | apply IHHwt2; exact Hwf].
  - apply sub_all with (L := L `union` dom E).
    + apply (IHHwt Hwf).
    + intros X HX.
      pose proof HX as HXL. apply notin_union_1 in HXL.
      pose proof HX as HXD. apply notin_union_2 in HXD.
      assert (HwfX : wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E)).
      { apply wf_env_sub; assumption. }
      apply (H0 X HXL HwfX).
  - apply sub_box; [apply IHHwt; exact Hwf | apply IHHwt; exact Hwf].
  - apply sub_readonly. apply IHHwt; exact Hwf.
  - apply sub_inter with (T1:=typ_int T1 T2).
    + apply sub_inter_left; [exact Hwf | exact Hwt1 | exact Hwt2].
    + apply sub_inter_right; [exact Hwf | exact Hwt1 | exact Hwt2].
  - apply sub_record; [apply IHHwt; exact Hwf | apply IHHwt; exact Hwf].
Qed.

Definition env_sub_shape (E E' : env) : Prop :=
  forall Y U, binds Y (bind_sub U) E -> exists U', binds Y (bind_sub U') E'.

Lemma env_sub_shape_cons_sub : forall E E',
  env_sub_shape E E' ->
  forall X U V, env_sub_shape (X ~ bind_sub U ++ E) (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E').
Proof.
  intros E E' Hshape X U V Y W HY.
  apply binds_cons_iff in HY.
  destruct HY as [[Heq1 Heq2] | HY].
  - subst. exists V. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity.
  - destruct (Hshape Y W HY) as [W' HW'].
    exists W'. apply binds_cons_3. exact HW'.
Qed.

Lemma env_sub_shape_cons_typ : forall E E',
  env_sub_shape E E' ->
  forall X U V, env_sub_shape (X ~ bind_typ U ++ E) (X ~ bind_typ V ++ E').
Proof.
  intros E E' Hshape X U V Y W HY.
  apply binds_cons_iff in HY.
  destruct HY as [[Heq1 Heq2] | HY].
  - subst. inversion Heq2.
  - destruct (Hshape Y W HY) as [W' HW'].
    exists W'. apply binds_cons_3. exact HW'.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_env_sub_shape : forall E T, wf_typ E T ->
  forall E', env_sub_shape E E' -> wf_typ E' T.
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction H; intros E' Hshape.
  - apply wf_typ_top.
  - destruct (Hshape X U H) as [U' HU'].
    apply wf_typ_var with (U:=U'). exact HU'.
  - apply wf_typ_arrow.
    + apply (IHwf_typ1 E' Hshape).
    + apply (IHwf_typ2 E' Hshape).
  - apply wf_typ_all with (L:=L).
    + apply (IHwf_typ E' Hshape).
    + intros X HX.
      pose proof (H1 X HX (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E')) as HB.
      apply HB. apply env_sub_shape_cons_sub; exact Hshape.
  - apply wf_typ_box. apply (IHwf_typ E' Hshape).
  - apply wf_typ_readonly. apply (IHwf_typ E' Hshape).
  - apply wf_typ_intersect; [apply (IHwf_typ1 E' Hshape) | apply (IHwf_typ2 E' Hshape)].
  - apply wf_typ_record. apply (IHwf_typ E' Hshape).
Qed.

Lemma env_sub_shape_refl : forall E, env_sub_shape E E.
Proof.
  intros E Y U HY. exists U. exact HY.
Qed.

Lemma sub_wf_typ : forall E A B, sub E A B -> wf_typ E A /\ wf_typ E B.
Proof.
  intros E A B H. induction H.
  - split; [assumption | apply wf_typ_top].
  - split; assumption.
  - split.
    + apply wf_typ_var with (U:=U). exact H.
    + apply IHsub.
  - split.
    + apply wf_typ_arrow; [apply (proj2 IHsub1) | apply (proj1 IHsub2)].
    + apply wf_typ_arrow; [apply (proj1 IHsub1) | apply (proj2 IHsub2)].
  - split.
    + apply wf_typ_all with (L := L).
      * apply (proj2 IHsub).
      * intros X HX.
        apply (wf_typ_env_sub_shape _ _ (proj1 (H1 X HX))).
        apply env_sub_shape_cons_sub. apply env_sub_shape_refl.
    + apply wf_typ_all with (L := L).
      * apply (proj1 IHsub).
      * intros X HX. apply (proj2 (H1 X HX)).
  - split; [apply wf_typ_box; apply (proj1 IHsub1) | apply wf_typ_box; apply (proj1 IHsub2)].
  - split; [apply wf_typ_readonly; apply (proj1 IHsub) | apply wf_typ_readonly; apply (proj2 IHsub)].
  - split; [apply (proj1 IHsub) | apply wf_typ_readonly; apply (proj2 IHsub)].
  - split; [apply (proj1 IHsub1) | apply (proj2 IHsub2)].
  - split.
    + apply wf_typ_intersect; assumption.
    + assumption.
  - split.
    + apply wf_typ_intersect; assumption.
    + assumption.
  - split.
    + apply (proj1 IHsub1).
    + apply wf_typ_intersect; [apply (proj2 IHsub1) | apply (proj2 IHsub2)].
  - split; [apply wf_typ_record; apply (proj1 IHsub1) | apply wf_typ_record; apply (proj1 IHsub2)].
  - split; [apply wf_typ_readonly; apply wf_typ_record; apply (proj1 IHsub) | apply wf_typ_readonly; apply wf_typ_record; apply (proj2 IHsub)].
  - split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_subst_tvar_ctx : forall E T, wf_typ E T ->
  forall D E0 X U V,
    E = D ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E0 ->
    wf_env E ->
    subst_tvar_env X V E0 = E0 ->
    type V -> wf_typ E0 V ->
    wf_typ (subst_tvar_env X V D ++ E0) (subst_tvar_t X V T).
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction H; intros D E0 Xs Us Vs eq_refl HwfE HE0 HV HwtV.
  - subst E. apply wf_typ_top.
  - subst E. simpl.
    destruct (aeq Xs X) as [HeqX | HneX].
    + subst X.
      eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; [exact HwtV |].
      intros Z c HZ. apply binds_app_3. exact HZ.
    + apply wf_typ_var with (U:=subst_tvar_t Xs Vs U).
      apply binds_app_iff in H. destruct H as [HD | Hrest].
      * apply binds_app_2. exact (binds_subst_tvar_env Xs Vs D X (bind_sub U) HD).
      * apply binds_app_iff in Hrest. destruct Hrest as [Hhead | HE].
        -- apply binds_one_iff in Hhead. destruct Hhead as [HeqY HeqB].
           exfalso. apply HneX. symmetry. exact HeqY.
        -- rewrite <- HE0. apply binds_app_3. exact (binds_subst_tvar_env Xs Vs E0 X (bind_sub U) HE).
  - subst E. apply wf_typ_arrow.
    + apply (IHwf_typ1 D E0 Xs Us Vs eq_refl HwfE HE0 HV HwtV).
    + apply (IHwf_typ2 D E0 Xs Us Vs eq_refl HwfE HE0 HV HwtV).
  - subst E. apply wf_typ_all with
      (L := L `union` {{Xs}} `union` dom (D ++ Xs ~ bind_sub Us ++ E0)).
    + apply (IHwf_typ D E0 Xs Us Vs eq_refl HwfE HE0 HV HwtV).
    + intros Y HY.
      pose proof HY as HyL. apply notin_union_1 in HyL.
      pose proof HY as Hrest. apply notin_union_2 in Hrest.
      pose proof Hrest as HyS. apply notin_union_1 in HyS.
      pose proof Hrest as HyD. apply notin_union_2 in HyD.
      pose proof (notin_singleton_1 Xs Y HyS) as HneXY.
      assert (HwfSrcExt : wf_env (Y ~ bind_sub T1 ++ D ++ Xs ~ bind_sub Us ++ E0)).
      { apply wf_env_sub; [exact HwfE | exact H | exact HyD]. }
      pose proof (H1 Y HyL (Y ~ bind_sub T1 ++ D) E0 Xs Us Vs eq_refl HwfSrcExt HE0 HV HwtV) as Hbody.
      unfold open_tt in Hbody.
      rewrite (subst_tvar_t_open_tt_comm T2 Xs Vs 0 (typ_fvar Y)
        (type_tlc Vs HV) (notin_ftv_typ_fvar Xs Y HneXY)) in Hbody.
      exact Hbody.
  - subst E. apply wf_typ_box. apply (IHwf_typ D E0 Xs Us Vs eq_refl HwfE HE0 HV HwtV).
  - subst E. apply wf_typ_readonly. apply (IHwf_typ D E0 Xs Us Vs eq_refl HwfE HE0 HV HwtV).
  - subst E. apply wf_typ_intersect.
    + apply (IHwf_typ1 D E0 Xs Us Vs eq_refl HwfE HE0 HV HwtV).
    + apply (IHwf_typ2 D E0 Xs Us Vs eq_refl HwfE HE0 HV HwtV).
  - subst E. apply wf_typ_record. apply (IHwf_typ D E0 Xs Us Vs eq_refl HwfE HE0 HV HwtV).
Qed.

Lemma binds_subst_tvar_ctx_other : forall D E0 X U V y b,
  y <> X ->
  binds y b (D ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E0) ->
  subst_tvar_env X V E0 = E0 ->
  binds y (subst_tvar_binding X V b) (subst_tvar_env X V D ++ E0).
Proof.
  intros D E0 X U V y b Hne Hb HE0.
  apply binds_app_iff in Hb. destruct Hb as [HD | Hrest].
  - apply binds_app_2. exact (binds_subst_tvar_env X V D y b HD).
  - apply binds_app_iff in Hrest. destruct Hrest as [Hhead | HE].
    + apply binds_one_iff in Hhead. destruct Hhead as [HeqY HeqB].
      exfalso. apply Hne. exact HeqY.
    + rewrite <- HE0. apply binds_app_3.
      exact (binds_subst_tvar_env X V E0 y b HE).
Qed.

Fixpoint ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_forward (T : typ) :
    forall K Y X, X `notin` ftv_t T -> X <> Y ->
      X `notin` ftv_t (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Y) T)
with ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_backward (T : typ) :
    forall K Y X, X `notin` ftv_t (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Y) T) -> X <> Y ->
      X `notin` ftv_t T.
Proof.
  - destruct T as [|n|Z|A B|A B|A|m A|A B|a A]; intros K Y X Hfv Hne; simpl in *.
    + apply notin_empty.
    + destruct (K == n); simpl.
      * apply notin_singleton. intro Heq. apply Hne. symmetry. exact Heq.
      * apply notin_empty.
    + exact Hfv.
    + pose proof Hfv as H1. apply notin_union_1 in H1.
      pose proof Hfv as H2. apply notin_union_2 in H2.
      apply notin_union; [apply (ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_forward A K Y X H1 Hne) |
                        apply (ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_forward B K Y X H2 Hne)].
    + pose proof Hfv as H1. apply notin_union_1 in H1.
      pose proof Hfv as H2. apply notin_union_2 in H2.
      apply notin_union; [apply (ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_forward A K Y X H1 Hne) |
                        apply (ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_forward B (S K) Y X H2 Hne)].
    + apply ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_forward; assumption.
    + apply ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_forward; assumption.
    + pose proof Hfv as H1. apply notin_union_1 in H1.
      pose proof Hfv as H2. apply notin_union_2 in H2.
      apply notin_union; [apply (ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_forward A K Y X H1 Hne) |
                        apply (ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_forward B K Y X H2 Hne)].
    + apply ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_forward; assumption.
  - destruct T as [|n|Z|A B|A B|A|m A|A B|a A]; intros K Y X Hfv Hne; simpl in *.
    + exact Hfv.
    + destruct (K == n); simpl in *.
      * apply notin_empty.
      * exact Hfv.
    + exact Hfv.
    + apply notin_union.
      * apply (ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_backward A K Y X); [apply notin_union_1 in Hfv; exact Hfv | exact Hne].
      * apply (ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_backward B K Y X); [apply notin_union_2 in Hfv; exact Hfv | exact Hne].
    + apply notin_union.
      * apply (ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_backward A K Y X); [apply notin_union_1 in Hfv; exact Hfv | exact Hne].
      * apply (ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_backward B (S K) Y X); [apply notin_union_2 in Hfv; exact Hfv | exact Hne].
    + apply (ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_backward A K Y X Hfv Hne).
    + apply (ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_backward A K Y X Hfv Hne).
    + apply notin_union.
      * apply (ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_backward A K Y X); [apply notin_union_1 in Hfv; exact Hfv | exact Hne].
      * apply (ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_backward B K Y X); [apply notin_union_2 in Hfv; exact Hfv | exact Hne].
    + apply (ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_backward A K Y X Hfv Hne).
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_notin_dom_ftv : forall E T, wf_typ E T ->
  forall Xn, Xn `notin` dom E -> Xn `notin` ftv_t T.
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction H; intros Xn Hnotin; simpl.
  - apply notin_empty.
  - apply notin_singleton. intro Heq. subst Xn.
    pose proof (binds_In binding X (bind_sub U) E H) as Hin.
    exact (Hnotin Hin).
  - apply notin_union.
    + apply IHwf_typ1. exact Hnotin.
    + apply IHwf_typ2. exact Hnotin.
  - apply notin_union.
    + apply IHwf_typ. exact Hnotin.
    + destruct (atom_fresh (L `union` {{Xn}} `union` dom E)) as [Y HY].
      pose proof HY as HYL. apply notin_union_1 in HYL.
      pose proof HY as Hrest. apply notin_union_2 in Hrest.
      pose proof Hrest as HYS. apply notin_union_1 in HYS.
      pose proof Hrest as HYD. apply notin_union_2 in HYD.
      pose proof (notin_singleton_1 Xn Y HYS) as Hne.
      assert (HnotinY : Xn `notin` dom (Y ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E)).
      { simpl. apply notin_add; [intro Heq; apply Hne; symmetry; exact Heq | exact Hnotin]. }
      pose proof (H1 Y HYL Xn HnotinY) as Hbody.
      apply (ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_backward T2 0 Y Xn); assumption.
  - apply IHwf_typ. exact Hnotin.
  - apply IHwf_typ. exact Hnotin.
  - apply notin_union.
    + apply IHwf_typ1. exact Hnotin.
    + apply IHwf_typ2. exact Hnotin.
  - apply IHwf_typ. exact Hnotin.
Qed.


Lemma wf_env_cons_inv : forall y b D', wf_env ((y,b) :: D') ->
  wf_env D' /\
  (forall T, b = bind_sub T -> wf_typ D' T) /\
  (forall T, b = bind_typ T -> wf_typ D' T) /\
  y `notin` dom D'.
Proof.
  intros y b D' H. inversion H; subst.
  - split; [exact H3 | split; [intros T0 Heq; inversion Heq; subst T0; exact H4 |
      split; [intros T0 Heq; inversion Heq | exact H5]]].
  - split; [exact H3 | split; [intros T0 Heq; inversion Heq |
      split; [intros T0 Heq; inversion Heq; subst T0; exact H4 | exact H5]]].
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_notin_tail : forall D X b E0,
  wf_env (D ++ X ~ b ++ E0) -> X `notin` dom E0.
Proof.
  induction D as [|[y b'] D IH]; intros X b E0 H.
  - simpl in H. pose proof (wf_env_cons_inv X b E0 H) as [_ [_ [_ Hnotin]]]. exact Hnotin.
  - simpl in H. pose proof (wf_env_cons_inv y b' (D ++ X ~ b ++ E0) H) as [Htail _].
    apply (IH X b E0 Htail).
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_wf_tail : forall D X U E0,
  wf_env (D ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E0) -> wf_typ E0 U.
Proof.
  induction D as [|[y b'] D IH]; intros X U E0 H.
  - simpl in H. pose proof (wf_env_cons_inv X (bind_sub U) E0 H) as [_ [Hsub _]].
    apply (Hsub U eq_refl).
  - simpl in H. pose proof (wf_env_cons_inv y b' (D ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E0) H) as [Htail _].
    apply (IH X U E0 Htail).
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_notin_prefix : forall D X b E0,
  wf_env (D ++ X ~ b ++ E0) -> X `notin` dom D.
Proof.
  induction D as [|[y b'] D IH]; intros X b E0 H.
  - simpl. apply notin_empty.
  - simpl in H. pose proof (wf_env_cons_inv y b' (D ++ X ~ b ++ E0) H) as [Htail [_ [_ Hfresh]]].
    pose proof (IH X b E0 Htail) as HXD.
    simpl. apply notin_add.
    + intro Heq.
      assert (Hin : X `in` dom (D ++ X ~ b ++ E0)).
      { apply binds_In with (A:=binding) (x:=X) (a:=b).
        apply binds_app_3. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity. }
      apply Hfresh. rewrite Heq. exact Hin.
    + exact HXD.
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_binds_top_sub : forall D X U E0 U0,
  wf_env (D ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E0) ->
  binds X (bind_sub U0) (D ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E0) -> U0 = U.
Proof.
  induction D as [|[y b'] D IH]; intros X U E0 U0 H Hb.
  - simpl in Hb. apply binds_cons_iff in Hb. destruct Hb as [Hhead | HE].
    + destruct Hhead as [_ Heq]. inversion Heq. reflexivity.
    + pose proof (wf_env_notin_tail nil X (bind_sub U) E0 H) as Hnotin.
      pose proof (binds_In binding X (bind_sub U0) E0 HE) as Hin.
      exfalso. exact (Hnotin Hin).
  - simpl in H. pose proof (wf_env_cons_inv y b' (D ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E0) H) as [Htail [_ [_ Hfresh]]].
    simpl in Hb. apply binds_cons_iff in Hb. destruct Hb as [[HeqY HeqB] | Hb].
    + subst y. exfalso.
      assert (Hin : X `in` dom (D ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E0)).
      { apply binds_In with (A:=binding) (x:=X) (a:=bind_sub U).
        apply binds_app_3. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity. }
      exact (Hfresh Hin).
    + apply (IH X U E0 U0 Htail Hb).
Qed.

Lemma merge_mutability_nf : forall U M,
  normal_form_typing U = U ->
  normal_form_typing (merge_mutability U M) = merge_mutability U M.
Proof.
  intros U. induction U; intros M Hnf; simpl in *.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - injection Hnf as H1 H2. simpl. rewrite H1, H2. reflexivity.
  - injection Hnf as H1 H2. simpl. rewrite H1, H2. reflexivity.
  - injection Hnf as H1. simpl. rewrite H1. reflexivity.
  - exact Hnf.
  - injection Hnf as H1 H2. simpl.
    rewrite (IHU1 M H1), (IHU2 M H2). reflexivity.
  - injection Hnf as H1. simpl. rewrite H1. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma normal_form_typing_idem : forall T,
  normal_form_typing (normal_form_typing T) = normal_form_typing T.
Proof.
  intros T. induction T.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - change (typ_arrow (normal_form_typing (normal_form_typing T1))
              (normal_form_typing (normal_form_typing T2))
            = typ_arrow (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2)).
    rewrite IHT1, IHT2. reflexivity.
  - change (typ_all (normal_form_typing (normal_form_typing T1))
              (normal_form_typing (normal_form_typing T2))
            = typ_all (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2)).
    rewrite IHT1, IHT2. reflexivity.
  - change (typ_box (normal_form_typing (normal_form_typing T))
            = typ_box (normal_form_typing T)).
    rewrite IHT. reflexivity.
  - change (normal_form_typing (merge_mutability (normal_form_typing T) m)
            = merge_mutability (normal_form_typing T) m).
    apply merge_mutability_nf. exact IHT.
  - change (typ_int (normal_form_typing (normal_form_typing T1))
              (normal_form_typing (normal_form_typing T2))
            = typ_int (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2)).
    rewrite IHT1, IHT2. reflexivity.
  - change (typ_record a (normal_form_typing (normal_form_typing T))
            = typ_record a (normal_form_typing T)).
    rewrite IHT. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_merge_mutability : forall E U, wf_typ E U ->
  forall M, wf_typ E (merge_mutability U M).
Proof.
  intros E U H. induction H; intros M; simpl.
  - apply wf_typ_top.
  - destruct M. apply wf_typ_readonly. apply wf_typ_var with (U:=U). exact H.
  - apply wf_typ_arrow; [apply (IHwf_typ1 M) | apply (IHwf_typ2 M)].
  - apply wf_typ_all with (L:=L).
    + exact H.
    + intros X HX. apply (H0 X HX).
  - destruct M. apply wf_typ_readonly. apply wf_typ_box. exact H.
  - exact H.
  - apply wf_typ_intersect; [apply (IHwf_typ1 M) | apply (IHwf_typ2 M)].
  - destruct M. apply wf_typ_readonly. apply wf_typ_record. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_normal_form_typing : forall E T, wf_typ E T ->
  wf_typ E (normal_form_typing T).
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction H; simpl.
  - apply wf_typ_top.
  - apply wf_typ_var with (U:=U). exact H.
  - apply wf_typ_arrow; assumption.
  - apply wf_typ_all with (L:=L); [exact IHHwt | intros X HX; apply (H0 X HX)].
  - apply wf_typ_box. exact IHHwt.
  - apply wf_typ_merge_mutability. exact IHHwt.
  - apply wf_typ_intersect; assumption.

From Stdlib Require Import Lia.
From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.

Fixpoint typ_size (T : typ) : nat :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => 1
  | typ_bvar _ => 1
  | typ_fvar _ => 1
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => S (typ_size T1 + typ_size T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => S (typ_size T1 + typ_size T2)
  | typ_box T => S (typ_size T)
  | typ_mut _ T => S (typ_size T)
  | typ_int T1 T2 => S (typ_size T1 + typ_size T2)
  | typ_record _ T => S (typ_size T)
  end.

Fixpoint exp_size (e : exp) : nat :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar _ => 1
  | exp_fvar _ => 1
  | exp_abs T e1 => S (typ_size T + exp_size e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => S (exp_size e1 + exp_size e2)
  | exp_tabs T e1 => S (typ_size T + exp_size e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 T => S (exp_size e1 + typ_size T)
  | exp_let e1 e2 => S (exp_size e1 + exp_size e2)
  | exp_box e1 => S (exp_size e1)
  | exp_unbox e1 => S (exp_size e1)
  | exp_set_box e1 e2 => S (exp_size e1 + exp_size e2)
  | exp_ref _ => 1
  | exp_seal e1 => S (exp_size e1)
  | exp_record r => S (rec_size r)
  | exp_record_read e1 _ => S (exp_size e1)
  | exp_record_write e1 _ e2 => S (exp_size e1 + exp_size e2)
  end
with rec_size (r : rec_comp) : nat :=
  match r with
  | rec_empty => 1
  | rec_exp _ e r1 => S (exp_size e + rec_size r1)
  | rec_ref _ _ r1 => S (rec_size r1)
  end.

Lemma typ_size_open_tt_rec : forall K U T,
  typ_size U <= 1 -> typ_size (open_tt_rec K U T) <= typ_size T.
Proof.
  intros K U T HU. revert K.
  induction T; intros K; simpl.
  - lia.
  - destruct (K == n); simpl; lia.
  - lia.
  - pose proof (IHT1 K). pose proof (IHT2 K). lia.
  - pose proof (IHT1 K). pose proof (IHT2 (S K)). lia.
  - pose proof (IHT K). lia.
  - pose proof (IHT K). lia.
  - pose proof (IHT1 K). pose proof (IHT2 K). lia.
  - pose proof (IHT K). lia.
Qed.

Lemma typ_size_open_tt : forall T (X:atom),
  typ_size (open_tt T (typ_fvar X)) <= typ_size T.
Proof.
  intros. apply typ_size_open_tt_rec. simpl. lia.
Qed.

with rec_size_open_te_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (r : rec_comp)

Proof.

    + lia.
    + pose proof (exp_size_open_te_rec K U e HU).
      pose proof (typ_size_open_tt_rec K U T HU). lia.
    + pose proof (exp_size_open_te_rec K U e1 HU).
      pose proof (exp_size_open_te_rec K U e2 HU). lia.
    + pose proof (exp_size_open_te_rec (S K) U e HU).
      pose proof (typ_size_open_tt_rec K U T HU). lia.
    + pose proof (exp_size_open_te_rec K U e1 HU).
      pose proof (typ_size_open_tt_rec K U T HU). lia.
    + pose proof (exp_size_open_te_rec K U e1 HU).
      pose proof (exp_size_open_te_rec K U e2 HU). lia.
    + pose proof (exp_size_open_te_rec K U e HU). lia.
    + pose proof (exp_size_open_te_rec K U e HU). lia.
    + pose proof (exp_size_open_te_rec K U e1 HU).
      pose proof (exp_size_open_te_rec K U e2 HU). lia.
    + lia.
    + pose proof (exp_size_open_te_rec K U e HU). lia.
    + pose proof (rec_size_open_te_rec K U r HU). lia.
    + pose proof (exp_size_open_te_rec K U e HU). lia.
    + pose proof (exp_size_open_te_rec K U e1 HU).
      pose proof (exp_size_open_te_rec K U e2 HU). lia.
  - destruct r as [ | a e r | a l r]; simpl.
    + lia.
    + pose proof (exp_size_open_te_rec K U e HU).
      pose proof (rec_size_open_te_rec K U r HU). lia.
    + pose proof (rec_size_open_te_rec K U r HU). lia.
Qed.

Fixpoint exp_size_open_ee_rec (K : nat) (u : exp) (e : exp)

with rec_size_open_ee_rec (K : nat) (u : exp) (r : rec_comp)

    + lia.
    + pose proof (exp_size_open_ee_rec (S K) u e HU). lia.
    + pose proof (exp_size_open_ee_rec K u e1 HU).
      pose proof (exp_size_open_ee_rec K u e2 HU). lia.
    + pose proof (exp_size_open_ee_rec K u e HU). lia.
    + pose proof (exp_size_open_ee_rec K u e1 HU). lia.
    + pose proof (exp_size_open_ee_rec K u e1 HU).
      pose proof (exp_size_open_ee_rec (S K) u e2 HU). lia.
    + pose proof (exp_size_open_ee_rec K u e HU). lia.
    + pose proof (exp_size_open_ee_rec K u e HU). lia.
    + pose proof (exp_size_open_ee_rec K u e1 HU).

    + pose proof (exp_size_open_ee_rec K u e HU). lia.
    + pose proof (rec_size_open_ee_rec K u r HU). lia.
    + pose proof (exp_size_open_ee_rec K u e HU). lia.

Lemma exp_size_open_ee : forall e (x:atom),
  exp_size (open_ee e (exp_fvar x)) <= exp_size e.
Proof.
  intros. unfold open_ee. apply exp_size_open_ee_rec. simpl. lia.
Qed.

Lemma exp_size_open_te : forall e (X:atom),
  exp_size (open_te e (typ_fvar X)) <= exp_size e.
Proof.
  intros. unfold open_te. apply exp_size_open_te_rec. simpl. lia.
Qed.

(* ================= locally-closed term-level predicate ================= *)
Fixpoint lc_at (k : nat) (e : exp) : Prop :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => i < k
  | exp_fvar _ => True
  | exp_abs T e1 => lc_at (S k) e1
  | exp_app e1 e2 => lc_at k e1 /\ lc_at k e2
  | exp_tabs T e1 => lc_at k e1
  | exp_tapp e1 T => lc_at k e1
  | exp_let e1 e2 => lc_at k e1 /\ lc_at (S k) e2
  | exp_box e1 => lc_at k e1
  | exp_unbox e1 => lc_at k e1
  | exp_set_box e1 e2 => lc_at k e1 /\ lc_at k e2
  | exp_ref _ => True
  | exp_seal e1 => lc_at k e1
  | exp_record r => lc_at_rec k r
  | exp_record_read e1 _ => lc_at k e1
  | exp_record_write e1 _ e2 => lc_at k e1 /\ lc_at k e2
  end
with lc_at_rec (k : nat) (r : rec_comp) : Prop :=
  match r with
  | rec_empty => True
  | rec_exp _ e r1 => lc_at k e /\ lc_at_rec k r1
  | rec_ref _ _ r1 => lc_at_rec k r1
  end.

Fixpoint lc_at_weaken (e : exp) : forall k k', k <= k' -> lc_at k e -> lc_at k' e
with lc_at_rec_weaken (r : rec_comp) :
    forall k k', k <= k' -> lc_at_rec k r -> lc_at_rec k' r.
Proof.
  - intros k k' Hle H.
    destruct e as [n | x | T e | e1 e2 | T e | e1 T | e1 e2 | e | e | e1 e2 | l | e | r | e a | e1 a e2]; simpl in *.
    + lia.
    + auto.
    + apply lc_at_weaken with (S k); [lia | assumption].
    + destruct H as [H1 H2]; split.
      * apply lc_at_weaken with k; [exact Hle | exact H1].
      * apply lc_at_weaken with k; [exact Hle | exact H2].
    + apply lc_at_weaken with k; [exact Hle | assumption].
    + apply lc_at_weaken with k; [exact Hle | assumption].
    + destruct H as [H1 H2]; split.
      * apply lc_at_weaken with k; [exact Hle | exact H1].
      * apply lc_at_weaken with (S k); [lia | exact H2].
    + apply lc_at_weaken with k; [exact Hle | assumption].
    + apply lc_at_weaken with k; [exact Hle | assumption].
    + destruct H as [H1 H2]; split.
      * apply lc_at_weaken with k; [exact Hle | exact H1].
      * apply lc_at_weaken with k; [exact Hle | exact H2].
    + auto.
    + apply lc_at_weaken with k; [exact Hle | assumption].
    + apply lc_at_rec_weaken with k; [exact Hle | assumption].
    + apply lc_at_weaken with k; [exact Hle | assumption].
    + destruct H as [H1 H2]; split.
      * apply lc_at_weaken with k; [exact Hle | exact H1].
      * apply lc_at_weaken with k; [exact Hle | exact H2].
  - intros k k' Hle H.
    destruct r as [ | a e r | a l r]; simpl in *.
    + auto.
    + destruct H as [H1 H2]; split.
      * apply lc_at_weaken with k; [exact Hle | exact H1].
      * apply lc_at_rec_weaken with k; [exact Hle | exact H2].
    + apply lc_at_rec_weaken with k; [exact Hle | assumption].
Qed.

(* open_te does not change term-level lc *)

    forall K U k, lc_at k e <-> lc_at k (open_te_rec K U e)

    forall K U k, lc_at_rec k r <-> lc_at_rec k (open_te_record_rec K U r).
Proof.

    destruct e as [n | x | T e | e1 e2 | T e | e1 T | e1 e2 | e | e | e1 e2 | l | e | r | e a | e1 a e2]; simpl.
    + tauto.
    + tauto.
    + apply lc_at_open_te.
    + destruct (lc_at_open_te e1 K U k) as [A B]; destruct (lc_at_open_te e2 K U k) as [C D]; tauto.
    + apply lc_at_open_te.
    + apply lc_at_open_te.
    + destruct (lc_at_open_te e1 K U k) as [A B]; destruct (lc_at_open_te e2 K U (S k)) as [C D]; tauto.

    + apply lc_at_open_te.
    + destruct (lc_at_open_te e1 K U k) as [A B]; destruct (lc_at_open_te e2 K U k) as [C D]; tauto.

    + apply lc_at_open_te.
    + apply lc_at_rec_open_te.
    + apply lc_at_open_te.
    + destruct (lc_at_open_te e1 K U k) as [A B]; destruct (lc_at_open_te e2 K U k) as [C D]; tauto.

    + destruct (lc_at_open_te e K U k) as [A B]; destruct (lc_at_rec_open_te r K U k) as [C D]; tauto.

Fixpoint lc_at_open_ee_inv (e : exp) :

Fixpoint lc_at_open_ee_subst (e : exp) :
    forall k u, lc_at (S k) e -> lc_at 0 u -> lc_at k (open_ee_rec k u e)
with lc_at_rec_open_ee_subst (r : rec_comp) :

    + destruct H as [H1 H2]; split; [apply lc_at_open_ee_subst with (k:=k) (u:=u) | apply lc_at_open_ee_subst with (k:=S k) (u:=u)]; auto.

      rewrite lc_at_open_id with (k:=k) (K:=K) (v:=v); [| exact H1 | exact Hk].
      rewrite lc_at_rec_open_id with (k:=k) (K:=K) (v:=v); [reflexivity | exact H2 | exact Hk].
    + rewrite lc_at_rec_open_id with (k:=k) (K:=K) (v:=v); [reflexivity | assumption | exact Hk].
Qed.

Lemma open_ee_lc0_id : forall u K v, lc_at 0 u -> open_ee_rec K v u = u.
Proof.
  intros. apply lc_at_open_id with (k:=0); auto; lia.
Qed.

Lemma open_ee_lc0_id_sym : forall u K v, lc_at 0 u -> u = open_ee_rec K v u.
Proof.
  intros. symmetry. apply open_ee_lc0_id with (K:=K) (v:=v); auto.
Qed.

Definition body_te (e:exp) := exists L, forall X:atom, X `notin` L -> expr (open_te e X).
Lemma expr_abs_inv : forall T e1, expr (exp_abs T e1) -> type T /\ body_e e1.
