Lemma wf_typ_type : forall E T, wf_typ E T -> type T.
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction H; simpl.
  - apply type_top.
  - apply type_var.
  - apply type_arrow; assumption.
  - apply type_all with (L:=L); [assumption |].
    intros X HX. apply H1; assumption.
  - apply type_box; assumption.
  - apply type_readonly; assumption.
  - apply type_intersect; assumption.
  - apply type_record; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma sub_type : forall E A B, sub E A B -> type A /\ type B.
Proof.
  intros E A B H. induction H.
  - split; [eapply wf_typ_type; eassumption | apply type_top].
  - split; [apply type_var | apply type_var].
  - split; [apply type_var | apply (proj2 IHsub)].
  - split.
    + apply type_arrow; [apply (proj2 IHsub1) | apply (proj1 IHsub2)].
    + apply type_arrow; [apply (proj1 IHsub1) | apply (proj2 IHsub2)].
  - split.
    + apply type_all with (L:=L); [apply (proj2 IHsub) |].
      intros X HX. apply (proj1 (H1 X HX)).
    + apply type_all with (L:=L); [apply (proj1 IHsub) |].
      intros X HX. apply (proj2 (H1 X HX)).
  - split.
    + apply type_box; apply (proj1 IHsub1).
    + apply type_box; apply (proj1 IHsub2).
  - split; [apply type_readonly; apply (proj1 IHsub) | apply type_readonly; apply (proj2 IHsub)].
  - split; [apply (proj1 IHsub) | apply type_readonly; apply (proj2 IHsub)].
  - split; [apply (proj1 IHsub1) | apply (proj2 IHsub2)].
  - split; [apply type_intersect; eapply wf_typ_type; eassumption | eapply wf_typ_type; eassumption].
  - split; [apply type_intersect; eapply wf_typ_type; eassumption | eapply wf_typ_type; eassumption].
  - split; [apply (proj1 IHsub1) | apply type_intersect; [apply (proj2 IHsub1) | apply (proj2 IHsub2)]].
  - split.
    + apply type_record; apply (proj1 IHsub1).
    + apply type_record; apply (proj1 IHsub2).
  - split; [apply type_readonly; apply type_record; apply (proj1 IHsub) |
             apply type_readonly; apply type_record; apply (proj2 IHsub)].
  - split; [eapply wf_typ_type; eassumption | eapply wf_typ_type; eassumption].
Qed.

Lemma typing_expr : forall E R e T, typing E R e T -> expr e.
Proof.
  intros E R e T H.
  induction H using typing_mut with
    (P0 := fun E R r T (h:typing_record_comp E R r T) => record_comp r).
  - apply expr_var.
  - destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx].
    pose proof (typing_wf_env (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) R (open_ee e1 x) T1 (t x Hx)) as HwfE.
    inversion HwfE; subst.
    apply expr_abs with (L:=L).
    + eapply wf_typ_type; eassumption.
    + intros y Hy. apply H; exact Hy.
  - apply expr_app; assumption.
  - destruct (atom_fresh L) as [X HX].
    pose proof (typing_wf_env (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) R (open_te e1 X) (open_tt T1 X) (t X HX)) as HwfE.
    inversion HwfE; subst.
    apply expr_tabs with (L:=L).
    + eapply wf_typ_type; eassumption.
    + intros Y HY. apply H; exact HY.
  - apply expr_tapp; [assumption | apply (proj1 (sub_type E T T1 s))].
  - assumption.
  - destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx].
    apply expr_let with (L:=L); [assumption |].
    intros y Hy. apply H0; exact Hy.
  - apply expr_box; assumption.
  - apply expr_unbox; assumption.
  - apply expr_set_box; assumption.
  - apply expr_ref.
  - apply expr_seal; assumption.
  - apply expr_unbox; assumption.
  - apply expr_record; assumption.
  - apply expr_record_read; assumption.
  - apply expr_record_read; assumption.
  - apply expr_record_write; assumption.
  - apply record_comp_empty.
  - apply record_comp_exp; assumption.
  - apply record_comp_ref; assumption.
Qed.

Fixpoint maybe_box (T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => False
  | typ_bvar _ => False
  | typ_fvar _ => True
  | typ_arrow _ _ => False
  | typ_all _ _ => False
  | typ_box _ => True
  | typ_mut _ _ => False
  | typ_int A B => maybe_box A \/ maybe_box B
  | typ_record _ _ => True
  end.

Lemma maybe_box_merge_false : forall U m, maybe_box (merge_mutability U m) -> False.
Proof.
  induction U as [|n|X|A B|A B|A|m0 A|A B|a A]; intros m H; simpl in *; try exact H.
  - (* int *) destruct H as [H | H]; [apply B in H | apply IHU1 in H]; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma maybe_box_nf : forall T, maybe_box (normal_form_typing T) <-> maybe_box T.
Proof.
  induction T; simpl.
  - tauto.
  - tauto.
  - tauto.
  - tauto.
  - tauto.
  - tauto.
  - split; intros H; [exfalso; eapply maybe_box_merge_false; eauto | destruct H].
  - split; intros [H | H]; [left; apply IHT1 | right; apply IHT2 | left; apply IHT1 | right; apply IHT2]; assumption.
  - tauto.
Qed.

Lemma maybe_box_sub : forall E A B, sub E A B -> maybe_box B -> maybe_box A.
Proof.
  intros E A B H. induction H; intros HB.
  - destruct HB.
  - exact I.
  - exact I.
  - destruct HB.
  - destruct HB.
  - exact I.
  - destruct HB.
  - destruct HB.
  - apply IHsub1. apply IHsub2. exact HB.
  - left. exact HB.
  - right. exact HB.
  - destruct HB as [HB | HB]; [apply IHsub1 in HB | apply IHsub2 in HB]; exact HB.
  - exact I.
  - destruct HB.
  - apply (proj1 (maybe_box_nf T1)). apply IHsub. apply (proj2 (maybe_box_nf T2)). exact HB.
Qed.

Lemma sub_readonly_not_box : forall E S T,
  sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly S) (typ_box T) -> False.
Proof.
  intros E S T H. apply (maybe_box_sub E _ _ H). exact I.
Qed.

Lemma sub_readonly_not_record : forall E S a T,
  sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly S) (typ_record a T) -> False.
Proof.
  intros E S a T H. apply (maybe_box_sub E _ _ H). exact I.
Qed.

Lemma typing_seal_not_box : forall E R e T,
  typing E R (exp_seal e) (typ_box T) -> False.
Proof.
  intros E R e T H.
  destruct (typing_seal_inv E R e (typ_box T) H) as [S [Ht [Heq | Hsub]]].
  - inversion Heq.
  - eapply sub_readonly_not_box; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma typing_seal_not_record : forall E R e a T,
  typing E R (exp_seal e) (typ_record a T) -> False.
Proof.
  intros E R e a T H.
  destruct (typing_seal_inv E R e (typ_record a T) H) as [S [Ht [Heq | Hsub]]].
  - inversion Heq.
  - eapply sub_readonly_not_record; eauto.
Qed.

Fixpoint remove_atom (x : atom) (E : env) {struct E} : env :=
  match E with
  | nil => nil
  | (y,b) :: E' => if aeq x y then E' else (y,b) :: remove_atom x E'
  end.

Lemma remove_atom_cons_neq : forall x y b E, x <> y ->
  remove_atom x ((y,b) :: E) = (y,b) :: remove_atom x E.
Proof.
  intros x y b E Hne. simpl. destruct (aeq x y) as [Heq | Hne2]; [exfalso; auto | reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma remove_atom_cons_eq : forall x b E,
  remove_atom x ((x,b) :: E) = E.
Proof.
  intros. simpl. destruct (aeq x x); [reflexivity | exfalso; auto].
Qed.

Lemma binds_remove_atom_other : forall x y b E,
  x <> y -> binds y b (remove_atom x E) <-> binds y b E.
Proof.
  intros x y b E Hne. induction E as [| [z c] E' IH]; simpl.
  - tauto.
  - destruct (aeq x z) as [Heq | Hneq].
    + subst z. split; intro H.
      * apply binds_cons. exact H.
      * apply binds_cons_iff in H. destruct H as [[Hy Hc] | H].
        -- subst. exfalso; apply Hne; reflexivity.
        -- exact H.
    + split; intro H.
      * apply binds_cons_iff in H. destruct H as [[Hy Hc] | H].
        -- subst. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity.
        -- apply binds_cons. apply (proj1 IH). exact H.
      * apply binds_cons_iff in H. destruct H as [[Hy Hc] | H].
        -- subst. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity.
        -- apply binds_cons. apply (proj2 IH). exact H.
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_binds_fun : forall E, wf_env E ->
  forall z b1 b2, binds z b1 E -> binds z b2 E -> b1 = b2.
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H; intros z b1 b2 K1 K2.
  - apply binds_nil_iff in K1. destruct K1.
  - apply binds_cons_iff in K1. apply binds_cons_iff in K2.
    destruct K1 as [[Heq1 Hb1] | K1]; destruct K2 as [[Heq2 Hb2] | K2].
    + subst. reflexivity.
    + subst. exfalso. eapply binds_dom_contradiction; eauto.
    + subst. exfalso. eapply binds_dom_contradiction; eauto.
    + exact (IHwf_env z b1 b2 K1 K2).
  - apply binds_cons_iff in K1. apply binds_cons_iff in K2.
    destruct K1 as [[Heq1 Hb1] | K1]; destruct K2 as [[Heq2 Hb2] | K2].
    + subst. reflexivity.
    + subst. exfalso. eapply binds_dom_contradiction; eauto.
    + subst. exfalso. eapply binds_dom_contradiction; eauto.
    + exact (IHwf_env z b1 b2 K1 K2).
Qed.

Lemma wf_sig_weaken_binds : forall E R, wf_sig E R ->
  forall E', wf_env E' -> (forall X b, binds X b E -> binds X b E') -> wf_sig E' R.
Proof.
  intros E R H. induction H; intros E' Hwf' Hb.
  - apply wf_sig_empty. exact Hwf'.
  - apply wf_sig_typ.
    + apply IHwf_sig; assumption.
    + apply wf_typ_weaken_binds with (E:=E); assumption.
    + assumption.
Qed.

Lemma typing_wf_sig : forall E R e T, typing E R e T -> wf_sig E R.
Proof.
  intros E R e T H.
  induction H using typing_mut with
    (P0 := fun E R r T (h:typing_record_comp E R r T) => wf_sig E R).
  all: try assumption.
Qed.

Lemma sub_wf_env : forall E A B, sub E A B -> wf_env E.
Proof.
  intros E A B H. induction H; auto.
Qed.

Lemma sub_weaken_binds : forall E A B, sub E A B ->
  forall E', wf_env E' ->
  (forall X b, binds X b E -> binds X b E') ->
  sub E' A B.
Proof.
  intros E A B H.
  induction H; intros E' Hwf' Hb.
  - apply sub_top.
    + exact Hwf'.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; eassumption.
  - apply sub_refl_tvar.
    + exact Hwf'.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; eassumption.
  - apply sub_trans_tvar with (U:=U).
    + apply Hb. exact H.
    + apply IHsub. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
  - apply sub_arrow.
    + apply IHsub1. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
    + apply IHsub2. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
  - (* sub_all *)
    apply sub_all with (L := L `union` dom E').
    + apply IHsub. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
    + intros X HX.
      pose proof HX as HXL. apply notin_union_1 in HXL.
      pose proof HX as HXD. apply notin_union_2 in HXD.
      assert (HwfX : wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E)).
      { eapply sub_wf_env. apply H0. exact HXL. }
      assert (Hwt : wf_typ E T1).
      { inversion HwfX; subst; assumption. }
      assert (Hwt' : wf_typ E' T1).
      { eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; eassumption. }
      assert (HwfEE' : wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E')).
      { apply wf_env_sub; assumption. }
      apply (H1 X HXL (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E') HwfEE').
      intros Y c HY. apply binds_cons_iff in HY.
      destruct HY as [[HYe1 HYe2] | HY].
      * subst. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity.
      * apply binds_cons_3. apply Hb. exact HY.
  - apply sub_box.
    + apply IHsub1. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
    + apply IHsub2. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
  - apply sub_readonly. apply IHsub. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
  - apply sub_readonly_mutable. apply IHsub. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
  - eapply sub_trans.
    + apply IHsub1. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
    + apply IHsub2. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
  - apply sub_inter_left.
    + exact Hwf'.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; eassumption.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; eassumption.
  - apply sub_inter_right.
    + exact Hwf'.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; eassumption.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; eassumption.
  - apply sub_inter.
    + apply IHsub1. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
    + apply IHsub2. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
  - apply sub_record.
    + apply IHsub1. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
    + apply IHsub2. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
  - apply sub_readonly_record. apply IHsub. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
  - apply sub_denormalize.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; eassumption.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; eassumption.
    + apply IHsub. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma typing_weaken_binds_aux : forall E R e T, typing E R e T ->
  forall E', wf_env E' ->
  (forall X b, binds X b E -> binds X b E') ->
  wf_sig E' R -> typing E' R e T.
Proof.
  intros E R e T H.
  induction H using typing_mut with
    (P := fun E R e T (h:typing E R e T) =>
       forall E', wf_env E' ->
       (forall X b, binds X b E -> binds X b E') ->
       wf_sig E' R -> typing E' R e T)
    (P0 := fun E R r T (h:typing_record_comp E R r T) =>
       forall E', wf_env E' ->
       (forall X b, binds X b E -> binds X b E') ->
       wf_sig E' R -> typing_record_comp E' R r T).
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs. apply typing_var; [exact Hwf' | exact Hs | apply Hb; exact b].
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs.
    eapply typing_abs with (L := L `union` dom E').
    + exact Hs.
    + intros x Hx.
      pose proof Hx as HxL. apply notin_union_1 in HxL.
      pose proof Hx as HxD. apply notin_union_2 in HxD.
      pose proof (t x HxL) as Hbody.
      pose proof (typing_wf_env _ _ _ _ Hbody) as Hwfx.
      inversion Hwfx; subst.
      assert (Hwt' : wf_typ E' V).
      { eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; eassumption. }
      assert (Hwfx' : wf_env (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E')).
      { apply wf_env_typ; assumption. }
      assert (Hsx : wf_sig (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E') R).
      { eapply wf_sig_weaken_binds; [exact Hs | exact Hwfx' |].
        intros Y c HY. apply binds_cons_3. exact HY. }
      apply (H x HxL (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E') Hwfx').
      * intros Y c HY. apply binds_cons_iff in HY.
        destruct HY as [[HYe1 HYe2] | HY].
        -- subst. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity.
        -- apply binds_cons_3. apply Hb. exact HY.
      * exact Hsx.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs.
    eapply typing_app.
    + exact Hs.
    + apply IHtyping1; assumption.
    + apply IHtyping2; assumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs.
    eapply typing_tabs with (L := L `union` dom E').
    + exact Hs.
    + intros X HX.
      pose proof HX as HXL. apply notin_union_1 in HXL.
      pose proof HX as HXD. apply notin_union_2 in HXD.
      pose proof (t X HXL) as Hbody.
      pose proof (typing_wf_env _ _ _ _ Hbody) as HwfX.
      inversion HwfX; subst.
      assert (Hwt' : wf_typ E' V).
      { eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; eassumption. }
      assert (HwfX' : wf_env (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E')).
      { apply wf_env_sub; assumption. }
      assert (HsX : wf_sig (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E') R).
      { eapply wf_sig_weaken_binds; [exact Hs | exact HwfX' |].
        intros Y c HY. apply binds_cons_3. exact HY. }
      apply (H X HXL (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E') HwfX').
      * intros Y c HY. apply binds_cons_iff in HY.
        destruct HY as [[HYe1 HYe2] | HY].
        -- subst. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity.
        -- apply binds_cons_3. apply Hb. exact HY.
      * exact HsX.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs.
    apply typing_tapp with (T1:=T1).
    + exact Hs.
    + apply IHtyping; assumption.
    + eapply sub_weaken_binds; eassumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs.
    eapply typing_sub.
    + exact Hs.
    + apply IHtyping; assumption.
    + eapply sub_weaken_binds; eassumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs.
    eapply typing_let with (L := L `union` dom E').
    + exact Hs.
    + apply IHtyping; assumption.
    + intros x Hx.
      pose proof Hx as HxL. apply notin_union_1 in HxL.
      pose proof Hx as HxD. apply notin_union_2 in HxD.
      pose proof (t x HxL) as Hbody.
      pose proof (typing_wf_env _ _ _ _ Hbody) as Hwfx.
      inversion Hwfx; subst.
      assert (Hwt' : wf_typ E' T1).
      { eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; eassumption. }
      assert (Hwfx' : wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E')).
      { apply wf_env_typ; assumption. }
      assert (Hsx : wf_sig (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E') R).
      { eapply wf_sig_weaken_binds; [exact Hs | exact Hwfx' |].
        intros Y c HY. apply binds_cons_3. exact HY. }
      apply (H0 x HxL (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E') Hwfx').
      * intros Y c HY. apply binds_cons_iff in HY.
        destruct HY as [[HYe1 HYe2] | HY].
        -- subst. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity.
        -- apply binds_cons_3. apply Hb. exact HY.
      * exact Hsx.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs. apply typing_box with (T:=T). exact Hs. apply IHtyping; assumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs. apply typing_unbox with (T:=T). exact Hs. apply IHtyping; assumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs. apply typing_set_box with (T:=T).
    + exact Hs.
    + apply IHtyping1; assumption.
    + apply IHtyping2; assumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs. apply typing_ref with (T:=T); assumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs. apply typing_seal with (T:=T). apply IHtyping; assumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs. apply typing_unbox_readonly with (T:=T). apply IHtyping; assumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs. apply typing_record with (T:=T). apply IHtyping; assumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs. apply typing_record_read with (a:=a) (T:=T). apply IHtyping; assumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs. apply typing_record_read_readonly with (a:=a) (T:=T). apply IHtyping; assumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs. apply typing_record_write with (a:=a) (T:=T).
    + apply IHtyping1; assumption.
    + apply IHtyping2; assumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs. apply typing_record_empty; assumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs. apply typing_record_exp with (a:=a) (T:=T).
    + exact n.
    + apply IHtyping; assumption.
    + apply IHtyping0; assumption.
  - intros E' Hwf' Hb Hs. apply typing_record_ref with (a:=a) (T:=T).
    + exact n.
    + apply IHtyping; assumption.
    + exact b.
Qed.

Lemma typing_weaken_binds : forall E R e T, typing E R e T ->
  forall E', wf_env E' ->
  (forall X b, binds X b E -> binds X b E') ->
  typing E' R e T.
Proof.
  intros E R e T H E' Hwf' Hb.
  pose proof (typing_wf_sig _ _ _ _ H) as Hs.
  pose proof (wf_sig_weaken_binds _ _ Hs E' Hwf' Hb) as Hs'.
  eapply typing_weaken_binds_aux; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma record_dom_subst_fvar : forall r z u,
  record_dom (subst_fvar_r z u r) = record_dom r.
Proof.
  intros r. induction r; intros z u; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHr. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHr. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma typing_subst_fvar : forall E R e T, typing E R e T ->
  forall x v V, binds x (bind_typ V) E -> typing E R v V -> expr v ->
    typing E R (subst_fvar_e x v e) T.
Proof.
  intros E R e T H.
  induction H using typing_mut with
    (P := fun E R e T (h:typing E R e T) =>
       forall z u U, binds z (bind_typ U) E ->
         typing E R u U -> expr u -> typing E R (subst_fvar_e z u e) T)
    (P0 := fun E R r T (h:typing_record_comp E R r T) =>
       forall z u U, binds z (bind_typ U) E ->
         typing E R u U -> expr u -> typing_record_comp E R (subst_fvar_r z u r) T).
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve.
    simpl. destruct (aeq z x) as [Heq | Hne].
    + subst. assert (HbEq : bind_typ U = bind_typ T).
      { eapply wf_env_binds_fun; [exact w | exact Hb | exact b]. }
      inversion HbEq; subst. exact Hv.
    + apply typing_var; assumption.
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve.
    simpl.
    eapply typing_abs with (L := L `union` {{z}} `union` dom E).
    + exact w.
    + intros y Hy.
      pose proof Hy as HyL. apply notin_union_1 in HyL.
      pose proof Hy as Hout2. apply notin_union_2 in Hout2.
      pose proof Hout2 as HyS. apply notin_union_1 in HyS.
      pose proof Hout2 as HyD. apply notin_union_2 in HyD.
      pose proof (notin_singleton_1 z y HyS) as Hne.
      pose proof (t y HyL) as Hbody.
      pose proof (typing_wf_env _ _ _ _ Hbody) as Hwfbody.
      inversion Hwfbody; subst.
      assert (Hwfy : wf_env (y ~ bind_typ V ++ E)).
      { apply wf_env_typ; assumption. }
      assert (Hvy : typing (y ~ bind_typ V ++ E) R u U).
      { eapply typing_weaken_binds; [exact Hv | exact Hwfy |].
        intros Y c HY. apply binds_cons_3. exact HY. }
      assert (Hby : binds z (bind_typ U) (y ~ bind_typ V ++ E)).
      { apply binds_cons_3. exact Hb. }
      pose proof (H y HyL z u U Hby Hvy Hve) as Hres.
      change (typing (y ~ bind_typ V ++ E) R
        (open_ee_rec 0 (exp_fvar y) (subst_fvar_e z u e1)) T1).
      rewrite (subst_fvar_open_ee e1 0 z u y (expr_lc u Hve) Hne).
      exact Hres.
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    eapply typing_app.
    + exact w.
    + apply (IHtyping1 z u U Hb Hv Hve).
    + apply (IHtyping2 z u U Hb Hv Hve).
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    eapply typing_tabs with (L := L `union` {{z}} `union` dom E).
    + exact w.
    + intros X HX.
      pose proof HX as HXL. apply notin_union_1 in HXL.
      pose proof HX as Hout2. apply notin_union_2 in Hout2.
      pose proof Hout2 as HXD. apply notin_union_2 in HXD.
      pose proof (t X HXL) as Hbody.
      pose proof (typing_wf_env _ _ _ _ Hbody) as HwfX.
      inversion HwfX; subst.
      assert (HwfX' : wf_env (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E)).
      { apply wf_env_sub; assumption. }
      assert (HvX : typing (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) R u U).
      { eapply typing_weaken_binds; [exact Hv | exact HwfX' |].
        intros Y c HY. apply binds_cons_3. exact HY. }
      assert (HbX : binds z (bind_typ U) (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E)).
      { apply binds_cons_3. exact Hb. }
      pose proof (H X HXL z u U HbX HvX Hve) as Hres.
      change (typing (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) R
        (open_te_rec 0 (typ_fvar X) (subst_fvar_e z u e1)) (open_tt T1 X)).
      rewrite <- (subst_fvar_open_te e1 z u 0 (typ_fvar X) (expr_tlc_all u Hve)).
      exact Hres.
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    eapply typing_tapp with (T1:=T1).
    + exact w.
    + apply (IHtyping z u U Hb Hv Hve).
    + exact s.
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    eapply typing_sub with (S:=S).
    + exact w.
    + apply (IHtyping z u U Hb Hv Hve).
    + exact s.
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    eapply typing_let with (L := L `union` {{z}} `union` dom E).
    + exact w.
    + apply (IHtyping z u U Hb Hv Hve).
    + intros y Hy.
      pose proof Hy as HyL. apply notin_union_1 in HyL.
      pose proof Hy as Hout2. apply notin_union_2 in Hout2.
      pose proof Hout2 as HyS. apply notin_union_1 in HyS.
      pose proof Hout2 as HyD. apply notin_union_2 in HyD.
      pose proof (notin_singleton_1 z y HyS) as Hne.
      pose proof (t y HyL) as Hbody.
      pose proof (typing_wf_env _ _ _ _ Hbody) as Hwfbody.
      inversion Hwfbody; subst.
      assert (Hwfy : wf_env (y ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E)).
      { apply wf_env_typ; assumption. }
      assert (Hvy : typing (y ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E) R u U).
      { eapply typing_weaken_binds; [exact Hv | exact Hwfy |].
        intros Y c HY. apply binds_cons_3. exact HY. }
      assert (Hby : binds z (bind_typ U) (y ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E)).
      { apply binds_cons_3. exact Hb. }
      pose proof (H0 y HyL z u U Hby Hvy Hve) as Hres.
      change (typing (y ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E) R
        (open_ee_rec 0 (exp_fvar y) (subst_fvar_e z u e2)) T2).
      rewrite (subst_fvar_open_ee e2 0 z u y (expr_lc u Hve) Hne).
      exact Hres.
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    apply typing_box with (T:=T).
    + exact w.
    + apply (IHtyping z u U Hb Hv Hve).
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    apply typing_unbox with (T:=T).
    + exact w.
    + apply (IHtyping z u U Hb Hv Hve).
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    eapply typing_set_box with (T:=T).
    + exact w.
    + apply (IHtyping1 z u U Hb Hv Hve).
    + apply (IHtyping2 z u U Hb Hv Hve).
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    apply typing_ref with (T:=T); assumption.
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    apply typing_seal with (T:=T).
    apply (IHtyping z u U Hb Hv Hve).
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    apply typing_unbox_readonly with (T:=T).
    apply (IHtyping z u U Hb Hv Hve).
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    apply typing_record with (T:=T).
    apply (IHtyping z u U Hb Hv Hve).
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    apply typing_record_read with (a:=a) (T:=T).
    apply (IHtyping z u U Hb Hv Hve).
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    apply typing_record_read_readonly with (a:=a) (T:=T).
    apply (IHtyping z u U Hb Hv Hve).
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    eapply typing_record_write with (a:=a) (T:=T).
    + apply (IHtyping1 z u U Hb Hv Hve).
    + apply (IHtyping2 z u U Hb Hv Hve).
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    apply typing_record_empty; assumption.
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    eapply typing_record_exp with (a:=a) (T:=T).
    + rewrite (record_dom_subst_fvar r z u). exact n.
    + apply (IHtyping z u U Hb Hv Hve).
    + apply (IHtyping0 z u U Hb Hv Hve).
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve. simpl.
    eapply typing_record_ref with (a:=a) (T:=T).
    + rewrite (record_dom_subst_fvar r z u). exact n.
    + apply (IHtyping z u U Hb Hv Hve).
    + exact b.
Qed.

Definition subst_tvar_binding (X : atom) (U : typ) (b : binding) : binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub T => bind_sub (subst_tvar_t X U T)
  | bind_typ T => bind_typ (subst_tvar_t X U T)
  end.

Definition subst_tvar_env (X : atom) (U : typ) (E : env) : env :=
  List.map (fun p => (fst p, subst_tvar_binding X U (snd p))) E.

Definition subst_tvar_sig_entry (X : atom) (U : typ) (s : signature) : signature :=
  match s with bind_sig T => bind_sig (subst_tvar_t X U T) end.

Definition subst_tvar_sig (X : atom) (U : typ) (R : sig) : sig :=
  List.map (fun p => (fst p, subst_tvar_sig_entry X U (snd p))) R.

Lemma dom_subst_tvar_env : forall X U E, dom (subst_tvar_env X U E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros X U E. induction E as [|[y b] E IH]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma dom_subst_tvar_sig : forall X U R, Signatures.dom (subst_tvar_sig X U R) = Signatures.dom R.
Proof.
  intros X U R. induction R as [|[l s] R IH]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_subst_tvar_env : forall X U E y b,
  binds y b E -> binds y (subst_tvar_binding X U b) (subst_tvar_env X U E).
Proof.
  intros X U E. induction E as [|[y' b'] E IH]; intros y b Hb.
  - apply binds_nil_iff in Hb. destruct Hb.
  - simpl. apply binds_cons_iff in Hb.
    destruct Hb as [[Heq1 Heq2] | Hb].
    + subst. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity.
    + apply binds_cons_3. apply IH. exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma binds_subst_tvar_sig : forall X U R l T,
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig (subst_tvar_t X U T)) (subst_tvar_sig X U R).
Proof.
  intros X U R. induction R as [|[l' s] R IH]; intros l T Hb.
  - inversion Hb.
  - simpl in Hb. destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. simpl. left. reflexivity.
    + simpl. right. apply IH. exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_subst_tvar : forall E T, wf_typ E T ->
  forall X U, type U -> wf_typ (subst_tvar_env X U E) U ->
    wf_typ (subst_tvar_env X U E) (subst_tvar_t X U T).
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction H; intros Xs Us HUs HwtUs; simpl.
  - apply wf_typ_top.
  - destruct (aeq Xs X) as [Heq | Hne].
    + subst. exact HwtUs.
    + apply wf_typ_var with (U:=subst_tvar_t Xs Us U). exact (binds_subst_tvar_env Xs Us E X (bind_sub U) H).
  - apply wf_typ_arrow.
    + apply (IHwf_typ1 Xs Us HUs HwtUs).
    + apply (IHwf_typ2 Xs Us HUs HwtUs).
  - apply wf_typ_all with (L := L `union` {{Xs}}).
    + apply (IHwf_typ Xs Us HUs HwtUs).
    + intros Y HY.
      pose proof HY as HYL. apply notin_union_1 in HYL.
      pose proof HY as HYS. apply notin_union_2 in HYS.
      pose proof (notin_singleton_1 Xs Y HYS) as Hne.
      assert (HfvY : Xs `notin` ftv_t (typ_fvar Y)).
      { simpl. apply notin_singleton. intro Heq. apply Hne. symmetry. exact Heq. }
      assert (HwtUs' : wf_typ (Y ~ bind_sub (subst_tvar_t Xs Us T1) ++ subst_tvar_env Xs Us E) Us).
      { eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; [exact HwtUs |].
        intros Z c HZ. apply binds_cons_3. exact HZ. }
      pose proof (H1 Y HYL Xs Us HUs HwtUs') as Hbody.
      unfold open_tt in Hbody.
      rewrite (subst_tvar_t_open_tt_comm T2 Xs Us 0 (typ_fvar Y) (type_tlc Us HUs) HfvY) in Hbody.
      exact Hbody.
  - apply wf_typ_box. apply (IHwf_typ Xs Us HUs HwtUs).
  - apply wf_typ_readonly. apply (IHwf_typ Xs Us HUs HwtUs).
  - apply wf_typ_intersect.
    + apply (IHwf_typ1 Xs Us HUs HwtUs).
    + apply (IHwf_typ2 Xs Us HUs HwtUs).
  - apply wf_typ_record. apply (IHwf_typ Xs Us HUs HwtUs).
Qed.

Lemma notin_ftv_typ_fvar : forall X Y, X <> Y -> X `notin` ftv_t (typ_fvar Y).
Proof.
  intros X Y Hne. simpl. apply notin_singleton.
  intro HYX. apply Hne. symmetry. exact HYX.
Qed.

Lemma sub_refl_wf : forall E T, wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> sub E T T.
Proof.
  intros E T Hwf Hwt. revert Hwf. induction Hwt; intros Hwf.
  - apply sub_top; [exact Hwf | apply wf_typ_top].
  - apply sub_refl_tvar; [exact Hwf | apply wf_typ_var with (U:=U); exact H].
  - apply sub_arrow; [apply IHHwt1; exact Hwf | apply IHHwt2; exact Hwf].
  - apply sub_all with (L := L `union` dom E).
    + apply (IHHwt Hwf).
    + intros X HX.
      pose proof HX as HXL. apply notin_union_1 in HXL.
      pose proof HX as HXD. apply notin_union_2 in HXD.
      assert (HwfX : wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E)).
      { apply wf_env_sub; assumption. }
      apply (H0 X HXL HwfX).
  - apply sub_box; [apply IHHwt; exact Hwf | apply IHHwt; exact Hwf].
  - apply sub_readonly. apply IHHwt; exact Hwf.
  - apply sub_inter with (T1:=typ_int T1 T2).
    + apply sub_inter_left; [exact Hwf | exact Hwt1 | exact Hwt2].
    + apply sub_inter_right; [exact Hwf | exact Hwt1 | exact Hwt2].
  - apply sub_record; [apply IHHwt; exact Hwf | apply IHHwt; exact Hwf].
Qed.

Definition env_sub_shape (E E' : env) : Prop :=
  forall Y U, binds Y (bind_sub U) E -> exists U', binds Y (bind_sub U') E'.

Lemma env_sub_shape_cons_sub : forall E E',
  env_sub_shape E E' ->
  forall X U V, env_sub_shape (X ~ bind_sub U ++ E) (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E').
Proof.
  intros E E' Hshape X U V Y W HY.
  apply binds_cons_iff in HY.
  destruct HY as [[Heq1 Heq2] | HY].
  - subst. exists V. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity.
  - destruct (Hshape Y W HY) as [W' HW'].
    exists W'. apply binds_cons_3. exact HW'.
Qed.

Lemma env_sub_shape_cons_typ : forall E E',
  env_sub_shape E E' ->
  forall X U V, env_sub_shape (X ~ bind_typ U ++ E) (X ~ bind_typ V ++ E').
Proof.
  intros E E' Hshape X U V Y W HY.
  apply binds_cons_iff in HY.
  destruct HY as [[Heq1 Heq2] | HY].
  - subst. inversion Heq2.
  - destruct (Hshape Y W HY) as [W' HW'].
    exists W'. apply binds_cons_3. exact HW'.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_env_sub_shape : forall E T, wf_typ E T ->
  forall E', env_sub_shape E E' -> wf_typ E' T.
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction H; intros E' Hshape.
  - apply wf_typ_top.
  - destruct (Hshape X U H) as [U' HU'].
    apply wf_typ_var with (U:=U'). exact HU'.
  - apply wf_typ_arrow.
    + apply (IHwf_typ1 E' Hshape).
    + apply (IHwf_typ2 E' Hshape).
  - apply wf_typ_all with (L:=L).
    + apply (IHwf_typ E' Hshape).
    + intros X HX.
      pose proof (H1 X HX (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E')) as HB.
      apply HB. apply env_sub_shape_cons_sub; exact Hshape.
  - apply wf_typ_box. apply (IHwf_typ E' Hshape).
  - apply wf_typ_readonly. apply (IHwf_typ E' Hshape).
  - apply wf_typ_intersect; [apply (IHwf_typ1 E' Hshape) | apply (IHwf_typ2 E' Hshape)].
  - apply wf_typ_record. apply (IHwf_typ E' Hshape).
Qed.

Lemma env_sub_shape_refl : forall E, env_sub_shape E E.
Proof.
  intros E Y U HY. exists U. exact HY.
Qed.

Lemma sub_wf_typ : forall E A B, sub E A B -> wf_typ E A /\ wf_typ E B.
Proof.
  intros E A B H. induction H.
  - split; [assumption | apply wf_typ_top].
  - split; assumption.
  - split.
    + apply wf_typ_var with (U:=U). exact H.
    + apply IHsub.
  - split.
    + apply wf_typ_arrow; [apply (proj2 IHsub1) | apply (proj1 IHsub2)].
    + apply wf_typ_arrow; [apply (proj1 IHsub1) | apply (proj2 IHsub2)].
  - split.
    + apply wf_typ_all with (L := L).
      * apply (proj2 IHsub).
      * intros X HX.
        apply (wf_typ_env_sub_shape _ _ (proj1 (H1 X HX))).
        apply env_sub_shape_cons_sub. apply env_sub_shape_refl.
    + apply wf_typ_all with (L := L).
      * apply (proj1 IHsub).
      * intros X HX. apply (proj2 (H1 X HX)).
  - split; [apply wf_typ_box; apply (proj1 IHsub1) | apply wf_typ_box; apply (proj1 IHsub2)].
  - split; [apply wf_typ_readonly; apply (proj1 IHsub) | apply wf_typ_readonly; apply (proj2 IHsub)].
  - split; [apply (proj1 IHsub) | apply wf_typ_readonly; apply (proj2 IHsub)].
  - split; [apply (proj1 IHsub1) | apply (proj2 IHsub2)].
  - split.
    + apply wf_typ_intersect; assumption.
    + assumption.
  - split.
    + apply wf_typ_intersect; assumption.
    + assumption.
  - split.
    + apply (proj1 IHsub1).
    + apply wf_typ_intersect; [apply (proj2 IHsub1) | apply (proj2 IHsub2)].
  - split; [apply wf_typ_record; apply (proj1 IHsub1) | apply wf_typ_record; apply (proj1 IHsub2)].
  - split; [apply wf_typ_readonly; apply wf_typ_record; apply (proj1 IHsub) | apply wf_typ_readonly; apply wf_typ_record; apply (proj2 IHsub)].
  - split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_subst_tvar_ctx : forall E T, wf_typ E T ->
  forall D E0 X U V,
    E = D ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E0 ->
    wf_env E ->
    subst_tvar_env X V E0 = E0 ->
    type V -> wf_typ E0 V ->
    wf_typ (subst_tvar_env X V D ++ E0) (subst_tvar_t X V T).
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction H; intros D E0 Xs Us Vs eq_refl HwfE HE0 HV HwtV.
  - subst E. apply wf_typ_top.
  - subst E. simpl.
    destruct (aeq Xs X) as [HeqX | HneX].
    + subst X.
      eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; [exact HwtV |].
      intros Z c HZ. apply binds_app_3. exact HZ.
    + apply wf_typ_var with (U:=subst_tvar_t Xs Vs U).
      apply binds_app_iff in H. destruct H as [HD | Hrest].
      * apply binds_app_2. exact (binds_subst_tvar_env Xs Vs D X (bind_sub U) HD).
      * apply binds_app_iff in Hrest. destruct Hrest as [Hhead | HE].
        -- apply binds_one_iff in Hhead. destruct Hhead as [HeqY HeqB].
           exfalso. apply HneX. symmetry. exact HeqY.
        -- rewrite <- HE0. apply binds_app_3. exact (binds_subst_tvar_env Xs Vs E0 X (bind_sub U) HE).
  - subst E. apply wf_typ_arrow.
    + apply (IHwf_typ1 D E0 Xs Us Vs eq_refl HwfE HE0 HV HwtV).
    + apply (IHwf_typ2 D E0 Xs Us Vs eq_refl HwfE HE0 HV HwtV).
  - subst E. apply wf_typ_all with
      (L := L `union` {{Xs}} `union` dom (D ++ Xs ~ bind_sub Us ++ E0)).
    + apply (IHwf_typ D E0 Xs Us Vs eq_refl HwfE HE0 HV HwtV).
    + intros Y HY.
      pose proof HY as HyL. apply notin_union_1 in HyL.
      pose proof HY as Hrest. apply notin_union_2 in Hrest.
      pose proof Hrest as HyS. apply notin_union_1 in HyS.
      pose proof Hrest as HyD. apply notin_union_2 in HyD.
      pose proof (notin_singleton_1 Xs Y HyS) as HneXY.
      assert (HwfSrcExt : wf_env (Y ~ bind_sub T1 ++ D ++ Xs ~ bind_sub Us ++ E0)).
      { apply wf_env_sub; [exact HwfE | exact H | exact HyD]. }
      pose proof (H1 Y HyL (Y ~ bind_sub T1 ++ D) E0 Xs Us Vs eq_refl HwfSrcExt HE0 HV HwtV) as Hbody.
      unfold open_tt in Hbody.
      rewrite (subst_tvar_t_open_tt_comm T2 Xs Vs 0 (typ_fvar Y)
        (type_tlc Vs HV) (notin_ftv_typ_fvar Xs Y HneXY)) in Hbody.
      exact Hbody.
  - subst E. apply wf_typ_box. apply (IHwf_typ D E0 Xs Us Vs eq_refl HwfE HE0 HV HwtV).
  - subst E. apply wf_typ_readonly. apply (IHwf_typ D E0 Xs Us Vs eq_refl HwfE HE0 HV HwtV).
  - subst E. apply wf_typ_intersect.
    + apply (IHwf_typ1 D E0 Xs Us Vs eq_refl HwfE HE0 HV HwtV).
    + apply (IHwf_typ2 D E0 Xs Us Vs eq_refl HwfE HE0 HV HwtV).
  - subst E. apply wf_typ_record. apply (IHwf_typ D E0 Xs Us Vs eq_refl HwfE HE0 HV HwtV).
Qed.

Lemma binds_subst_tvar_ctx_other : forall D E0 X U V y b,
  y <> X ->
  binds y b (D ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E0) ->
  subst_tvar_env X V E0 = E0 ->
  binds y (subst_tvar_binding X V b) (subst_tvar_env X V D ++ E0).
Proof.
  intros D E0 X U V y b Hne Hb HE0.
  apply binds_app_iff in Hb. destruct Hb as [HD | Hrest].
  - apply binds_app_2. exact (binds_subst_tvar_env X V D y b HD).
  - apply binds_app_iff in Hrest. destruct Hrest as [Hhead | HE].
    + apply binds_one_iff in Hhead. destruct Hhead as [HeqY HeqB].
      exfalso. apply Hne. exact HeqY.
    + rewrite <- HE0. apply binds_app_3.
      exact (binds_subst_tvar_env X V E0 y b HE).
Qed.

Fixpoint ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_forward (T : typ) :
    forall K Y X, X `notin` ftv_t T -> X <> Y ->
      X `notin` ftv_t (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Y) T)
with ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_backward (T : typ) :
    forall K Y X, X `notin` ftv_t (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Y) T) -> X <> Y ->
      X `notin` ftv_t T.
Proof.
  - destruct T as [|n|Z|A B|A B|A|m A|A B|a A]; intros K Y X Hfv Hne; simpl in *.
    + apply notin_empty.
    + destruct (K == n); simpl.
      * apply notin_singleton. intro Heq. apply Hne. symmetry. exact Heq.
      * apply notin_empty.
    + exact Hfv.
    + pose proof Hfv as H1. apply notin_union_1 in H1.
      pose proof Hfv as H2. apply notin_union_2 in H2.
      apply notin_union; [apply (ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_forward A K Y X H1 Hne) |
                        apply (ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_forward B K Y X H2 Hne)].
    + pose proof Hfv as H1. apply notin_union_1 in H1.
      pose proof Hfv as H2. apply notin_union_2 in H2.
      apply notin_union; [apply (ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_forward A K Y X H1 Hne) |
                        apply (ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_forward B (S K) Y X H2 Hne)].
    + apply ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_forward; assumption.
    + apply ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_forward; assumption.
    + pose proof Hfv as H1. apply notin_union_1 in H1.
      pose proof Hfv as H2. apply notin_union_2 in H2.
      apply notin_union; [apply (ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_forward A K Y X H1 Hne) |
                        apply (ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_forward B K Y X H2 Hne)].
    + apply ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_forward; assumption.
  - destruct T as [|n|Z|A B|A B|A|m A|A B|a A]; intros K Y X Hfv Hne; simpl in *.
    + exact Hfv.
    + destruct (K == n); simpl in *.
      * apply notin_empty.
      * exact Hfv.
    + exact Hfv.
    + apply notin_union.
      * apply (ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_backward A K Y X); [apply notin_union_1 in Hfv; exact Hfv | exact Hne].
      * apply (ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_backward B K Y X); [apply notin_union_2 in Hfv; exact Hfv | exact Hne].
    + apply notin_union.
      * apply (ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_backward A K Y X); [apply notin_union_1 in Hfv; exact Hfv | exact Hne].
      * apply (ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_backward B (S K) Y X); [apply notin_union_2 in Hfv; exact Hfv | exact Hne].
    + apply (ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_backward A K Y X Hfv Hne).
    + apply (ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_backward A K Y X Hfv Hne).
    + apply notin_union.
      * apply (ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_backward A K Y X); [apply notin_union_1 in Hfv; exact Hfv | exact Hne].
      * apply (ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_backward B K Y X); [apply notin_union_2 in Hfv; exact Hfv | exact Hne].
    + apply (ftv_t_open_tt_fvar_backward A K Y X Hfv Hne).
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_notin_dom_ftv : forall E T, wf_typ E T ->
  forall Xn, Xn `notin` dom E -> Xn `notin` ftv_t T.
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction H; intros Xn Hnotin; simpl.
  - apply notin_empty.
  - apply notin_singleton. intro Heq. subst Xn.
    pose proof (binds_In binding X (bind_sub U) E H) as Hin.
    exact (Hnotin Hin).
  - apply notin_union.
    + apply IHwf_typ1. exact Hnotin.
    + apply IHwf_typ2. exact Hnotin.
  - apply notin_union.
    + apply IHwf_typ. exact Hnotin.
    + destruct (atom_fresh (L `union` {{Xn}} `union` dom E)) as [Y HY].
      pose proof HY as HYL. apply notin_union_1 in HYL.
      pose proof HY as Hrest. apply notin_union_2 in Hrest.
      pose proof Hrest as HYS. apply notin_union_1 in HYS.
      pose proof Hrest as HYD. apply notin_union_2 in HYD.

Lemma wf_env_cons_inv : forall y b D', wf_env ((y,b) :: D') ->
  wf_env D' /\
  (forall T, b = bind_sub T -> wf_typ D' T) /\
  (forall T, b = bind_typ T -> wf_typ D' T) /\
  y `notin` dom D'.
Proof.
  intros y b D' H. inversion H; subst.
  - split; [exact H3 | split; [intros T0 Heq; inversion Heq; subst T0; exact H4 |
      split; [intros T0 Heq; inversion Heq | exact H5]]].
  - split; [exact H3 | split; [intros T0 Heq; inversion Heq |
      split; [intros T0 Heq; inversion Heq; subst T0; exact H4 | exact H5]]].
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_notin_tail : forall D X b E0,
  wf_env (D ++ X ~ b ++ E0) -> X `notin` dom E0.
Proof.
  induction D as [|[y b'] D IH]; intros X b E0 H.
  - simpl in H. pose proof (wf_env_cons_inv X b E0 H) as [_ [_ [_ Hnotin]]]. exact Hnotin.
  - simpl in H. pose proof (wf_env_cons_inv y b' (D ++ X ~ b ++ E0) H) as [Htail _].
    apply (IH X b E0 Htail).
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_wf_tail : forall D X U E0,
  wf_env (D ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E0) -> wf_typ E0 U.
Proof.
  induction D as [|[y b'] D IH]; intros X U E0 H.
  - simpl in H. pose proof (wf_env_cons_inv X (bind_sub U) E0 H) as [_ [Hsub _]].
    apply (Hsub U eq_refl).
  - simpl in H. pose proof (wf_env_cons_inv y b' (D ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E0) H) as [Htail _].
    apply (IH X U E0 Htail).
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_notin_prefix : forall D X b E0,
  wf_env (D ++ X ~ b ++ E0) -> X `notin` dom D.
Proof.
  induction D as [|[y b'] D IH]; intros X b E0 H.
  - simpl. apply notin_empty.
  - simpl in H. pose proof (wf_env_cons_inv y b' (D ++ X ~ b ++ E0) H) as [Htail [_ [_ Hfresh]]].
    pose proof (IH X b E0 Htail) as HXD.
    simpl. apply notin_add.
    + intro Heq.
      assert (Hin : X `in` dom (D ++ X ~ b ++ E0)).
      { apply binds_In with (A:=binding) (x:=X) (a:=b).
        apply binds_app_3. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity. }
      apply Hfresh. rewrite Heq. exact Hin.
    + exact HXD.
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_binds_top_sub : forall D X U E0 U0,
  wf_env (D ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E0) ->
  binds X (bind_sub U0) (D ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E0) -> U0 = U.
Proof.
  induction D as [|[y b'] D IH]; intros X U E0 U0 H Hb.
  - simpl in Hb. apply binds_cons_iff in Hb. destruct Hb as [Hhead | HE].
    + destruct Hhead as [_ Heq]. inversion Heq. reflexivity.
    + pose proof (wf_env_notin_tail nil X (bind_sub U) E0 H) as Hnotin.
      pose proof (binds_In binding X (bind_sub U0) E0 HE) as Hin.

  - simpl in H. pose proof (wf_env_cons_inv y b' (D ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E0) H) as [Htail [_ [_ Hfresh]]].
    simpl in Hb. apply binds_cons_iff in Hb. destruct Hb as [[HeqY HeqB] | Hb].

        apply binds_app_3. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity. }

Lemma merge_mutability_nf : forall U M,
  normal_form_typing U = U ->
  normal_form_typing (merge_mutability U M) = merge_mutability U M.
Proof.
  intros U. induction U; intros M Hnf; simpl in *.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - injection Hnf as H1 H2. simpl. rewrite H1, H2. reflexivity.
  - injection Hnf as H1 H2. simpl. rewrite H1, H2. reflexivity.
  - injection Hnf as H1. simpl. rewrite H1. reflexivity.
  - exact Hnf.
  - injection Hnf as H1 H2. simpl.
    rewrite (IHU1 M H1), (IHU2 M H2). reflexivity.
  - injection Hnf as H1. simpl. rewrite H1. reflexivity.
Qed.

  normal_form_typing (normal_form_typing T) = normal_form_typing T.

Lemma record_dom_subst_tvar : forall r X V,
  record_dom (subst_tvar_r X V r) = record_dom r.
Proof.
  intros r. induction r; intros X V; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHr. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHr. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma typing_subst_tvar_ctx : forall E R e T, typing E R e T ->
  forall D E0 X U V,
    E = D ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E0 ->
    wf_env E ->
    subst_tvar_env X V E0 = E0 ->
    subst_tvar_sig X V R = R ->
    type V -> wf_typ E0 V ->
    wf_env (subst_tvar_env X V D ++ E0) ->
    wf_sig (subst_tvar_env X V D ++ E0) R ->
    sub E0 V U ->
    typing (subst_tvar_env X V D ++ E0) R
      (subst_tvar_e X V e) (subst_tvar_t X V T).
Proof.
  intros E R e T H.
  induction H using typing_mut with
    (P := fun E R e T (h:typing E R e T) =>
      forall D E0 X U V,
        E = D ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E0 ->
        wf_env E ->
        subst_tvar_env X V E0 = E0 ->
        subst_tvar_sig X V R = R ->
        type V -> wf_typ E0 V ->
        wf_env (subst_tvar_env X V D ++ E0) ->
        wf_sig (subst_tvar_env X V D ++ E0) R ->
        sub E0 V U ->
        typing (subst_tvar_env X V D ++ E0) R
          (subst_tvar_e X V e) (subst_tvar_t X V T))
    (P0 := fun E R r T (h:typing_record_comp E R r T) =>
      forall D E0 X U V,
        E = D ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E0 ->
        wf_env E ->
        subst_tvar_env X V E0 = E0 ->
        subst_tvar_sig X V R = R ->
        type V -> wf_typ E0 V ->
        wf_env (subst_tvar_env X V D ++ E0) ->
        wf_sig (subst_tvar_env X V D ++ E0) R ->
        sub E0 V U ->
        typing_record_comp (subst_tvar_env X V D ++ E0) R
          (subst_tvar_r X V r) (subst_tvar_t X V T)).
  - (* var *)
    intros D E0 Xs Us Vs Heq HwfE HE0 HEsig HV HwtV HwfTgt HsigTgt HsubVU.
    subst E.
    assert (Hne : x <> Xs).
    { intro HeqY. subst x.
      pose proof (binds_cons_2 (x:=Xs) (y:=Xs) (a:=bind_sub Us) (b:=bind_sub Us) eq_refl eq_refl) as Htop0.
      pose proof (binds_app_3 _ _ _ _ _ Htop0) as Htop.
      pose proof (wf_env_binds_fun _ HwfE _ _ _ b Htop) as HbEq.
      inversion HbEq. }
    destruct (aeq Xs x) as [HeqX | HneX].
    + exfalso. apply Hne. symmetry. exact HeqX.
    + simpl. apply typing_var.
      * exact HwfTgt.
      * exact HsigTgt.
      * exact (binds_subst_tvar_ctx_other D E0 Xs Us Vs x (bind_typ T) Hne b HE0).
  - (* abs *)
    intros D E0 Xs Us Vs Heq HwfE HE0 HEsig HV HwtV HwfTgt HsigTgt HsubVU.
    subst E. simpl.
    eapply typing_abs with (L := L `union` {{Xs}} `union` dom (D ++ Xs ~ bind_sub Us ++ E0) `union` dom (subst_tvar_env Xs Vs D ++ E0)).

      inversion HwfBody; subst.
      assert (HwtVtgt : wf_typ (subst_tvar_env Xs Vs D ++ E0) (subst_tvar_t Xs Vs V)).
      { apply wf_typ_subst_tvar_ctx with (E:=D ++ Xs ~ bind_sub Us ++ E0) (D:=D) (E0:=E0) (X:=Xs) (U:=Us) (V:=Vs);
          [exact H3 | exact eq_refl | exact HwfE | exact HE0 | exact HV | exact HwtV]. }

        intros Y c HY. apply binds_cons_3. exact HY. }
      pose proof (H x HxL (x ~ bind_typ V ++ D) E0 Xs Us Vs

    subst E. simpl.
    eapply typing_app.
    + exact HsigTgt.
    + apply (IHtyping1 D E0 Xs Us Vs eq_refl HwfE HE0 HEsig HV HwtV HwfTgt HsigTgt HsubVU).
    + apply (IHtyping2 D E0 Xs Us Vs eq_refl HwfE HE0 HEsig HV HwtV HwfTgt HsigTgt HsubVU).

Lemma typing_sig_weaken : forall E R e T, typing E R e T ->
  forall R',
    (forall l b, Signatures.binds l b R -> Signatures.binds l b R') ->
    wf_sig E R' -> typing E R' e T.
Proof.
  intros E R e T H.
  induction H using typing_mut with
    (P := fun E R e T (h:typing E R e T) =>
      forall R',
        (forall l b, Signatures.binds l b R -> Signatures.binds l b R') ->
        wf_sig E R' -> typing E R' e T)
    (P0 := fun E R r T (h:typing_record_comp E R r T) =>
      forall R',
        (forall l b, Signatures.binds l b R -> Signatures.binds l b R') ->
        wf_sig E R' -> typing_record_comp E R' r T).
  - intros R' Hb Hs. apply typing_var; assumption.
  - intros R' Hb Hs. eapply typing_abs; [exact Hs | intros x Hx; apply (H x Hx R' Hb Hs)].
  - intros R' Hb Hs. eapply typing_app; [exact Hs | apply (IHtyping1 R' Hb Hs) | apply (IHtyping2 R' Hb Hs)].
  - intros R' Hb Hs. eapply typing_tabs; [exact Hs | intros X HX; apply (H X HX R' Hb Hs)].

  - intros R' Hb Hs. eapply typing_sub; [exact Hs | apply (IHtyping R' Hb Hs) | exact s].
  - intros R' Hb Hs. eapply typing_let; [exact Hs | apply (IHtyping R' Hb Hs) | intros x Hx; apply (H0 x Hx R' Hb Hs)].
  - intros R' Hb Hs. apply typing_box with (T:=T); [exact Hs | apply (IHtyping R' Hb Hs)].
  - intros R' Hb Hs. apply typing_unbox with (T:=T); [exact Hs | apply (IHtyping R' Hb Hs)].

  - intros R' Hb Hs. apply typing_ref with (T:=T); [exact H | exact Hs | apply Hb; exact b].

cd /tmp/dev && cat >> dev.v <<'EOF'

Scheme red_mut := Induction for red Sort Prop
  with red_record_mut := Induction for red_record_comp Sort Prop.

Ltac solve_det_red :=
  first [
    match goal with
    | IH : forall x y, red ?a ?b x y -> _ |- _ =>
        match goal with
        | Hsub : red ?a ?b ?c ?d |- _ =>
            let Heq := fresh "Heq" in
            destruct (IH c d Hsub) as [Heq Hse]; subst; reflexivity
        end
    end
  | exfalso; eapply value_no_red; [eassumption | eassumption]
  | exfalso; eapply value_record_comp_no_red; [eassumption | eassumption]
  | split; reflexivity
  | split; discriminate
  | reflexivity
  | discriminate
  ].

Ltac solve_det_rec :=
  first [
    match goal with
    | IH : forall x y, red_record_comp ?a ?b x y -> _ |- _ =>
        match goal with
        | Hsub : red_record_comp ?a ?b ?c ?d |- _ =>
            let Heq := fresh "Heq" in
            destruct (IH c d Hsub) as [Heq Hse]; subst; reflexivity
        end
    end
  | exfalso; eapply value_record_comp_no_red; [eassumption | eassumption]
  | split; reflexivity
  | split; discriminate
  | reflexivity
  | discriminate
  ].

Lemma red_det : forall e s e1 s1, red e s e1 s1 ->
  forall e2 s2, red e s e2 s2 -> e1 = e2 /\ s1 = s2.
Proof.
  intros e s e1 s1 H.
  induction H using red_mut with
    (P0 := fun r s r1 s1 (h:red_record_comp r s r1 s1) =>
      forall r2 s2, red_record_comp r s r2 s2 -> r1 = r2 /\ s1 = s2).
  all: try clear H.
  all: try (intros ? ? H2).
  all: try (inversion H2; subst).
  all: try clear H2.
  all: try solve_det_red.
  all: try solve_det_rec.
  Show.
Qed.
EOF

(* Based on the System F-sub development by Brian Aydemir and Arthur
   Charguéraud, with Aaron Bohannon, Jeffrey Vaughan, and Dimitrios Vytiniotis. *)

Require Export Fsub.FmMeta.Metatheory.

Require Export String.

Require Export Fsub.Label.

Require Export Fsub.Signatures.

Require Export Fsub.LabelMap.

Require Export Coq.Program.Equality.


Inductive mut : Set :=
  | mut_readonly : mut
.

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_top : typ
  | typ_bvar : nat -> typ
  | typ_fvar : atom -> typ
  | typ_arrow : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_all : typ -> typ -> typ

  | typ_box : typ -> typ

  | typ_mut : mut -> typ -> typ

  | typ_int : typ -> typ -> typ

  | typ_record : atom -> typ -> typ
.

Inductive exp : Set :=
  | exp_bvar : nat -> exp
  | exp_fvar : atom -> exp
  | exp_abs : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_app : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tabs : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tapp : exp -> typ -> exp
  | exp_let : exp -> exp -> exp

  | exp_box : exp -> exp
  | exp_unbox : exp -> exp
  | exp_set_box : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_ref : label -> exp

  | exp_seal : exp -> exp

  | exp_record : rec_comp -> exp
  | exp_record_read : exp -> atom -> exp
  | exp_record_write: exp -> atom -> exp -> exp
with rec_comp : Set :=


  | rec_empty : rec_comp
  | rec_exp : atom -> exp -> rec_comp -> rec_comp
  | rec_ref : atom -> label -> rec_comp -> rec_comp
.

Coercion typ_bvar : nat >-> typ.

Coercion typ_fvar : atom >-> typ.

Coercion exp_bvar : nat >-> exp.

Coercion exp_fvar : atom >-> exp.

Fixpoint open_tt_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (T : typ)  {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_bvar J => if K == J then U else (typ_bvar J)
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec (S K) U T2)
  | typ_box T => typ_box (open_tt_rec K U T)
  | typ_mut M T => typ_mut M (open_tt_rec K U T)
  | typ_int T1 T2 => typ_int (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_record a T1 => typ_record a (open_tt_rec K U T1)
  end.

Fixpoint open_te_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs  (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec K U e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app  (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec (S K) U e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_tt_rec K U V)
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_box e => exp_box (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_unbox e => exp_unbox (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_set_box b e => exp_set_box (open_te_rec K U b) (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_ref l => exp_ref l
  | exp_seal e => exp_seal (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_record r => exp_record (open_te_record_rec K U r)
  | exp_record_read e a => exp_record_read (open_te_rec K U e) a
  | exp_record_write e1 a e2 => exp_record_write (open_te_rec K U e1) a (open_te_rec K U e2)
  end
with
  open_te_record_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (r : rec_comp) {struct r} : rec_comp :=
  match r with
  | rec_empty => rec_empty
  | rec_exp a e r => rec_exp a (open_te_rec K U e) (open_te_record_rec K U r)
  | rec_ref a l r => rec_ref a l (open_te_record_rec K U r)
  end.

Fixpoint open_ee_rec (k : nat) (f : exp) (e : exp)  {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => if k == i then f else (exp_bvar i)
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs V (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs V (open_ee_rec k f e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_ee_rec k f e1) V
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec (S k) f e2)
  | exp_box e => exp_box (open_ee_rec k f e)
        LabelSetImpl.notin l (Signatures.dom R) ->
        wf_sig E (l ~ bind_sig T ++ R).

Fixpoint merge_mutability (T : typ) (m : mut) {struct T} :=
    match T with



    | typ_bvar J => (typ_mut m T)
    | typ_fvar X => (typ_mut m (typ_fvar X))
    | typ_box T => (typ_mut m (typ_box T))
    | typ_record a T => (typ_mut m (typ_record a T))

    | typ_int T1 T2 => (typ_int (merge_mutability T1 m) (merge_mutability T2 m))

    | _ => T
    end.

Fixpoint normal_form_typing (T : typ) {struct T} :=
    match T with
    | typ_top => typ_top
    | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
    | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar X
    | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2)
    | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2)
    | typ_box T => typ_box (normal_form_typing T)
    | typ_int T1 T2 => typ_int (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2)
    | typ_mut M T =>
        (merge_mutability (normal_form_typing T) M)
    | typ_record a T => typ_record a (normal_form_typing T)
    end.

Arguments merge_mutability T m /.

Arguments normal_form_typing T /.

Inductive in_normal_form : typ -> Prop :=
  | top_in_normal_form :
    in_normal_form typ_top
  | fvar_in_normal_form : forall (X : atom),
    in_normal_form X
  | readonly_fvar_in_normal_form : forall (X : atom) m,
    in_normal_form (typ_mut m X)
  | arrow_in_normal_form : forall T1 T2,
    in_normal_form T1 ->
    in_normal_form T2 ->
    in_normal_form (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | all_in_normal_form : forall L T1 T2,
    in_normal_form T1 ->
    (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> in_normal_form (open_tt T2 X)) ->
    in_normal_form (typ_all T1 T2)
  | box_in_normal_form : forall T,
    in_normal_form T ->
    in_normal_form (typ_box T)
  | readonly_box_in_normal_form : forall T m,
    in_normal_form T ->
    in_normal_form (typ_mut m (typ_box T))
  | int_in_normal_form : forall T1 T2,
    in_normal_form T1 ->
    in_normal_form T2 ->
    in_normal_form (typ_int T1 T2)
  | record_in_normal_form : forall a T1,
    in_normal_form T1 ->
    in_normal_form (typ_record a T1)
  | readonly_record_in_normal_form : forall T a m,
    in_normal_form T ->
    in_normal_form (typ_mut m (typ_record a T))
.

Inductive in_intersection : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | actually_equal : forall S T,
    S = T ->
    in_intersection S T
  | in_intersection_left : forall S L R,
    in_intersection S L ->
    in_intersection S (typ_int L R)
  | in_intersection_right : forall S L R,
    in_intersection S R ->
    in_intersection S (typ_int L R).

Definition in_intersection_component (S T : typ) :=
    (~ exists L R, S = typ_int L R) /\
    (in_intersection S T).

Inductive sub : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | sub_top : forall E S,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E S ->
      sub E S typ_top
  | sub_refl_tvar : forall E X,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E (typ_fvar X) ->
      sub E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
  | sub_trans_tvar : forall U E T X,
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      sub E U T ->
      sub E (typ_fvar X) T
  | sub_arrow : forall E S1 S2 T1 T2,
      sub E T1 S1 ->
      sub E S2 T2 ->
      sub E (typ_arrow S1 S2) (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | sub_all : forall L E S1 S2 T1 T2,
      sub E T1 S1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
          sub (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt S2 X) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      sub E (typ_all S1 S2) (typ_all T1 T2)
  | sub_box : forall E T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T2 T1 ->
      sub E (typ_box T1) (typ_box T2)

  | sub_readonly : forall E T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly T1) (typ_mut mut_readonly T2)

  | sub_readonly_mutable : forall E T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T1 (typ_mut mut_readonly T2)
  | sub_trans : forall E T1 T2 T3,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T2 T3 ->
      sub E T1 T3
  | sub_inter_left : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      sub E (typ_int T1 T2) T1
  | sub_inter_right : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      sub E (typ_int T1 T2) T2
  | sub_inter : forall E T1 T2 T3,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T1 T3 ->
      sub E T1 (typ_int T2 T3)
  | sub_record : forall E a T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T2 T1 ->
      sub E (typ_record a T1) (typ_record a T2)

  | sub_readonly_record : forall E a T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T1)) (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T2))

  | sub_denormalize : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      sub E (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2) ->
      sub E T1 T2
.

Notation "E |-s S <: T" := (sub E S T) (at level 70).

Fixpoint record_dom (r : rec_comp)  {struct r} : atoms :=
    match r with
    | rec_empty => {}
    | rec_exp a e r => {{ a }} `union` record_dom r
    | rec_ref a l r => {{ a }} `union` record_dom r
    end.

Inductive typing : env -> sig -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
  | typing_var : forall E R x T,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_sig E R ->
      binds x (bind_typ T) E ->
      typing E R (exp_fvar x) T
  | typing_abs : forall L E R V e1 T1,
      wf_sig E R ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) R (open_ee e1 x) T1) ->
      typing E R (exp_abs V e1) (typ_arrow V T1)
  | typing_app : forall T1 E R e1 e2 T2,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 (typ_arrow T1 T2) ->
      typing E R e2 T1 ->
      typing E R (exp_app e1 e2) T2
  | typing_tabs : forall L E R V e1 T1,
      wf_sig E R ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        typing (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) R (open_te e1 X) (open_tt T1 X)) ->
      typing E R (exp_tabs V e1) (typ_all V T1)
  | typing_tapp : forall T1 E R e1 T T2,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 (typ_all T1 T2) ->
      sub E T T1 ->
      typing E R (exp_tapp e1 T) (open_tt T2 T)
  | typing_sub : forall S E R e T,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e S ->
      sub E S T ->
      typing E R e T
  | typing_let : forall L T1 T2 e1 e2 E R,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 T1 ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E) R (open_ee e2 x) T2) ->
      typing E R (exp_let e1 e2) T2
  | typing_box : forall E R e T,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e T ->
      typing E R (exp_box e) (typ_box T)
  | typing_unbox : forall E R e T,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e (typ_box T) ->
      typing E R (exp_unbox e) T

  | typing_set_box : forall E R e1 e2 T,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 (typ_box T) ->
      typing E R e2 T ->
      typing E R (exp_set_box e1 e2) T
  | typing_ref : forall E R l T,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_sig E R ->
      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
      typing E R (exp_ref l) (typ_box T)

  | typing_seal : forall E R e T,
      typing E R e T ->
      typing E R (exp_seal e) (typ_mut mut_readonly T)

  | typing_unbox_readonly : forall E R e T,
      typing E R e (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box T)) ->
      typing E R (exp_unbox e) (typ_mut mut_readonly T)
  | typing_record : forall E R r T,
      typing_record_comp E R r T ->
      typing E R (exp_record r) T

  | typing_record_read : forall E R e a T,
      typing E R e (typ_record a T) ->
      typing E R (exp_record_read e a) T
  | typing_record_read_readonly : forall E R e a T,
      typing E R e (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T)) ->
      typing E R (exp_record_read e a) (typ_mut mut_readonly T)

  | typing_record_write : forall E R e1 a e2 T,
      typing E R e1 (typ_record a T) ->
      typing E R e2 T ->
      typing E R (exp_record_write e1 a e2) T
with typing_record_comp : env -> sig -> rec_comp -> typ -> Prop :=
  | typing_record_empty : forall E R,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing_record_comp E R rec_empty typ_top
  | typing_record_exp : forall E R a e r T Tr,
      a `notin` record_dom r ->
      typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
      typing E R e T ->
      typing_record_comp E R (rec_exp a e r) (typ_int (typ_record a T) Tr)
  | typing_record_ref : forall E R a l r T Tr,
      a `notin` record_dom r ->
      typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
      typing_record_comp E R (rec_ref a l r) (typ_int (typ_record a T) Tr)
.

Notation "E @ R |- e T" := (typing E R e T) (at level 70).

Notation "E @ R |-r r T" := (typing_record_comp E R r T) (at level 70).

Inductive value : exp -> Prop :=
  | value_abs : forall T e1,
      expr (exp_abs T e1) ->
      value (exp_abs T e1)
  | value_tabs : forall T e1,
      expr (exp_tabs T e1) ->
      value (exp_tabs T e1)
  | value_ref : forall l,
      value (exp_ref l)
  | value_sealed_ref : forall l,
      value (exp_seal (exp_ref l))
  | value_record : forall r,
      value_record_comp r ->
      value (exp_record r)
  | value_sealed_record : forall r,
      value_record_comp r ->
      value (exp_seal (exp_record r))
with value_record_comp : rec_comp -> Prop :=
  | value_rec_empty :
      value_record_comp rec_empty
  | value_rec_ref : forall a l r,
      value_record_comp r ->
      value_record_comp (rec_ref a l r)
.

Notation store := (LabelMap exp).

Notation empty_store := (LabelMapImpl.empty store).

Definition well_formed_store (s : store) :=
  forall l v, LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s -> value v.

(* The original dependent pair uses this same witness. *)
Definition fresh_label_for_store (s : store) :=
  Label.fresh (List.map fst (LabelMapImpl.elements s)).

Definition typing_store (E: env) (R : sig) (s : store) :=
  forall l,
    (forall T, Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
        exists v,
            (LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s) /\
            typing E R v T /\ value v)
    /\
    (forall v, (LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s) ->
        exists T, (value v /\ typing E R v T /\ Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R)).

Notation "E |-st s @ R" := (typing_store E R s) (at level 70).

Fixpoint record_lookup_ref (a : atom) (r : rec_comp) : option label :=
    match r with
    | rec_ref a' l r => if (a === a') then Some l else record_lookup_ref a r
    | _ => None
    end.

Notation "r # a" := (record_lookup_ref a r) (at level 70).

Inductive red : exp -> store -> exp -> store -> Prop :=
  | red_app_1 : forall e1 e1' s1 s1' e2,
      expr e2 ->
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_app e1 e2) s1 (exp_app e1' e2) s1'
  | red_app_2 : forall e1 e2 s2 e2' s2',
      value e1 ->
      red e2 s2 e2' s2' ->
      red (exp_app e1 e2) s2 (exp_app e1 e2') s2'
  | red_tapp : forall e1 e1' s1 s1' V,
      type V ->
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_tapp e1 V) s1 (exp_tapp e1' V) s1'
  | red_abs : forall T e1 s1 v2,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      expr (exp_abs T e1) ->
      value v2 ->
      red (exp_app (exp_abs T e1) v2) s1 (open_ee e1 v2) s1
  | red_tabs : forall T1 e1 s1 T2,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      expr (exp_tabs T1 e1) ->
      type T2 ->
      red (exp_tapp (exp_tabs T1 e1) T2) s1 (open_te e1 T2) s1
  | red_let_1 : forall e1 e1' s1 s1' e2,
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      body_e e2 ->
      red (exp_let e1 e2) s1 (exp_let e1' e2) s1'
  | red_let : forall v1 e2 s2,
      well_formed_store s2 ->
      value v1 ->
      body_e e2 ->
      red (exp_let v1 e2) s2 (open_ee e2 v1) s2
  | red_box_1 : forall e1 e1' s1 s1',
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_box e1) s1 (exp_box e1') s1'
  | red_box_ref : forall v1 l s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      value v1 ->
      l = fresh_label_for_store s1 ->
      red (exp_box v1) s1 (exp_ref l) (LabelMapImpl.add l v1 s1)
  | red_unbox_1 : forall e1 e1' s1 s1',
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_unbox e1) s1 (exp_unbox e1') s1'
  | red_unbox_ref : forall l v1 s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      value v1 ->
      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v1 s1 ->
      red (exp_unbox (exp_ref l)) s1 v1 s1
  | red_unbox_sealed_ref : forall l v1 s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      value v1 ->
      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v1 s1 ->
      red (exp_unbox (exp_seal (exp_ref l))) s1 (exp_seal v1) s1
  | red_set_box_1 : forall e1 s1 e1' s1' e2,
      expr e2 ->
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_set_box e1 e2) s1 (exp_set_box e1' e2) s1'
  | red_set_box_2 : forall v1 e2 s2 e2' s2',
      value v1 ->
      red e2 s2 e2' s2' ->
      red (exp_set_box v1 e2) s2 (exp_set_box v1 e2') s2'
  | red_set_box_ref : forall l v1 v2 s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      value v1 ->
      value v2 ->
      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v1 s1 ->
      red (exp_set_box (exp_ref l) v2) s1 v1 (LabelMapImpl.add l v2 s1)
  | red_seal_1 : forall e1 s1 e1' s1',
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_seal e1) s1 (exp_seal e1') s1'
  | red_seal_abs : forall T e1 s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      expr (exp_abs T e1) ->
      red (exp_seal (exp_abs T e1)) s1 (exp_abs T e1) s1
  | red_seal_tabs : forall T e1 s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      expr (exp_tabs T e1) ->
      red (exp_seal (exp_tabs T e1)) s1 (exp_tabs T e1) s1
  | red_seal_sealed_ref: forall l s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      red (exp_seal (exp_seal (exp_ref l))) s1 (exp_seal (exp_ref l)) s1
  | red_seal_sealed_record : forall r s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      value_record_comp r ->
      red (exp_seal (exp_seal (exp_record r))) s1 (exp_seal (exp_record r)) s1
  | red_record : forall r1 s1 r1' s1',
      red_record_comp r1 s1 r1' s1' ->
      red (exp_record r1) s1 (exp_record r1') s1'
  | red_record_read_1 : forall a e1 e1' s1 s1',
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_record_read e1 a) s1 (exp_record_read e1' a) s1'
  | red_record_read_ref : forall r a l v1 s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      value_record_comp r ->
      record_lookup_ref a r = Some l ->
      value v1 ->
      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v1 s1 ->
      red (exp_record_read (exp_record r) a) s1 v1 s1
  | red_sealed_record_read_ref : forall r a l v1 s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      value_record_comp r ->
      record_lookup_ref a r = Some l ->
      value v1 ->
      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v1 s1 ->
      red (exp_record_read (exp_seal (exp_record r)) a) s1 (exp_seal v1) s1
  | red_record_write_1 : forall a e1 s1 e1' s1' e2,
      expr e2 ->
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_record_write e1 a e2) s1 (exp_record_write e1' a e2) s1'
  | red_record_write_2 : forall a v1 e2 s2 e2' s2',
      value v1 ->
      red e2 s2 e2' s2' ->
      red (exp_record_write v1 a e2) s2 (exp_record_write v1 a e2') s2'
  | red_record_write_ref : forall a l r v1 v2 s1,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      value_record_comp r ->
      record_lookup_ref a r = Some l ->
      value v1 ->
      value v2 ->
      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v1 s1 ->
      red (exp_record_write (exp_record r) a v2) s1 v1 (LabelMapImpl.add l v2 s1)
with red_record_comp : rec_comp -> store -> rec_comp -> store -> Prop :=
  | red_record_exp_1 : forall a e1 s1 e1' s1' r1,
      record_comp r1 ->
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red_record_comp (rec_exp a e1 r1) s1 (rec_exp a e1' r1) s1'
  | red_record_exp_2 : forall a v r1 s1 l,
      well_formed_store s1 ->
      record_comp r1 ->
      value v ->
      l = fresh_label_for_store s1 ->
      red_record_comp (rec_exp a v r1) s1 (rec_ref a l r1) (LabelMapImpl.add l v s1)
  | red_record_ref : forall a l r1 s1 r1' s1',
      red_record_comp r1 s1 r1' s1' ->
      red_record_comp (rec_ref a l r1) s1 (rec_ref a l r1') s1'
.

Notation "< e1 | s1 > --> < e1' | s1' >" := (red e1 s1 e1' s1') (at level 69).

Notation "< r1 | s1 > -->r < r1' | s1' >" := (red_record_comp r1 s1 r1' s1') (at level 69).

Inductive redm : exp -> store -> exp -> store -> Prop :=
  | redm_eq : forall e s e' s',
    e = e' -> s = s' -> redm e s e' s'
  | redm_step : forall e s e'' s'' e' s',
    red e s e'' s'' ->
    redm e'' s'' e' s' ->
    redm e s e' s'.

Notation "< e1 | s1 > -->* < e1' | s1' >" := (redm e1 s1 e1' s1') (at level 69).

Inductive sealcomp : exp -> exp -> Prop :=
  | sealcomp_fvar : forall (x : atom),
      sealcomp x x
  | sealcomp_bvar : forall (n : nat),
      sealcomp n n
  | sealcomp_abs : forall T e1 e2,
      sealcomp e1 e2 ->
      sealcomp (exp_abs T e1) (exp_abs T e2)
  | sealcomp_app : forall e1 e2 f1 f2,
      sealcomp e1 f1 ->
      sealcomp e2 f2 ->
      sealcomp (exp_app e1 e2) (exp_app f1 f2)
  | sealcomp_tabs : forall T e1 e2,
      sealcomp e1 e2 ->
      sealcomp (exp_tabs T e1) (exp_tabs T e2)
  | sealcomp_tapp : forall T e1 e2,
      sealcomp e1 e2 ->
      sealcomp (exp_tapp e1 T) (exp_tapp e2 T)
  | sealcomp_let : forall e1 e2 f1 f2,
      sealcomp e1 f1 ->
      sealcomp e2 f2 ->
      sealcomp (exp_let e1 e2) (exp_let f1 f2)
  | sealcomp_box : forall e1 e2,
      sealcomp e1 e2 ->
      sealcomp (exp_box e1) (exp_box e2)
  | sealcomp_unbox : forall e1 e2,
      sealcomp e1 e2 ->
      sealcomp (exp_unbox e1) (exp_unbox e2)
  | sealcomp_set_box : forall e1 e2 f1 f2,
      sealcomp e1 f1 ->
      sealcomp e2 f2 ->
      sealcomp (exp_set_box e1 e2) (exp_set_box f1 f2)
  | sealcomp_ref : forall l,
      sealcomp (exp_ref l) (exp_ref l)
  | sealcomp_seal : forall e1 e2,
      sealcomp e1 e2 ->
      sealcomp (exp_seal e1) (exp_seal e2)
  | sealcomp_record : forall r1 r2,
      sealcomp_rec_comp r1 r2 ->
      sealcomp (exp_record r1) (exp_record r2)
  | sealcomp_record_read : forall e1 e2 x,
      sealcomp e1 e2 ->
      sealcomp (exp_record_read e1 x) (exp_record_read e2 x)
  | sealcomp_record_write : forall e1 f1 x e2 f2,
      sealcomp e1 f1 ->
      sealcomp e2 f2 ->
      sealcomp (exp_record_write e1 x e2) (exp_record_write f1 x f2)
  | sealcomp_multiple_seal : forall e1 e2,
      sealcomp e1 e2 ->
      sealcomp e1 (exp_seal e2)
with sealcomp_rec_comp : rec_comp -> rec_comp -> Prop :=
  | sealcomp_rec_empty :
      sealcomp_rec_comp (rec_empty) (rec_empty)
  | sealcomp_rec_exp : forall a e1 e2 r1 r2,
      sealcomp_rec_comp r1 r2 ->
      sealcomp e1 e2 ->
      sealcomp_rec_comp (rec_exp a e1 r1) (rec_exp a e2 r2)
  | sealcomp_rec_ref : forall a l r1 r2,
      sealcomp_rec_comp r1 r2 ->
      sealcomp_rec_comp (rec_ref a l r1) (rec_ref a l r2)
.

Definition sealcomp_store (s1 : store) (s2 : store) :=
  (forall l v, (LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s1) ->
      exists v', (LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v' s2) /\ sealcomp v v') /\
  (forall l v', (LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v' s2) ->
      exists v, (LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s1) /\ sealcomp v v').

Notation "e1 <e= e2" := (sealcomp e1 e2) (at level 60).

Notation "r1 <r= r2" := (sealcomp_rec_comp r1 r2) (at level 60).

Notation "s1 <s= s2" := (sealcomp_store s1 s2) (at level 60).

Fixpoint seal_count (e : exp)  {struct e} : nat :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => 0
  | exp_fvar x => 0

Interesting: sealcomp includes `sealcomp_multiple_seal` wrapping extra seals only at root repeatedly, not inside arbitrary? Actually recursive relation: if e <e= f then e <e= seal f. So f can have extra seals at any position matching recursive subexpressions. And sealcomp e f means f is e with zero or more seal wrappers inserted anywhere. It does not insert extra seal around subterms except via multiple_seal at each node.

Theorem 1: e reduces to value e'. f is e plus seals, typed. Need find f' more sealed than e' and f reduces to f'. This is "sealing simulation": extra seals may cause f to reduce to seal-wrapped value. Since typing f ensures extra seals only around things that can be sealed? Hmm.

But maybe theorem 1 is actually easy operationally without deep typing: given e ->* e', f = seals(e), can we reduce f to some f' with e' <e= f'? The issue: extra seals can block reductions? E.g. e = app (abs ...) v; f = app (seal (abs ...)) v. e reduces to body; f: app (seal abs) v. seal(abs) reduces to abs via red_seal_abs, then beta. So fine. e = record...; f = seal(record); reading sealed record works with special rules. Writing an immutable field of a sealed record: e can write, f cannot (sealed ref?). But typing f may block such a scenario? Actually f typing with seal generates readonly typ, so record_write on sealed record not typeable. Thus typing ensures e's reduction is preserved in f? Maybe.

But perhaps we can prove a direct **untyped** simulation with a "sealed context" interpretation that handles seals on the fly, and only uses typing to rule out writes to sealed refs. This is likely the intended proof.

Lemma sealcomp_expr_down : forall e f, sealcomp e f -> expr f -> expr e.
Proof.
  intros e f Hsc Hf.
  eapply (sealcomp_expr_fuel (exp_size f) e f); [lia | exact Hsc | exact Hf].
Qed.

Lemma sealcomp_rec_comp_down : forall r1 r2,
  sealcomp_rec_comp r1 r2 -> record_comp r2 -> record_comp r1.
Proof.
  intros r1 r2 Hsc Hf.
  eapply (sealcomp_rec_fuel (rec_size r2) r1 r2); [lia | exact Hsc | exact Hf].
Qed.

Lemma value_sealcomp_down' : forall e f, sealcomp e f -> value f -> value e.
Proof.
  intros e f Hsc Hv.
  eapply value_sealcomp_down; [exact Hsc | exact Hv |].
  apply (sealcomp_expr_down e f Hsc). apply value_expr. exact Hv.
Qed.

Lemma well_formed_store_sealcomp : forall s ns,
  well_formed_store ns -> sealcomp_store s ns -> well_formed_store s.
Proof.
  intros s ns Hwf Hsc l v Hm.
  destruct (proj1 Hsc l v Hm) as [v' [Hm' Hscv]].
  apply (value_sealcomp_down' v v' Hscv).
  exact (Hwf l v' Hm').
Qed.

Lemma wf_store_of_sealcomp_typing : forall s ns E R,
  typing_store E R ns -> s <s= ns -> well_formed_store s.
Proof.
  intros s ns E R Hst Hsc.
  apply (well_formed_store_sealcomp s ns).
  - apply (typing_store_wf_store E R ns). exact Hst.
  - exact Hsc.
Qed.

Fixpoint typ_size (T : typ) : nat :=
  match T with

  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => S (typ_size T1 + typ_size T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => S (typ_size T1 + typ_size T2)
  | typ_box T => S (typ_size T)
  | typ_mut _ T => S (typ_size T)

Fixpoint exp_size (e : exp) : nat :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar _ => 1
  | exp_fvar _ => 1
  | exp_abs T e1 => S (typ_size T + exp_size e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => S (exp_size e1 + exp_size e2)
  | exp_tabs T e1 => S (typ_size T + exp_size e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 T => S (exp_size e1 + typ_size T)
  | exp_let e1 e2 => S (exp_size e1 + exp_size e2)
  | exp_box e1 => S (exp_size e1)
  | exp_unbox e1 => S (exp_size e1)
  | exp_set_box e1 e2 => S (exp_size e1 + exp_size e2)
  | exp_ref _ => 1
  | exp_seal e1 => S (exp_size e1)

Inductive sub : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | sub_top : forall E S,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E S ->
      sub E S typ_top
  | sub_refl_tvar : forall E X,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E (typ_fvar X) ->
      sub E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
  | sub_trans_tvar : forall U E T X,
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      sub E U T ->
      sub E (typ_fvar X) T
  | sub_arrow : forall E S1 S2 T1 T2,
      sub E T1 S1 ->
      sub E S2 T2 ->
      sub E (typ_arrow S1 S2) (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | sub_all : forall L E S1 S2 T1 T2,
      sub E T1 S1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
          sub (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt S2 X) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      sub E (typ_all S1 S2) (typ_all T1 T2)
  | sub_box : forall E T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T2 T1 ->
      sub E (typ_box T1) (typ_box T2)

  | sub_readonly : forall E T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly T1) (typ_mut mut_readonly T2)

  | sub_readonly_mutable : forall E T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T1 (typ_mut mut_readonly T2)
  | sub_trans : forall E T1 T2 T3,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T2 T3 ->
      sub E T1 T3
  | sub_inter_left : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      sub E (typ_int T1 T2) T1
  | sub_inter_right : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      sub E (typ_int T1 T2) T2
  | sub_inter : forall E T1 T2 T3,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T1 T3 ->
      sub E T1 (typ_int T2 T3)
  | sub_record : forall E a T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T2 T1 ->
      sub E (typ_record a T1) (typ_record a T2)

  | sub_readonly_record : forall E a T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T1)) (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T2))

  | sub_denormalize : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      sub E (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2) ->
      sub E T1 T2
.

Notation "E |-s S <: T" := (sub E S T) (at level 70).

Fixpoint record_dom (r : rec_comp)  {struct r} : atoms :=
    match r with
    | rec_empty => {}
    | rec_exp a e r => {{ a }} `union` record_dom r
    | rec_ref a l r => {{ a }} `union` record_dom r
    end.
