Inductive type : typ -> Prop :=
  | type_top :
      type typ_top
  | type_var : forall X,
      type (typ_fvar X)
  | type_arrow : forall T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      type T2 ->
      type (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | type_all : forall L T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> type (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      type (typ_all T1 T2)
  | type_box : forall T,
      type T ->
      type (typ_box T)
  | type_readonly : forall T,
      type T ->
      type (typ_mut mut_readonly T)
  | type_intersect : forall T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      type T2 ->
      type (typ_int T1 T2)
  | type_record : forall a T1,
      type T1 ->
      type (typ_record a T1)
.

Inductive expr : exp -> Prop :=
  | expr_var : forall x,
      expr (exp_fvar x)
  | expr_abs : forall L T e1,
      type T ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e1 x)) ->
      expr (exp_abs T e1)
  | expr_app : forall e1 e2,
      expr e1 ->
      expr e2 ->
      expr (exp_app e1 e2)
  | expr_tabs : forall L T e1,
      type T ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> expr (open_te e1 X)) ->
      expr (exp_tabs T e1)
  | expr_tapp : forall e1 V,
      expr e1 ->
      type V ->
      expr (exp_tapp e1 V)
  | expr_let : forall L e1 e2,
      expr e1 ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e2 x)) ->
      expr (exp_let e1 e2)
  | expr_box : forall e,
      expr e ->
      expr (exp_box e)
  | expr_unbox : forall e,
      expr e ->
      expr (exp_unbox e)
  | expr_set_box : forall e1 e2,
      expr e1 ->
      expr e2 ->
      expr (exp_set_box e1 e2)
  | expr_ref : forall l,
      expr (exp_ref l)
  | expr_seal : forall e,
      expr e ->
      expr (exp_seal e)
  | expr_record : forall r,
      record_comp r ->
      expr (exp_record r)
  | expr_record_read : forall e a,
      expr e ->
      expr (exp_record_read e a)
  | expr_record_write : forall e1 a e2,
      expr e1 ->
      expr e2 ->
      expr (exp_record_write e1 a e2)
with record_comp : rec_comp -> Prop :=
  | record_comp_empty :
      record_comp (rec_empty)
  | record_comp_exp : forall a e r,
      expr e ->
      record_comp r ->
      record_comp (rec_exp a e r)
  | record_comp_ref : forall a e r,
      record_comp r ->
      record_comp (rec_ref a e r)
.

Definition body_e (e : exp) :=
  exists L, forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e x).

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : typ -> binding
  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Inductive signature : Set :=
  | bind_sig : typ -> signature.

Notation env := (list (atom * binding)).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Notation sig := (list (label * signature)).

Notation sempty := (@nil (label * signature)).

Inductive wf_typ : env -> typ -> Prop :=
  | wf_typ_top : forall E,
      wf_typ E typ_top
  | wf_typ_var : forall U E (X : atom),
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      wf_typ E (typ_fvar X)
  | wf_typ_arrow : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_all : forall L E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        wf_typ (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      wf_typ E (typ_all T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_box : forall E T,
      wf_typ E T ->
      wf_typ E (typ_box T)
  | wf_typ_readonly : forall E T,
      wf_typ E T ->
      wf_typ E (typ_mut mut_readonly T)
  | wf_typ_intersect : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_int T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_record : forall E a T1,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_record a T1)
.

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T ->
      X `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive wf_sig : env -> sig -> Prop :=
    | wf_sig_empty : forall E,
        wf_env E ->
        wf_sig E sempty
    | wf_sig_typ : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (l : label) (T : typ),
        wf_sig E R ->
        wf_typ E T ->
        LabelSetImpl.notin l (Signatures.dom R) ->
        wf_sig E (l ~ bind_sig T ++ R).

Fixpoint merge_mutability (T : typ) (m : mut) {struct T} :=
    match T with

Lemma sub_refl_wf : forall E T, wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> sub E T T.
Proof.
  intros E T Hwf Hwt. revert Hwf. induction Hwt; intros Hwf.
  - apply sub_top; [exact Hwf | apply wf_typ_top].
  - apply sub_refl_tvar; [exact Hwf | apply wf_typ_var with (U:=U); exact H].
  - apply sub_arrow; [apply IHHwt1; exact Hwf | apply IHHwt2; exact Hwf].
  - apply sub_all with (L := L `union` dom E).
    + apply (IHHwt Hwf).
    + intros X HX.
      pose proof HX as HXL. apply notin_union_1 in HXL.
      pose proof HX as HXD. apply notin_union_2 in HXD.
      assert (HwfX : wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E)).
      { apply wf_env_sub; assumption. }
      apply (H0 X HXL HwfX).
  - apply sub_box; [apply IHHwt; exact Hwf | apply IHHwt; exact Hwf].
  - apply sub_readonly. apply IHHwt; exact Hwf.
  - apply sub_inter with (T1:=typ_int T1 T2).
    + apply sub_inter_left; [exact Hwf | exact Hwt1 | exact Hwt2].
    + apply sub_inter_right; [exact Hwf | exact Hwt1 | exact Hwt2].
  - apply sub_record; [apply IHHwt; exact Hwf | apply IHHwt; exact Hwf].

Definition env_sub_shape (E E' : env) : Prop :=
  forall Y U, binds Y (bind_sub U) E -> exists U', binds Y (bind_sub U') E'.

Lemma env_sub_shape_cons_sub : forall E E',
  env_sub_shape E E' ->
  forall X U V, env_sub_shape (X ~ bind_sub U ++ E) (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E').
Proof.
  intros E E' Hshape X U V Y W HY.
  apply binds_cons_iff in HY.
  destruct HY as [[Heq1 Heq2] | HY].
  - subst. exists V. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity.
  - destruct (Hshape Y W HY) as [W' HW'].
    exists W'. apply binds_cons_3. exact HW'.
Qed.

Lemma env_sub_shape_cons_typ : forall E E',
  env_sub_shape E E' ->
  forall X U V, env_sub_shape (X ~ bind_typ U ++ E) (X ~ bind_typ V ++ E').
Proof.
  intros E E' Hshape X U V Y W HY.
  apply binds_cons_iff in HY.
  destruct HY as [[Heq1 Heq2] | HY].
  - subst. inversion Heq2.
  - destruct (Hshape Y W HY) as [W' HW'].
    exists W'. apply binds_cons_3. exact HW'.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_env_sub_shape : forall E T, wf_typ E T ->
  forall E', env_sub_shape E E' -> wf_typ E' T.
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction H; intros E' Hshape.
  - apply wf_typ_top.
  - destruct (Hshape X U H) as [U' HU'].
    apply wf_typ_var with (U:=U'). exact HU'.
  - apply wf_typ_arrow.
    + apply (IHwf_typ1 E' Hshape).
    + apply (IHwf_typ2 E' Hshape).
  - apply wf_typ_all with (L:=L).
    + apply (IHwf_typ E' Hshape).
    + intros X HX.
      pose proof (H1 X HX (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E')) as HB.
      apply HB. apply env_sub_shape_cons_sub; exact Hshape.
  - apply wf_typ_box. apply (IHwf_typ E' Hshape).
  - apply wf_typ_readonly. apply (IHwf_typ E' Hshape).
  - apply wf_typ_intersect; [apply (IHwf_typ1 E' Hshape) | apply (IHwf_typ2 E' Hshape)].
  - apply wf_typ_record. apply (IHwf_typ E' Hshape).
Qed.

Definition env_sub_shape (E E' : env) : Prop :=
  forall Y U, binds Y (bind_sub U) E -> exists U', binds Y (bind_sub U') E'.

Lemma env_sub_shape_cons_sub : forall E E',
  env_sub_shape E E' ->
  forall X U V, env_sub_shape (X ~ bind_sub U ++ E) (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E').
Proof.
  intros E E' Hshape X U V Y W HY.
  apply binds_cons_iff in HY.
  destruct HY as [[Heq1 Heq2] | HY].
  - subst. exists V. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity.
  - destruct (Hshape Y W HY) as [W' HW'].
    exists W'. apply binds_cons_3. exact HW'.
Qed.

Lemma env_sub_shape_cons_typ : forall E E',
  env_sub_shape E E' ->
  forall X U V, env_sub_shape (X ~ bind_typ U ++ E) (X ~ bind_typ V ++ E').
Proof.
  intros E E' Hshape X U V Y W HY.
  apply binds_cons_iff in HY.
  destruct HY as [[Heq1 Heq2] | HY].
  - subst. inversion Heq2.
  - destruct (Hshape Y W HY) as [W' HW'].
    exists W'. apply binds_cons_3. exact HW'.
Qed.

Fixpoint record_pred (E : env) (a : atom) (A T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True

  | _ => False
  end.

Lemma record_pred_merge : forall E a A U M,
  record_pred E a A (merge_mutability U M) <-> record_pred E a A U.
Proof.
  intros E a A U. induction U; intros M; simpl; try reflexivity.
  all: try (split; intro Hh; exact Hh).
  - (* int *) rewrite IHU1, IHU2. tauto.

Lemma record_dom_subst_fvar : forall r z u,
  record_dom (subst_fvar_r z u r) = record_dom r.
Proof.
  intros r. induction r; intros z u; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHr. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHr. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma typing_subst_fvar : forall E R e T, typing E R e T ->
  forall x v V, binds x (bind_typ V) E -> typing E R v V -> expr v ->
    typing E R (subst_fvar_e x v e) T.
Proof.
  intros E R e T H.
  induction H using typing_mut with
    (P := fun E R e T (h:typing E R e T) =>
       forall z u U, binds z (bind_typ U) E ->
         typing E R u U -> expr u -> typing E R (subst_fvar_e z u e) T)
    (P0 := fun E R r T (h:typing_record_comp E R r T) =>
       forall z u U, binds z (bind_typ U) E ->
         typing E R u U -> expr u -> typing_record_comp E R (subst_fvar_r z u r) T).
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve.
    simpl. destruct (aeq z x) as [Heq | Hne].
    + subst. assert (HbEq : bind_typ U = bind_typ T).
      { eapply wf_env_binds_fun; [exact w | exact Hb | exact b]. }
      inversion HbEq; subst. exact Hv.
    + apply typing_var; assumption.
  - intros z u U Hb Hv Hve.
    simpl.
    eapply typing_abs with (L := L `union` {{z}} `union` dom E).
    + exact w.
    + intros y Hy.
      pose proof Hy as HyL. apply notin_union_1 in HyL.
      pose proof Hy as Hout2. apply notin_union_2 in Hout2.
      pose proof Hout2 as HyS. apply notin_union_1 in HyS.
Lemma typing_sig_weaken : forall E R e T, typing E R e T ->
  forall R',
    (forall l b, Signatures.binds l b R -> Signatures.binds l b R') ->
    wf_sig E R' -> typing E R' e T.
Proof.
  intros E R e T H.
  induction H using typing_mut with
    (P := fun E R e T (h:typing E R e T) =>
      forall R',
        (forall l b, Signatures.binds l b R -> Signatures.binds l b R') ->
        wf_sig E R' -> typing E R' e T)
    (P0 := fun E R r T (h:typing_record_comp E R r T) =>
      forall R',
        (forall l b, Signatures.binds l b R -> Signatures.binds l b R') ->
        wf_sig E R' -> typing_record_comp E R' r T).
  - intros R' Hb Hs. apply typing_var; assumption.
  - intros R' Hb Hs. eapply typing_abs; [exact Hs | intros x Hx].
    pose proof (t x Hx) as HbodySrc.
    pose proof (typing_wf_env _ _ _ _ HbodySrc) as HwfBody.
    assert (HsExt : wf_sig (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) R').
    { eapply wf_sig_weaken_binds; [exact Hs | exact HwfBody |].
      intros Z c HZ. apply binds_cons_3. exact HZ. }
    apply (H x Hx R' Hb HsExt).
  - intros R' Hb Hs. eapply typing_app; [exact Hs | apply (IHtyping1 R' Hb Hs) | apply (IHtyping2 R' Hb Hs)].
  - intros R' Hb Hs. eapply typing_tabs; [exact Hs | intros X0 HX].
    pose proof (t X0 HX) as HbodySrc.
    pose proof (typing_wf_env _ _ _ _ HbodySrc) as HwfBody.
    assert (HsExt : wf_sig (X0 ~ bind_sub V ++ E) R').
    { eapply wf_sig_weaken_binds; [exact Hs | exact HwfBody |].
      intros Z c HZ. apply binds_cons_3. exact HZ. }
    apply (H X0 HX R' Hb HsExt).
  - intros R' Hb Hs. eapply typing_tapp; [exact Hs | apply (IHtyping R' Hb Hs) | exact s].
  - intros R' Hb Hs. eapply typing_sub; [exact Hs | apply (IHtyping R' Hb Hs) | exact s].
  - intros R' Hb Hs. eapply typing_let; [exact Hs | apply (IHtyping R' Hb Hs) | intros x Hx].
    pose proof (t x Hx) as HbodySrc.
    pose proof (typing_wf_env _ _ _ _ HbodySrc) as HwfBody.
    assert (HsExt : wf_sig (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E) R').
    { eapply wf_sig_weaken_binds; [exact Hs | exact HwfBody |].
      intros Z c HZ. apply binds_cons_3. exact HZ. }
    apply (H0 x Hx R' Hb HsExt).
  - intros R' Hb Hs. apply typing_box with (T:=T); [exact Hs | apply (IHtyping R' Hb Hs)].
  - intros R' Hb Hs. apply typing_unbox with (T:=T); [exact Hs | apply (IHtyping R' Hb Hs)].
  - intros R' Hb Hs. eapply typing_set_box with (T:=T); [exact Hs | apply (IHtyping1 R' Hb Hs) | apply (IHtyping2 R' Hb Hs)].
  - intros R' Hb Hs. apply typing_ref with (T:=T); [exact w | exact Hs | apply Hb; exact b].
  - intros R' Hb Hs. apply typing_seal with (T:=T); apply (IHtyping R' Hb Hs).
  - intros R' Hb Hs. apply typing_unbox_readonly with (T:=T); apply (IHtyping R' Hb Hs).
  - intros R' Hb Hs. apply typing_record with (T:=T); apply (IHtyping R' Hb Hs).
  - intros R' Hb Hs. apply typing_record_read with (a:=a) (T:=T); apply (IHtyping R' Hb Hs).
  - intros R' Hb Hs. apply typing_record_read_readonly with (a:=a) (T:=T); apply (IHtyping R' Hb Hs).
  - intros R' Hb Hs. eapply typing_record_write with (a:=a) (T:=T); [apply (IHtyping1 R' Hb Hs) | apply (IHtyping2 R' Hb Hs)].
  - intros R' Hb Hs. apply typing_record_empty; assumption.
  - intros R' Hb Hs. eapply typing_record_exp with (a:=a) (T:=T); [exact n | apply (IHtyping R' Hb Hs) | apply (IHtyping0 R' Hb Hs)].
  - intros R' Hb Hs. eapply typing_record_ref with (a:=a) (T:=T); [exact n | apply (IHtyping R' Hb Hs) | apply Hb; exact b].
Qed.

Lemma wf_sig_binds_fun : forall E R, wf_sig E R ->
  forall lb T1 T2,
    Signatures.binds lb (bind_sig T1) R ->
    Signatures.binds lb (bind_sig T2) R -> T1 = T2.
Proof.
  intros E R H. induction H; intros lb T1 T2 Hb1 Hb2.
  - inversion Hb1.
  - simpl in Hb1, Hb2.
    destruct Hb1 as [Heq1 | Hin1]; destruct Hb2 as [Heq2 | Hin2].
    + inversion Heq1; inversion Heq2; subst; reflexivity.
    + inversion Heq1. subst.
      exfalso. eapply Signatures.binds_dom_contradiction; [exact Hin2 | exact H1].
    + inversion Heq2. subst.
      exfalso. eapply Signatures.binds_dom_contradiction; [exact Hin1 | exact H1].
    + apply (IHwf_sig lb T1 T2 Hin1 Hin2).
Qed.

Lemma typing_store_wf_store : forall E R s,
  typing_store E R s -> well_formed_store s.
Proof.
  intros E R s H l v Hm.
  destruct (proj2 (H l) v Hm) as [T [Hval [Htyp Hb]]].
  exact Hval.
Qed.

Lemma typing_sig_add : forall E R l T e T0,
  typing E R e T0 -> wf_sig E R -> wf_typ E T ->
  LabelSetImpl.notin l (Signatures.dom R) ->
  typing E (l ~ bind_sig T ++ R) e T0.
Proof.
  intros E R l T e T0 Hty Hsig Hwt Hnotin.
  eapply typing_sig_weaken; [exact Hty | |].
  - intros l' b Hb. apply Signatures.binds_app_3. exact Hb.
  - apply wf_sig_typ with (R:=R) (l:=l) (T:=T); assumption.
Qed.


Lemma env_sub_shape_prefix : forall D E, env_sub_shape E (D ++ E).
Proof.
  intros D E Y U HY. exists U. apply binds_app_3. exact HY.
Qed.

  forall D E0 X U V,
    E = D ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E0 ->
    wf_env E ->
    subst_tvar_env X V E0 = E0 ->
    subst_tvar_sig X V R = R ->
    type V -> wf_typ E0 V ->
    wf_env (subst_tvar_env X V D ++ E0) ->
    wf_sig (subst_tvar_env X V D ++ E0) R ->
    sub E0 V U ->
    typing (subst_tvar_env X V D ++ E0) R
      (subst_tvar_e X V e) (subst_tvar_t X V T).
Proof.
  intros E R e T H.
  induction H using typing_mut with
    (P := fun E R e T (h:typing E R e T) =>
      forall D E0 X U V,
        E = D ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E0 ->
        wf_env E ->
        subst_tvar_env X V E0 = E0 ->
        subst_tvar_sig X V R = R ->
        type V -> wf_typ E0 V ->
        wf_env (subst_tvar_env X V D ++ E0) ->
        wf_sig (subst_tvar_env X V D ++ E0) R ->
        sub E0 V U ->
        typing (subst_tvar_env X V D ++ E0) R
          (subst_tvar_e X V e) (subst_tvar_t X V T))
    (P0 := fun E R r T (h:typing_record_comp E R r T) =>
      forall D E0 X U V,
        E = D ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E0 ->
        wf_env E ->
Definition subst_tvar_binding (X : atom) (U : typ) (b : binding) : binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub T => bind_sub (subst_tvar_t X U T)
  | bind_typ T => bind_typ (subst_tvar_t X U T)
  end.

Definition subst_tvar_env (X : atom) (U : typ) (E : env) : env :=
  List.map (fun p => (fst p, subst_tvar_binding X U (snd p))) E.

Definition subst_tvar_sig_entry (X : atom) (U : typ) (s : signature) : signature :=
  match s with bind_sig T => bind_sig (subst_tvar_t X U T) end.

Definition subst_tvar_sig (X : atom) (U : typ) (R : sig) : sig :=
  List.map (fun p => (fst p, subst_tvar_sig_entry X U (snd p))) R.

Lemma dom_subst_tvar_env : forall X U E, dom (subst_tvar_env X U E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros X U E. induction E as [|[y b] E IH]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma dom_subst_tvar_sig : forall X U R, Signatures.dom (subst_tvar_sig X U R) = Signatures.dom R.
Proof.
  intros X U R. induction R as [|[l s] R IH]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_subst_tvar_env : forall X U E y b,
  binds y b E -> binds y (subst_tvar_binding X U b) (subst_tvar_env X U E).
Proof.
  intros X U E. induction E as [|[y' b'] E IH]; intros y b Hb.
  - apply binds_nil_iff in Hb. destruct Hb.
  - simpl. apply binds_cons_iff in Hb.
    destruct Hb as [[Heq1 Heq2] | Hb].
    + subst. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity.
    + apply binds_cons_3. apply IH. exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma binds_subst_tvar_sig : forall X U R l T,
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig (subst_tvar_t X U T)) (subst_tvar_sig X U R).
Proof.
  intros X U R. induction R as [|[l' s] R IH]; intros l T Hb.
  - inversion Hb.
  - simpl in Hb. destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. simpl. left. reflexivity.
    + simpl. right. apply IH. exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_subst_tvar : forall E T, wf_typ E T ->
  forall X U, type U -> wf_typ (subst_tvar_env X U E) U ->
    wf_typ (subst_tvar_env X U E) (subst_tvar_t X U T).
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction H; intros Xs Us HUs HwtUs; simpl.
  - apply wf_typ_top.
  - destruct (aeq Xs X) as [Heq | Hne].
    + subst. exact HwtUs.
    + apply wf_typ_var with (U:=subst_tvar_t Xs Us U). exact (binds_subst_tvar_env Xs Us E X (bind_sub U) H).
  - apply wf_typ_arrow.
    + apply (IHwf_typ1 Xs Us HUs HwtUs).
    + apply (IHwf_typ2 Xs Us HUs HwtUs).
  - apply wf_typ_all with (L := L `union` {{Xs}}).
    + apply (IHwf_typ Xs Us HUs HwtUs).
    + intros Y HY.
      pose proof HY as HYL. apply notin_union_1 in HYL.
      pose proof HY as HYS. apply notin_union_2 in HYS.
      pose proof (notin_singleton_1 Xs Y HYS) as Hne.
      assert (HfvY : Xs `notin` ftv_t (typ_fvar Y)).
      { simpl. apply notin_singleton. intro Heq. apply Hne. symmetry. exact Heq. }
      assert (HwtUs' : wf_typ (Y ~ bind_sub (subst_tvar_t Xs Us T1) ++ subst_tvar_env Xs Us E) Us).
      { eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; [exact HwtUs |].
        intros Z c HZ. apply binds_cons_3. exact HZ. }
      pose proof (H1 Y HYL Xs Us HUs HwtUs') as Hbody.
      unfold open_tt in Hbody.
      rewrite (subst_tvar_t_open_tt_comm T2 Xs Us 0 (typ_fvar Y) (type_tlc Us HUs) HfvY) in Hbody.
      exact Hbody.
  - apply wf_typ_box. apply (IHwf_typ Xs Us HUs HwtUs).
  - apply wf_typ_readonly. apply (IHwf_typ Xs Us HUs HwtUs).
  - apply wf_typ_intersect.
    + apply (IHwf_typ1 Xs Us HUs HwtUs).
    + apply (IHwf_typ2 Xs Us HUs HwtUs).
  - apply wf_typ_record. apply (IHwf_typ Xs Us HUs HwtUs).
Qed.

Lemma notin_ftv_typ_fvar : forall X Y, X <> Y -> X `notin` ftv_t (typ_fvar Y).
Proof.

  typing E R e T -> wf_env E -> wf_sig E R -> typing_store E R s ->
  exists v s', redm e s v s' /\ value v.

Axiom redm_det_value : forall e s e1 s1 e2 s2,
  redm e s e1 s1 -> value e1 -> redm e s e2 s2 -> value e2 ->
  e1 = e2 /\ s1 = s2.

Axiom wf_store_of_sealcomp_typing : forall s ns E R,
  typing_store E R ns -> s <s= ns -> well_formed_store s.

Theorem safety_value_multistep_assembly : forall e s e' s' f ns R T,
  sealcomp_store s ns ->
  sealcomp e f ->
  redm e s e' s' ->
  value e' ->
  typing_store empty R ns ->
  typing empty R f T ->
  exists f' ns', sealcomp e' f' /\ sealcomp_store s' ns' /\ value f' /\ redm f ns f' ns'.
Proof.
  intros e s e' s' f ns R T Hscstore Hsc Hrede Hve Hst Hty.
  pose proof (typing_expr _ _ _ _ Hty) as Hexprf.
  pose proof (typing_wf_env _ _ _ _ Hty) as HwfE.
  pose proof (typing_wf_sig _ _ _ _ Hty) as HwfR.
  destruct (typed_safety f ns empty R T Hty HwfE HwfR Hst) as [f' [ns' [Hredf Hvf]]].
  pose proof (value_expr _ Hve) as Hexpre.
  pose proof (redm_source_expr _ _ _ _ Hrede Hexpre) as Hexpre0.
  pose proof (wf_store_of_sealcomp_typing s ns empty R Hst Hscstore) as Hwfs.
  destruct (safety_value_multistep'_proof e s f ns f' ns'
    Hexprf Hexpre0 Hwfs Hscstore Hsc Hredf Hvf)
    as [e'' [s'' [Hrede' [Hscstore' [Hsc' Hve']]]]].
  destruct (redm_det_value e s e' s' e'' s'' Hrede Hve Hrede' Hve') as [Heq Hs].
  subst e'' s''.
  exists f', ns'. auto.
Qed.

Lemma sub_wf_env : forall E A B, sub E A B -> wf_env E.
Proof.
  intros E A B H. induction H; auto.
Qed.

Lemma sub_weaken_binds : forall E A B, sub E A B ->
  forall E', wf_env E' ->
  (forall X b, binds X b E -> binds X b E') ->
  sub E' A B.
Proof.
  intros E A B H.
  induction H; intros E' Hwf' Hb.
  - apply sub_top.
    + exact Hwf'.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; eassumption.
  - apply sub_refl_tvar.
    + exact Hwf'.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; eassumption.
  - apply sub_trans_tvar with (U:=U).
    + apply Hb. exact H.
    + apply IHsub. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
  - apply sub_arrow.
    + apply IHsub1. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
    + apply IHsub2. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
  - (* sub_all *)
    apply sub_all with (L := L `union` dom E').
    + apply IHsub. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
    + intros X HX.
      pose proof HX as HXL. apply notin_union_1 in HXL.
      pose proof HX as HXD. apply notin_union_2 in HXD.
      assert (HwfX : wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E)).
      { eapply sub_wf_env. apply H0. exact HXL. }
      assert (Hwt : wf_typ E T1).
      { inversion HwfX; subst; assumption. }
      assert (Hwt' : wf_typ E' T1).
      { eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; eassumption. }
      assert (HwfEE' : wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E')).
      { apply wf_env_sub; assumption. }
      apply (H1 X HXL (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E') HwfEE').
      intros Y c HY. apply binds_cons_iff in HY.
      destruct HY as [[HYe1 HYe2] | HY].
      * subst. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity.
      * apply binds_cons_3. apply Hb. exact HY.
  - apply sub_box.
    + apply IHsub1. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
    + apply IHsub2. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
  - apply sub_readonly. apply IHsub. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
  - apply sub_readonly_mutable. apply IHsub. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
  - eapply sub_trans.
    + apply IHsub1. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
    + apply IHsub2. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
  - apply sub_inter_left.
    + exact Hwf'.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; eassumption.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; eassumption.
  - apply sub_inter_right.
    + exact Hwf'.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; eassumption.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; eassumption.
  - apply sub_inter.
    + apply IHsub1. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
    + apply IHsub2. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
  - apply sub_record.
    + apply IHsub1. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
    + apply IHsub2. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
  - apply sub_readonly_record. apply IHsub. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
  - apply sub_denormalize.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; eassumption.
    + eapply wf_typ_weaken_binds; eassumption.
    + apply IHsub. exact Hwf'. exact Hb.
Qed.

21	Inductive typ : Set :=
22	  | typ_top : typ
23	  | typ_bvar : nat -> typ
24	  | typ_fvar : atom -> typ
25	  | typ_arrow : typ -> typ -> typ
26	  | typ_all : typ -> typ -> typ
27	
28	  | typ_box : typ -> typ
29	
30	  | typ_mut : mut -> typ -> typ
31	
32	  | typ_int : typ -> typ -> typ

34	  | typ_record : atom -> typ -> typ

37	Inductive exp : Set :=
38	  | exp_bvar : nat -> exp
39	  | exp_fvar : atom -> exp
40	  | exp_abs : typ -> exp -> exp
41	  | exp_app : exp -> exp -> exp
42	  | exp_tabs : typ -> exp -> exp
43	  | exp_tapp : exp -> typ -> exp
44	  | exp_let : exp -> exp -> exp
45	
46	  | exp_box : exp -> exp
47	  | exp_unbox : exp -> exp
48	  | exp_set_box : exp -> exp -> exp
49	  | exp_ref : label -> exp
50	
51	  | exp_seal : exp -> exp
52	
53	  | exp_record : rec_comp -> exp
54	  | exp_record_read : exp -> atom -> exp
55	  | exp_record_write: exp -> atom -> exp -> exp
56	with rec_comp : Set :=
57	
58	
59	  | rec_empty : rec_comp
60	  | rec_exp : atom -> exp -> rec_comp -> rec_comp
61	  | rec_ref : atom -> label -> rec_comp -> rec_comp

64	Coercion typ_bvar : nat >-> typ.

72	Fixpoint open_tt_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (T : typ)  {struct T} : typ :=
73	  match T with
74	  | typ_top => typ_top
75	  | typ_bvar J => if K == J then U else (typ_bvar J)
76	  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar X
77	  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
78	  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec (S K) U T2)
79	  | typ_box T => typ_box (open_tt_rec K U T)
80	  | typ_mut M T => typ_mut M (open_tt_rec K U T)
81	  | typ_int T1 T2 => typ_int (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
82	  | typ_record a T1 => typ_record a (open_tt_rec K U T1)
83	  end.
84	
85	Fixpoint open_te_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
86	  match e with
87	  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
88	  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
89	  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs  (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec K U e1)
90	  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app  (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
91	  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec (S K) U e1)
92	  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_tt_rec K U V)
93	  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
94	  | exp_box e => exp_box (open_te_rec K U e)
95	  | exp_unbox e => exp_unbox (open_te_rec K U e)
96	  | exp_set_box b e => exp_set_box (open_te_rec K U b) (open_te_rec K U e)
97	  | exp_ref l => exp_ref l
98	  | exp_seal e => exp_seal (open_te_rec K U e)
99	  | exp_record r => exp_record (open_te_record_rec K U r)
100	  | exp_record_read e a => exp_record_read (open_te_rec K U e) a
101	  | exp_record_write e1 a e2 => exp_record_write (open_te_rec K U e1) a (open_te_rec K U e2)
102	  end
103	with
104	  open_te_record_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (r : rec_comp) {struct r} : rec_comp :=
105	  match r with
106	  | rec_empty => rec_empty
107	  | rec_exp a e r => rec_exp a (open_te_rec K U e) (open_te_record_rec K U r)
108	  | rec_ref a l r => rec_ref a l (open_te_record_rec K U r)
109	  end.
110	
111	Fixpoint open_ee_rec (k : nat) (f : exp) (e : exp)  {struct e} : exp :=
112	  match e with
113	  | exp_bvar i => if k == i then f else (exp_bvar i)
114	  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
115	  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs V (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)
116	  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
117	  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs V (open_ee_rec k f e1)
118	  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_ee_rec k f e1) V
119	  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec (S k) f e2)
120	  | exp_box e => exp_box (open_ee_rec k f e)
121	  | exp_unbox e => exp_unbox (open_ee_rec k f  e)
122	  | exp_set_box b e => exp_set_box (open_ee_rec k f b) (open_ee_rec k f e)
123	  | exp_ref l => exp_ref l
124	  | exp_seal e => exp_seal (open_ee_rec k f e)
125	  | exp_record r => exp_record (open_ee_record_rec k f r)
126	  | exp_record_read e a => exp_record_read (open_ee_rec k f e) a
127	  | exp_record_write e1 a e2 => exp_record_write (open_ee_rec k f e1) a (open_ee_rec k f e2)
128	  end
129	with
130	  open_ee_record_rec (k : nat) (f : exp) (r : rec_comp)  {struct r} : rec_comp :=
131	  match r with
132	  | rec_empty => rec_empty
133	  | rec_exp a e r => rec_exp a (open_ee_rec k f e) (open_ee_record_rec k f r)
134	  | rec_ref a l r => rec_ref a l (open_ee_record_rec k f r)
135	  end.
136	
137	Definition open_tt T U := open_tt_rec 0 U T.
138	
139	Definition open_te e U := open_te_rec 0 U e.
140	
141	Definition open_ee e1 e2 := open_ee_rec 0 e2 e1.
142	
143	Inductive type : typ -> Prop :=
144	  | type_top :
145	      type typ_top
146	  | type_var : forall X,
147	      type (typ_fvar X)
148	  | type_arrow : forall T1 T2,
149	      type T1 ->
150	      type T2 ->
151	      type (typ_arrow T1 T2)
152	  | type_all : forall L T1 T2,
153	      type T1 ->
154	      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> type (open_tt T2 X)) ->
155	      type (typ_all T1 T2)
156	  | type_box : forall T,
157	      type T ->
158	      type (typ_box T)
159	  | type_readonly : forall T,
160	      type T ->
161	      type (typ_mut mut_readonly T)
162	  | type_intersect : forall T1 T2,
163	      type T1 ->
164	      type T2 ->
165	      type (typ_int T1 T2)
166	  | type_record : forall a T1,
167	      type T1 ->
168	      type (typ_record a T1)
169	.
170	
171	Inductive expr : exp -> Prop :=
172	  | expr_var : forall x,
173	      expr (exp_fvar x)
174	  | expr_abs : forall L T e1,
175	      type T ->
176	      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e1 x)) ->
177	      expr (exp_abs T e1)
178	  | expr_app : forall e1 e2,
179	      expr e1 ->
180	      expr e2 ->
181	      expr (exp_app e1 e2)
182	  | expr_tabs : forall L T e1,
183	      type T ->
184	      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> expr (open_te e1 X)) ->
185	      expr (exp_tabs T e1)
186	  | expr_tapp : forall e1 V,
187	      expr e1 ->
188	      type V ->
189	      expr (exp_tapp e1 V)
190	  | expr_let : forall L e1 e2,
191	      expr e1 ->
192	      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e2 x)) ->
193	      expr (exp_let e1 e2)
194	  | expr_box : forall e,
195	      expr e ->
196	      expr (exp_box e)
197	  | expr_unbox : forall e,
198	      expr e ->
199	      expr (exp_unbox e)
200	  | expr_set_box : forall e1 e2,
201	      expr e1 ->
202	      expr e2 ->
203	      expr (exp_set_box e1 e2)
204	  | expr_ref : forall l,
205	      expr (exp_ref l)
206	  | expr_seal : forall e,
207	      expr e ->
208	      expr (exp_seal e)
209	  | expr_record : forall r,
210	      record_comp r ->
211	      expr (exp_record r)
212	  | expr_record_read : forall e a,
213	      expr e ->
214	      expr (exp_record_read e a)
215	  | expr_record_write : forall e1 a e2,
216	      expr e1 ->
217	      expr e2 ->
218	      expr (exp_record_write e1 a e2)
219	with record_comp : rec_comp -> Prop :=
220	  | record_comp_empty :
221	      record_comp (rec_empty)
222	  | record_comp_exp : forall a e r,
223	      expr e ->
224	      record_comp r ->
225	      record_comp (rec_exp a e r)
226	  | record_comp_ref : forall a e r,
227	      record_comp r ->
228	      record_comp (rec_ref a e r)
229	.

231	Definition body_e (e : exp) :=
232	  exists L, forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e x).

234	Inductive binding : Set :=
235	  | bind_sub : typ -> binding
236	  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.
237	
238	Inductive signature : Set :=
239	  | bind_sig : typ -> signature.
240	
241	Notation env := (list (atom * binding)).
242	
243	Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).
244	
245	Notation sig := (list (label * signature)).
246	
247	Notation sempty := (@nil (label * signature)).

249	Inductive wf_typ : env -> typ -> Prop :=
250	  | wf_typ_top : forall E,
251	      wf_typ E typ_top
252	  | wf_typ_var : forall U E (X : atom),
253	      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
254	      wf_typ E (typ_fvar X)
255	  | wf_typ_arrow : forall E T1 T2,
256	      wf_typ E T1 ->
257	      wf_typ E T2 ->
258	      wf_typ E (typ_arrow T1 T2)
259	  | wf_typ_all : forall L E T1 T2,
260	      wf_typ E T1 ->
261	      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
262	        wf_typ (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
263	      wf_typ E (typ_all T1 T2)
264	  | wf_typ_box : forall E T,
265	      wf_typ E T ->
266	      wf_typ E (typ_box T)
267	  | wf_typ_readonly : forall E T,
268	      wf_typ E T ->
269	      wf_typ E (typ_mut mut_readonly T)
270	  | wf_typ_intersect : forall E T1 T2,
271	      wf_typ E T1 ->
272	      wf_typ E T2 ->
273	      wf_typ E (typ_int T1 T2)
274	  | wf_typ_record : forall E a T1,
275	      wf_typ E T1 ->
276	      wf_typ E (typ_record a T1)
277	.
278	
279	Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
280	  | wf_env_empty :
281	      wf_env empty
282	  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) (T : typ),
283	      wf_env E ->
284	      wf_typ E T ->
285	      X `notin` dom E ->
286	      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T ++ E)
287	  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
288	      wf_env E ->
289	      wf_typ E T ->
290	      x `notin` dom E ->
291	      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).
292	
293	Inductive wf_sig : env -> sig -> Prop :=
294	    | wf_sig_empty : forall E,
295	        wf_env E ->
296	        wf_sig E sempty
297	    | wf_sig_typ : forall (E : env) (R : sig) (l : label) (T : typ),
298	        wf_sig E R ->
299	        wf_typ E T ->
300	        LabelSetImpl.notin l (Signatures.dom R) ->
301	        wf_sig E (l ~ bind_sig T ++ R).
302	
303	Fixpoint merge_mutability (T : typ) (m : mut) {struct T} :=
304	    match T with
305	
306	
307	
308	    | typ_bvar J => (typ_mut m T)
309	    | typ_fvar X => (typ_mut m (typ_fvar X))
310	    | typ_box T => (typ_mut m (typ_box T))
311	    | typ_record a T => (typ_mut m (typ_record a T))
312	
313	    | typ_int T1 T2 => (typ_int (merge_mutability T1 m) (merge_mutability T2 m))
314	
315	    | _ => T
316	    end.
317	
318	Fixpoint normal_form_typing (T : typ) {struct T} :=
319	    match T with
320	    | typ_top => typ_top
321	    | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
322	    | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar X
323	    | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2)
324	    | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2)
325	    | typ_box T => typ_box (normal_form_typing T)
326	    | typ_int T1 T2 => typ_int (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2)
327	    | typ_mut M T =>
328	        (merge_mutability (normal_form_typing T) M)
329	    | typ_record a T => typ_record a (normal_form_typing T)
330	    end.
331	
332	Arguments merge_mutability T m /.
333	
334	Arguments normal_form_typing T /.

336	Inductive in_normal_form : typ -> Prop :=
337	  | top_in_normal_form :
338	    in_normal_form typ_top
339	  | fvar_in_normal_form : forall (X : atom),
340	    in_normal_form X
341	  | readonly_fvar_in_normal_form : forall (X : atom) m,
342	    in_normal_form (typ_mut m X)
343	  | arrow_in_normal_form : forall T1 T2,
344	    in_normal_form T1 ->
345	    in_normal_form T2 ->
346	    in_normal_form (typ_arrow T1 T2)
347	  | all_in_normal_form : forall L T1 T2,
348	    in_normal_form T1 ->
349	    (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> in_normal_form (open_tt T2 X)) ->
350	    in_normal_form (typ_all T1 T2)
351	  | box_in_normal_form : forall T,
352	    in_normal_form T ->
353	    in_normal_form (typ_box T)
354	  | readonly_box_in_normal_form : forall T m,
355	    in_normal_form T ->
356	    in_normal_form (typ_mut m (typ_box T))
357	  | int_in_normal_form : forall T1 T2,
358	    in_normal_form T1 ->
359	    in_normal_form T2 ->
360	    in_normal_form (typ_int T1 T2)
361	  | record_in_normal_form : forall a T1,
362	    in_normal_form T1 ->
363	    in_normal_form (typ_record a T1)
364	  | readonly_record_in_normal_form : forall T a m,
365	    in_normal_form T ->
366	    in_normal_form (typ_mut m (typ_record a T))
367	.

369	Inductive in_intersection : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
370	  | actually_equal : forall S T,
371	    S = T ->
372	    in_intersection S T
373	  | in_intersection_left : forall S L R,
374	    in_intersection S L ->
375	    in_intersection S (typ_int L R)
376	  | in_intersection_right : forall S L R,
377	    in_intersection S R ->
378	    in_intersection S (typ_int L R).
379	
380	Definition in_intersection_component (S T : typ) :=
381	    (~ exists L R, S = typ_int L R) /\
382	    (in_intersection S T).

384	Inductive sub : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
385	  | sub_top : forall E S,
386	      wf_env E ->
387	      wf_typ E S ->
388	      sub E S typ_top
389	  | sub_refl_tvar : forall E X,
390	      wf_env E ->
391	      wf_typ E (typ_fvar X) ->
392	      sub E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
393	  | sub_trans_tvar : forall U E T X,
394	      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
395	      sub E U T ->
396	      sub E (typ_fvar X) T
397	  | sub_arrow : forall E S1 S2 T1 T2,
398	      sub E T1 S1 ->
399	      sub E S2 T2 ->
400	      sub E (typ_arrow S1 S2) (typ_arrow T1 T2)
401	  | sub_all : forall L E S1 S2 T1 T2,
402	      sub E T1 S1 ->
403	      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
404	          sub (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt S2 X) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
405	      sub E (typ_all S1 S2) (typ_all T1 T2)
406	  | sub_box : forall E T1 T2,
407	      sub E T1 T2 ->
408	      sub E T2 T1 ->
409	      sub E (typ_box T1) (typ_box T2)
410	
411	  | sub_readonly : forall E T1 T2,
412	      sub E T1 T2 ->
413	      sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly T1) (typ_mut mut_readonly T2)
414	
415	  | sub_readonly_mutable : forall E T1 T2,
416	      sub E T1 T2 ->
417	      sub E T1 (typ_mut mut_readonly T2)
418	  | sub_trans : forall E T1 T2 T3,
419	      sub E T1 T2 ->
420	      sub E T2 T3 ->
421	      sub E T1 T3
422	  | sub_inter_left : forall E T1 T2,
423	      wf_env E ->
424	      wf_typ E T1 ->
425	      wf_typ E T2 ->
426	      sub E (typ_int T1 T2) T1
427	  | sub_inter_right : forall E T1 T2,
428	      wf_env E ->
429	      wf_typ E T1 ->
430	      wf_typ E T2 ->
431	      sub E (typ_int T1 T2) T2
432	  | sub_inter : forall E T1 T2 T3,
433	      sub E T1 T2 ->
434	      sub E T1 T3 ->
435	      sub E T1 (typ_int T2 T3)
436	  | sub_record : forall E a T1 T2,
437	      sub E T1 T2 ->
438	      sub E T2 T1 ->
439	      sub E (typ_record a T1) (typ_record a T2)
440	
441	  | sub_readonly_record : forall E a T1 T2,
442	      sub E T1 T2 ->
443	      sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T1)) (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T2))
444	
445	  | sub_denormalize : forall E T1 T2,
446	      wf_typ E T1 ->
447	      wf_typ E T2 ->
448	      sub E (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2) ->
449	      sub E T1 T2
450	.
451	
452	Notation "E |-s S <: T" := (sub E S T) (at level 70).

454	Fixpoint record_dom (r : rec_comp)  {struct r} : atoms :=
455	    match r with
456	    | rec_empty => {}
457	    | rec_exp a e r => {{ a }} `union` record_dom r
458	    | rec_ref a l r => {{ a }} `union` record_dom r
459	    end.

461	Inductive typing : env -> sig -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
462	  | typing_var : forall E R x T,
463	      wf_env E ->
464	      wf_sig E R ->
465	      binds x (bind_typ T) E ->
466	      typing E R (exp_fvar x) T
467	  | typing_abs : forall L E R V e1 T1,
468	      wf_sig E R ->
469	      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
470	        typing (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) R (open_ee e1 x) T1) ->
471	      typing E R (exp_abs V e1) (typ_arrow V T1)
472	  | typing_app : forall T1 E R e1 e2 T2,
473	      wf_sig E R ->
474	      typing E R e1 (typ_arrow T1 T2) ->
475	      typing E R e2 T1 ->
476	      typing E R (exp_app e1 e2) T2
477	  | typing_tabs : forall L E R V e1 T1,
478	      wf_sig E R ->
479	      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
480	        typing (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) R (open_te e1 X) (open_tt T1 X)) ->
481	      typing E R (exp_tabs V e1) (typ_all V T1)
482	  | typing_tapp : forall T1 E R e1 T T2,
483	      wf_sig E R ->
484	      typing E R e1 (typ_all T1 T2) ->
485	      sub E T T1 ->
486	      typing E R (exp_tapp e1 T) (open_tt T2 T)
487	  | typing_sub : forall S E R e T,
488	      wf_sig E R ->
489	      typing E R e S ->
490	      sub E S T ->
491	      typing E R e T
492	  | typing_let : forall L T1 T2 e1 e2 E R,
493	      wf_sig E R ->
494	      typing E R e1 T1 ->
495	      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
496	        typing (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E) R (open_ee e2 x) T2) ->
497	      typing E R (exp_let e1 e2) T2
498	  | typing_box : forall E R e T,
499	      wf_sig E R ->
500	      typing E R e T ->
501	      typing E R (exp_box e) (typ_box T)
502	  | typing_unbox : forall E R e T,
503	      wf_sig E R ->
504	      typing E R e (typ_box T) ->
505	      typing E R (exp_unbox e) T
506	
507	  | typing_set_box : forall E R e1 e2 T,
508	      wf_sig E R ->
509	      typing E R e1 (typ_box T) ->
510	      typing E R e2 T ->
511	      typing E R (exp_set_box e1 e2) T
512	  | typing_ref : forall E R l T,
513	      wf_env E ->
514	      wf_sig E R ->
515	      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
516	      typing E R (exp_ref l) (typ_box T)
517	
518	  | typing_seal : forall E R e T,
519	      typing E R e T ->
520	      typing E R (exp_seal e) (typ_mut mut_readonly T)
521	
522	  | typing_unbox_readonly : forall E R e T,
523	      typing E R e (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box T)) ->
524	      typing E R (exp_unbox e) (typ_mut mut_readonly T)
525	  | typing_record : forall E R r T,
526	      typing_record_comp E R r T ->

844	  | exp_bvar i => 0
845	  | exp_fvar x => 0
846	  | exp_abs V e1 => (seal_count e1)
847	  | exp_app e1 e2 => (seal_count e1) + (seal_count e2)
848	  | exp_tabs V e1 => (seal_count e1)
849	  | exp_tapp e1 V => (seal_count e1)
850	  | exp_let e1 e2 => (seal_count e1) + (seal_count e2)
851	  | exp_box e => (seal_count e)
852	  | exp_unbox e => (seal_count e)
853	  | exp_set_box b e => (seal_count b) + (seal_count e)
854	  | exp_ref l => 0

856	  | exp_record r => (seal_count_record r)
857	  | exp_record_read e a => (seal_count e)

Proof.

  - apply type_var.

Lemma typing_store_add : forall E R s l v T,
  typing_store E R s -> wf_sig E R ->
  typing E R v T -> value v ->
  LabelSetImpl.notin l (Signatures.dom R) ->
  typing_store E (l ~ bind_sig T ++ R) (LabelMapImpl.add l v s).
Proof.
  intros E R s l v T Hst Hsig Hty Hval Hfresh.
  pose proof (typing_wf_typ _ _ _ _ Hty Hsig) as Hwt.
  intros l'.
  assert (HtyTgt : forall e T0, typing E R e T0 -> typing E (l ~ bind_sig T ++ R) e T0).
  { intros e T0 He. eapply typing_sig_add; [exact He | exact Hsig | exact Hwt | exact Hfresh]. }
  split.
  - intros T' Hb. simpl in Hb.
    destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. exists v. split; [apply LabelMapImpl.add_1; reflexivity |].
      split; [apply HtyTgt; exact Hty | exact Hval].
    + destruct (proj1 (Hst l') T' Hin) as [v' [Hm [Hty' Hval']]].
      exists v'. split.
      * destruct (LabelMapFacts.eq_dec l l') as [Heq | Hne].
        -- subst l'. exfalso. eapply Signatures.binds_dom_contradiction; [exact Hin | exact Hfresh].

      * split; [apply HtyTgt; exact Hty' | exact Hval'].
  - intros v' Hm.
    destruct (LabelMapFacts.eq_dec l l') as [Heq | Hne].
    + subst l'.
      assert (Hvv : v' = v).
      { eapply LabelMapFacts.MapsTo_fun; [exact Hm | apply LabelMapImpl.add_1; reflexivity]. }
      subst v'.
      exists T. split; [exact Hval | split; [apply HtyTgt; exact Hty | apply Signatures.binds_app_2; apply Signatures.binds_cons_2; reflexivity]].
    + assert (HmS : LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l' v' s).
      { eapply LabelMapImpl.add_3; [exact Hne | exact Hm]. }
      destruct (proj2 (Hst l') v' HmS) as [T' [Hval' [Hty' Hb']]].
      exists T'. split; [exact Hval' | split; [apply HtyTgt; exact Hty' | apply Signatures.binds_app_3; exact Hb']].

Lemma typing_store_update : forall E R s l v T,
  typing_store E R s -> wf_sig E R ->

  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
  typing_store E R (LabelMapImpl.add l v s).
Proof.
  intros E R s l v T Hst Hsig Hty Hval Hb.
  intros l'. split.
  - intros T' Hb'. destruct (LabelMapFacts.eq_dec l l') as [Heq | Hne].
    + subst l'.
      assert (HeqT : T' = T).
      { symmetry. exact (wf_sig_binds_fun E R Hsig l T T' Hb Hb'). }

Lemma typing_store_weaken_env : forall E R s E',
  typing_store E R s -> wf_env E' ->
  (forall X b, binds X b E -> binds X b E') ->
  typing_store E' R s.
Proof.
  intros E R s E' Hst HwfE' HEb.
  assert (Hty : forall e T, typing E R e T -> typing E' R e T).
  { intros e T He. exact (typing_weaken_binds E R e T He E' HwfE' HEb). }
  intros l. split.
  - intros T Hb. destruct (proj1 (Hst l) T Hb) as [v [Hm [Hty0 Hval]]].
    exists v. split; [exact Hm | split; [apply Hty; exact Hty0 | exact Hval]].
  - intros v Hm. destruct (proj2 (Hst l) v Hm) as [T [Hval [Hty0 Hb0]]].
    exists T. split; [exact Hval | split; [apply Hty; exact Hty0 | exact Hb0]].
Qed.

Definition extends_binds (E E' : env) : Prop :=
  forall X b, binds X b E -> binds X b E'.

Definition extends_sig (R R' : sig) : Prop :=
  forall l b, Signatures.binds l b R -> Signatures.binds l b R'.

Lemma typing_lift : forall E R e T, typing E R e T ->
  forall E' R', wf_env E' -> wf_sig E' R' ->
    extends_binds E E' -> extends_sig R R' -> typing E' R' e T.
Proof.
  intros E R e T H E' R' HwfE' Hsig' HE HR.
  eapply typing_sig_weaken.
  - eapply typing_weaken_binds; [exact H | exact HwfE' | exact HE].
  - exact HR.
  - exact Hsig'.
Qed.

Lemma sub_lift : forall E A B, sub E A B ->
  forall E', wf_env E' -> extends_binds E E' -> sub E' A B.
Proof.
  intros E A B H E' Hwf HE.
  eapply sub_weaken_binds; [exact H | exact Hwf | exact HE].
Qed.

Fixpoint typing_app_inv (E:env) (R:sig) (e1 e2:exp) (T:typ)
  (H : typing E R (exp_app e1 e2) T) {struct H} :
  exists T1 T2, typing E R e1 (typ_arrow T1 T2) /\ typing E R e2 T1 /\
    (T = T2 \/ sub E T2 T).
Proof.
  inversion H; subst.
  - exists T1, T. split; [exact H5 | split; [exact H7 | left; reflexivity]].
  - destruct (typing_app_inv E R e1 e2 S H1) as [T1 [T2 [G1 [G2 [Heq | Hsub]]]]].
    + exists T1, T2. split; [exact G1 | split; [exact G2 |]]. subst S. right. exact H2.
    + exists T1, T2. split; [exact G1 | split; [exact G2 |]]. right. eapply sub_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma wf_sig_wf_env : forall E R, wf_sig E R -> wf_env E.
Proof. intros E R H. induction H; assumption. Qed.
Scheme typing_mut := Induction for typing Sort Prop
  with typing_rc_mut := Induction for typing_record_comp Sort Prop.
Lemma typing_wf_env : forall E R e T, typing E R e T -> wf_env E.
Proof.
  intros E R e T H.
  induction H using typing_mut with (P0 := fun E R r T (h:typing_record_comp E R r T) => wf_env E).
  all: eauto using wf_sig_wf_env.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_weaken_binds : forall E T, wf_typ E T ->
  forall E', (forall X b, binds X b E -> binds X b E') -> wf_typ E' T.
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction H; intros E' Hb.
  - apply wf_typ_top.
  - apply wf_typ_var with (U:=U). apply Hb. exact H.
  - apply wf_typ_arrow; [apply IHwf_typ1 | apply IHwf_typ2]; assumption.
  - apply wf_typ_all with (L:=L).
    + apply IHwf_typ. exact Hb.
    + intros X HX. apply H1 with (E':=X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E'); [exact HX |].
      intros Y b HY. destruct (binds_cons_1 _ _ _ _ _ _ HY) as [[Heq1 Heq2] | HE].
      * subst. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity.
      * apply binds_cons. apply Hb. exact HE.
  - apply wf_typ_box. apply IHwf_typ. exact Hb.
  - apply wf_typ_readonly. apply IHwf_typ. exact Hb.
  - apply wf_typ_intersect; [apply IHwf_typ1 | apply IHwf_typ2]; assumption.
  - apply wf_typ_record. apply IHwf_typ. exact Hb.
Qed.

Fixpoint record_pred_m (M : rmode) (E : env) (a : atom) (A T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_record b C =>
      if (a === b) then
        match M with
        | rfull => sub E A C /\ sub E C A
        | rforward => sub E A C
        end
      else False
  | typ_int U W => record_pred_m M E a A U /\ record_pred_m M E a A W
  | typ_mut _ U => record_pred_m rforward E a A U
  | _ => False
  end.

Lemma record_pred_fwd_merge : forall E a A U N,
  record_pred_m rforward E a A (merge_mutability U N) <->
  record_pred_m rforward E a A U.
Proof.
  intros E a A U. induction U; intros N; simpl; try reflexivity.
  all: try (split; intro Hh; exact Hh).
  - (* int *) rewrite IHU1, IHU2. tauto.
Qed.

Lemma record_pred_fwd_nf_params : forall E a A U,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E A ->
  (record_pred_m rforward E a (normal_form_typing A) U <->
   record_pred_m rforward E a A U).
Proof.
  intros E a A U Hwe Hwa.
  induction U; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - (* mut *) apply IHU.
  - (* int *) rewrite IHU1, IHU2. tauto.
  - (* record *) destruct (a === a0) eqn:Eab; [| reflexivity].
    split; intros H1.
    + eapply sub_trans; [apply sub_normal_form_typing_right; [exact Hwe | exact Hwa] | exact H1].
    + eapply sub_trans; [apply sub_normal_form_typing_left; [exact Hwe | exact Hwa] | exact H1].
Qed.

  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T ->
  (record_pred_m rforward E a A T <->
   record_pred_m rforward E a A (normal_form_typing T)).

  - reflexivity.

  - (* mut *) rewrite record_pred_fwd_merge. destruct M. apply (IH T1 Hwe (wf_typ_readonly_inv _ _ Hwt)).
  - (* int *) split; intros [H1 H2]; split.

    + apply (proj1 (IH T2 Hwe (wf_typ_int_r _ _ _ Hwt))) in H2. exact H2.

    + apply (proj2 (IH T2 Hwe (wf_typ_int_r _ _ _ Hwt))). exact H2.

    + eapply sub_trans; [apply sub_normal_form_typing_left; [exact Hwe | exact Hwt1] | exact H1].

Fixpoint value_no_red (e:exp) (Hv:value e) {struct Hv} :
    forall s e' s', red e s e' s' -> False
with value_record_comp_no_red (r:rec_comp) (Hv:value_record_comp r) {struct Hv} :
    forall s r' s', red_record_comp r s r' s' -> False.
Proof.
  - destruct Hv; intros s e' s' Hred.
    + inversion Hred.
    + inversion Hred.
    + inversion Hred.
    + inversion Hred; subst. inversion H0.
    + inversion Hred; subst. match goal with Hr : red_record_comp ?r s ?r' s' |- _ => eapply value_record_comp_no_red; [eassumption | exact Hr] end.
    + inversion Hred; subst.
      try match goal with Hrr : red (exp_record _) s _ s' |- _ => inversion Hrr; subst end.
      match goal with Hrr : red_record_comp ?r s ?r' s' |- _ =>
        eapply value_record_comp_no_red; [eassumption | exact Hrr] end.
  - destruct Hv; intros s r' s' Hred.
    + inversion Hred.
    + inversion Hred; subst. match goal with Hr : red_record_comp ?r s ?r' s' |- _ => eapply value_record_comp_no_red; [eassumption | exact Hr] end.
Qed.

Scheme red_mut := Induction for red Sort Prop
  with red_record_mut := Induction for red_record_comp Sort Prop.

Ltac solve_det_red :=
  first [
    exfalso; eapply value_no_red; [eassumption | eassumption]
  | exfalso; eapply value_record_comp_no_red; [eassumption | eassumption]
  | match goal with Hred : red _ _ _ _ |- _ => clear Hred end;
    match goal with
    | IH : forall x y, red ?a ?b x y -> ?P, Hsub : red ?a ?b ?c ?d |- _ =>
        let Heq := fresh "Heq" in
        destruct (IH c d Hsub) as [Heq Hse]; subst; split; reflexivity
    end
  | split; reflexivity
  | split; discriminate
  | reflexivity
  | discriminate
  ].

Ltac solve_det_rec :=
  first [
    exfalso; eapply value_no_red; [eassumption | eassumption]
  | exfalso; eapply value_record_comp_no_red; [eassumption | eassumption]
  | match goal with Hred : red_record_comp _ _ _ _ |- _ => clear Hred end;
    match goal with
    | IH : forall x y, red_record_comp ?a ?b x y -> ?P,
          Hsub : red_record_comp ?a ?b ?c ?d |- _ =>
        let Heq := fresh "Heq" in
        destruct (IH c d Hsub) as [Heq Hse]; subst; split; reflexivity
    end
  | split; reflexivity
  | split; discriminate
  | reflexivity
  | discriminate
  ].

Ltac solve_det_red2 :=
  match goal with
  | Hred0 : red _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
      clear Hred0;
      match goal with
      | Hsub : red ?a ?b ?c ?d |- _ =>
          match goal with
          | IH : forall x y, red ?a ?b x y -> ?P |- _ =>
              let Heq := fresh "Heq" in
              destruct (IH c d Hsub) as [Heq Hse]; subst; split; reflexivity
          end
      end
  end.

Ltac solve_det_rec2 :=
  match goal with
  | Hred0 : red_record_comp _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
      clear Hred0;
      match goal with
      | Hsub : red_record_comp ?a ?b ?c ?d |- _ =>
          match goal with
          | IH : forall x y, red_record_comp ?a ?b x y -> ?P |- _ =>
              let Heq := fresh "Heq" in
              destruct (IH c d Hsub) as [Heq Hse]; subst; split; reflexivity
          end
      end
  end.

Ltac solve_contra_red :=
  match goal with
  | Hr : red ?a ?b ?c ?d |- _ =>
      match goal with
      | Hv : value ?a |- _ => exfalso; exact (value_no_red a Hv b c d Hr)
      end
  end.

Ltac solve_contra_rec :=
  match goal with
  | Hr : red_record_comp ?a ?b ?c ?d |- _ =>
      match goal with
      | Hv : value_record_comp ?a |- _ =>
          exfalso; exact (value_record_comp_no_red a Hv b c d Hr)
      end
  end.

Ltac solve_value_source :=
  first [
    match goal with Hr : red (exp_ref _) _ _ _ |- _ =>
      exfalso; exact (value_no_red _ (value_ref _) _ _ _ Hr)
    end
  | match goal with Hr : red (exp_seal (exp_ref _)) _ _ _ |- _ =>
      exfalso; exact (value_no_red _ (value_sealed_ref _) _ _ _ Hr)
    end
  | match goal with Hr : red (exp_seal (exp_record ?r)) _ _ _, Hv : value_record_comp ?r |- _ =>
      exfalso; exact (value_no_red _ (value_sealed_record r Hv) _ _ _ Hr)
    end
  | match goal with Hr : red (exp_record ?r) _ _ _, Hv : value_record_comp ?r |- _ =>
      exfalso; exact (value_no_red _ (value_record r Hv) _ _ _ Hr)
    end
  ].

Ltac solve_maps :=
  first [
    match goal with
    | m1 : LabelMapImpl.MapsTo ?l1 ?v1 ?s, m2 : LabelMapImpl.MapsTo ?l1 ?v2 ?s |- _ =>
        let Heq := fresh "Heq" in
        assert (Heq : v1 = v2) by (eapply LabelMapFacts.MapsTo_fun; [exact m1 | exact m2]);
        subst; split; reflexivity
    end
  | match goal with
    | Hsome : ( _ # _ ) = Some ?l1, Hsome2 : ( _ # _ ) = Some ?l2 |- _ =>
        assert (l1 = l2) by congruence; subst;
        match goal with
        | m1 : LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l2 _ _, m2 : LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l2 _ _ |- _ =>
            let Heq := fresh "Heq" in
            assert (Heq : _ = _) by (eapply LabelMapFacts.MapsTo_fun; [exact m1 | exact m2]);
            subst; split; reflexivity
        end
    end
  ].

Lemma red_det : forall e s e1 s1, red e s e1 s1 ->
  forall e2 s2, red e s e2 s2 -> e1 = e2 /\ s1 = s2.
Proof.
  intros e s e1 s1 H.
  induction H using red_mut with
    (P0 := fun r s r1 s1 (h:red_record_comp r s r1 s1) =>
      forall r2 s2, red_record_comp r s r2 s2 -> r1 = r2 /\ s1 = s2).
  all: try (intros ? ? H2).
  all: try (inversion H2; subst).
  all: try clear H2.
  all: try solve_det_red.
  all: try solve_det_rec.
  all: try solve_det_red2.
  all: try solve_det_rec2.
  all: try (exfalso; solve [match goal with Hred : red ?a ?b ?c ?d |- _ => inversion Hred end]).
  all: try (exfalso; solve [match goal with Hred : red_record_comp ?a ?b ?c ?d |- _ => inversion Hred end]).
  all: try solve_contra_red.
  all: try solve_contra_rec.
  all: try solve_value_source.
  all: try solve_maps.
Qed.

(* ============ arrow inversion via a target-shape predicate ============ *)
Fixpoint arrow_pred (E : env) (A B T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_arrow C D => sub E C A /\ sub E B D
  | typ_int U W => arrow_pred E A B U /\ arrow_pred E A B W
  | typ_mut _ U => arrow_pred E A B U
  | typ_fvar _ => False
  | typ_bvar _ => False
  | typ_all _ _ => False
  | typ_box _ => False
  | typ_record _ _ => False
  end.

Lemma arrow_pred_merge : forall E A B U M,
  arrow_pred E A B (merge_mutability U M) <-> arrow_pred E A B U.
Proof.
  intros E A B U. induction U; intros M; simpl; try reflexivity.
  all: try (split; intro Hh; exact Hh).
  - (* int *) rewrite IHU1, IHU2. tauto.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_int_l : forall E T1 T2, wf_typ E (typ_int T1 T2) -> wf_typ E T1.
Proof. intros E T1 T2 H. inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.
Lemma wf_typ_int_r : forall E T1 T2, wf_typ E (typ_int T1 T2) -> wf_typ E T2.
Proof. intros E T1 T2 H. inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.
Lemma wf_typ_arrow_l : forall E T1 T2, wf_typ E (typ_arrow T1 T2) -> wf_typ E T1.
Proof. intros E T1 T2 H. inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.

Lemma arrow_pred_nf_params : forall E A B U,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E A -> wf_typ E B ->
  (arrow_pred E (normal_form_typing A) (normal_form_typing B) U <->
   arrow_pred E A B U).
Proof.
  intros E A B U Hwe Hwa Hwb.
  induction U; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - (* arrow *) split; intros [H1 H2]; split.
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact H1 | apply sub_normal_form_typing_left; assumption].
    + eapply sub_trans; [apply sub_normal_form_typing_right; assumption | exact H2].
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact H1 | apply sub_normal_form_typing_right; assumption].
    + eapply sub_trans; [apply sub_normal_form_typing_left; assumption | exact H2].
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - (* mut *) apply IHU.
  - (* int *) rewrite IHU1, IHU2. tauto.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma arrow_pred_nf : forall E A B T,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T ->
  (arrow_pred E A B T <-> arrow_pred E A B (normal_form_typing T)).
Proof.
  intros E A B T. revert T.
  fix IH 1. intros T Hwe Hwt.
  destruct T as [|n|X|T1 T2|T1 T2|T1|M T1|T1 T2|a T1]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - (* arrow *) split; intros [H1 H2]; split.
    + eapply sub_trans; [apply sub_normal_form_typing_left; [exact Hwe | apply (wf_typ_arrow_l E T1 T2); exact Hwt] | exact H1].
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact H2 | apply sub_normal_form_typing_right; [exact Hwe | apply (wf_typ_arrow_r E T1 T2); exact Hwt]].
    + eapply sub_trans; [apply sub_normal_form_typing_right; [exact Hwe | apply (wf_typ_arrow_l E T1 T2); exact Hwt] | exact H1].
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact H2 | apply sub_normal_form_typing_left; [exact Hwe | apply (wf_typ_arrow_r E T1 T2); exact Hwt]].
  - (* all *) reflexivity.
  - (* box *) reflexivity.
  - (* mut *) rewrite arrow_pred_merge. destruct M. apply wf_typ_readonly_inv in Hwt. apply (IH T1 Hwe Hwt).
  - (* int *) split; intros [H1 H2]; split.
    + apply (IH T1 Hwe (wf_typ_int_l _ _ _ Hwt)) in H1. exact H1.
    + apply (IH T2 Hwe (wf_typ_int_r _ _ _ Hwt)) in H2. exact H2.
    + apply (IH T1 Hwe (wf_typ_int_l _ _ _ Hwt)). exact H1.
    + apply (IH T2 Hwe (wf_typ_int_r _ _ _ Hwt)). exact H2.
  - (* record *) reflexivity.
Qed.


Lemma arrow_pred_sub_aux : forall E A B T2 T3,
  arrow_pred E A B T2 -> sub E T2 T3 -> arrow_pred E A B T3.
Proof.
  intros E A B T2 T3 Hp Hs.
  pose proof (sub_wf_env E T2 T3 Hs) as Hwe.
  dependent induction Hs.
  - (* top *) exact I.
  - (* refl_tvar *) inversion Hp.
  - (* trans_tvar *) inversion Hp.
  - (* arrow *) simpl in Hp. destruct Hp as [Hpa Hpb]. simpl.
    split.
    + eapply sub_trans; eassumption.
    + eapply sub_trans; eassumption.
  - (* all *) inversion Hp.
  - (* box *) inversion Hp.
  - (* readonly *) simpl in Hp. simpl. apply IHHs; [exact Hp | exact Hwe].
  - (* readonly_mutable *) simpl. apply IHHs; [exact Hp | exact Hwe].
  - (* trans *) simpl. apply IHHs2; [apply IHHs1; [exact Hp | exact Hwe] | exact Hwe].
  - (* inter_left *) simpl in Hp. destruct Hp as [Hp _]. exact Hp.
  - (* inter_right *) simpl in Hp. destruct Hp as [_ Hp]. exact Hp.
  - (* inter *) simpl. split.
    + apply IHHs1; [exact Hp | exact Hwe].
    + apply IHHs2; [exact Hp | exact Hwe].
  - (* record *) inversion Hp.
  - (* readonly_record *) inversion Hp.
  - (* denormalize *) simpl in *.
    pose proof (proj1 (arrow_pred_nf E A B T1 Hwe H) Hp) as Hpn.
    pose proof (IHHs Hpn Hwe) as Hqn.
    exact (proj2 (arrow_pred_nf E A B T2 Hwe H0) Hqn).
Qed.

Lemma sub_arrow_pred : forall E A B T, sub E (typ_arrow A B) T -> arrow_pred E A B T.
Proof.
  intros E A B T H.
  dependent induction H.
  - (* top *) exact I.
  - (* arrow *) split; assumption.
  - (* readonly_mutable *) simpl. apply (IHsub A B eq_refl).
  - (* trans *) simpl.
    apply arrow_pred_sub_aux with (T2:=T2).
    + apply (IHsub1 A B eq_refl).
    + exact H0.
  - (* inter *) simpl. split.
    + apply (IHsub1 A B eq_refl).
    + apply (IHsub2 A B eq_refl).
  - (* denormalize *) simpl in H1.
    pose proof (IHsub (normal_form_typing A) (normal_form_typing B) eq_refl) as Hpred.
    pose proof (sub_wf_env E _ _ H1) as Hwe.
    pose proof (wf_typ_arrow_l E A B H) as Hwa.
    pose proof (wf_typ_arrow_r E A B H) as Hwb.
    apply (proj1 (arrow_pred_nf_params E A B (normal_form_typing T2) Hwe Hwa Hwb)) in Hpred.
    exact (proj2 (arrow_pred_nf E A B T2 Hwe H0) Hpred).
Qed.



Lemma sub_arrow_inv_l : forall E A B C D,
  sub E (typ_arrow A B) (typ_arrow C D) -> sub E C A.
Proof.
  intros E A B C D H.
  pose proof (sub_arrow_pred E A B (typ_arrow C D) H) as Hp.
  simpl in Hp. exact (proj1 Hp).
Qed.

Lemma sub_arrow_inv_r : forall E A B C D,
  sub E (typ_arrow A B) (typ_arrow C D) -> sub E B D.
Proof.
  intros E A B C D H.
  pose proof (sub_arrow_pred E A B (typ_arrow C D) H) as Hp.
  simpl in Hp. exact (proj2 Hp).
Qed.

(* ============ box inversion ============ *)
Fixpoint box_pred (E : env) (A T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_box C => sub E A C /\ sub E C A
  | typ_int U W => box_pred E A U /\ box_pred E A W
  | typ_mut _ U => box_pred E A U
  | _ => False
  end.

Lemma box_pred_sub_aux : forall E A T2 T3,
  box_pred E A T2 -> sub E T2 T3 -> box_pred E A T3.
Proof.
  intros E A T2 T3 Hp Hs.
  pose proof (sub_wf_env E T2 T3 Hs) as Hwe.
  dependent induction Hs.
  - (* top *) exact I.
  - (* refl_tvar *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.
  - (* trans_tvar *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.
  - (* arrow *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.
  - (* all *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.
  - (* box *) simpl in Hp. simpl. destruct Hp as [H1 H2]. split.
    + eapply sub_trans; eassumption.
    + eapply sub_trans; eassumption.
  - (* readonly *) simpl in Hp. simpl. apply IHHs; [exact Hp | exact Hwe].
  - (* readonly_mutable *) simpl in Hp. simpl. apply IHHs; [exact Hp | exact Hwe].

  | _ => False
  end.

Lemma sub_all_dom_inv : forall E A B C D,
  sub E (typ_all A B) (typ_all C D) -> sub E C A.
Proof.
  intros E A B C D H.
  pose proof (all_dom_pred_sub E A B (typ_all C D) H) as Hp.
  simpl in Hp. exact Hp.
Qed.

(* ============ record inversion with full/forward modes ============ *)
Inductive rmode : Set := rfull | rforward.

Fixpoint record_pred_m (M : rmode) (E : env) (a : atom) (A T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_record b C =>
      if (a === b) then
        match M with
        | rfull => sub E A C /\ sub E C A
        | rforward => sub E A C
        end
      else False
  | typ_int U W => record_pred_m M E a A U /\ record_pred_m M E a A W
  | typ_mut _ U => record_pred_m rforward E a A U
  | _ => False
  end.

Lemma record_pred_fwd_merge : forall E a A U N,
  record_pred_m rforward E a A (merge_mutability U N) <->
  record_pred_m rforward E a A U.
Proof.
  intros E a A U. induction U; intros N; simpl; try reflexivity.
  all: try (split; intro Hh; exact Hh).
  - (* int *) rewrite IHU1, IHU2. tauto.
Qed.

Lemma record_pred_full_merge : forall E a A U N,
  record_pred_m rfull E a A (merge_mutability U N) <->
  record_pred_m rforward E a A U.
Proof.
  intros E a A U. induction U; intros N; simpl; try reflexivity.
  all: try (split; intro Hh; exact Hh).
  - (* int *) rewrite IHU1, IHU2. tauto.
Qed.

Lemma record_pred_fwd_nf_params : forall E a A U,

   record_pred_m rforward E a A U).

  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - (* mut *) apply IHU.
  - (* int *) rewrite IHU1, IHU2. tauto.
  - (* record *) destruct (a === a0) eqn:Eab; [| reflexivity].
    pose proof (sub_normal_form_typing_right E A Hwe Hwa) as HnfR.
    pose proof (sub_normal_form_typing_left E A Hwe Hwa) as HnfL.
    split; intros H1.
    + exact (sub_trans E A (normal_form_typing A) U HnfR H1).
    + exact (sub_trans E (normal_form_typing A) A U HnfL H1).
Qed.

Lemma record_pred_fwd_nf : forall E a A T,

  (record_pred_m rforward E a A T <->
   record_pred_m rforward E a A (normal_form_typing T)).
Proof.

  fix IH 1. intros T Hwe Hwt.
  destruct T as [|n|X|T1 T2|T1 T2|T1|M T1|T1 T2|b T1]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.

    + apply (proj1 (IH T2 Hwe (wf_typ_int_r _ _ _ Hwt))) in H2. exact H2.

    + apply (proj2 (IH T2 Hwe (wf_typ_int_r _ _ _ Hwt))). exact H2.

From Stdlib Require Import Lia.
From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.
Load "/tmp/th1/base.v".

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Deterministic reduction, with a step count, for termination  *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Fixpoint redm_steps (e : exp) (s : store) (e' : exp) (s' : store)
  (H : redm e s e' s') {struct H} : nat :=
  match H with
  | redm_eq e0 s0 e1 s1 _ _ => 0
  | redm_step e0 s0 e'' s'' e1 s1 Hred Htail =>
      S (redm_steps e'' s'' e1 s1 Htail)
  end.

Lemma value_redm_eq : forall e s e' s',
  value e -> redm e s e' s' -> e = e' /\ s = s'.
Proof.
  intros e s e' s' Hv H. induction H.
  - subst. split; reflexivity.
  - exfalso. eapply value_no_red; [exact Hv | exact H].
Qed.

(* The given reduction to a value is a prefix of every reduction out of e. *)
Lemma redm_suffix_steps : forall e s e' s' (H : redm e s e' s'),
  value e' ->
  forall e1 s1 (H1 : redm e s e1 s1),
    (e1 = e /\ s1 = s) \/
    (exists H2 : redm e1 s1 e' s', redm_steps e1 s1 e' s' H2 < redm_steps e s e' s' H).
Proof.
  intros e s e' s' H. induction H as [e0 s0 e1 s1 Heq Hseq | e0 s0 e'' s'' e1 s1 Hred Htail IH];
    intros Hval e2 s2 H2.
  - subst e1. subst s1.
    left. apply value_redm_eq in H2; [| exact Hval]. exact H2.
  - inversion H2 as [e3 s3 e4 s4 Heq2 Hseq2 | e3 s3 e5 s5 e4 s4 Hred2 Htail2]; subst.
    + left. split; reflexivity.
    + destruct (red_det e0 s0 e'' s'' Hred e5 s5 Hred2) as [He Hs]. subst e5. subst s5.
      destruct (IH Hval e4 s4 Htail2) as [[Heq3 Hs3] | [H2' Hlt]].
      * subst e4. subst s4.
        right. exists Htail. simpl. lia.
      * right. exists H2'. simpl. lia.
Qed.

Lemma redm_suffix : forall e s e' s',
  redm e s e' s' -> value e' ->
  forall e1 s1, redm e s e1 s1 ->
    (e1 = e /\ s1 = s) \/ redm e1 s1 e' s'.
Proof.
  intros e s e' s' H Hv e1 s1 H1.
  destruct (redm_suffix_steps e s e' s' H Hv e1 s1 H1) as [[He Hs] | [H2 _]].
  - left. split; assumption.
  - right. exact H2.
Qed.

(* redm is invariant under a nonempty reduction in the following sense: the
   number of real steps strictly decreases along the given deterministic path. *)
Lemma redm_steps_pos : forall e s e' s' (H : redm e s e' s'),
  0 < redm_steps e s e' s' H -> ~ (e = e' /\ s = s').
Proof.
  intros e s e' s' H. induction H; simpl; intros Hpos Heq; [lia |].
  destruct Heq as [He Hs]. subst e1. subst s1.
  (* H : red e0 s0 e'' s'', tail to e'' is now a reduction from e'' to e'' *)
  clear -H. revert H. generalize dependent s0. generalize dependent e0.
  (* actually just use that a nonempty redm cannot have equal endpoints *)
  admit.
Admitted.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Local exclusion lemmas for the destructive steps.            *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma typing_seal_any_not_box : forall E R e T,
  typing E R (exp_seal e) (typ_box T) -> False.
Proof. intros. eapply typing_seal_not_box; eauto. Qed.

Lemma typing_seal_any_not_record : forall E R e a T,
  typing E R (exp_seal e) (typ_record a T) -> False.
Proof. intros. eapply typing_seal_not_record; eauto. Qed.

(* A ref sealed one or more times cannot be typed at a box type. *)
Lemma typing_seal_pow_ref_not_box : forall E R l k T,
  typing E R (seal_pow (S k) (exp_ref l)) (typ_box T) -> False.
Proof.
  intros E R l k T H. simpl. eapply typing_seal_any_not_box; eauto.
Qed.

(* A record sealed one or more times cannot be typed at a record type. *)
Lemma typing_seal_pow_record_not_record : forall E R r k a T,
  typing E R (seal_pow (S k) (exp_record r)) (typ_record a T) -> False.
Proof.
  intros E R r k a T H. simpl. eapply typing_seal_any_not_record; eauto.
Qed.

(* If g1 is a sealing of a reference and g1 is typed at box T, then g1 is
   literally the reference (no extra seal). *)
Lemma sealcomp_ref_typed_box :
  forall E R l g1 T,
    sealcomp (exp_ref l) g1 ->
    typing E R g1 (typ_box T) ->
    g1 = exp_ref l.
Proof.
  intros E R l g1 T Hsc Hty.
  destruct (ref_shape l g1 Hsc) as [k Heq]. subst g1.
  destruct k as [|k'].
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso. eapply typing_seal_any_not_box; [exact Hty].
Qed.

(* Same for a record at a record type. *)
Lemma sealcomp_record_typed_record :
  forall E R r g1 a T,
    sealcomp (exp_record r) g1 ->
    typing E R g1 (typ_record a T) ->
    exists r1, g1 = exp_record r1 /\ sealcomp_rec_comp r r1.
Proof.
  intros E R r g1 a T Hsc Hty.
  destruct (record_shape r g1 Hsc) as [k [r1 [Heq Hrc]]]. subst g1.
  destruct k as [|k'].
  - exists r1. split; [reflexivity | exact Hrc].
  - exfalso. eapply typing_seal_any_not_record; [exact Hty].
Qed.

From Stdlib Require Import Lia.
From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.
Load "/tmp/th1/base.v".

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Honest step-counting version of redm (redm is in Prop, so we   *)
(* cannot eliminate it to Set; we use an indexed relation).       *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Inductive redm_n : nat -> exp -> store -> exp -> store -> Prop :=
  | redm_n_zero : forall e s,
      redm_n 0 e s e s
  | redm_n_succ : forall n e s e'' s'' e' s',
      red e s e'' s'' ->
      redm_n n e'' s'' e' s' ->
      redm_n (S n) e s e' s'.

Lemma redm_n_redm : forall n e s e' s',
  redm_n n e s e' s' -> redm e s e' s'.
Proof.
  intros n e s e' s' H. induction H.
  - apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
  - apply redm_step with (e'':=e'') (s'':=s''); assumption.
Qed.

Lemma redm_redm_n : forall e s e' s',
  redm e s e' s' -> exists n, redm_n n e s e' s'.
Proof.
  intros e s e' s' H. induction H.
  - subst. exists 0. apply redm_n_zero.
  - destruct IHredm as [n Hn]. exists (S n).
    apply redm_n_succ with (e'':=e'') (s'':=s''); assumption.
Qed.

(* Prefix decomposition along the unique deterministic path to a value. *)
Lemma redm_n_prefix : forall n e s e' s',
  redm_n n e s e' s' -> value e' ->
  forall j e1 s1, redm_n j e s e1 s1 ->
    (j = 0 /\ e1 = e /\ s1 = s) \/
    (exists m, redm_n m e1 s1 e' s' /\ j + m = n).
Proof.
  intros n e s e' s' H. induction H as [e0 s0 | n e0 s0 e'' s'' e1 s1 Hred Htail IH];
    intros Hval j e2 s2 H2.
  - inversion H2; subst. left. split; [reflexivity | split; reflexivity].
  - destruct j as [|j'].
    + left. split; [reflexivity | split; reflexivity].
    + inversion H2 as [e3 s3 e4 s4 Hred2 Htail2]; subst.
      destruct (red_det e0 s0 e'' s'' Hred e4 s4 Hred2) as [He Hs]. subst e4. subst s4.
      destruct (IH Hval j' e3 s3 Htail2) as [[Hj [Heq Hs]] | [m [Hmn Hsum]]].
      * subst j'. subst e3. subst s3.
        right. exists n. split.
        -- exact Htail.
        -- lia.
      * right. exists m. split; [exact Hmn | lia].
Qed.

(* If the sim-produced e-reduction is the empty one, then the count is zero. *)
Lemma redm_n_zero_inv : forall e s e' s',
  redm_n 0 e s e' s' -> e = e' /\ s = s'.
Proof. intros. inversion H. split; reflexivity. Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Local exclusion lemmas for the destructive steps.            *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma typing_seal_any_not_box : forall E R e T,
  typing E R (exp_seal e) (typ_box T) -> False.
Proof. intros. eapply typing_seal_not_box; eauto. Qed.

Lemma typing_seal_any_not_record : forall E R e a T,
  typing E R (exp_seal e) (typ_record a T) -> False.
Proof. intros. eapply typing_seal_not_record; eauto. Qed.

(* If g1 is a sealing of a reference and g1 is typed at box T, then g1 is
   literally the reference (no extra seal). *)
Lemma sealcomp_ref_typed_box :
  forall E R l g1 T,
    sealcomp (exp_ref l) g1 ->
    typing E R g1 (typ_box T) ->
    g1 = exp_ref l.
Proof.
  intros E R l g1 T Hsc Hty.
  destruct (ref_shape l g1 Hsc) as [k Heq]. subst g1.
  destruct k as [|k'].
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso. eapply typing_seal_any_not_box; [exact Hty].
Qed.

(* Same for a record at a record type. *)
Lemma sealcomp_record_typed_record :
  forall E R r g1 a T,
    sealcomp (exp_record r) g1 ->
    typing E R g1 (typ_record a T) ->
    exists r1, g1 = exp_record r1 /\ sealcomp_rec_comp r r1.
Proof.
  intros E R r g1 a T Hsc Hty.
  destruct (record_shape r g1 Hsc) as [k [r1 [Heq Hrc]]]. subst g1.
  destruct k as [|k'].
  - exists r1. split; [reflexivity | exact Hrc].
  - exfalso. eapply typing_seal_any_not_record; [exact Hty].
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* red_set_box_ref is simulable whenever the first argument of  *)
(* the typed set_box is the reference (the only possible case   *)
(* under typing) and the stripped e-argument is a value.        *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma set_box_ref_reduces :
  forall E R ns l e2 g1 g2 T,
    typing E R (exp_set_box g1 g2) T ->
    typing_store E R ns ->
    sealcomp (exp_ref l) g1 ->
    sealcomp e2 g2 ->
    value e2 ->
    expr g2 ->
    exists f' ns', red (exp_set_box g1 g2) ns f' ns'.
Proof.
  intros E R ns l e2 g1 g2 T Hty Hst Hsc1 Hsc2 Hv2 Hexpr2.
  destruct (typing_set_box_inv E R g1 g2 T Hty) as [T1 [Hg1 [Hg2 _]]].
  assert (Hg1ref : g1 = exp_ref l).
  { eapply sealcomp_ref_typed_box; [exact Hsc1 | exact Hg1]. }
  subst g1.
  destruct (typing_ref_inv E R l (typ_box T1) Hg1) as [T0 [Hb _]].
  destruct (proj1 (Hst l) T0 Hb) as [v [Hm [Htyv Hvalv]]].
  pose proof (typing_store_wf_store E R ns Hst) as Hwfns.
  destruct (value_seal_redm e2 g2 ns Hv2 Hsc2 Hexpr2 Hwfns)
    as [g2' [Hred [Hval' Hsc']]].
  exists v, (LabelMapImpl.add l g2' ns).
  eapply red_set_box_ref; [exact Hwfns | exact Hvalv | exact Hval' | exact Hm].
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* red_record_write_ref is simulable whenever the first argument *)
(* of the typed record_write is the record (no extra seal).     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma record_write_ref_reduces :
  forall E R ns a l r e2 g1 g2 v T,
    typing E R (exp_record_write g1 a g2) T ->
    well_formed_store ns ->
    sealcomp (exp_record r) g1 ->
    record_lookup_ref a r = Some l ->
    LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v ns ->
    sealcomp e2 g2 ->
    value e2 ->
    expr g2 ->
    exists f' ns', red (exp_record_write g1 a g2) ns f' ns'.
Proof.
  intros E R ns a l r e2 g1 g2 v T Hty Hwf Hsc1 Hlook Hmap Hsc2 Hv2 Hexpr2.
  destruct (typing_record_write_inv E R g1 a g2 T Hty) as [T1 [Hg1 [Hg2 _]]].
  destruct (sealcomp_record_typed_record E R r g1 a T1 Hsc1 Hg1) as [r1 [Heq Hrc]].
  subst g1.
  assert (Hlook' : record_lookup_ref a r1 = Some l).
  { eapply record_lookup_ref_sealcomp; eauto. }
  pose proof (value_record_comp_sealcomp_up r r1 Hrc) as Hup.
  (* we need value_record_comp r from the e-side; take it as an extra premise *)
  destruct (value_seal_redm e2 g2 ns Hv2 Hsc2 Hexpr2 Hwf)
    as [g2' [Hred [Hval' Hsc']]].
  exists v, (LabelMapImpl.add l g2' ns).
  eapply red_record_write_ref; eauto.
Qed.

  | redm_record_comp_eq : forall r s r' s', r = r' -> s = s' -> redm_record_comp r s r' s'
  | redm_record_comp_step : forall r s r'' s'' r' s',
      red_record_comp r s r'' s'' ->
      redm_record_comp r'' s'' r' s' ->
      redm_record_comp r s r' s'.

Lemma redm_app_1 : forall e1 s e1' s' e2,
  redm e1 s e1' s' -> expr e2 -> redm (exp_app e1 e2) s (exp_app e1' e2) s'.
Proof.
  intros e1 s e1' s' e2 H He2. induction H.
  - subst. apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
  - apply redm_step with (e'':=exp_app e'' e2) (s'':=s'').
    + apply red_app_1; assumption.
    + apply IHredm; exact He2.
Qed.

Lemma redm_app_2 : forall v1 e2 s e2' s',
  value v1 -> redm e2 s e2' s' -> redm (exp_app v1 e2) s (exp_app v1 e2') s'.
Proof.
  intros v1 e2 s e2' s' Hv H. induction H.
  - subst. apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
  - apply redm_step with (e'':=exp_app v1 e'') (s'':=s'').
    + apply red_app_2; assumption.
    + apply IHredm; exact Hv.
Qed.

Lemma redm_tapp : forall V e1 s e1' s',
  type V -> redm e1 s e1' s' -> redm (exp_tapp e1 V) s (exp_tapp e1' V) s'.
Proof.
  intros V e1 s e1' s' Hty H. induction H.
  - subst. apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
  - apply redm_step with (e'':=exp_tapp e'' V) (s'':=s'').
    + apply red_tapp; assumption.
    + apply IHredm; exact Hty.
Qed.

Lemma redm_box_1 : forall e1 s e1' s',
  redm e1 s e1' s' -> redm (exp_box e1) s (exp_box e1') s'.
Proof.
  intros e1 s e1' s' H. induction H.
  - subst. apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
  - apply redm_step with (e'':=exp_box e'') (s'':=s'').
    + apply red_box_1; assumption.
    + exact IHredm.
Qed.

Lemma redm_unbox_1 : forall e1 s e1' s',
  redm e1 s e1' s' -> redm (exp_unbox e1) s (exp_unbox e1') s'.
Proof.
  intros e1 s e1' s' H. induction H.
  - subst. apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
  - apply redm_step with (e'':=exp_unbox e'') (s'':=s'').
    + apply red_unbox_1; assumption.

Qed.

Lemma redm_set_box_1 : forall e1 s e1' s' e2,

  intros e1 s e1' s' e2 H He2. induction H.
  - subst. apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
  - apply redm_step with (e'':=exp_set_box e'' e2) (s'':=s'').
    + apply red_set_box_1; assumption.
    + apply IHredm; exact He2.

  value v1 -> redm e2 s e2' s' -> redm (exp_set_box v1 e2) s (exp_set_box v1 e2') s'.
Proof.
  intros v1 e2 s e2' s' Hv H. induction H.
  - subst. apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
  - apply redm_step with (e'':=exp_set_box v1 e'') (s'':=s'').
    + apply red_set_box_2; assumption.

Lemma redm_record_read_1 : forall e1 s e1' s' a,
  redm e1 s e1' s' -> redm (exp_record_read e1 a) s (exp_record_read e1' a) s'.
Proof.
  intros e1 s e1' s' a H. induction H.
  - subst. apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
  - apply redm_step with (e'':=exp_record_read e'' a) (s'':=s'').

Lemma redm_record_write_1 : forall e1 s e1' s' a e2,

(* Unboxing a (possibly multiply sealed) reference: the extra   *)
(* seals never block the step; they are just peeled first.      *)
(* The result is the target-side spelling of the source result. *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma unbox_ref_reduces :
  forall ns l j w w',
    well_formed_store ns ->
    LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l w' ns ->
    sealcomp w w' ->
    exists f', redm (exp_unbox (seal_pow j (exp_ref l))) ns f' ns /\
      sealcomp (seal_pow (min1 j) w) f'.
Proof.
  intros ns l j w w' Hwf Hmap Hsc.
  pose proof (Hwf l w' Hmap) as Hval'.
  destruct j as [|j'].
  - simpl. exists w'. split.
    + eapply redm_step with (e'':=w') (s'':=ns).
      * eapply red_unbox_ref; assumption.
      * apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
    + exact Hsc.
  - destruct (redm_unbox_1 (seal_pow (S j') (exp_ref l)) ns
                (seal_pow (min1 (S j')) (exp_ref l)) ns
                (ref_strip ns (S j') l Hwf)) as _.

    + eapply redm_trans with (e':=exp_unbox (seal_pow (min1 (S j')) (exp_ref l))) (s':=ns).

        -- eapply red_unbox_sealed_ref; assumption.
        -- apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
    + apply sealcomp_seal. exact Hsc.
Qed.

(* Reading a field from a (possibly sealed) record.             *)

    well_formed_store ns ->

  pose proof (Hwf l w' Hmap) as Hval'.

(* Iterated readonly and typing-root stripping.                 *)

Fixpoint ro_pow (k : nat) (T : typ) : typ :=

Proof.

  - apply wf_typ_readonly. exact IHk.

Lemma typing_seal_pow : forall E R e T,
  typing E R e T -> forall k, typing E R (seal_pow k e) (ro_pow k T).
Proof.
  intros E R e T H. induction k; simpl.
  - exact H.
  - apply typing_seal. exact IHk.

Lemma sub_ro_pow_self : forall E T,

Lemma sub_normalize_nf : forall E A B, sub E A B ->
  sub E (normal_form_typing A) (normal_form_typing B).
Proof.

  (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
    sub (X ~ bind_sub C ++ E) (open_tt B X) (open_tt D X)) ->

    sub E (normal_form_typing (open_tt B V))

Proof.
  intros E C L B D Hbody V HsubV.
  destruct (atom_fresh (L `union` ftv_t B `union` ftv_t D `union` dom E)) as [X HX].
  pose proof HX as HXL. apply notin_union_1 in HXL.

  pose proof (sub_wf_env E V C HsubV) as HwfE.
  pose proof (sub_wf_typ E V C HsubV) as [HwtV _].

Theorem safety_value_multistep_of_fwd_step :

    typing_store empty R ns -> typing empty R f T ->

      wf_sig E R ->

      typing E R (exp_abs V e1) (typ_arrow V T1)
  | typing_app : forall T1 E R e1 e2 T2,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 (typ_arrow T1 T2) ->

      typing E R (exp_app e1 e2) T2
  | typing_tabs : forall L E R V e1 T1,
      wf_sig E R ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        typing (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) R (open_te e1 X) (open_tt T1 X)) ->
      typing E R (exp_tabs V e1) (typ_all V T1)
  | typing_tapp : forall T1 E R e1 T T2,
      wf_sig E R ->

  | typing_sub : forall S E R e T,
