Lemma redm_wf_store : forall e s e' s', redm e s e' s' -> well_formed_store s -> well_formed_store s'.
Proof.

(* ================= basic seal compilation lemmas ================= *)
Fixpoint sealcomp_refl (e : exp) : sealcomp e e
with sealcomp_rec_refl (r : rec_comp) : sealcomp_rec_comp r r.
Proof.
  - destruct e; try constructor; auto;
      try apply sealcomp_refl; try apply sealcomp_rec_refl.
  - destruct r; try constructor; auto;
      try apply sealcomp_refl; try apply sealcomp_rec_refl.
Qed.

Lemma sealcomp_abs_inv : forall e T e2, sealcomp e (exp_abs T e2) ->
  exists e1, e = exp_abs T e1 /\ sealcomp e1 e2.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

Lemma sealcomp_app_inv : forall e e1' e2', sealcomp e (exp_app e1' e2') ->
  exists e1 e2, e = exp_app e1 e2 /\ sealcomp e1 e1' /\ sealcomp e2 e2'.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

Lemma sealcomp_tabs_inv : forall e T e2, sealcomp e (exp_tabs T e2) ->
  exists e1, e = exp_tabs T e1 /\ sealcomp e1 e2.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

Lemma sealcomp_tapp_inv : forall e e1' T, sealcomp e (exp_tapp e1' T) ->
  exists e1, e = exp_tapp e1 T /\ sealcomp e1 e1'.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

Lemma sealcomp_let_inv : forall e e1' e2', sealcomp e (exp_let e1' e2') ->
  exists e1 e2, e = exp_let e1 e2 /\ sealcomp e1 e1' /\ sealcomp e2 e2'.

Lemma sealcomp_box_inv : forall e e1', sealcomp e (exp_box e1') ->

Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

Lemma sealcomp_unbox_inv : forall e e1', sealcomp e (exp_unbox e1') ->
  exists e1, e = exp_unbox e1 /\ sealcomp e1 e1'.

Lemma sealcomp_set_box_inv : forall e e1' e2', sealcomp e (exp_set_box e1' e2') ->
  exists e1 e2, e = exp_set_box e1 e2 /\ sealcomp e1 e1' /\ sealcomp e2 e2'.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

Lemma sealcomp_ref_inv : forall e l, sealcomp e (exp_ref l) -> e = exp_ref l.
Proof. intros. inversion H; subst; auto. Qed.

Lemma sealcomp_record_inv : forall e r2, sealcomp e (exp_record r2) ->
  exists r1, e = exp_record r1 /\ sealcomp_rec_comp r1 r2.

Lemma sealcomp_rec_exp_inv : forall r a e2 r2, sealcomp_rec_comp r (rec_exp a e2 r2) ->
  exists e1 r1, r = rec_exp a e1 r1 /\ sealcomp e1 e2 /\ sealcomp_rec_comp r1 r2.

Lemma record_lookup_ref_sealcomp : forall a r1 r2,
  sealcomp_rec_comp r1 r2 -> record_lookup_ref a r1 = record_lookup_ref a r2.
Proof.
  intros a r1 r2 H. induction H.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (a === a0); [reflexivity | exact IHsealcomp_rec_comp].
Qed.

Fixpoint value_record_comp_sealcomp_down (r1 r2 : rec_comp) (H : sealcomp_rec_comp r1 r2) {struct H} :
    value_record_comp r2 -> value_record_comp r1.
Proof.
  intros Hv. destruct H as [ | a e1 e2 r1' r2' Hrec Hsc | a l r1' r2' Hrec].
  - exact value_rec_empty.
  - inversion Hv.
  - inversion Hv; subst. apply value_rec_ref.
    apply (value_record_comp_sealcomp_down _ _ Hrec); assumption.
Qed.

Fixpoint value_sealcomp_down (e f : exp) (H : sealcomp e f) {struct H} :
    value f -> expr e -> value e.
Proof.
  intros Hv Hexpr.
  destruct H as
    [ x
    | n
    | T e1 e2 Hsc
    | e1 e2 f1 f2 Hsc1 Hsc2
    | T e1 e2 Hsc
    | T e1 e2 Hsc
    | e1 e2 f1 f2 Hsc1 Hsc2
    | e1 e2 Hsc
    | e1 e2 Hsc
    | e1 e2 f1 f2 Hsc1 Hsc2
    | l
    | e1 e2 Hsc
    | r1 r2 Hsc
    | e1 e2 y Hsc
    | e1 f1 y e2 f2 Hsc1 Hsc2
    | e1 e2 Hsc ].
  - inversion Hv.
  - inversion Hv.
  - apply value_abs; exact Hexpr.
  - inversion Hv.
  - apply value_tabs; exact Hexpr.
  - inversion Hv.
  - inversion Hv.
  - inversion Hv.
  - inversion Hv.
  - inversion Hv.
  - apply value_ref.
  - inversion Hv; subst.
    + apply sealcomp_ref_inv in Hsc. subst. apply value_sealed_ref.
    + destruct (sealcomp_record_inv _ _ Hsc) as [r1 [Heq Hrc]]. subst.
      apply value_sealed_record. eapply value_record_comp_sealcomp_down; eauto.
  - inversion Hv; subst.
    apply value_record. eapply value_record_comp_sealcomp_down; eauto.
  - inversion Hv.
  - inversion Hv.
  - inversion Hv; subst.
    + apply sealcomp_ref_inv in Hsc. subst. apply value_ref.
    + destruct (sealcomp_record_inv _ _ Hsc) as [r1 [Heq Hrc]]. subst.
      apply value_record. eapply value_record_comp_sealcomp_down; eauto.
Qed.

Fixpoint sealcomp_open_ee (e1 f1 : exp) (H : sealcomp e1 f1) {struct H} :
    forall k u v, sealcomp u v ->
      sealcomp (open_ee_rec k u e1) (open_ee_rec k v f1)
with sealcomp_rec_open_ee (r1 r2 : rec_comp) (H : sealcomp_rec_comp r1 r2) {struct H} :
    forall k u v, sealcomp u v ->
      sealcomp_rec_comp (open_ee_record_rec k u r1) (open_ee_record_rec k v r2).
Proof.
  - intros k u v Huv.
    destruct H as
      [ x
      | n
      | T e1 e2 Hsc
      | e1 e2 f1 f2 Hsc1 Hsc2
      | T e1 e2 Hsc
      | T e1 e2 Hsc
      | e1 e2 f1 f2 Hsc1 Hsc2
      | e1 e2 Hsc
      | e1 e2 Hsc
      | e1 e2 f1 f2 Hsc1 Hsc2
      | l
      | e1 e2 Hsc
      | r1 r2 Hsc
      | e1 e2 y Hsc
      | e1 f1 y e2 f2 Hsc1 Hsc2
      | e1 e2 Hsc ].
    + apply sealcomp_fvar.
    + simpl. destruct (k == n); [exact Huv | apply sealcomp_bvar].
    + apply sealcomp_abs. apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc (S k) u v Huv).
    + apply sealcomp_app.
      * apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc1 k u v Huv).
      * apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc2 k u v Huv).
    + apply sealcomp_tabs. apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc k u v Huv).
    + apply sealcomp_tapp. apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc k u v Huv).
    + apply sealcomp_let.
      * apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc1 k u v Huv).
      * apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc2 (S k) u v Huv).
    + apply sealcomp_box. apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc k u v Huv).
    + apply sealcomp_unbox. apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc k u v Huv).
    + apply sealcomp_set_box.
      * apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc1 k u v Huv).
      * apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc2 k u v Huv).
    + apply sealcomp_ref.
    + apply sealcomp_seal. apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc k u v Huv).
    + apply sealcomp_record. apply (sealcomp_rec_open_ee _ _ Hsc k u v Huv).
    + apply sealcomp_record_read. apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc k u v Huv).
    + apply sealcomp_record_write.
      * apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc1 k u v Huv).
      * apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc2 k u v Huv).
    + apply sealcomp_multiple_seal. apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc k u v Huv).
  - intros k u v Huv.
    destruct H as [ | a e1 e2 r1 r2 Hrec Hsc | a l r1 r2 Hrec ].
    + apply sealcomp_rec_empty.
    + apply sealcomp_rec_exp.
      * apply (sealcomp_rec_open_ee _ _ Hrec k u v Huv).
      * apply (sealcomp_open_ee _ _ Hsc k u v Huv).
    + apply sealcomp_rec_ref. apply (sealcomp_rec_open_ee _ _ Hrec k u v Huv).
Qed.

Fixpoint sealcomp_open_te (e1 f1 : exp) (H : sealcomp e1 f1) {struct H} :
    forall k U, sealcomp (open_te_rec k U e1) (open_te_rec k U f1)
with sealcomp_rec_open_te (r1 r2 : rec_comp) (H : sealcomp_rec_comp r1 r2) {struct H} :
    forall k U, sealcomp_rec_comp (open_te_record_rec k U r1) (open_te_record_rec k U r2).
Proof.
  - intros k U.
    destruct H as
      [ x
      | n
      | T e1 e2 Hsc
      | e1 e2 f1 f2 Hsc1 Hsc2
      | T e1 e2 Hsc
      | T e1 e2 Hsc
      | e1 e2 f1 f2 Hsc1 Hsc2
      | e1 e2 Hsc
      | e1 e2 Hsc
      | e1 e2 f1 f2 Hsc1 Hsc2
      | l
      | e1 e2 Hsc
      | r1 r2 Hsc
      | e1 e2 y Hsc
      | e1 f1 y e2 f2 Hsc1 Hsc2
      | e1 e2 Hsc ].
    + apply sealcomp_fvar.
    + apply sealcomp_bvar.
    + apply sealcomp_abs. apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc k U).
    + apply sealcomp_app.
      * apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc1 k U).
      * apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc2 k U).
    + apply sealcomp_tabs. apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc (S k) U).
    + apply sealcomp_tapp. apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc k U).
    + apply sealcomp_let.
      * apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc1 k U).
      * apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc2 k U).
    + apply sealcomp_box. apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc k U).
    + apply sealcomp_unbox. apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc k U).
    + apply sealcomp_set_box.
      * apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc1 k U).
      * apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc2 k U).
    + apply sealcomp_ref.
    + apply sealcomp_seal. apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc k U).
    + apply sealcomp_record. apply (sealcomp_rec_open_te _ _ Hsc k U).
    + apply sealcomp_record_read. apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc k U).
    + apply sealcomp_record_write.
      * apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc1 k U).
      * apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc2 k U).
    + apply sealcomp_multiple_seal. apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc k U).
  - intros k U.
    destruct H as [ | a e1 e2 r1 r2 Hrec Hsc | a l r1 r2 Hrec ].
    + apply sealcomp_rec_empty.
    + apply sealcomp_rec_exp.
      * apply (sealcomp_rec_open_te _ _ Hrec k U).
      * apply (sealcomp_open_te _ _ Hsc k U).
    + apply sealcomp_rec_ref. apply (sealcomp_rec_open_te _ _ Hrec k U).
Qed.

Fixpoint seal_pow (k : nat) (e : exp) {struct k} : exp :=
  match k with
  | 0 => e
  | S k' => exp_seal (seal_pow k' e)
  end.
Arguments seal_pow k e /.

Lemma seal_pow_add : forall a b e, seal_pow (a + b) e = seal_pow a (seal_pow b e).
Proof.
  induction a; intros b e; simpl; [reflexivity | rewrite IHa; reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma seal_pow_expr_inv : forall k e, expr (seal_pow k e) -> expr e.
Proof.

  - exact H.
  - apply IHk. apply expr_seal_inv. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma sealcomp_pow_right : forall e f, sealcomp e f -> forall k, sealcomp e (seal_pow k f).
Proof.
  intros e f H. induction k; simpl.
  - exact H.
  - apply sealcomp_multiple_seal. exact IHk.
Qed.

Fixpoint seal_lhs_shape (e0 : exp) (f : exp) (H : sealcomp (exp_seal e0) f) {struct f} :

Proof.

Fixpoint tabs_shape (T : typ) (e1 : exp) (f : exp) (H : sealcomp (exp_tabs T e1) f) {struct f} :

Definition min1 (k : nat) : nat := match k with 0 => 0 | S _ => 1 end.

Lemma abs_strip : forall s k T e1,
  well_formed_store s -> expr (exp_abs T e1) ->
  redm (seal_pow k (exp_abs T e1)) s (exp_abs T e1) s.
Proof.
  intros s k T e1 Hwf Hexpr. induction k as [|k IH]; simpl.
  - apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
  - apply redm_trans with (e':=exp_seal (exp_abs T e1)) (s':=s).
    + apply redm_seal. exact IH.
    + apply redm_step with (e'':=exp_abs T e1) (s'':=s).
      * apply red_seal_abs; assumption.
      * apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma tabs_strip : forall s k T e1,
  well_formed_store s -> expr (exp_tabs T e1) ->
  redm (seal_pow k (exp_tabs T e1)) s (exp_tabs T e1) s.
Proof.
  intros s k T e1 Hwf Hexpr. induction k as [|k IH]; simpl.
  - apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
  - apply redm_trans with (e':=exp_seal (exp_tabs T e1)) (s':=s).
    + apply redm_seal. exact IH.
    + apply redm_step with (e'':=exp_tabs T e1) (s'':=s).
      * apply red_seal_tabs; assumption.
      * apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma ref_strip : forall s k l,
  well_formed_store s ->
  redm (seal_pow k (exp_ref l)) s (seal_pow (min1 k) (exp_ref l)) s.
Proof.
  intros s k l Hwf. induction k as [|k IH]; simpl.
  - apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
  - destruct k as [|k'].
    + apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
    + apply redm_trans with (e':=exp_seal (exp_seal (exp_ref l))) (s':=s).
      * apply redm_seal. exact IH.
      * apply redm_step with (e'':=exp_seal (exp_ref l)) (s'':=s).
        -- apply red_seal_sealed_ref; exact Hwf.
        -- apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma record_strip : forall s k r,
  well_formed_store s -> value_record_comp r ->
  redm (seal_pow k (exp_record r)) s (seal_pow (min1 k) (exp_record r)) s.
Proof.
  intros s k r Hwf Hv. induction k as [|k IH]; simpl.
  - apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
  - destruct k as [|k'].
    + apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
    + apply redm_trans with (e':=exp_seal (exp_seal (exp_record r))) (s':=s).
      * apply redm_seal. exact IH.

    pose proof (seal_pow_expr_inv k (exp_tabs T f1) Hexpr) as Hcore.
    exists (exp_tabs T f1). split; [| split].

Lemma in_dom_elements : forall (s:store) l,
  In l (List.map fst (LabelMapImpl.elements s)) <-> exists v, LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s.
Proof.
  intros s l. split.
  - intros H. apply List.in_map_iff in H. destruct H as [p [Hfst Hin]].
    destruct p as [l' v]. simpl in Hfst. subst l'.
    exists v. apply (@LabelMapImpl.elements_2 exp s l v).
    apply InA_alt. exists (l, v). split.
    * simpl. split; reflexivity.
    * exact Hin.
  - intros [v Hmap].
    pose proof (@LabelMapImpl.elements_1 exp s l v Hmap) as HmapA.
    apply InA_alt in HmapA. destruct HmapA as [y [Heq Hiny]].
    destruct y as [l2 v2]. simpl in Heq. destruct Heq as [Hl Hv]. simpl in Hl, Hv. subst.
    apply List.in_map_iff. exists (l2, v2). split; [reflexivity | exact Hiny].
Qed.

Lemma fresh_label_sealcomp_store : forall s ns,
  s <s= ns -> fresh_label_for_store s = fresh_label_for_store ns.
Proof.
  intros s ns [H1 H2]. unfold fresh_label_for_store.
  apply Label.fresh_permute. intros l.
  rewrite in_dom_elements. rewrite in_dom_elements.
  split; intros [v Hv].
  - destruct (H1 l v Hv) as [v' [Hv' _]]. exists v'. exact Hv'.
  - destruct (H2 l v Hv) as [v' [Hv' _]]. exists v'. exact Hv'.
Qed.

Lemma sim2_multi : forall f ns f' ns', redm f ns f' ns' -> forall e s,
  expr f -> expr e -> well_formed_store s -> s <s= ns -> sealcomp e f ->
  exists e' s', redm e s e' s' /\ s' <s= ns' /\ sealcomp e' f' /\
  well_formed_store s' /\ expr f' /\ expr e'.
Proof.
  intros f ns f' ns' H. induction H as
    [ f0 s0 f1 s1 Heq Hseq | f0 s0 f2 s2 f1 s1 Hred Hredm IHredm ]; intros e s Hf He Hwf Hst Hsc.
  - subst. exists e, s. split.
    + apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
    + split; [exact Hst | split; [exact Hsc | split; [exact Hwf | split; [exact Hf | exact He]]]].
  - destruct (sim2_step f0 s0 f2 s2 Hred e s Hf He Hwf Hst Hsc)
      as [e1 [s1' [Hred1 [Hst1 [Hsc1 [Hwf1 [Hf1 He1]]]]]]].
    destruct (IHredm e1 s1' Hf1 He1 Hwf1 Hst1 Hsc1)
      as [e' [s' [Hred2 [Hst2 [Hsc2 [Hwf2 [Hf2 He2]]]]]]].
    exists e', s'. split.
    + apply redm_trans with (e':=e1) (s':=s1'); assumption.
    + split; [exact Hst2 | split; [exact Hsc2 | split; [exact Hwf2 | split; [exact Hf2 | exact He2]]]].
Qed.

  forall lb T1 T2,
    Signatures.binds lb (bind_sig T1) R ->
    Signatures.binds lb (bind_sig T2) R -> T1 = T2.
Proof.

    pose proof (typing_wf_env _ _ _ _ Hbody) as HwfBody.
    pose proof (wf_env_cons_inv x (bind_typ V) E HwfBody) as [Htail [_ [Htyp _]]].
    pose proof (Htyp V eq_refl) as HwV.
    assert (HsBody : wf_sig (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) R).

    pose proof (H x Hx HsBody) as HwBody.

  - (* app *)

  - (* tabs *)
    intros Hs.

    pose proof (typing_wf_env _ _ _ _ Hbody) as HwfBody.
    pose proof (wf_env_cons_inv X (bind_sub V) E HwfBody) as [Htail [Hsub _]].

  - (* tapp *)
    intros Hs.
    pose proof (typing_wf_env _ _ _ _ H) as HwfE.
    pose proof (IHtyping Hs) as HwAll.
    pose proof HwAll as Hinv.
    inversion Hinv; subst.
    pose proof (proj1 (sub_wf_typ _ _ _ s)) as HwT.
    pose proof (proj2 (sub_wf_typ _ _ _ s)) as HwT1.
    pose proof (sub_type _ _ _ s) as HtypeT.
    destruct (atom_fresh (L `union` dom E `union` ftv_t T2)) as [X HX].
    pose proof HX as HXL. apply notin_union_1 in HXL.
    pose proof HX as Hrest. apply notin_union_2 in Hrest.
    pose proof Hrest as HXD. apply notin_union_1 in HXD.
    pose proof Hrest as HfT2. apply notin_union_2 in HfT2.
    pose proof (H4 X HXL) as HwBody.
    assert (HwfSrcExt : wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E)).
    { apply wf_env_sub; [exact HwfE | exact HwT1 | exact HXD]. }
    assert (HE0 : subst_tvar_env X T E = E).
    { apply subst_tvar_env_id_wf; [exact HwfE | exact HXD]. }
    pose proof (wf_typ_subst_tvar_ctx (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt T2 X)
      HwBody nil E X T1 T eq_refl HwfSrcExt HE0 (proj1 HtypeT) HwT) as Hres.
    change (wf_typ E (open_tt_rec 0 T T2)).
    rewrite (open_tt_tsubst_eq T2 0 X T HfT2). exact Hres.
  - (* sub *)
    intros Hs. exact (proj2 (sub_wf_typ _ _ _ s)).
  - (* let *)
    intros Hs.
    destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx].
    pose proof (t x Hx) as Hbody.
    pose proof (typing_wf_env _ _ _ _ Hbody) as HwfBody.
    assert (HsBody : wf_sig (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E) R).
    { eapply wf_sig_weaken_binds; [exact Hs | exact HwfBody |].
      intros Z c HZ. apply binds_cons_3. exact HZ. }
    pose proof (H0 x Hx HsBody) as HwBody.
    exact (wf_typ_drop_term_binder nil x T1 E T2 HwBody).
  - (* box *) intros Hs. apply wf_typ_box. exact (IHtyping Hs).
  - (* unbox *) intros Hs. exact (wf_typ_box_inv _ _ (IHtyping Hs)).
  - (* set_box *) intros Hs. exact (wf_typ_box_inv _ _ (IHtyping1 Hs)).

    + exact (IHtyping Hs).
Qed.

Lemma typing_store_add : forall E R s l v T,
  typing_store E R s -> wf_sig E R ->
  typing E R v T -> value v ->
  LabelSetImpl.notin l (Signatures.dom R) ->
  typing_store E (l ~ bind_sig T ++ R) (LabelMapImpl.add l v s).
Proof.
  intros E R s l v T Hst Hsig Hty Hval Hfresh.
  pose proof (typing_wf_typ _ _ _ _ Hty Hsig) as Hwt.
  intros l'.
  assert (HtyTgt : forall e T0, typing E R e T0 -> typing E (l ~ bind_sig T ++ R) e T0).
  { intros e T0 He. eapply typing_sig_add; [exact He | exact Hsig | exact Hwt | exact Hfresh]. }
  split.
  - intros T' Hb. simpl in Hb.
    destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. exists v. split; [apply LabelMapImpl.add_1; reflexivity |].
      split; [apply HtyTgt; exact Hty | exact Hval].
    + destruct (proj1 (Hst l') T' Hin) as [v' [Hm [Hty' Hval']]].
      exists v'. split.
      * destruct (LabelMapFacts.eq_dec l l') as [Heq | Hne].
        -- subst l'. exfalso. eapply Signatures.binds_dom_contradiction; [exact Hin | exact Hfresh].
        -- apply LabelMapImpl.add_2; assumption.
      * split; [apply HtyTgt; exact Hty' | exact Hval'].
  - intros v' Hm.
    destruct (LabelMapFacts.eq_dec l l') as [Heq | Hne].
    + subst l'.
      assert (Hvv : v' = v).
      { eapply LabelMapFacts.MapsTo_fun; [exact Hm | apply LabelMapImpl.add_1; reflexivity]. }
      subst v'.
      exists T. split; [exact Hval | split; [apply HtyTgt; exact Hty | apply Signatures.binds_app_2; apply Signatures.binds_cons_2; reflexivity]].
    + assert (HmS : LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l' v' s).
      { eapply LabelMapImpl.add_3; [exact Hne | exact Hm]. }
      destruct (proj2 (Hst l') v' HmS) as [T' [Hval' [Hty' Hb']]].
      exists T'. split; [exact Hval' | split; [apply HtyTgt; exact Hty' | apply Signatures.binds_app_3; exact Hb']].
Qed.

Lemma typing_store_update : forall E R s l v T,
  typing_store E R s -> wf_sig E R ->
  typing E R v T -> value v ->
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
  typing_store E R (LabelMapImpl.add l v s).
Proof.
  intros E R s l v T Hst Hsig Hty Hval Hb.
  intros l'. split.
  - intros T' Hb'. destruct (LabelMapFacts.eq_dec l l') as [Heq | Hne].
    + subst l'.
      assert (HeqT : T' = T).
      { symmetry. exact (wf_sig_binds_fun E R Hsig l T T' Hb Hb'). }
      subst T'. exists v. split; [apply LabelMapImpl.add_1; reflexivity |].
      split; [exact Hty | exact Hval].
    + destruct (proj1 (Hst l') T' Hb') as [v' [Hm [Hty' Hval']]].
      exists v'. split.
      * apply LabelMapImpl.add_2; [exact Hne | exact Hm].
      * split; [exact Hty' | exact Hval'].
  - intros v' Hm. destruct (LabelMapFacts.eq_dec l l') as [Heq | Hne].
    + subst l'.
      assert (Hvv : v' = v).
      { eapply LabelMapFacts.MapsTo_fun; [exact Hm | apply LabelMapImpl.add_1; reflexivity]. }
      subst v'. exists T. split; [exact Hval | split; [exact Hty | exact Hb]].
    + assert (HmS : LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l' v' s).
      { eapply LabelMapImpl.add_3; [exact Hne | exact Hm]. }
      destruct (proj2 (Hst l') v' HmS) as [T' [Hval' [Hty' Hb']]].
      exists T'. split; [exact Hval' | split; [exact Hty' | exact Hb']].
Qed.

Lemma typing_store_weaken_env : forall E R s E',
  typing_store E R s -> wf_env E' ->
  (forall X b, binds X b E -> binds X b E') ->
  typing_store E' R s.
Proof.
  intros E R s E' Hst HwfE' HEb.
  assert (Hty : forall e T, typing E R e T -> typing E' R e T).
  { intros e T He. exact (typing_weaken_binds E R e T He E' HwfE' HEb). }
  intros l. split.
  - intros T Hb. destruct (proj1 (Hst l) T Hb) as [v [Hm [Hty0 Hval]]].
    exists v. split; [exact Hm | split; [apply Hty; exact Hty0 | exact Hval]].
  - intros v Hm. destruct (proj2 (Hst l) v Hm) as [T [Hval [Hty0 Hb0]]].
    exists T. split; [exact Hval | split; [apply Hty; exact Hty0 | exact Hb0]].
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_type : forall E T, wf_typ E T -> type T.
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction H; simpl.
  - apply type_top.
  - apply type_var.
  - apply type_arrow; assumption.
  - apply type_all with (L:=L); [assumption |].
    intros X HX. apply H1; assumption.
  - apply type_box; assumption.
  - apply type_readonly; assumption.
  - apply type_intersect; assumption.
  - apply type_record; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma sub_type : forall E A B, sub E A B -> type A /\ type B.
Proof.
  intros E A B H. induction H.
  - split; [eapply wf_typ_type; eassumption | apply type_top].
  - split; [apply type_var | apply type_var].
  - split; [apply type_var | apply (proj2 IHsub)].
  - split.
    + apply type_arrow; [apply (proj2 IHsub1) | apply (proj1 IHsub2)].
    + apply type_arrow; [apply (proj1 IHsub1) | apply (proj2 IHsub2)].
  - split.
    + apply type_all with (L:=L); [apply (proj2 IHsub) |].
      intros X HX. apply (proj1 (H1 X HX)).
    + apply type_all with (L:=L); [apply (proj1 IHsub) |].
      intros X HX. apply (proj2 (H1 X HX)).
  - split.
    + apply type_box; apply (proj1 IHsub1).
    + apply type_box; apply (proj1 IHsub2).
  - split; [apply type_readonly; apply (proj1 IHsub) | apply type_readonly; apply (proj2 IHsub)].
  - split; [apply (proj1 IHsub) | apply type_readonly; apply (proj2 IHsub)].
  - split; [apply (proj1 IHsub1) | apply (proj2 IHsub2)].
  - split; [apply type_intersect; eapply wf_typ_type; eassumption | eapply wf_typ_type; eassumption].
  - split; [apply type_intersect; eapply wf_typ_type; eassumption | eapply wf_typ_type; eassumption].
  - split; [apply (proj1 IHsub1) | apply type_intersect; [apply (proj2 IHsub1) | apply (proj2 IHsub2)]].
  - split.
    + apply type_record; apply (proj1 IHsub1).
    + apply type_record; apply (proj1 IHsub2).
  - split; [apply type_readonly; apply type_record; apply (proj1 IHsub) |
             apply type_readonly; apply type_record; apply (proj2 IHsub)].
  - split; [eapply wf_typ_type; eassumption | eapply wf_typ_type; eassumption].
Qed.

(* red_set_box_ref is simulable whenever the first argument of  *)
(* the typed set_box is the reference (the only possible case   *)
(* under typing) and the stripped e-argument is a value.        *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma set_box_ref_reduces :
  forall E R ns l e2 g1 g2 T,
    typing E R (exp_set_box g1 g2) T ->
    typing_store E R ns ->
    sealcomp (exp_ref l) g1 ->
    sealcomp e2 g2 ->
    value e2 ->
    expr g2 ->
    exists f' ns', redm (exp_set_box g1 g2) ns f' ns'.
Proof.
  intros E R ns l e2 g1 g2 T Hty Hst Hsc1 Hsc2 Hv2 Hexpr2.
  destruct (typing_set_box_inv E R g1 g2 T Hty) as [T1 [Hg1 [Hg2 _]]].
  assert (Hg1ref : g1 = exp_ref l).
  { eapply sealcomp_ref_typed_box; [exact Hsc1 | exact Hg1]. }
  subst g1.
  destruct (typing_ref_inv E R l (typ_box T1) Hg1) as [T0 [Hb _]].
  destruct (proj1 (Hst l) T0 Hb) as [v [Hm [Htyv Hvalv]]].
  pose proof (typing_store_wf_store E R ns Hst) as Hwfns.
  destruct (value_seal_redm e2 g2 ns Hv2 Hsc2 Hexpr2 Hwfns)
    as [g2' [Hred [Hval' Hsc']]].
  exists v, (LabelMapImpl.add l g2' ns).
  eapply redm_trans with (e':=exp_set_box (exp_ref l) g2') (s':=ns).
  - eapply redm_set_box_2; [apply value_ref | exact Hred].
  - eapply redm_step with (e'':=v) (s'':=LabelMapImpl.add l g2' ns).
    + eapply red_set_box_ref; [exact Hwfns | exact Hvalv | exact Hval' | exact Hm].
    + apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* red_record_write_ref is simulable whenever the first argument *)
(* of the typed record_write is the record (no extra seal).     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma record_write_ref_reduces :
  forall E R ns a l r e2 g1 g2 v T,
    typing E R (exp_record_write g1 a g2) T ->
    well_formed_store ns ->
    sealcomp (exp_record r) g1 ->
    value_record_comp r ->
    record_lookup_ref a r = Some l ->
    LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v ns ->
    sealcomp e2 g2 ->
    value e2 ->
    expr g2 ->
    exists f' ns', redm (exp_record_write g1 a g2) ns f' ns'.
Proof.
  intros E R ns a l r e2 g1 g2 v T Hty Hwf Hsc1 Hvrc Hlook Hmap Hsc2 Hv2 Hexpr2.
  destruct (typing_record_write_inv E R g1 a g2 T Hty) as [T1 [Hg1 [Hg2 _]]].
  destruct (sealcomp_record_typed_record E R r g1 a T1 Hsc1 Hg1) as [r1 [Heq Hrc]].
  subst g1.
  assert (Hlook' : record_lookup_ref a r1 = Some l).
  { rewrite <- (record_lookup_ref_sealcomp a r r1 Hrc). exact Hlook. }
  pose proof (value_record_comp_sealcomp_up r r1 Hrc Hvrc) as Hvrc1.
  pose proof (Hwf l v Hmap) as Hval.
  destruct (value_seal_redm e2 g2 ns Hv2 Hsc2 Hexpr2 Hwf)
    as [g2' [Hred [Hval' Hsc']]].
  exists v, (LabelMapImpl.add l g2' ns).
  eapply redm_trans with (e':=exp_record_write (exp_record r1) a g2') (s':=ns).
  - eapply redm_record_write_2; [apply value_record; exact Hvrc1 | exact Hred].
  - eapply redm_step with (e'':=v) (s'':=LabelMapImpl.add l g2' ns).
    + eapply red_record_write_ref; eauto.
    + apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Unboxing a (possibly multiply sealed) reference: the extra   *)
(* seals never block the step; they are just peeled first.      *)
(* The result is the target-side spelling of the source result. *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma unbox_ref_reduces :
  forall ns l j w w',
    well_formed_store ns ->
    LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l w' ns ->
    sealcomp w w' ->
    exists f', redm (exp_unbox (seal_pow j (exp_ref l))) ns f' ns /\
      sealcomp (seal_pow (min1 j) w) f'.
Proof.
  intros ns l j w w' Hwf Hmap Hsc.
  pose proof (Hwf l w' Hmap) as Hval'.
  destruct j as [|j'].
  - simpl. exists w'. split.
    + eapply redm_step with (e'':=w') (s'':=ns).
      * eapply red_unbox_ref; assumption.
      * apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
    + exact Hsc.
  - exists (exp_seal w'). split.
    + eapply redm_trans with (e':=exp_unbox (seal_pow (min1 (S j')) (exp_ref l))) (s':=ns).
      * eapply redm_unbox_1. apply ref_strip; exact Hwf.
      * change (redm (exp_unbox (exp_seal (exp_ref l))) ns (exp_seal w') ns).
        eapply redm_step with (e'':=exp_seal w') (s'':=ns).
        -- eapply red_unbox_sealed_ref; assumption.
        -- apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
    + apply sealcomp_seal. exact Hsc.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Reading a field from a (possibly sealed) record.             *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma record_read_ref_reduces :
  forall ns a j r l w w',
    well_formed_store ns ->
    value_record_comp r ->
    record_lookup_ref a r = Some l ->
    LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l w' ns ->
    sealcomp w w' ->
    exists f', redm (exp_record_read (seal_pow j (exp_record r)) a) ns f' ns /\
      sealcomp (seal_pow (min1 j) w) f'.
Proof.
  intros ns a j r l w w' Hwf Hvrc Hlook Hmap Hsc.
  pose proof (Hwf l w' Hmap) as Hval'.
  destruct j as [|j'].
  - simpl. exists w'. split.
    + eapply redm_step with (e'':=w') (s'':=ns).
      * eapply red_record_read_ref; eauto.
      * apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
    + exact Hsc.
  - exists (exp_seal w'). split.
    + eapply redm_trans with (e':=exp_record_read (seal_pow (min1 (S j')) (exp_record r)) a) (s':=ns).
      * eapply redm_record_read_1. apply record_strip; assumption.
      * change (redm (exp_record_read (exp_seal (exp_record r)) a) ns (exp_seal w') ns).
        eapply redm_step with (e'':=exp_seal w') (s'':=ns).
        -- eapply red_sealed_record_read_ref; eauto.
        -- apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
    + apply sealcomp_seal. exact Hsc.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Iterated readonly and typing-root stripping.                 *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Fixpoint ro_pow (k : nat) (T : typ) : typ :=
  match k with
  | 0 => T
  | S k' => typ_mut mut_readonly (ro_pow k' T)
  end.

Lemma wf_typ_ro_pow : forall E T, wf_typ E T -> forall k, wf_typ E (ro_pow k T).
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction k; simpl.
  - exact H.
  - apply wf_typ_readonly. exact IHk.
Qed.

Lemma typing_seal_pow : forall E R e T,
  typing E R e T -> forall k, typing E R (seal_pow k e) (ro_pow k T).
Proof.
  intros E R e T H. induction k; simpl.
  - exact H.
  - apply typing_seal. exact IHk.
Qed.

Lemma sub_ro_pow_self : forall E T,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> forall k, sub E T (ro_pow k T).
Proof.
  intros E T Hwe Hwt. induction k; simpl.
  - apply sub_refl_wf; assumption.
  - apply sub_readonly_mutable. exact IHk.
Qed.

Lemma sub_ro_pow : forall E A B, sub E A B ->
  forall k, sub E (ro_pow k A) (ro_pow k B).
Proof.
  intros E A B H. induction k; simpl.
  - exact H.
  - apply sub_readonly. exact IHk.
Qed.

Lemma typing_root_strip : forall E R k f0 T,
  typing E R (seal_pow k f0) T -> wf_sig E R ->
  exists T0, typing E R f0 T0 /\ sub E (ro_pow k T0) T.
Proof.
  intros E R k. induction k as [|k IH]; simpl; intros f0 T Hty Hsig.
  - exists T. split; [exact Hty |].
    apply sub_refl_wf.
    + exact (wf_sig_wf_env E R Hsig).
    + eapply typing_wf_typ; eassumption.
  - destruct (typing_seal_inv E R (seal_pow k f0) T Hty) as [S [Hinner [Heq | Hsub]]].
    + subst T.
      destruct (IH f0 S Hinner Hsig) as [T0 [Hf0 Hsub0]].
      exists T0. split; [exact Hf0 |].
      eapply sub_trans.
      * apply sub_readonly. exact Hsub0.
      * apply sub_refl_wf.
        -- exact (wf_sig_wf_env E R Hsig).
        -- apply wf_typ_readonly. eapply typing_wf_typ; eassumption.
    + destruct (IH f0 S Hinner Hsig) as [T0 [Hf0 Hsub0]].
      exists T0. split; [exact Hf0 |].
      eapply sub_trans.
      * apply sub_readonly. exact Hsub0.
      * exact Hsub.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Typing-preserving peel of the extra seals on a value.        *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma value_seal_redm_typed : forall E R v g T ns,
  value v -> sealcomp v g -> typing E R g T -> wf_sig E R ->
  well_formed_store ns ->
  exists g', redm g ns g' ns /\ value g' /\ sealcomp v g' /\ typing E R g' T.
Proof.
  intros E R v g T ns Hv Hsc Hty Hsig Hwf.
  pose proof (wf_sig_wf_env E R Hsig) as Hwe.
  destruct Hv as [T0 body Hexpr_body | T0 body Hexpr_body | l | l | r Hvrc | r Hvrc].
  - (* abs *)
    destruct (abs_shape T0 body g Hsc) as [k [f1 [Heq Hsc1]]]. subst g.
    destruct (typing_root_strip E R k (exp_abs T0 f1) T Hty Hsig) as [T1 [Hcore Hsub]].
    exists (exp_abs T0 f1). split; [| split; [| split]].
    + apply abs_strip; [exact Hwf | eapply typing_expr; eassumption].
    + apply value_abs. eapply typing_expr; eassumption.
    + apply sealcomp_abs; exact Hsc1.
    + eapply typing_sub; [exact Hsig | exact Hcore |].
      eapply sub_trans.
      * apply sub_ro_pow_self; [exact Hwe |].
        eapply typing_wf_typ; eassumption.
      * exact Hsub.

Lemma typing_seal_pow : forall E R e T,

Lemma sub_ro_pow_self : forall E T,

(* ============ box inversion ============ *)
Fixpoint box_pred (E : env) (A T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_box C => sub E A C /\ sub E C A
  | typ_int U W => box_pred E A U /\ box_pred E A W
  | typ_mut _ U => box_pred E A U
  | _ => False
  end.

Lemma box_pred_merge : forall E A U M,
  box_pred E A (merge_mutability U M) <-> box_pred E A U.
Proof.
  intros E A U. induction U; intros M; simpl; try reflexivity.
  all: try (split; intro Hh; exact Hh).
  - (* int *) rewrite IHU1, IHU2. tauto.
Qed.

Lemma box_pred_nf_params : forall E A U,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E A ->
  (box_pred E (normal_form_typing A) U <-> box_pred E A U).
Proof.
  intros E A U Hwe Hwa.
  induction U; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - (* box *) split; intros [H1 H2]; split.
    + eapply sub_trans; [apply sub_normal_form_typing_right; [exact Hwe | exact Hwa] | exact H1].
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact H2 | apply sub_normal_form_typing_left; [exact Hwe | exact Hwa]].
    + eapply sub_trans; [apply sub_normal_form_typing_left; [exact Hwe | exact Hwa] | exact H1].
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact H2 | apply sub_normal_form_typing_right; [exact Hwe | exact Hwa]].
  - (* mut *) apply IHU.
  - (* int *) rewrite IHU1, IHU2. tauto.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma box_pred_nf : forall E A T,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T ->
  (box_pred E A T <-> box_pred E A (normal_form_typing T)).
Proof.
  intros E A T. revert T.
  fix IH 1. intros T Hwe Hwt.
  destruct T as [|n|X|T1 T2|T1 T2|T1|M T1|T1 T2|a T1]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - (* box *) pose proof (wf_typ_box_inv E T1 Hwt) as Hwt1. split; intros [H1 H2]; split.
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact H1 | apply sub_normal_form_typing_right; [exact Hwe | exact Hwt1]].
    + eapply sub_trans; [apply sub_normal_form_typing_left; [exact Hwe | exact Hwt1] | exact H2].
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact H1 | apply sub_normal_form_typing_left; [exact Hwe | exact Hwt1]].
    + eapply sub_trans; [apply sub_normal_form_typing_right; [exact Hwe | exact Hwt1] | exact H2].
  - (* mut *) rewrite box_pred_merge. destruct M. apply (IH T1 Hwe (wf_typ_readonly_inv _ _ Hwt)).
  - (* int *) split; intros [H1 H2]; split.
    + apply (proj1 (IH T1 Hwe (wf_typ_int_l _ _ _ Hwt))) in H1. exact H1.
    + apply (proj1 (IH T2 Hwe (wf_typ_int_r _ _ _ Hwt))) in H2. exact H2.
    + apply (proj2 (IH T1 Hwe (wf_typ_int_l _ _ _ Hwt))). exact H1.
    + apply (proj2 (IH T2 Hwe (wf_typ_int_r _ _ _ Hwt))). exact H2.
  - (* record *) reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma box_pred_sub_aux : forall E A T2 T3,
  box_pred E A T2 -> sub E T2 T3 -> box_pred E A T3.
Proof.
  intros E A T2 T3 Hp Hs.
  pose proof (sub_wf_env E T2 T3 Hs) as Hwe.
  dependent induction Hs.
  - (* top *) exact I.
  - (* refl_tvar *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.
  - (* trans_tvar *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.
  - (* arrow *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.
  - (* all *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.
  - (* box *) simpl in Hp. simpl. destruct Hp as [H1 H2]. split.
    + eapply sub_trans; eassumption.
    + eapply sub_trans; eassumption.
  - (* readonly *) simpl in Hp. simpl. apply IHHs; [exact Hp | exact Hwe].
  - (* readonly_mutable *) simpl in Hp. simpl. apply IHHs; [exact Hp | exact Hwe].
  - (* trans *) simpl. apply IHHs2; [apply IHHs1; [exact Hp | exact Hwe] | exact Hwe].
  - (* inter_left *) simpl in Hp. destruct Hp as [Hp _]. exact Hp.
  - (* inter_right *) simpl in Hp. destruct Hp as [_ Hp]. exact Hp.
  - (* inter *) simpl. split.
    + apply IHHs1; [exact Hp | exact Hwe].
    + apply IHHs2; [exact Hp | exact Hwe].
  - (* record *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.
  - (* readonly_record *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.
  - (* denormalize *) simpl in *.
    pose proof (proj1 (box_pred_nf E A T1 Hwe H) Hp) as Hpn.
    pose proof (IHHs Hpn Hwe) as Hqn.
    exact (proj2 (box_pred_nf E A T2 Hwe H0) Hqn).
Qed.

Lemma box_pred_sub : forall E A T, sub E (typ_box A) T -> box_pred E A T.
Proof.
  intros E A T H.
  dependent induction H.
  - (* top *) exact I.
  - (* box *) simpl. split; assumption.
  - (* readonly_mutable *) simpl. apply (IHsub A eq_refl).
  - (* trans *) simpl.
    apply box_pred_sub_aux with (T2:=T2).
    + apply (IHsub1 A eq_refl).
    + exact H0.
  - (* inter *) simpl. split.
    + apply (IHsub1 A eq_refl).
    + apply (IHsub2 A eq_refl).
  - (* denormalize *) simpl in H1.
    pose proof (IHsub (normal_form_typing A) eq_refl) as Hpred.
    pose proof (sub_wf_env E _ _ H1) as Hwe.
    pose proof (wf_typ_box_inv E A H) as Hwa.
    apply (proj1 (box_pred_nf_params E A (normal_form_typing T2) Hwe Hwa)) in Hpred.
    exact (proj2 (box_pred_nf E A T2 Hwe H0) Hpred).
Qed.

Lemma sub_box_inv_l : forall E A B, sub E (typ_box A) (typ_box B) -> sub E A B.
Proof.
  intros E A B H. pose proof (box_pred_sub E A (typ_box B) H) as Hp.
  simpl in Hp. exact (proj1 Hp).
Qed.
Lemma sub_box_inv_r : forall E A B, sub E (typ_box A) (typ_box B) -> sub E B A.
Proof.
  intros E A B H. pose proof (box_pred_sub E A (typ_box B) H) as Hp.
  simpl in Hp. exact (proj2 Hp).
Qed.

Notation env := (list (atom * binding)).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Notation sig := (list (label * signature)).

Notation sempty := (@nil (label * signature)).

Inductive wf_typ : env -> typ -> Prop :=
  | wf_typ_top : forall E,
      wf_typ E typ_top
  | wf_typ_var : forall U E (X : atom),
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      wf_typ E (typ_fvar X)
  | wf_typ_arrow : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_all : forall L E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        wf_typ (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      wf_typ E (typ_all T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_box : forall E T,
      wf_typ E T ->
      wf_typ E (typ_box T)
  | wf_typ_readonly : forall E T,
      wf_typ E T ->
      wf_typ E (typ_mut mut_readonly T)
  | wf_typ_intersect : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_int T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_record : forall E a T1,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_record a T1)

  s <s= ns -> sealcomp v w ->
  LabelMapImpl.add l v s <s= LabelMapImpl.add l w ns.
Proof.
  intros s ns l v w [H1 H2] Hsc. split.
  - intros l0 v0 Hmap.
    destruct (Label.eq_dec l0 l) as [Heq | Hneq].

    + destruct (H1 l0 v0) as [w' [Hw' Hsc']].

Fixpoint ro_pow (k : nat) (T : typ) : typ :=
  match k with
  | 0 => T
  | S k' => typ_mut mut_readonly (ro_pow k' T)
  end.

Lemma wf_typ_ro_pow : forall E T, wf_typ E T -> forall k, wf_typ E (ro_pow k T).
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction k; simpl.
  - exact H.
  - apply wf_typ_readonly. exact IHk.
Qed.

Lemma typing_seal_pow : forall E R e T,
  typing E R e T -> forall k, typing E R (seal_pow k e) (ro_pow k T).
Proof.
  intros E R e T H. induction k; simpl.
  - exact H.
  - apply typing_seal. exact IHk.
Qed.

Lemma sub_ro_pow_self : forall E T,

Proof.

  induction Hred as
    [ e0 s0 e2 s2 Heq Hseq

    intros f ns R T He Hf Hwf Hscst Hle Hsc Hsig Hstyp Hty.

    exists f', ns', R', T'.

Theorem safety_value_multistep_of_fwd_step :
  forall e s e' s' f ns R T,
    sealcomp_store s ns ->
    sealcomp e f ->
    redm e s e' s' ->
    value e' ->
    typing_store empty R ns ->
    typing empty R f T ->
    exists f' ns',

Proof.

  pose proof (typing_wf_sig empty R f T Hty) as Hsig.
  pose proof (typing_expr empty R f T Hty) as Hf.
  pose proof (sealcomp_expr_down e f Hsc Hf) as He.
  pose proof (wf_store_of_sealcomp_typing s ns empty R Hstyp Hscst) as Hwf.

From Stdlib Require Import Lia.
From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.
Load "/tmp/th1/base.v".

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Normal forms commute with opening at an arbitrary type.      *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma normal_form_typing_open_tt_any : forall D X,
  normal_form_typing (open_tt D X) =
  normal_form_typing (open_tt (normal_form_typing D) X).
Proof.
  intros D X.
  change (normal_form_typing (open_tt_rec 0 X D) =
          normal_form_typing (open_tt_rec 0 X (normal_form_typing D))).
  destruct (atom_fresh (ftv_t D `union` ftv_t (normal_form_typing D))) as [Y HY].
  pose proof HY as HY1. apply notin_union_1 in HY1.
  pose proof HY as HY2. apply notin_union_2 in HY2.
  (* open D X = subst Y X (open D (fvar Y)) *)
  rewrite (open_tt_tsubst_eq D 0 Y X HY1).
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.
From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.
Load "/tmp/th1/base.v".

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Honest step-counting version of redm (redm is in Prop, so we   *)
(* cannot eliminate it to Set; we use an indexed relation).       *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Inductive redm_n : nat -> exp -> store -> exp -> store -> Prop :=
  | redm_n_zero : forall e s,
      redm_n 0 e s e s
Proof.
  intros E A B C D H X HXC.
  pose proof (all_codom_pred_sub E A B (typ_all C D) H) as Hp.
  simpl in Hp. destruct Hp as [_ Hcod]. exact (Hcod X HXC).
Qed.

Fixpoint record_pred (E : env) (a : atom) (A T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_record b C => if (a === b) then (sub E A C /\ sub E C A) else False
  | typ_int U W => record_pred E a A U /\ record_pred E a A W
  | typ_mut _ U => record_pred E a A U
  | _ => False
  end.

Lemma record_pred_merge : forall E a A U M,
  record_pred E a A (merge_mutability U M) <-> record_pred E a A U.
Proof.
  intros E a A U. induction U; intros M; simpl; try reflexivity.
  all: try (split; intro Hh; exact Hh).
  - (* int *) rewrite IHU1, IHU2. tauto.
Qed.

Lemma record_pred_nf_params : forall E a A U,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E A ->
  (record_pred E a (normal_form_typing A) U <-> record_pred E a A U).
Proof.
  intros E a A U Hwe Hwa.
  induction U; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - (* mut *) apply IHU.
  - (* int *) rewrite IHU1, IHU2. tauto.
  - (* record *) destruct (a === a0) eqn:Eab; [| reflexivity].
    split; intros [H1 H2]; split.
    + eapply sub_trans; [apply sub_normal_form_typing_right; [exact Hwe | exact Hwa] | exact H1].
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact H2 | apply sub_normal_form_typing_left; [exact Hwe | exact Hwa]].
    + eapply sub_trans; [apply sub_normal_form_typing_left; [exact Hwe | exact Hwa] | exact H1].
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact H2 | apply sub_normal_form_typing_right; [exact Hwe | exact Hwa]].
Qed.

Lemma record_pred_nf : forall E a A T,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T ->
  (record_pred E a A T <-> record_pred E a A (normal_form_typing T)).
Proof.
  intros E a A T. revert T.
  fix IH 1. intros T Hwe Hwt.
  destruct T as [|n|X|T1 T2|T1 T2|T1|M T1|T1 T2|b T1]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - (* mut *) rewrite record_pred_merge. destruct M. apply (IH T1 Hwe (wf_typ_readonly_inv _ _ Hwt)).
  - (* int *) split; intros [H1 H2]; split.
    + apply (proj1 (IH T1 Hwe (wf_typ_int_l _ _ _ Hwt))) in H1. exact H1.
    + apply (proj1 (IH T2 Hwe (wf_typ_int_r _ _ _ Hwt))) in H2. exact H2.
    + apply (proj2 (IH T1 Hwe (wf_typ_int_l _ _ _ Hwt))). exact H1.
    + apply (proj2 (IH T2 Hwe (wf_typ_int_r _ _ _ Hwt))). exact H2.

    pose proof (wf_typ_record_inv E b T1 Hwt) as Hwt1.
    split; intros [H1 H2]; split.
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact H1 | apply sub_normal_form_typing_right; [exact Hwe | exact Hwt1]].
    + eapply sub_trans; [apply sub_normal_form_typing_left; [exact Hwe | exact Hwt1] | exact H2].
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact H1 | apply sub_normal_form_typing_left; [exact Hwe | exact Hwt1]].
    + eapply sub_trans; [apply sub_normal_form_typing_right; [exact Hwe | exact Hwt1] | exact H2].
Qed.



Lemma wf_typ_all_l : forall E T1 T2, wf_typ E (typ_all T1 T2) -> wf_typ E T1.
Proof. intros E T1 T2 H. inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.

(* ============ all-domain inversion ============ *)
Fixpoint all_dom_pred (E : env) (A T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_all C D => sub E C A
  | typ_int U W => all_dom_pred E A U /\ all_dom_pred E A W
  | typ_mut _ U => all_dom_pred E A U
  | _ => False
  end.
Proof.
  intros E S T H. apply (maybe_box_sub E _ _ H). exact I.
Qed.

Lemma sub_readonly_not_record : forall E S a T,
  sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly S) (typ_record a T) -> False.
Proof.
  intros E S a T H. apply (maybe_box_sub E _ _ H). exact I.
Qed.

Lemma typing_seal_not_box : forall E R e T,
  typing E R (exp_seal e) (typ_box T) -> False.
Proof.
  intros E R e T H.
  destruct (typing_seal_inv E R e (typ_box T) H) as [S [Ht [Heq | Hsub]]].
  - inversion Heq.
  - eapply sub_readonly_not_box; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma typing_seal_not_record : forall E R e a T,

  - inversion Heq.
  - eapply sub_readonly_not_record; eauto.
Qed.

Fixpoint remove_atom (x : atom) (E : env) {struct E} : env :=
  match E with
  | nil => nil
  | (y,b) :: E' => if aeq x y then E' else (y,b) :: remove_atom x E'

Lemma remove_atom_cons_neq : forall x y b E, x <> y ->

Proof.
  intros x y b E Hne. simpl. destruct (aeq x y) as [Heq | Hne2]; [exfalso; auto | reflexivity].

Lemma remove_atom_cons_eq : forall x b E,

        -- subst. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity.

Qed.

Lemma wf_env_binds_fun : forall E, wf_env E ->
  forall z b1 b2, binds z b1 E -> binds z b2 E -> b1 = b2.
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H; intros z b1 b2 K1 K2.

Lemma record_pred_sub_aux : forall E a A T2 T3,

  dependent induction Hs.
  - (* top *) exact I.
  - (* refl_tvar *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.
  - (* trans_tvar *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.

(* Single source step simulated by the target, preserving a typed  *)
(* invariant.  [T'] is the type of the new target term, related   *)
(* to the old type [T] by subtyping.  The signature [R] may be    *)
(* extended (fresh reference allocation).                         *)
Variable fwd_step : forall e s e1 s1,
  red e s e1 s1 ->
  forall f ns R T,
    expr e -> expr f ->
    well_formed_store s -> sealcomp_store s ns -> s <s= ns ->
    sealcomp e f ->
    wf_sig empty R -> typing_store empty R ns -> typing empty R f T ->
    exists f1 ns1 R' T',
      redm f ns f1 ns1 /\
      sealcomp e1 f1 /\
      well_formed_store s1 /\ s1 <s= ns1 /\
      wf_sig empty R' /\ typing_store empty R' ns1 /\
      typing empty R' f1 T' /\ sub empty T' T /\
      expr e1 /\ expr f1.

Lemma fwd_multi : forall e s e' s', redm e s e' s' ->
  forall f ns R T,
    expr e -> expr f ->
    well_formed_store s -> sealcomp_store s ns -> s <s= ns ->
    sealcomp e f ->
    wf_sig empty R -> typing_store empty R ns -> typing empty R f T ->
    exists f' ns' R' T',
      redm f ns f' ns' /\
      sealcomp e' f' /\
      well_formed_store s' /\ s' <s= ns' /\
      wf_sig empty R' /\ typing_store empty R' ns' /\
      typing empty R' f' T' /\ expr e' /\ expr f'.
Proof.
  intros e s e' s' Hred.
  induction Hred as
    [ e0 s0 e2 s2 Heq Hseq
    | e0 s0 e2 s2 e1 s1 Hred Hrest IH ];
    intros f ns R T He Hf Hwf Hscst Hle Hsc Hsig Hstyp Hty.
  - subst. exists f, ns, R, T.
    split; [apply redm_eq; reflexivity |].
    split; [exact Hsc |].
    split; [exact Hwf |].
    split; [exact Hle |].
    split; [exact Hsig |].
    split; [exact Hstyp |].
    split; [exact Hty |].
    split; [exact He | exact Hf].
  - destruct (fwd_step e0 s0 e2 s2 Hred f ns R T He Hf Hwf Hscst Hle Hsc
                Hsig Hstyp Hty)
      as [f1 [ns1 [R1 [T1 [Hredm1 [Hsc1 [Hwf1 [Hle1 [Hsig1 [Hstyp1
                [Hty1 [Hsub1 [He1 Hf1]]]]]]]]]]]]].
    destruct (IH f1 ns1 R1 T1 He1 Hf1 Hwf1 Hle1 Hle1 Hsc1 Hsig1 Hstyp1 Hty1)
      as [f' [ns' [R' [T' [Hredm2 [Hsc2 [Hwf2 [Hle2 [Hsig2 [Hstyp2
                [Hty2 [He2 Hf2]]]]]]]]]]]].
    exists f', ns', R', T'.
    split; [apply redm_trans with (e':=f1) (s':=ns1); assumption |].
    split; [exact Hsc2 |].
    split; [exact Hwf2 |].
    split; [exact Hle2 |].
    split; [exact Hsig2 |].
    split; [exact Hstyp2 |].
    split; [exact Hty2 |].
    split; [exact He2 | exact Hf2].
Qed.

(* The final value peel: the target is a sealing of a value, so it   *)
(* reduces (by stripping the seals) to a value.                      *)
Theorem safety_value_multistep_of_fwd_step :
  forall e s e' s' f ns R T,
    sealcomp_store s ns ->
    sealcomp e f ->
    redm e s e' s' ->
    value e' ->
    typing_store empty R ns ->
    typing empty R f T ->
    exists f' ns',
      sealcomp e' f' /\ sealcomp_store s' ns' /\ value f' /\ redm f ns f' ns'.
Proof.
  intros e s e' s' f ns R T Hscst Hsc Hred Hv Hstyp Hty.
  pose proof (typing_wf_sig empty R f T Hty) as Hsig.
  pose proof (typing_expr empty R f T Hty) as Hf.
  pose proof (sealcomp_expr_down e f Hsc Hf) as He.
  pose proof (wf_store_of_sealcomp_typing s ns empty R Hstyp Hscst) as Hwf.
  destruct (fwd_multi e s e' s' Hred f ns R T He Hf Hwf Hscst Hscst Hsc
              Hsig Hstyp Hty)
    as [f1 [ns1 [R1 [T1 [Hredm [Hsc1 [Hwf1 [Hle1 [Hsig1 [Hstyp1
              [Hty1 [He1 Hf1]]]]]]]]]]]].
  pose proof (typing_store_wf_store empty R1 ns1 Hstyp1) as Hwf_ns1.
  destruct (value_seal_redm e' f1 ns1 Hv Hsc1 Hf1 Hwf_ns1)
    as [f' [Hred1 [Hv' Hsc']]].
  exists f', ns1.
  split; [exact Hsc' |].
  split; [exact Hle1 |].
  split; [exact Hv' |].
  apply redm_trans with (e':=f1) (s':=ns1); assumption.
Qed.

  | typ_mut M T => typ_mut M (open_tt_rec K U T)
  | typ_int T1 T2 => typ_int (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)

Definition open_ee e1 e2 := open_ee_rec 0 e2 e1.

Inductive type : typ -> Prop :=
  | type_top :
      type typ_top
  | type_var : forall X,
      type (typ_fvar X)
  | type_arrow : forall T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      type T2 ->
      type (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | type_all : forall L T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> type (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      type (typ_all T1 T2)
  | type_box : forall T,
      type T ->
      type (typ_box T)
  | type_readonly : forall T,
      type T ->
      type (typ_mut mut_readonly T)
  | type_intersect : forall T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      type T2 ->
      type (typ_int T1 T2)
  | type_record : forall a T1,
      type T1 ->
      type (typ_record a T1)
.

Inductive expr : exp -> Prop :=
  | expr_var : forall x,
      expr (exp_fvar x)
  | expr_abs : forall L T e1,
      type T ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e1 x)) ->
      expr (exp_abs T e1)
  | expr_app : forall e1 e2,
      expr e1 ->
      expr e2 ->
      expr (exp_app e1 e2)
  | expr_tabs : forall L T e1,
      type T ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> expr (open_te e1 X)) ->
      expr (exp_tabs T e1)
  | expr_tapp : forall e1 V,
      expr e1 ->
      type V ->
      expr (exp_tapp e1 V)
  | expr_let : forall L e1 e2,
      expr e1 ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e2 x)) ->
      expr (exp_let e1 e2)
  | expr_box : forall e,
      expr e ->
      expr (exp_box e)
  | expr_unbox : forall e,
      expr e ->
      expr (exp_unbox e)
  | expr_set_box : forall e1 e2,
      expr e1 ->
      expr e2 ->
      expr (exp_set_box e1 e2)
  | expr_ref : forall l,
      expr (exp_ref l)
  | expr_seal : forall e,
      expr e ->
      expr (exp_seal e)
  | expr_record : forall r,
      record_comp r ->
      expr (exp_record r)
  | expr_record_read : forall e a,
      expr e ->
      expr (exp_record_read e a)
  | expr_record_write : forall e1 a e2,
      expr e1 ->
      expr e2 ->
      expr (exp_record_write e1 a e2)
with record_comp : rec_comp -> Prop :=
  | record_comp_empty :
      record_comp (rec_empty)
  | record_comp_exp : forall a e r,
      expr e ->
      record_comp r ->
      record_comp (rec_exp a e r)
  | record_comp_ref : forall a e r,
      record_comp r ->
      record_comp (rec_ref a e r)
.

Definition body_e (e : exp) :=
  exists L, forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e x).

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : typ -> binding
  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Inductive signature : Set :=
  | bind_sig : typ -> signature.

Notation env := (list (atom * binding)).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Notation sig := (list (label * signature)).

Notation sempty := (@nil (label * signature)).

Inductive wf_typ : env -> typ -> Prop :=
  | wf_typ_top : forall E,
      wf_typ E typ_top
  | wf_typ_var : forall U E (X : atom),
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      wf_typ E (typ_fvar X)
  | wf_typ_arrow : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
      wf_typ E T2 ->
      wf_typ E (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | wf_typ_all : forall L E T1 T2,
      wf_typ E T1 ->
Inductive sub : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | sub_top : forall E S,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E S ->
      sub E S typ_top
  | sub_refl_tvar : forall E X,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E (typ_fvar X) ->
      sub E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
  | sub_trans_tvar : forall U E T X,
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      sub E U T ->
      sub E (typ_fvar X) T
  | sub_arrow : forall E S1 S2 T1 T2,
      sub E T1 S1 ->

  | sub_all : forall L E S1 S2 T1 T2,

  | sub_trans : forall E T1 T2 T3,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T2 T3 ->
      sub E T1 T3
  | sub_inter_left : forall E T1 T2,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E T1 ->

  | sub_inter_right : forall E T1 T2,

  | sub_inter : forall E T1 T2 T3,

  | sub_record : forall E a T1 T2,

  | sub_readonly_record : forall E a T1 T2,

  | sub_denormalize : forall E T1 T2,

      sub E T1 T2
.

Notation "E |-s S <: T" := (sub E S T) (at level 70).

Fixpoint record_dom (r : rec_comp)  {struct r} : atoms :=
    match r with
    | rec_empty => {}
    | rec_exp a e r => {{ a }} `union` record_dom r
    | rec_ref a l r => {{ a }} `union` record_dom r

Inductive typing : env -> sig -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
  | typing_var : forall E R x T,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_sig E R ->
      binds x (bind_typ T) E ->

Inductive rmode : Set := rfull | rforward.

Fixpoint record_pred_m (M : rmode) (E : env) (a : atom) (A T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_record b C =>
      if (a === b) then
        match M with
        | rfull => sub E A C /\ sub E C A
        | rforward => sub E A C
        end
      else False
  | typ_int U W => record_pred_m M E a A U /\ record_pred_m M E a A W
  | typ_mut _ U => record_pred_m rforward E a A U
  | _ => False
  end.

Lemma record_pred_fwd_merge : forall E a A U N,
  record_pred_m rforward E a A (merge_mutability U N) <->
  record_pred_m rforward E a A U.
Proof.
  intros E a A U. induction U; intros N; simpl; try reflexivity.
  all: try (split; intro Hh; exact Hh).
  - (* int *) rewrite IHU1, IHU2. tauto.
Qed.

Lemma record_pred_full_merge : forall E a A U N,
  record_pred_m rfull E a A (merge_mutability U N) <->
  record_pred_m rforward E a A U.
Proof.
  intros E a A U. induction U; intros N; simpl; try reflexivity.
  all: try (split; intro Hh; exact Hh).
  - (* int *) rewrite IHU1, IHU2. tauto.
Qed.

Lemma record_pred_fwd_nf_params : forall E a A U,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E A ->
  (record_pred_m rforward E a (normal_form_typing A) U <->
   record_pred_m rforward E a A U).
Proof.
  intros E a A U Hwe Hwa.
  induction U; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - (* mut *) apply IHU.
  - (* int *) rewrite IHU1, IHU2. tauto.
  - (* record *) destruct (a === a0) eqn:Eab; [| reflexivity].
    pose proof (sub_normal_form_typing_right E A Hwe Hwa) as HnfR.
    pose proof (sub_normal_form_typing_left E A Hwe Hwa) as HnfL.
    split; intros H1.
    + exact (sub_trans E A (normal_form_typing A) U HnfR H1).
    + exact (sub_trans E (normal_form_typing A) A U HnfL H1).
Qed.

Lemma record_pred_fwd_nf : forall E a A T,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T ->
  (record_pred_m rforward E a A T <->
   record_pred_m rforward E a A (normal_form_typing T)).
Proof.
  intros E a A T. revert T.
  fix IH 1. intros T Hwe Hwt.
  destruct T as [|n|X|T1 T2|T1 T2|T1|M T1|T1 T2|b T1]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - (* mut *) rewrite record_pred_fwd_merge. destruct M. apply (IH T1 Hwe (wf_typ_readonly_inv _ _ Hwt)).
  - (* int *) split; intros [H1 H2]; split.
    + apply (proj1 (IH T1 Hwe (wf_typ_int_l _ _ _ Hwt))) in H1. exact H1.
    + apply (proj1 (IH T2 Hwe (wf_typ_int_r _ _ _ Hwt))) in H2. exact H2.
    + apply (proj2 (IH T1 Hwe (wf_typ_int_l _ _ _ Hwt))). exact H1.
    + apply (proj2 (IH T2 Hwe (wf_typ_int_r _ _ _ Hwt))). exact H2.
  - (* record *) destruct (a === b) eqn:Eab; [| reflexivity].
    pose proof (wf_typ_record_inv E b T1 Hwt) as Hwt1.
    pose proof (sub_normal_form_typing_right E T1 Hwe Hwt1) as HnfR.
    pose proof (sub_normal_form_typing_left E T1 Hwe Hwt1) as HnfL.
    split; intros H1.
    + exact (sub_trans E A T1 (normal_form_typing T1) H1 HnfR).
    + exact (sub_trans E A (normal_form_typing T1) T1 H1 HnfL).
Qed.

Lemma record_pred_full_nf_params : forall E a A U,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E A ->
  (record_pred_m rfull E a (normal_form_typing A) U <->
   record_pred_m rfull E a A U).
Proof.
  intros E a A U Hwe Hwa.
  induction U; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - (* mut *) apply record_pred_fwd_nf_params; assumption.
  - (* int *) rewrite IHU1, IHU2. tauto.
  - (* record *) destruct (a === a0) eqn:Eab; [| reflexivity].
    split; intros [H1 H2]; split.
    + eapply sub_trans; [apply sub_normal_form_typing_right; [exact Hwe | exact Hwa] | exact H1].
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact H2 | apply sub_normal_form_typing_left; [exact Hwe | exact Hwa]].
    + eapply sub_trans; [apply sub_normal_form_typing_left; [exact Hwe | exact Hwa] | exact H1].
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact H2 | apply sub_normal_form_typing_right; [exact Hwe | exact Hwa]].
Qed.

Lemma record_pred_full_nf : forall E a A T,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T ->
  (record_pred_m rfull E a A T <->
   record_pred_m rfull E a A (normal_form_typing T)).
Proof.
  intros E a A T. revert T.
  fix IH 1. intros T Hwe Hwt.
  destruct T as [|n|X|T1 T2|T1 T2|T1|M T1|T1 T2|b T1]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - (* mut *) rewrite record_pred_full_merge.
    destruct M. apply (record_pred_fwd_nf E a A T1 Hwe (wf_typ_readonly_inv _ _ Hwt)).
  - (* int *) split; intros [H1 H2]; split.
    + apply (proj1 (IH T1 Hwe (wf_typ_int_l _ _ _ Hwt))) in H1. exact H1.
    + apply (proj1 (IH T2 Hwe (wf_typ_int_r _ _ _ Hwt))) in H2. exact H2.
    + apply (proj2 (IH T1 Hwe (wf_typ_int_l _ _ _ Hwt))). exact H1.
    + apply (proj2 (IH T2 Hwe (wf_typ_int_r _ _ _ Hwt))). exact H2.
  - (* record *) destruct (a === b) eqn:Eab; [| reflexivity].
    pose proof (wf_typ_record_inv E b T1 Hwt) as Hwt1.
    split; intros [H1 H2]; split.
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact H1 | apply sub_normal_form_typing_right; [exact Hwe | exact Hwt1]].
    + eapply sub_trans; [apply sub_normal_form_typing_left; [exact Hwe | exact Hwt1] | exact H2].
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact H1 | apply sub_normal_form_typing_left; [exact Hwe | exact Hwt1]].
    + eapply sub_trans; [apply sub_normal_form_typing_right; [exact Hwe | exact Hwt1] | exact H2].
Qed.

Lemma record_pred_fwd_sub_aux : forall E a A T2 T3,
  record_pred_m rforward E a A T2 -> sub E T2 T3 ->
  record_pred_m rforward E a A T3.
Proof.
  intros E a A T2 T3 Hp Hs.
  pose proof (sub_wf_env E T2 T3 Hs) as Hwe.
  dependent induction Hs.
  - (* top *) exact I.
  - (* refl_tvar *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.
  - (* trans_tvar *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.
  - (* arrow *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.
  - (* all *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.
  - (* box *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.
  - (* readonly *) simpl in Hp. simpl.
    apply IHHs; [exact Hp | exact Hwe].
  - (* readonly_mutable *) simpl in Hp. simpl.
    apply IHHs; [exact Hp | exact Hwe].
  - (* trans *) simpl. apply IHHs2; [apply IHHs1; [exact Hp | exact Hwe] | exact Hwe].
  - (* inter_left *) simpl in Hp. destruct Hp as [Hp _]. exact Hp.
  - (* inter_right *) simpl in Hp. destruct Hp as [_ Hp]. exact Hp.
  - (* inter *) simpl. split.
    + apply IHHs1; [exact Hp | exact Hwe].
    + apply IHHs2; [exact Hp | exact Hwe].
  - (* record *) simpl in Hp. simpl.
    destruct (a === a0) eqn:Eab.
    + exact (sub_trans E A T1 T2 Hp Hs1).
    + exact Hp.
  - (* readonly_record *) simpl in Hp. simpl.
    destruct (a === a0) eqn:Eab.
    + exact (sub_trans E A T1 T2 Hp Hs).
    + exact Hp.
  - (* denormalize *) simpl in *.
    pose proof (proj1 (record_pred_fwd_nf E a A T1 Hwe H) Hp) as Hpn.
    pose proof (IHHs Hpn Hwe) as Hqn.
    exact (proj2 (record_pred_fwd_nf E a A T2 Hwe H0) Hqn).
Qed.

Lemma record_pred_full_to_fwd : forall E a A T,
  record_pred_m rfull E a A T -> record_pred_m rforward E a A T.
Proof.
  intros E a A T. induction T; simpl; intros H.
  - exact I.
  - exact H.
  - exact H.
  - exact H.
  - exact H.
  - exact H.
  - (* mut *) exact H.
  - (* int *) destruct H as [H1 H2]. split; [apply IHT1 | apply IHT2]; assumption.
  - (* record *) destruct (a === a0) eqn:Eab.
    + destruct H as [H1 H2]. exact H1.
    + exact H.
Qed.

Lemma record_pred_full_sub_fwd_aux : forall E a A T2 T3,
  record_pred_m rfull E a A T2 -> sub E T2 T3 ->
  record_pred_m rforward E a A T3.
Proof.
  intros E a A T2 T3 Hp Hs.
  pose proof (sub_wf_env E T2 T3 Hs) as Hwe.
  dependent induction Hs.
  - (* top *) exact I.
  - (* refl_tvar *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.
  - (* trans_tvar *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.
  - (* arrow *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.
  - (* all *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.
  - (* box *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.
  - (* readonly *) simpl in Hp. simpl.
    apply record_pred_fwd_sub_aux with (T2:=T1); [exact Hp | exact Hs].
  - (* readonly_mutable *) simpl in Hp. simpl.
    apply IHHs; [exact Hp | exact Hwe].
  - (* trans *) simpl.
    pose proof (IHHs1 Hp Hwe) as Hmid.
    apply record_pred_fwd_sub_aux with (T2:=T2); [exact Hmid | exact Hs2].
  - (* inter_left *) simpl in Hp. destruct Hp as [Hp _]. apply record_pred_full_to_fwd. exact Hp.
  - (* inter_right *) simpl in Hp. destruct Hp as [_ Hp]. apply record_pred_full_to_fwd. exact Hp.
  - (* inter *) simpl. split.
    + apply IHHs1; [exact Hp | exact Hwe].
    + apply IHHs2; [exact Hp | exact Hwe].
  - (* record *) simpl in Hp. simpl.
    destruct (a === a0) eqn:Eab.
    + destruct Hp as [Hpa Hpb]. exact (sub_trans E A T1 T2 Hpa Hs1).
    + exact Hp.
  - (* readonly_record *) simpl in Hp. simpl.
    destruct (a === a0) eqn:Eab.
    + exact (sub_trans E A T1 T2 Hp Hs).
    + exact Hp.
  - (* denormalize *) simpl in *.
    pose proof (proj1 (record_pred_full_nf E a A T1 Hwe H) Hp) as Hpn.
    pose proof (IHHs Hpn Hwe) as Hqn.
    exact (proj2 (record_pred_fwd_nf E a A T2 Hwe H0) Hqn).
Qed.

Lemma record_pred_full_sub_full_aux : forall E a A T2 T3,
  record_pred_m rfull E a A T2 -> sub E T2 T3 ->
  record_pred_m rfull E a A T3.
Proof.
  intros E a A T2 T3 Hp Hs.
  pose proof (sub_wf_env E T2 T3 Hs) as Hwe.
  dependent induction Hs.
  - (* top *) exact I.
  - (* refl_tvar *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.
  - (* trans_tvar *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.
  - (* arrow *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.
  - (* all *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.
  - (* box *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.
  - (* readonly *) simpl in Hp. simpl.
    apply record_pred_fwd_sub_aux with (T2:=T1); [exact Hp | exact Hs].
  - (* readonly_mutable *) simpl in Hp. simpl.
    apply record_pred_full_sub_fwd_aux with (T2:=T1); [exact Hp | exact Hs].
  - (* trans *) simpl.
    apply IHHs2; [apply IHHs1; [exact Hp | exact Hwe] | exact Hwe].
  - (* inter_left *) simpl in Hp. destruct Hp as [Hp _]. exact Hp.
  - (* inter_right *) simpl in Hp. destruct Hp as [_ Hp]. exact Hp.
  - (* inter *) simpl. split.
    + apply IHHs1; [exact Hp | exact Hwe].
    + apply IHHs2; [exact Hp | exact Hwe].
  - (* record *) simpl in Hp. simpl.
    destruct (a === a0) eqn:Eab.
    + destruct Hp as [Hpa Hpb]. split.
      * exact (sub_trans E A T1 T2 Hpa Hs1).
      * exact (sub_trans E T2 T1 A Hs2 Hpb).
    + exact Hp.
  - (* readonly_record *) simpl in Hp. simpl.
    destruct (a === a0) eqn:Eab.
    + exact (sub_trans E A T1 T2 Hp Hs).
    + exact Hp.
  - (* denormalize *) simpl in *.
    pose proof (proj1 (record_pred_full_nf E a A T1 Hwe H) Hp) as Hpn.
    pose proof (IHHs Hpn Hwe) as Hqn.
    exact (proj2 (record_pred_full_nf E a A T2 Hwe H0) Hqn).
Qed.

Lemma record_pred_full_sub : forall E a A T,
  sub E (typ_record a A) T -> record_pred_m rfull E a A T.
Proof.
  intros E a A T H.
  dependent induction H.
  - (* top *) exact I.
  - (* readonly_mutable *) simpl.
    apply record_pred_full_to_fwd.
    apply (IHsub a A eq_refl).
  - (* trans *) simpl.
    apply record_pred_full_sub_full_aux with (T2:=T2).
    + apply (IHsub1 a A eq_refl).
    + exact H0.
  - (* inter *) simpl. split.
    + apply (IHsub1 a A eq_refl).
    + apply (IHsub2 a A eq_refl).
  - (* record *) simpl. rewrite (eq_dec_refl a). simpl. split; assumption.
  - (* denormalize *) simpl in H1.
    pose proof (IHsub a (normal_form_typing A) eq_refl) as Hpred.
    pose proof (sub_wf_env E _ _ H1) as Hwe.
    pose proof (wf_typ_record_inv E a A H) as Hwa.
    apply (proj1 (record_pred_full_nf_params E a A (normal_form_typing T2) Hwe Hwa)) in Hpred.
    exact (proj2 (record_pred_full_nf E a A T2 Hwe H0) Hpred).
Qed.

Lemma sub_record_inv_l : forall E a A B,
  sub E (typ_record a A) (typ_record a B) -> sub E A B.
Proof.
  intros E a A B H.
  pose proof (record_pred_full_sub E a A (typ_record a B) H) as Hp.
  simpl in Hp. rewrite (eq_dec_refl a) in Hp. simpl in Hp.
  exact (proj1 Hp).
Qed.

Lemma sub_record_inv_r : forall E a A B,
  sub E (typ_record a A) (typ_record a B) -> sub E B A.
Proof.
  intros E a A B H.
  pose proof (record_pred_full_sub E a A (typ_record a B) H) as Hp.
  simpl in Hp. rewrite (eq_dec_refl a) in Hp. simpl in Hp.
  exact (proj2 Hp).
Qed.

  wf_typ (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E0) T.

  expr f -> expr e -> well_formed_store s -> s <s= ns -> sealcomp e f ->
  exists e' s', redm e s e' s' /\ s' <s= ns' /\ sealcomp e' f' /\
  well_formed_store s' /\ expr f' /\ expr e'.
Proof.
  intros f ns f' ns' H. induction H as
    [ f0 s0 f1 s1 Heq Hseq | f0 s0 f2 s2 f1 s1 Hred Hredm IHredm ]; intros e s Hf He Hwf Hst Hsc.

    + split; [exact Hst | split; [exact Hsc | split; [exact Hwf | split; [exact Hf | exact He]]]].

574	  { rewrite <- (record_lookup_ref_sealcomp a r r1 Hrc). exact Hlook. }
575	  pose proof (value_record_comp_sealcomp_up r r1 Hrc Hvrc) as Hvrc1.
576	  pose proof (Hwf l v Hmap) as Hval.
577	  destruct (value_seal_redm e2 g2 ns Hv2 Hsc2 Hexpr2 Hwf)
578	    as [g2' [Hred [Hval' Hsc']]].
579	  exists v, (LabelMapImpl.add l g2' ns).
580	  eapply redm_trans with (e':=exp_record_write (exp_record r1) a g2') (s':=ns).
581	  - eapply redm_record_write_2; [apply value_record; exact Hvrc1 | exact Hred].
582	  - eapply redm_step with (e'':=v) (s'':=LabelMapImpl.add l g2' ns).
583	    + eapply red_record_write_ref; eauto.
584	    + apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
585	Qed.

588	(* Unboxing a (possibly multiply sealed) reference: the extra   *)
589	(* seals never block the step; they are just peeled first.      *)
590	(* The result is the target-side spelling of the source result. *)

593	Lemma unbox_ref_reduces :
594	  forall ns l j w w',
595	    well_formed_store ns ->
596	    LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l w' ns ->
597	    sealcomp w w' ->
598	    exists f', redm (exp_unbox (seal_pow j (exp_ref l))) ns f' ns /\
599	      sealcomp (seal_pow (min1 j) w) f'.
600	Proof.
601	  intros ns l j w w' Hwf Hmap Hsc.
602	  pose proof (Hwf l w' Hmap) as Hval'.
603	  destruct j as [|j'].
604	  - simpl. exists w'. split.
605	    + eapply redm_step with (e'':=w') (s'':=ns).
606	      * eapply red_unbox_ref; assumption.
607	      * apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
608	    + exact Hsc.
609	  - exists (exp_seal w'). split.
610	    + eapply redm_trans with (e':=exp_unbox (seal_pow (min1 (S j')) (exp_ref l))) (s':=ns).
611	      * eapply redm_unbox_1. apply ref_strip; exact Hwf.
612	      * change (redm (exp_unbox (exp_seal (exp_ref l))) ns (exp_seal w') ns).
613	        eapply redm_step with (e'':=exp_seal w') (s'':=ns).
614	        -- eapply red_unbox_sealed_ref; assumption.
615	        -- apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
616	    + apply sealcomp_seal. exact Hsc.
617	Qed.

692	Lemma typing_root_strip : forall E R k f0 T,
693	  typing E R (seal_pow k f0) T -> wf_sig E R ->
694	  exists T0, typing E R f0 T0 /\ sub E (ro_pow k T0) T.
695	Proof.
696	  intros E R k. induction k as [|k IH]; simpl; intros f0 T Hty Hsig.
697	  - exists T. split; [exact Hty |].
698	    apply sub_refl_wf.
699	    + exact (wf_sig_wf_env E R Hsig).
700	    + eapply typing_wf_typ; eassumption.
701	  - destruct (typing_seal_inv E R (seal_pow k f0) T Hty) as [S [Hinner [Heq | Hsub]]].
702	    + subst T.
703	      destruct (IH f0 S Hinner Hsig) as [T0 [Hf0 Hsub0]].
704	      exists T0. split; [exact Hf0 |].
705	      eapply sub_trans.
706	      * apply sub_readonly. exact Hsub0.
707	      * apply sub_refl_wf.
708	        -- exact (wf_sig_wf_env E R Hsig).
709	        -- apply wf_typ_readonly. eapply typing_wf_typ; eassumption.
710	    + destruct (IH f0 S Hinner Hsig) as [T0 [Hf0 Hsub0]].
711	      exists T0. split; [exact Hf0 |].
712	      eapply sub_trans.
713	      * apply sub_readonly. exact Hsub0.
714	      * exact Hsub.
715	Qed.

721	Lemma value_seal_redm_typed : forall E R v g T ns,
722	  value v -> sealcomp v g -> typing E R g T -> wf_sig E R ->
723	  well_formed_store ns ->
724	  exists g', redm g ns g' ns /\ value g' /\ sealcomp v g' /\ typing E R g' T.
725	Proof.
726	  intros E R v g T ns Hv Hsc Hty Hsig Hwf.
727	  pose proof (wf_sig_wf_env E R Hsig) as Hwe.
728	  destruct Hv as [T0 body Hexpr_body | T0 body Hexpr_body | l | l | r Hvrc | r Hvrc].
729	  - (* abs *)
730	    destruct (abs_shape T0 body g Hsc) as [k [f1 [Heq Hsc1]]]. subst g.
731	    destruct (typing_root_strip E R k (exp_abs T0 f1) T Hty Hsig) as [T1 [Hcore Hsub]].
732	    exists (exp_abs T0 f1). split; [| split; [| split]].
733	    + apply abs_strip; [exact Hwf | eapply typing_expr; eassumption].
734	    + apply value_abs. eapply typing_expr; eassumption.
735	    + apply sealcomp_abs; exact Hsc1.
736	    + eapply typing_sub; [exact Hsig | exact Hcore |].
737	      eapply sub_trans.
738	      * apply sub_ro_pow_self; [exact Hwe |].
739	        eapply typing_wf_typ; eassumption.
740	      * exact Hsub.
741	  - (* tabs *)
742	    destruct (tabs_shape T0 body g Hsc) as [k [f1 [Heq Hsc1]]]. subst g.
743	    destruct (typing_root_strip E R k (exp_tabs T0 f1) T Hty Hsig) as [T1 [Hcore Hsub]].
744	    exists (exp_tabs T0 f1). split; [| split; [| split]].
745	    + apply tabs_strip; [exact Hwf | eapply typing_expr; eassumption].
746	    + apply value_tabs. eapply typing_expr; eassumption.
747	    + apply sealcomp_tabs; exact Hsc1.
748	    + eapply typing_sub; [exact Hsig | exact Hcore |].
749	      eapply sub_trans.
750	      * apply sub_ro_pow_self; [exact Hwe |].
751	        eapply typing_wf_typ; eassumption.
752	      * exact Hsub.
753	  - (* ref *)
754	    destruct (ref_shape l g Hsc) as [k Heq]. subst g.
755	    destruct (typing_root_strip E R k (exp_ref l) T Hty Hsig) as [T1 [Hcore Hsub]].
756	    exists (seal_pow (min1 k) (exp_ref l)). split; [| split; [| split]].
757	    + apply ref_strip; exact Hwf.
758	    + destruct k as [|k']; simpl. apply value_ref. apply value_sealed_ref.
759	    + apply sealcomp_pow_right with (k:=min1 k). apply sealcomp_refl.
760	    + destruct k as [|k'].
761	      * simpl in Hsub. eapply typing_sub; [exact Hsig | exact Hcore | exact Hsub].
762	      * simpl. eapply typing_sub.
763	        -- exact Hsig.
764	        -- eapply typing_seal. exact Hcore.
765	        -- eapply sub_trans.
766	           ++ apply sub_readonly. apply sub_ro_pow_self; [exact Hwe |].
767	              eapply typing_wf_typ; eassumption.
768	           ++ simpl in Hsub. exact Hsub.
769	  - (* sealed ref *)
770	    destruct (seal_lhs_shape (exp_ref l) g Hsc) as [k [f0 [Heq Hsc0]]]. subst g.
771	    destruct (ref_shape l f0 Hsc0) as [k0 Heq0]. subst f0.
772	    rewrite <- (seal_pow_add (S k) k0 (exp_ref l)) in Hty.
773	    destruct (typing_root_strip E R (S k + k0) (exp_ref l) T Hty Hsig)
774	      as [T1 [Hcore Hsub]].
775	    exists (exp_seal (exp_ref l)). split; [| split; [| split]].
776	    + rewrite <- (seal_pow_add (S k) k0 (exp_ref l)). apply ref_strip; exact Hwf.
777	    + apply value_sealed_ref.
778	    + apply sealcomp_refl.
779	    + simpl. eapply typing_sub.
780	      * exact Hsig.
781	      * eapply typing_seal. exact Hcore.
782	      * eapply sub_trans.
783	        -- apply sub_readonly. apply sub_ro_pow_self; [exact Hwe |].
784	           eapply typing_wf_typ; eassumption.
785	        -- simpl in Hsub. exact Hsub.
786	  - (* record *)
787	    destruct (record_shape r g Hsc) as [k [r1 [Heq Hsc1]]]. subst g.
788	    destruct (typing_root_strip E R k (exp_record r1) T Hty Hsig) as [T1 [Hcore Hsub]].
789	    pose proof (value_record_comp_sealcomp_up r r1 Hsc1 Hvrc) as Hvrc1.
790	    exists (seal_pow (min1 k) (exp_record r1)). split; [| split; [| split]].
791	    + apply record_strip; [exact Hwf | exact Hvrc1].
792	    + destruct k as [|k']; simpl. apply value_record; exact Hvrc1.
793	      apply value_sealed_record; exact Hvrc1.
794	    + apply sealcomp_pow_right with (k:=min1 k). apply sealcomp_record; exact Hsc1.
795	    + destruct k as [|k'].
796	      * simpl in Hsub. eapply typing_sub; [exact Hsig | exact Hcore | exact Hsub].
797	      * simpl. eapply typing_sub.
798	        -- exact Hsig.
799	        -- eapply typing_seal. exact Hcore.
800	        -- eapply sub_trans.
801	           ++ apply sub_readonly. apply sub_ro_pow_self; [exact Hwe |].
802	              eapply typing_wf_typ; eassumption.
803	           ++ simpl in Hsub. exact Hsub.
804	  - (* sealed record *)
805	    destruct (seal_lhs_shape (exp_record r) g Hsc) as [k [f0 [Heq Hsc0]]]. subst g.
806	    destruct (record_shape r f0 Hsc0) as [k0 [r1 [Heq0 Hsc1]]]. subst f0.
807	    rewrite <- (seal_pow_add (S k) k0 (exp_record r1)) in Hty.
808	    destruct (typing_root_strip E R (S k + k0) (exp_record r1) T Hty Hsig)
809	      as [T1 [Hcore Hsub]].
810	    pose proof (value_record_comp_sealcomp_up r r1 Hsc1 Hvrc) as Hvrc1.
811	    exists (exp_seal (exp_record r1)). split; [| split; [| split]].
812	    + rewrite <- (seal_pow_add (S k) k0 (exp_record r1)). apply record_strip; assumption.
813	    + apply value_sealed_record; exact Hvrc1.
814	    + apply sealcomp_seal. apply sealcomp_record; exact Hsc1.
815	    + simpl. eapply typing_sub.
816	      * exact Hsig.
817	      * eapply typing_seal. exact Hcore.
818	      * eapply sub_trans.
819	        -- apply sub_readonly. apply sub_ro_pow_self; [exact Hwe |].
820	           eapply typing_wf_typ; eassumption.
821	        -- simpl in Hsub. exact Hsub.
822	Qed.

825	(* Forward simulation architecture.                             *)
826	(*                                                              *)
827	(* The whole theorem reduces to [fwd_step] below.  The assembly *)
828	(* is verified; [fwd_step] is the single remaining obligation.  *)
829	(* ============================================================ *)
830	
831	Section ForwardAssembly.
832	
833	(* Single source step simulated by the target, preserving a typed  *)
834	(* invariant.  [T'] is the type of the new target term, related   *)
835	(* to the old type [T] by subtyping.  The signature [R] may be    *)
836	(* extended (fresh reference allocation).                         *)
837	Variable fwd_step : forall e s e1 s1,
838	  red e s e1 s1 ->
839	  forall f ns R T,
840	    expr e -> expr f ->
841	    well_formed_store s -> sealcomp_store s ns -> s <s= ns ->
842	    sealcomp e f ->
843	    wf_sig empty R -> typing_store empty R ns -> typing empty R f T ->
844	    exists f1 ns1 R' T',
845	      redm f ns f1 ns1 /\
846	      sealcomp e1 f1 /\
847	      well_formed_store s1 /\ s1 <s= ns1 /\
848	      wf_sig empty R' /\ typing_store empty R' ns1 /\
849	      typing empty R' f1 T' /\ sub empty T' T /\
850	      expr e1 /\ expr f1.
851	
852	Lemma fwd_multi : forall e s e' s', redm e s e' s' ->
853	  forall f ns R T,
854	    expr e -> expr f ->
855	    well_formed_store s -> sealcomp_store s ns -> s <s= ns ->
856	    sealcomp e f ->
857	    wf_sig empty R -> typing_store empty R ns -> typing empty R f T ->
858	    exists f' ns' R' T',
859	      redm f ns f' ns' /\
860	      sealcomp e' f' /\
861	      well_formed_store s' /\ s' <s= ns' /\
862	      wf_sig empty R' /\ typing_store empty R' ns' /\
863	      typing empty R' f' T' /\ expr e' /\ expr f'.
864	Proof.
865	  intros e s e' s' Hred.
866	  induction Hred as
867	    [ e0 s0 e2 s2 Heq Hseq
868	    | e0 s0 e2 s2 e1 s1 Hred Hrest IH ];
869	    intros f ns R T He Hf Hwf Hscst Hle Hsc Hsig Hstyp Hty.
870	  - subst. exists f, ns, R, T.
871	    split; [apply redm_eq; reflexivity |].
872	    split; [exact Hsc |].
873	    split; [exact Hwf |].
874	    split; [exact Hle |].
875	    split; [exact Hsig |].
876	    split; [exact Hstyp |].
877	    split; [exact Hty |].
878	    split; [exact He | exact Hf].
879	  - destruct (fwd_step e0 s0 e2 s2 Hred f ns R T He Hf Hwf Hscst Hle Hsc
880	                Hsig Hstyp Hty)
881	      as [f1 [ns1 [R1 [T1 [Hredm1 [Hsc1 [Hwf1 [Hle1 [Hsig1 [Hstyp1
882	                [Hty1 [Hsub1 [He1 Hf1]]]]]]]]]]]]].
883	    destruct (IH f1 ns1 R1 T1 He1 Hf1 Hwf1 Hle1 Hle1 Hsc1 Hsig1 Hstyp1 Hty1)
884	      as [f' [ns' [R' [T' [Hredm2 [Hsc2 [Hwf2 [Hle2 [Hsig2 [Hstyp2
885	                [Hty2 [He2 Hf2]]]]]]]]]]]].
886	    exists f', ns', R', T'.
887	    split; [apply redm_trans with (e':=f1) (s':=ns1); assumption |].
888	    split; [exact Hsc2 |].
889	    split; [exact Hwf2 |].
890	    split; [exact Hle2 |].
891	    split; [exact Hsig2 |].
892	    split; [exact Hstyp2 |].
893	    split; [exact Hty2 |].
894	    split; [exact He2 | exact Hf2].
895	Qed.

897	(* The final value peel: the target is a sealing of a value, so it   *)
898	(* reduces (by stripping the seals) to a value.                      *)
899	Theorem safety_value_multistep_of_fwd_step :
900	  forall e s e' s' f ns R T,
901	    sealcomp_store s ns ->
902	    sealcomp e f ->
903	    redm e s e' s' ->
904	    value e' ->
905	    typing_store empty R ns ->
906	    typing empty R f T ->
907	    exists f' ns',
908	      sealcomp e' f' /\ sealcomp_store s' ns' /\ value f' /\ redm f ns f' ns'.
909	Proof.
910	  intros e s e' s' f ns R T Hscst Hsc Hred Hv Hstyp Hty.
911	  pose proof (typing_wf_sig empty R f T Hty) as Hsig.
912	  pose proof (typing_expr empty R f T Hty) as Hf.
913	  pose proof (sealcomp_expr_down e f Hsc Hf) as He.
914	  pose proof (wf_store_of_sealcomp_typing s ns empty R Hstyp Hscst) as Hwf.
915	  destruct (fwd_multi e s e' s' Hred f ns R T He Hf Hwf Hscst Hscst Hsc
916	              Hsig Hstyp Hty)
917	    as [f1 [ns1 [R1 [T1 [Hredm [Hsc1 [Hwf1 [Hle1 [Hsig1 [Hstyp1
918	              [Hty1 [He1 Hf1]]]]]]]]]]]].
919	  pose proof (typing_store_wf_store empty R1 ns1 Hstyp1) as Hwf_ns1.
920	  destruct (value_seal_redm e' f1 ns1 Hv Hsc1 Hf1 Hwf_ns1)
921	    as [f' [Hred1 [Hv' Hsc']]].
922	  exists f', ns1.
923	  split; [exact Hsc' |].
924	  split; [exact Hle1 |].
925	  split; [exact Hv' |].
926	  apply redm_trans with (e':=f1) (s':=ns1); assumption.
927	Qed.

933	Fixpoint app_shape (e1' e2' : exp) (f : exp) (H : sealcomp (exp_app e1' e2') f) {struct f} :
934	  exists k f1 f2, f = seal_pow k (exp_app f1 f2) /\ sealcomp e1' f1 /\ sealcomp e2' f2.
935	Proof.
936	  destruct_f f; try (inversion H).
937	  destruct (sealcomp_app_inv _ _ _ H) as [ea1 [ea2 [Heq [Hsc1 Hsc2]]]].
938	  injection Heq as Heq1 Heq2. subst. exists 0, f1, f2. split; [reflexivity | split; assumption].
939	  destruct (sealcomp_seal_inv _ _ H) as [[e0 [Heq Hsc]] | Hsc].
940	  - inversion Heq.
941	  - destruct (app_shape e1' e2' f1 Hsc) as [k [f0 [f2 [Heq [Hs1 Hs2]]]]]. subst.
942	    exists (S k), f0, f2. split; [reflexivity | split; assumption].

951	  destruct (sealcomp_seal_inv _ _ H) as [[e0 [Heq Hsc]] | Hsc].
952	  - inversion Heq.
953	  - destruct (tapp_shape e1' T f1 Hsc) as [k [f0 [Heq Hsc2]]]. subst.

958	  exists k f1 f2, f = seal_pow k (exp_let f1 f2) /\ sealcomp e1' f1 /\ sealcomp e2' f2.
959	Proof.

961	  destruct (sealcomp_let_inv _ _ _ H) as [ea1 [ea2 [Heq [Hsc1 Hsc2]]]].
962	  injection Heq as Heq1 Heq2. subst. exists 0, f1, f2. split; [reflexivity | split; assumption].
963	  destruct (sealcomp_seal_inv _ _ H) as [[e0 [Heq Hsc]] | Hsc].

974	  injection Heq as Heq1. subst. exists 0, f1. split; [reflexivity | exact Hsc].

981	Fixpoint unbox_shape (e1' : exp) (f : exp) (H : sealcomp (exp_unbox e1') f) {struct f} :
982	  exists k f1, f = seal_pow k (exp_unbox f1) /\ sealcomp e1' f1.
