Inductive typing : env -> sig -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
  | typing_var : forall E R x T,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_sig E R ->
      binds x (bind_typ T) E ->
      typing E R (exp_fvar x) T
  | typing_abs : forall L E R V e1 T1,
      wf_sig E R ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) R (open_ee e1 x) T1) ->
      typing E R (exp_abs V e1) (typ_arrow V T1)
  | typing_app : forall T1 E R e1 e2 T2,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 (typ_arrow T1 T2) ->
      typing E R e2 T1 ->
      typing E R (exp_app e1 e2) T2
  | typing_tabs : forall L E R V e1 T1,
      wf_sig E R ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        typing (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) R (open_te e1 X) (open_tt T1 X)) ->
      typing E R (exp_tabs V e1) (typ_all V T1)
  | typing_tapp : forall T1 E R e1 T T2,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 (typ_all T1 T2) ->
      sub E T T1 ->
      typing E R (exp_tapp e1 T) (open_tt T2 T)
  | typing_sub : forall S E R e T,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e S ->
      sub E S T ->
      typing E R e T
  | typing_let : forall L T1 T2 e1 e2 E R,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 T1 ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E) R (open_ee e2 x) T2) ->
      typing E R (exp_let e1 e2) T2
  | typing_box : forall E R e T,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e T ->
      typing E R (exp_box e) (typ_box T)
  | typing_unbox : forall E R e T,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e (typ_box T) ->
      typing E R (exp_unbox e) T

  | typing_set_box : forall E R e1 e2 T,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 (typ_box T) ->

      typing E R (exp_set_box e1 e2) T

From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.

Theorem safety_value_multistep : forall e s e' s' f ns R T,
  sealcomp_store s ns ->
  sealcomp e f ->
  redm e s e' s' ->
  value e' ->
  typing_store empty R ns ->
  typing empty R f T ->
  exists f' ns', sealcomp e' f' /\ sealcomp_store s' ns' /\ value f' /\ redm f ns f' ns'.

Theorem safety_value_multistep' : forall e s f ns f' ns',
  expr f ->
  expr e ->
  well_formed_store s ->
  sealcomp_store s ns ->
  sealcomp e f ->
  redm f ns f' ns' ->
  value f' ->
  (exists e' s', redm e s e' s' /\ sealcomp_store s' ns' /\ sealcomp e' f' /\ value e').
Lemma safety_value_multistep'_proof : forall e s f ns f' ns',
  expr f ->
  expr e ->
  well_formed_store s ->
  sealcomp_store s ns ->
  sealcomp e f ->
  redm f ns f' ns' ->
  value f' ->
  (exists e' s', redm e s e' s' /\ sealcomp_store s' ns' /\ sealcomp e' f' /\ value e').
Proof.
  intros e s f ns f' ns' Hf He Hwf Hst Hsc Hred Hvf.
  destruct (sim2_multi f ns f' ns' Hred e s Hf He Hwf Hst Hsc)
    as [e' [s' [Hred' [Hst' [Hsc' [Hwf' [Hf' He']]]]]]].
  exists e', s'. split; [exact Hred' | split; [exact Hst' | split; [exact Hsc' | apply value_sealcomp_down with (f:=f'); assumption]]].
Qed.

Lemma wf_sig_binds_fun : forall E R, wf_sig E R ->
  forall lb T1 T2,
    Signatures.binds lb (bind_sig T1) R ->
    Signatures.binds lb (bind_sig T2) R -> T1 = T2.
Proof.
  intros E R H. induction H; intros lb T1 T2 Hb1 Hb2.
  - inversion Hb1.
  - simpl in Hb1, Hb2.
    destruct Hb1 as [Heq1 | Hin1]; destruct Hb2 as [Heq2 | Hin2].
    + inversion Heq1; inversion Heq2; subst; reflexivity.
    + inversion Heq1. subst.
      exfalso. eapply Signatures.binds_dom_contradiction; [exact Hin2 | exact H1].
    + inversion Heq2. subst.
      exfalso. eapply Signatures.binds_dom_contradiction; [exact Hin1 | exact H1].
    + apply (IHwf_sig lb T1 T2 Hin1 Hin2).
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Spine lookup / head atoms for the nested-int record shape.   *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Fixpoint rec_field (a : atom) (T : typ) : option typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_record b C => if (a === b) then Some C else None
  | typ_int U W =>
      match rec_field a U with
      | Some C => Some C
      | None => rec_field a W
      end
  | _ => None
  end.

Fixpoint rec_heads (T : typ) : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_int U W => union (rec_heads U) (rec_heads W)
  | typ_record a _ => singleton a
  | _ => empty
  end.

Inductive nested_rec : typ -> Prop :=
  | nested_rec_top : nested_rec typ_top
  | nested_rec_int : forall a C R,
      nested_rec R ->
      a `notin` rec_heads R ->
      nested_rec (typ_int (typ_record a C) R).

(* field lookup or absence is exactly membership in the head set *)
Lemma rec_field_heads : forall T a,
  match rec_field a T with
  | Some C => a `in` rec_heads T
  | None => ~ a `in` rec_heads T
  end.
Proof.
  intros T. induction T; intros a; simpl.
  - (* top *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 a H).
  - (* bvar *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 a H).
  - (* fvar *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 a H).
  - (* arrow *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 a H).
  - (* all *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 a H).
  - (* box *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 a H).
  - (* mut *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 a H).
  - (* int *)
    destruct (rec_field a T1) as [C|] eqn:E1.
    + simpl. apply AtomSetImpl.union_2. exact (IHT1 a).
    + simpl. rewrite IHT1. simpl. destruct (rec_field a T2) as [C|] eqn:E2.
      * apply AtomSetImpl.union_3. exact (IHT2 a).
      * intro H. apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in H. destruct H as [H|H].
        -- exact (IHT1 a H).
        -- exact (IHT2 a H).
  - (* record *)
    destruct (a === a0) as [e|ne].
    + simpl. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. symmetry. exact e.
    + simpl. intro H. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_1 in H. exact (ne (symmetry H)).
Qed.

Lemma rec_field_None_iff : forall T a,
  rec_field a T = None <-> ~ a `in` rec_heads T.
Proof.
  intros T a. pose proof (rec_field_heads T a) as H.
  destruct (rec_field a T) as [C|] eqn:E; simpl in H; split.
  - discriminate.
  - intros _. reflexivity.
  - intros _; exact H.
  - intro Hc; exfalso; exact (H Hc).

  ~ a `in` rec_heads T -> rec_field a T = None.
Proof. intros. apply rec_field_None_iff. exact H. Qed.

  a `in` rec_heads T -> exists C, rec_field a T = Some C.
Proof.

  - exists C. reflexivity.
  - exfalso. apply (rec_field_None_iff T a) in E. exact (E H).

(* ============ record inversion ============ *)
Fixpoint record_pred (E : env) (a : atom) (A T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_record b C => if (a === b) then (sub E A C /\ sub E C A) else False
  | typ_int U W => record_pred E a A U /\ record_pred E a A W
  | typ_mut _ U => record_pred E a A U
  | _ => False
  end.

Lemma record_pred_merge : forall E a A U M,
  record_pred E a A (merge_mutability U M) <-> record_pred E a A U.
Proof.
  intros E a A U. induction U; intros M; simpl; try reflexivity.
  all: try (split; intro Hh; exact Hh).
  - (* int *) rewrite IHU1, IHU2. tauto.
Qed.

Lemma record_pred_nf_params : forall E a A U,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E A ->
  (record_pred E a (normal_form_typing A) U <-> record_pred E a A U).
Proof.
  intros E a A U Hwe Hwa.
  induction U; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - (* mut *) apply IHU.
  - (* int *) rewrite IHU1, IHU2. tauto.
  - (* record *) destruct (a === a0) eqn:Eab; [| reflexivity].
    split; intros [H1 H2]; split.
    + eapply sub_trans; [apply sub_normal_form_typing_right; [exact Hwe | exact Hwa] | exact H1].
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact H2 | apply sub_normal_form_typing_left; [exact Hwe | exact Hwa]].
    + eapply sub_trans; [apply sub_normal_form_typing_left; [exact Hwe | exact Hwa] | exact H1].
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact H2 | apply sub_normal_form_typing_right; [exact Hwe | exact Hwa]].
Qed.

Lemma record_pred_nf : forall E a A T,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T ->
  (record_pred E a A T <-> record_pred E a A (normal_form_typing T)).
Proof.
  intros E a A T. revert T.
  fix IH 1. intros T Hwe Hwt.
  destruct T as [|n|X|T1 T2|T1 T2|T1|M T1|T1 T2|b T1]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - (* mut *) rewrite record_pred_merge. destruct M. apply (IH T1 Hwe (wf_typ_readonly_inv _ _ Hwt)).
  - (* int *) split; intros [H1 H2]; split.
    + apply (proj1 (IH T1 Hwe (wf_typ_int_l _ _ _ Hwt))) in H1. exact H1.
    + apply (proj1 (IH T2 Hwe (wf_typ_int_r _ _ _ Hwt))) in H2. exact H2.
    + apply (proj2 (IH T1 Hwe (wf_typ_int_l _ _ _ Hwt))). exact H1.
    + apply (proj2 (IH T2 Hwe (wf_typ_int_r _ _ _ Hwt))). exact H2.
  - (* record *) destruct (a === b) eqn:Eab; [| reflexivity].
    pose proof (wf_typ_record_inv E b T1 Hwt) as Hwt1.
    split; intros [H1 H2]; split.
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact H1 | apply sub_normal_form_typing_right; [exact Hwe | exact Hwt1]].
    + eapply sub_trans; [apply sub_normal_form_typing_left; [exact Hwe | exact Hwt1] | exact H2].
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact H1 | apply sub_normal_form_typing_left; [exact Hwe | exact Hwt1]].
    + eapply sub_trans; [apply sub_normal_form_typing_right; [exact Hwe | exact Hwt1] | exact H2].
Qed.



Lemma wf_typ_all_l : forall E T1 T2, wf_typ E (typ_all T1 T2) -> wf_typ E T1.
Proof. intros E T1 T2 H. inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.

(* ============ all-domain inversion ============ *)
Fixpoint all_dom_pred (E : env) (A T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_all C D => sub E C A
  | typ_int U W => all_dom_pred E A U /\ all_dom_pred E A W
  | typ_mut _ U => all_dom_pred E A U
  | _ => False
  end.

Lemma seal_pow_expr : forall k e, expr e -> expr (seal_pow k e).

(* A fresh label of the target store is not bound in the signature. *)
Lemma fresh_label_notin_sig : forall E R ns l,
  typing_store E R ns ->
  l = fresh_label_for_store ns ->
  LabelSetImpl.notin l (Signatures.dom R).
Proof.
  intros E R ns l Hst Hl. subst l.
  unfold LabelSetImpl.notin. intro Hin.
  destruct (Signatures.binds_In_inv signature (fresh_label_for_store ns) R Hin)
    as [sg Hb].
  destruct sg as [T].
  destruct (proj1 (Hst (fresh_label_for_store ns)) T Hb) as [v [Hm _]].
  unfold fresh_label_for_store in *.
  apply (Label.fresh_not_in (List.map fst (LabelMapImpl.elements ns))).
  apply (proj1 (in_dom_elements ns (fresh_label_for_store ns))).
  exact Hm.
Qed.

(* body_e is stable under the target-side sealcomp. *)
Lemma body_e_sealcomp : forall e f,
  body_e e -> sealcomp e f -> body_e f.
Proof.
  intros e f [L H] Hsc. exists L. intros x Hx.
  pose proof (H x Hx) as He.
  pose proof (sealcomp_open_ee e f Hsc 0 x x (sealcomp_fvar x)) as Hscx.

  eapply sealcomp_expr_down; eassumption.
Qed.

(* Open a term body at a value, extending the environment. *)
Lemma typing_open_ee_subst_ctx : forall E R T1 T2 body L,
  (forall x, x `notin` L ->
     typing (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E) R (open_ee body x) T2) ->
  forall v, typing E R v T1 -> expr v ->
  exists x E',
    E' = x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E /\
    x `notin` L /\ x `notin` fv_e body /\
    wf_env E' /\ extends_binds E E' /\
    typing E' R (open_ee body v) T2.
Proof.
  intros E R T1 T2 body L Hbody v Hv Hve.
  pose proof (typing_wf_env E R v T1 Hv) as HwfE.
  pose proof (typing_wf_typ E R v T1 Hv (typing_wf_sig E R v T1 Hv)) as HwtT1.
  destruct (atom_fresh (L `union` fv_e body `union` dom E)) as [x Hx].
  pose proof Hx as HL. apply notin_union_1 in HL.
  pose proof Hx as Hrest. apply notin_union_2 in Hrest.
  pose proof Hrest as Hfv. apply notin_union_1 in Hfv.
  pose proof Hrest as Hdom. apply notin_union_2 in Hdom.
  pose proof (Hbody x HL) as Htx.
  assert (HwfE' : wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E)).
  { apply wf_env_typ; assumption. }
  assert (Hb : binds x (bind_typ T1) (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E)).
  { apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity. }
  assert (Hv' : typing (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E) R v T1).
  { eapply typing_weaken_binds; [exact Hv | exact HwfE' |].
    intros Y c HY. apply binds_cons_3. exact HY. }
  pose proof (typing_subst_fvar (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E) R
                (open_ee body x) T2 Htx x v T1 Hb Hv' Hve) as Hres.
  rewrite <- (subst_fvar_open_ee_eq body 0 x v Hfv) in Hres.
  exists x, (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E). split; [reflexivity |].
  split; [exact HL |]. split; [exact Hfv |]. split; [exact HwfE' |].
  split; [| exact Hres].
  intros Y c HY. apply binds_cons_3. exact HY.
Qed.

(* Open a type abstraction body at a type, keeping the environment. *)
Lemma typing_open_te_subst : forall E R T1 U body L,
  (forall X, X `notin` L ->
     typing (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) R (open_te body X) (open_tt U X)) ->
  forall V, type V -> wf_typ E V -> sub E V T1 ->
  wf_sig E R ->
  typing E R (open_te body V) (open_tt U V).
Proof.
  intros E R T1 U body L Hbody V HV HwtV HsubV Hsig.
  pose proof (wf_sig_wf_env E R Hsig) as HwfE.
  destruct (atom_fresh (L `union` dom E `union` ftv_e body `union` ftv_t U))
    as [X HX].
  pose proof HX as HL. apply notin_union_1 in HL.
  pose proof HX as Hrest. apply notin_union_2 in Hrest.
  pose proof Hrest as Hdom. apply notin_union_1 in Hdom.
  pose proof Hrest as Hrest2. apply notin_union_2 in Hrest2.
  pose proof Hrest2 as Hfv. apply notin_union_1 in Hfv.
  pose proof Hrest2 as Hftv. apply notin_union_2 in Hftv.
  pose proof (Hbody X HL) as Htx.
  assert (HE0 : subst_tvar_env X V E = E).
  { apply subst_tvar_env_id_wf; assumption. }
  assert (HR0 : subst_tvar_sig X V R = R).
  { apply subst_tvar_sig_id_wf; assumption. }
  pose proof (typing_subst_tvar_ctx (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) R
                (open_te body X) (open_tt U X) Htx
                nil E X T1 V eq_refl
                (wf_env_sub HwtV HwfE Hdom) HE0 HR0 HV HwtV
                HwfE Hsig HsubV) as Hres.
  simpl in Hres.
  rewrite HE0 in Hres.
  change (typing E R
    (subst_tvar_e X V (open_te_rec 0 (typ_fvar X) body))
    (subst_tvar_t X V (open_tt_rec 0 (typ_fvar X) U))) in Hres.
  rewrite <- (open_te_tsubst_eq body 0 X V Hfv) in Hres.
  rewrite <- (open_tt_tsubst_eq U 0 X V Hftv) in Hres.
  exact Hres.

sub_ind' =
fun (P : forall (l : env) (t t0 : typ), l |-s t <: t0 -> Prop)
  (f : forall (E : env) (S : typ) (w : wf_env E) (w0 : wf_typ E S),
       P E S typ_top (sub_top E S w w0))
  (f0 : forall (E : env) (X : atom) (w : wf_env E) (w0 : wf_typ E X),
        P E X X (sub_refl_tvar E X w w0))
  (f1 : forall (U : typ) (E : env) (T : typ) (X : atom)
          (b : binds X (bind_sub U) E) (s : E |-s U <: T),
        P E U T s -> P E X T (sub_trans_tvar U E T X b s))
  (f2 : forall (E : env) (S1 S2 T1 T2 : typ) (s : E |-s T1 <: S1),
        P E T1 S1 s ->
        forall s0 : E |-s S2 <: T2,
        P E S2 T2 s0 ->
        P E (typ_arrow S1 S2) (typ_arrow T1 T2)
          (sub_arrow E S1 S2 T1 T2 s s0))
  (f3 : forall (L : atoms) (E : env) (S1 S2 T1 T2 : typ) (s : E |-s T1 <: S1),
        P E T1 S1 s ->
        forall
          s0 : forall X : atom,
               X `notin` L ->
               X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E |-s open_tt S2 X <: open_tt T2 X,
        (forall (X : atom) (n : X `notin` L),
         P (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt S2 X) (open_tt T2 X) (s0 X n)) ->
        P E (typ_all S1 S2) (typ_all T1 T2) (sub_all L E S1 S2 T1 T2 s s0))
  (f4 : forall (E : env) (T1 T2 : typ) (s : E |-s T1 <: T2),
        P E T1 T2 s ->
        forall s0 : E |-s T2 <: T1,
        P E T2 T1 s0 -> P E (typ_box T1) (typ_box T2) (sub_box E T1 T2 s s0))
  (f5 : forall (E : env) (T1 T2 : typ) (s : E |-s T1 <: T2),
        P E T1 T2 s ->
        P E (typ_mut mut_readonly T1) (typ_mut mut_readonly T2)
          (sub_readonly E T1 T2 s))
  (f6 : forall (E : env) (T1 T2 : typ) (s : E |-s T1 <: T2),
        P E T1 T2 s ->
        P E T1 (typ_mut mut_readonly T2) (sub_readonly_mutable E T1 T2 s))
  (f7 : forall (E : env) (T1 T2 T3 : typ) (s : E |-s T1 <: T2),
        P E T1 T2 s ->
        forall s0 : E |-s T2 <: T3,
        P E T2 T3 s0 -> P E T1 T3 (sub_trans E T1 T2 T3 s s0))
  (f8 : forall (E : env) (T1 T2 : typ) (w : wf_env E) 
          (w0 : wf_typ E T1) (w1 : wf_typ E T2),
        P E (typ_int T1 T2) T1 (sub_inter_left E T1 T2 w w0 w1))
  (f9 : forall (E : env) (T1 T2 : typ) (w : wf_env E) 
          (w0 : wf_typ E T1) (w1 : wf_typ E T2),
        P E (typ_int T1 T2) T2 (sub_inter_right E T1 T2 w w0 w1))
  (f10 : forall (E : env) (T1 T2 T3 : typ) (s : E |-s T1 <: T2),
         P E T1 T2 s ->
         forall s0 : E |-s T1 <: T3,
         P E T1 T3 s0 -> P E T1 (typ_int T2 T3) (sub_inter E T1 T2 T3 s s0))
  (f11 : forall (E : env) (a : atom) (T1 T2 : typ) (s : E |-s T1 <: T2),
         P E T1 T2 s ->
         forall s0 : E |-s T2 <: T1,
         P E T2 T1 s0 ->
         P E (typ_record a T1) (typ_record a T2) (sub_record E a T1 T2 s s0))
  (f12 : forall (E : env) (a : atom) (T1 T2 : typ) (s : E |-s T1 <: T2),
         P E T1 T2 s ->
         P E (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T1))
           (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T2))
           (sub_readonly_record E a T1 T2 s))
  (f13 : forall (E : env) (T1 T2 : typ) (w : wf_typ E T1) 
           (w0 : wf_typ E T2)
           (s : E |-s normal_form_typing T1 <: normal_form_typing T2),
         P E (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2) s ->
         P E T1 T2 (sub_denormalize E T1 T2 w w0 s)) =>
fix F (l : env) (t t0 : typ) (s : l |-s t <: t0) {struct s} : P l t t0 s :=
  match s as s0 in (l0 |-s t1 <: t2) return (P l0 t1 t2 s0) with
  | sub_top E S0 w w0 => f E S0 w w0
  | sub_refl_tvar E X w w0 => f0 E X w w0
  | sub_trans_tvar U E T X b s0 => f1 U E T X b s0 (F E U T s0)
  | sub_arrow E S1 S2 T1 T2 s0 s1 =>
      f2 E S1 S2 T1 T2 s0 (F E T1 S1 s0) s1 (F E S2 T2 s1)
  | sub_all L E S1 S2 T1 T2 s0 s1 =>
      f3 L E S1 S2 T1 T2 s0 (F E T1 S1 s0) s1
        (fun (X : atom) (n : X `notin` L) =>
         F (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt S2 X) (open_tt T2 X) (s1 X n))
  | sub_box E T1 T2 s0 s1 => f4 E T1 T2 s0 (F E T1 T2 s0) s1 (F E T2 T1 s1)
  | sub_readonly E T1 T2 s0 => f5 E T1 T2 s0 (F E T1 T2 s0)
  | sub_readonly_mutable E T1 T2 s0 => f6 E T1 T2 s0 (F E T1 T2 s0)
  | sub_trans E T1 T2 T3 s0 s1 =>
      f7 E T1 T2 T3 s0 (F E T1 T2 s0) s1 (F E T2 T3 s1)

Fixpoint typing_set_box_inv (E:env) (R:sig) (e1 e2:exp) (T:typ)
  (H : typing E R (exp_set_box e1 e2) T) {struct H} :
  exists T1, typing E R e1 (typ_box T1) /\ typing E R e2 T1 /\ (T = T1 \/ sub E T1 T).
Proof.
  inversion H; subst.
  - match goal with
    | H' : typing E R (exp_set_box e1 e2) ?S |- _ =>
      destruct (typing_set_box_inv E R e1 e2 S H') as [T1 [G1 [G2 [Heq | Hsub]]]]
    end.
    + eexists. split; [exact G1 | split; [exact G2 |]]. subst S. right. assumption.
    + eexists. split; [exact G1 | split; [exact G2 |]]. right. eapply sub_trans; eauto.
  - eexists. split; [eassumption | split; [eassumption | left; reflexivity]].
Qed.

Fixpoint typing_seal_inv (E:env) (R:sig) (e:exp) (T:typ)
  (H : typing E R (exp_seal e) T) {struct H} :
  exists T1, typing E R e T1 /\
    (T = typ_mut mut_readonly T1 \/ sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly T1) T).
Proof.

  - match goal with
    | H' : typing E R (exp_seal e) ?S |- _ =>
      destruct (typing_seal_inv E R e S H') as [T1 [G1 [Heq | Hsub]]]
    end.
    + eexists. split; [exact G1 |]. subst S. right. assumption.
    + eexists. split; [exact G1 |]. right. eapply sub_trans; eauto.

Fixpoint box_pred (E : env) (A T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_box C => sub E A C /\ sub E C A
  | typ_int U W => box_pred E A U /\ box_pred E A W
  | typ_mut _ U => box_pred E A U
  | _ => False
  end.

Lemma box_pred_merge : forall E A U M,
  box_pred E A (merge_mutability U M) <-> box_pred E A U.
Proof.
  intros E A U. induction U; intros M; simpl; try reflexivity.
  all: try (split; intro Hh; exact Hh).
  - (* int *) rewrite IHU1, IHU2. tauto.
Qed.

Lemma box_pred_nf_params : forall E A U,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E A ->
  (box_pred E (normal_form_typing A) U <-> box_pred E A U).
Proof.
  intros E A U Hwe Hwa.
  induction U; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - (* box *) split; intros [H1 H2]; split.
    + eapply sub_trans; [apply sub_normal_form_typing_right; [exact Hwe | exact Hwa] | exact H1].
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact H2 | apply sub_normal_form_typing_left; [exact Hwe | exact Hwa]].
    + eapply sub_trans; [apply sub_normal_form_typing_left; [exact Hwe | exact Hwa] | exact H1].
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact H2 | apply sub_normal_form_typing_right; [exact Hwe | exact Hwa]].
  - (* mut *) apply IHU.
  - (* int *) rewrite IHU1, IHU2. tauto.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma box_pred_nf : forall E A T,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T ->
  (box_pred E A T <-> box_pred E A (normal_form_typing T)).
Proof.
  intros E A T. revert T.
  fix IH 1. intros T Hwe Hwt.
  destruct T as [|n|X|T1 T2|T1 T2|T1|M T1|T1 T2|a T1]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - (* box *) pose proof (wf_typ_box_inv E T1 Hwt) as Hwt1. split; intros [H1 H2]; split.
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact H1 | apply sub_normal_form_typing_right; [exact Hwe | exact Hwt1]].
    + eapply sub_trans; [apply sub_normal_form_typing_left; [exact Hwe | exact Hwt1] | exact H2].
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact H1 | apply sub_normal_form_typing_left; [exact Hwe | exact Hwt1]].
    + eapply sub_trans; [apply sub_normal_form_typing_right; [exact Hwe | exact Hwt1] | exact H2].
  - (* mut *) rewrite box_pred_merge. destruct M. apply (IH T1 Hwe (wf_typ_readonly_inv _ _ Hwt)).
  - (* int *) split; intros [H1 H2]; split.
    + apply (proj1 (IH T1 Hwe (wf_typ_int_l _ _ _ Hwt))) in H1. exact H1.
    + apply (proj1 (IH T2 Hwe (wf_typ_int_r _ _ _ Hwt))) in H2. exact H2.
    + apply (proj2 (IH T1 Hwe (wf_typ_int_l _ _ _ Hwt))). exact H1.
    + apply (proj2 (IH T2 Hwe (wf_typ_int_r _ _ _ Hwt))). exact H2.
  - (* record *) reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma box_pred_sub_aux : forall E A T2 T3,
  box_pred E A T2 -> sub E T2 T3 -> box_pred E A T3.
Proof.
  intros E A T2 T3 Hp Hs.
  pose proof (sub_wf_env E T2 T3 Hs) as Hwe.
  dependent induction Hs.
  - (* top *) exact I.
  - (* refl_tvar *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.
  - (* trans_tvar *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.
  - (* arrow *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.
  - (* all *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.
  - (* box *) simpl in Hp. simpl. destruct Hp as [H1 H2]. split.
    + eapply sub_trans; eassumption.
    + eapply sub_trans; eassumption.
  - (* readonly *) simpl in Hp. simpl. apply IHHs; [exact Hp | exact Hwe].
  - (* readonly_mutable *) simpl in Hp. simpl. apply IHHs; [exact Hp | exact Hwe].
  - (* trans *) simpl. apply IHHs2; [apply IHHs1; [exact Hp | exact Hwe] | exact Hwe].
  - (* inter_left *) simpl in Hp. destruct Hp as [Hp _]. exact Hp.
  - (* inter_right *) simpl in Hp. destruct Hp as [_ Hp]. exact Hp.
  - (* inter *) simpl. split.
    + apply IHHs1; [exact Hp | exact Hwe].
    + apply IHHs2; [exact Hp | exact Hwe].
  - (* record *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.
  - (* readonly_record *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.
  - (* denormalize *) simpl in *.
    pose proof (proj1 (box_pred_nf E A T1 Hwe H) Hp) as Hpn.
    pose proof (IHHs Hpn Hwe) as Hqn.
    exact (proj2 (box_pred_nf E A T2 Hwe H0) Hqn).
Qed.

Lemma box_pred_sub : forall E A T, sub E (typ_box A) T -> box_pred E A T.
Proof.
  intros E A T H.
  dependent induction H.
  - (* top *) exact I.
  - (* box *) simpl. split; assumption.
  - (* readonly_mutable *) simpl. apply (IHsub A eq_refl).
  - (* trans *) simpl.
    apply box_pred_sub_aux with (T2:=T2).
    + apply (IHsub1 A eq_refl).
    + exact H0.
  - (* inter *) simpl. split.
    + apply (IHsub1 A eq_refl).
    + apply (IHsub2 A eq_refl).
  - (* denormalize *) simpl in H1.
    pose proof (IHsub (normal_form_typing A) eq_refl) as Hpred.
    pose proof (sub_wf_env E _ _ H1) as Hwe.
    pose proof (wf_typ_box_inv E A H) as Hwa.
    apply (proj1 (box_pred_nf_params E A (normal_form_typing T2) Hwe Hwa)) in Hpred.
    exact (proj2 (box_pred_nf E A T2 Hwe H0) Hpred).
Qed.

Lemma sub_box_inv_l : forall E A B, sub E (typ_box A) (typ_box B) -> sub E A B.
Proof.
  intros E A B H. pose proof (box_pred_sub E A (typ_box B) H) as Hp.
  simpl in Hp. exact (proj1 Hp).
Qed.
Lemma sub_box_inv_r : forall E A B, sub E (typ_box A) (typ_box B) -> sub E B A.
Proof.
  intros E A B H. pose proof (box_pred_sub E A (typ_box B) H) as Hp.
  simpl in Hp. exact (proj2 Hp).
Qed.

  intros e f Hsc Hv.
  eapply value_sealcomp_down; [exact Hsc | exact Hv |].

  well_formed_store ns -> sealcomp_store s ns -> well_formed_store s.

  intros s ns Hwf Hsc l v Hm.
  destruct (proj1 Hsc l v Hm) as [v' [Hm' Hscv]].

  exact (Hwf l v' Hm').
Qed.

type (typ_int T1 T2)
  | type_record : forall a T1,
      type T1 ->
      type (typ_record a T1)
.

Inductive expr : exp -> Prop :=
  | expr_var : forall x,
      expr (exp_fvar x)
  | expr_abs : forall L T e1,
      type T ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e1 x)) ->
      expr (exp_abs T e1)
  | expr_app : forall e1 e2,
      expr e1 ->
      expr e2 ->
      expr (exp_app e1 e2)
  | expr_tabs : forall L T e1,
      type T ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> expr (open_te e1 X)) ->
      expr (exp_tabs T e1)
  | expr_tapp : forall e1 V,
      expr e1 ->
      type V ->
      expr (exp_tapp e1 V)
  | expr_let : forall L e1 e2,
      expr e1 ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e2 x)) ->
      expr (exp_let e1 e2)
  | expr_box : forall e,
      expr e ->
      expr (exp_box e)
  | expr_unbox : forall e,
      expr e ->
      expr (exp_unbox e)
  | expr_set_box : forall e1 e2,
      expr e1 ->
      expr e2 ->
      expr (exp_set_box e1 e2)
  | expr_ref : forall l,
      expr (exp_ref l)
  | expr_seal : forall e,
      expr e ->
      expr (exp_seal e)
  | expr_record : forall r,
      record_comp r ->
      expr (exp_record r)
  | expr_record_read : forall e a,
      expr e ->
      expr (exp_record_read e a)
  | expr_record_write : forall e1 a e2,
      expr e1 ->
      expr e2 ->
      expr (exp_record_write e1 a e2)
with record_comp : rec_comp -> Prop :=
  | record_comp_empty :
      record_comp (rec_empty)
  | record_comp_exp : forall a e r,
      expr e ->
      record_comp r ->
      record_comp (rec_exp a e r)
  | record_comp_ref : forall a e r,
      record_comp r ->
      record_comp (rec_ref a e r)
.

109	                (typing_wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) R

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Spine lookup / head atoms for the nested-int record shape.   *)

Fixpoint rec_field (a : atom) (T : typ) : option typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_record b C => if (a === b) then Some C else None
  | typ_int U W =>
      match rec_field a U with
      | Some C => Some C
      | None => rec_field a W
      end
  | _ => None

Fixpoint rec_heads (T : typ) : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_int U W => union (rec_heads U) (rec_heads W)
  | typ_record a _ => singleton a
  | _ => AtomSetImpl.empty
  end.

  | nested_rec_int : forall a C R,

(* field lookup or absence is exactly membership in the head set *)
Lemma rec_field_heads : forall T a,
  match rec_field a T with
  | Some C => a `in` rec_heads T
  | None => ~ a `in` rec_heads T
  end.
Proof.
  intros T. induction T; intros x; simpl.
  - (* top *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H).
  - (* bvar *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H).
  - (* fvar *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H).
  - (* arrow *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H).
  - (* all *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H).
  - (* box *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H).
  - (* mut *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H).
  - (* int *)
    destruct (rec_field x T1) as [C|] eqn:E1.
    + specialize (IHT1 x) as H1. rewrite E1 in H1. simpl in H1.
      simpl. apply AtomSetImpl.union_2. exact H1.
    + specialize (IHT1 x) as H1. rewrite E1 in H1. simpl in H1.
      simpl. destruct (rec_field x T2) as [C|] eqn:E2.
      * specialize (IHT2 x) as H2. rewrite E2 in H2. simpl in H2.
        apply AtomSetImpl.union_3. exact H2.
      * intro H. apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in H. destruct H as [H|H].
        -- exact (H1 H).
        -- specialize (IHT2 x) as H2. rewrite E2 in H2. simpl in H2. exact (H2 H).
  - (* record *)
    destruct (x === a) as [e|ne].
    + simpl. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. symmetry. exact e.
    + simpl. intro H. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_1 in H. exact (ne (symmetry H)).
Qed.

Lemma rec_field_None_iff : forall T a,
  rec_field a T = None <-> ~ a `in` rec_heads T.
Proof.
  intros T a. pose proof (rec_field_heads T a) as H.
  destruct (rec_field a T) as [C|] eqn:E; simpl in H; split.
  - intro Hnone. discriminate Hnone.
  - intro Hnot. exfalso. exact (Hnot H).
  - intros _ Hc. exact (H Hc).
  - intros _. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma rec_field_None_of_notin : forall T a,
  ~ a `in` rec_heads T -> rec_field a T = None.
Proof. intros. apply rec_field_None_iff. exact H. Qed.

Lemma rec_field_Some_of_in : forall T a,
  a `in` rec_heads T -> exists C, rec_field a T = Some C.
Proof.
  intros T a H. destruct (rec_field a T) as [C|] eqn:E.
  - exists C. reflexivity.
  - exfalso. apply (rec_field_None_iff T a) in E. exact (E H).
Qed.

(* field of a nested record, unfolded on the head *)
Lemma rec_field_nested_head : forall a0 C0 R a,
  rec_field a (typ_int (typ_record a0 C0) R) =
    match (a === a0) with
    | left _ => Some C0
    | right _ => rec_field a R
    end.
Proof. intros. simpl. destruct (a === a0); reflexivity. Qed.

(* normal form commutes with spine lookup on nested records *)
Lemma rec_field_nf : forall T, nested_rec T ->
  forall a, rec_field a (normal_form_typing T) = option_map (normal_form_typing) (rec_field a T).
Proof.
  intros T H. induction H as [| a0 C0 R Hnr IH]; intros a.
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (a === a0) as [e|ne].
    + reflexivity.
    + simpl. apply IH.
Qed.

655	Fixpoint ro_pow (k : nat) (T : typ) : typ :=
656	  match k with
657	  | 0 => T
658	  | S k' => typ_mut mut_readonly (ro_pow k' T)
659	  end.
660	
661	Lemma wf_typ_ro_pow : forall E T, wf_typ E T -> forall k, wf_typ E (ro_pow k T).
662	Proof.
663	  intros E T H. induction k; simpl.
664	  - exact H.
665	  - apply wf_typ_readonly. exact IHk.
666	Qed.
667	
668	Lemma typing_seal_pow : forall E R e T,
669	  typing E R e T -> forall k, typing E R (seal_pow k e) (ro_pow k T).
670	Proof.
671	  intros E R e T H. induction k; simpl.
672	  - exact H.
673	  - apply typing_seal. exact IHk.
674	Qed.
675	
676	Lemma sub_ro_pow_self : forall E T,
677	  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> forall k, sub E T (ro_pow k T).
678	Proof.
679	  intros E T Hwe Hwt. induction k; simpl.
680	  - apply sub_refl_wf; assumption.
681	  - apply sub_readonly_mutable. exact IHk.
682	Qed.
683	
684	Lemma sub_ro_pow : forall E A B, sub E A B ->
685	  forall k, sub E (ro_pow k A) (ro_pow k B).
686	Proof.
687	  intros E A B H. induction k; simpl.
688	  - exact H.
689	  - apply sub_readonly. exact IHk.
690	Qed.
691	
692	Lemma typing_root_strip : forall E R k f0 T,
693	  typing E R (seal_pow k f0) T -> wf_sig E R ->
694	  exists T0, typing E R f0 T0 /\ sub E (ro_pow k T0) T.
695	Proof.
696	  intros E R k. induction k as [|k IH]; simpl; intros f0 T Hty Hsig.
697	  - exists T. split; [exact Hty |].
698	    apply sub_refl_wf.
699	    + exact (wf_sig_wf_env E R Hsig).
700	    + eapply typing_wf_typ; eassumption.
701	  - destruct (typing_seal_inv E R (seal_pow k f0) T Hty) as [S [Hinner [Heq | Hsub]]].
702	    + subst T.
703	      destruct (IH f0 S Hinner Hsig) as [T0 [Hf0 Hsub0]].
704	      exists T0. split; [exact Hf0 |].
705	      eapply sub_trans.
706	      * apply sub_readonly. exact Hsub0.
707	      * apply sub_refl_wf.
708	        -- exact (wf_sig_wf_env E R Hsig).
709	        -- apply wf_typ_readonly. eapply typing_wf_typ; eassumption.
710	    + destruct (IH f0 S Hinner Hsig) as [T0 [Hf0 Hsub0]].
711	      exists T0. split; [exact Hf0 |].
712	      eapply sub_trans.
713	      * apply sub_readonly. exact Hsub0.
714	      * exact Hsub.
715	Qed.
716	
717	(* ============================================================ *)
718	(* Typing-preserving peel of the extra seals on a value.        *)
719	(* ============================================================ *)
720	
721	Lemma value_seal_redm_typed : forall E R v g T ns,
722	  value v -> sealcomp v g -> typing E R g T -> wf_sig E R ->
723	  well_formed_store ns ->
724	  exists g', redm g ns g' ns /\ value g' /\ sealcomp v g' /\ typing E R g' T.
725	Proof.
726	  intros E R v g T ns Hv Hsc Hty Hsig Hwf.
727	  pose proof (wf_sig_wf_env E R Hsig) as Hwe.
728	  destruct Hv as [T0 body Hexpr_body | T0 body Hexpr_body | l | l | r Hvrc | r Hvrc].
729	  - (* abs *)
730	    destruct (abs_shape T0 body g Hsc) as [k [f1 [Heq Hsc1]]]. subst g.
731	    destruct (typing_root_strip E R k (exp_abs T0 f1) T Hty Hsig) as [T1 [Hcore Hsub]].
732	    exists (exp_abs T0 f1). split; [| split; [| split]].
733	    + apply abs_strip; [exact Hwf | eapply typing_expr; eassumption].
734	    + apply value_abs. eapply typing_expr; eassumption.
735	    + apply sealcomp_abs; exact Hsc1.
736	    + eapply typing_sub; [exact Hsig | exact Hcore |].
737	      eapply sub_trans.
738	      * apply sub_ro_pow_self; [exact Hwe |].
739	        eapply typing_wf_typ; eassumption.
740	      * exact Hsub.
741	  - (* tabs *)
742	    destruct (tabs_shape T0 body g Hsc) as [k [f1 [Heq Hsc1]]]. subst g.
743	    destruct (typing_root_strip E R k (exp_tabs T0 f1) T Hty Hsig) as [T1 [Hcore Hsub]].
744	    exists (exp_tabs T0 f1). split; [| split; [| split]].
745	    + apply tabs_strip; [exact Hwf | eapply typing_expr; eassumption].
746	    + apply value_tabs. eapply typing_expr; eassumption.
747	    + apply sealcomp_tabs; exact Hsc1.
748	    + eapply typing_sub; [exact Hsig | exact Hcore |].
749	      eapply sub_trans.
750	      * apply sub_ro_pow_self; [exact Hwe |].
751	        eapply typing_wf_typ; eassumption.
752	      * exact Hsub.
753	  - (* ref *)
754	    destruct (ref_shape l g Hsc) as [k Heq]. subst g.
755	    destruct (typing_root_strip E R k (exp_ref l) T Hty Hsig) as [T1 [Hcore Hsub]].
756	    exists (seal_pow (min1 k) (exp_ref l)). split; [| split; [| split]].
757	    + apply ref_strip; exact Hwf.
758	    + destruct k as [|k']; simpl. apply value_ref. apply value_sealed_ref.
759	    + apply sealcomp_pow_right with (k:=min1 k). apply sealcomp_refl.

Lemma typing_store_wf_store : forall E R s,
  typing_store E R s -> well_formed_store s.
Proof.

Lemma typing_sig_add : forall E R l T e T0,
  typing E R e T0 -> wf_sig E R -> wf_typ E T ->
  LabelSetImpl.notin l (Signatures.dom R) ->
  typing E (l ~ bind_sig T ++ R) e T0.
Proof.
  intros E R l T e T0 Hty Hsig Hwt Hnotin.
  eapply typing_sig_weaken; [exact Hty | |].
  - intros l' b Hb. apply Signatures.binds_app_3. exact Hb.

Lemma env_sub_shape_prefix : forall D E, env_sub_shape E (D ++ E).

Lemma wf_env_binds_typ_wf : forall E, wf_env E ->

Proof.

  - simpl in Hb. apply binds_cons_iff in Hb.

Lemma typing_wf_typ : forall E R e T, typing E R e T ->

Proof.
  intros E R e T H.
  induction H using typing_mut with
    (P := fun E R e T (h:typing E R e T) => wf_sig E R -> wf_typ E T)
    (P0 := fun E R r T (h:typing_record_comp E R r T) => wf_sig E R -> wf_typ E T).
  - intros Hs. apply (wf_env_binds_typ_wf E w x T b).
  - (* abs *)

    destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx].
    pose proof (t x Hx) as Hbody.
    pose proof (typing_wf_env _ _ _ _ Hbody) as HwfBody.

  - (* app *)

  - (* tabs *)

  - (* tapp *)
    intros Hs.
    pose proof (typing_wf_env _ _ _ _ H) as HwfE.
    pose proof (IHtyping Hs) as HwAll.
    pose proof HwAll as Hinv.
    inversion Hinv; subst.
    pose proof (proj1 (sub_wf_typ _ _ _ s)) as HwT.
    pose proof (proj2 (sub_wf_typ _ _ _ s)) as HwT1.
    pose proof (sub_type _ _ _ s) as HtypeT.

    pose proof HX as HXL. apply notin_union_1 in HXL.

    assert (HE0 : subst_tvar_env X T E = E).

    pose proof (wf_typ_subst_tvar_ctx (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt T2 X)

Lemma typing_store_add : forall E R s l v T,
  typing_store E R s -> wf_sig E R ->
  typing E R v T -> value v ->
  LabelSetImpl.notin l (Signatures.dom R) ->
  typing_store E (l ~ bind_sig T ++ R) (LabelMapImpl.add l v s).
Proof.
  intros E R s l v T Hst Hsig Hty Hval Hfresh.
  pose proof (typing_wf_typ _ _ _ _ Hty Hsig) as Hwt.
  intros l'.
  assert (HtyTgt : forall e T0, typing E R e T0 -> typing E (l ~ bind_sig T ++ R) e T0).
  { intros e T0 He. eapply typing_sig_add; [exact He | exact Hsig | exact Hwt | exact Hfresh]. }
  split.
  - intros T' Hb. simpl in Hb.
    destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. exists v. split; [apply LabelMapImpl.add_1; reflexivity |].
      split; [apply HtyTgt; exact Hty | exact Hval].
    + destruct (proj1 (Hst l') T' Hin) as [v' [Hm [Hty' Hval']]].
      exists v'. split.
      * destruct (LabelMapFacts.eq_dec l l') as [Heq | Hne].
        -- subst l'. exfalso. eapply Signatures.binds_dom_contradiction; [exact Hin | exact Hfresh].
        -- apply LabelMapImpl.add_2; assumption.
      * split; [apply HtyTgt; exact Hty' | exact Hval'].
  - intros v' Hm.
    destruct (LabelMapFacts.eq_dec l l') as [Heq | Hne].
    + subst l'.
      assert (Hvv : v' = v).
      { eapply LabelMapFacts.MapsTo_fun; [exact Hm | apply LabelMapImpl.add_1; reflexivity]. }
      subst v'.
      exists T. split; [exact Hval | split; [apply HtyTgt; exact Hty | apply Signatures.binds_app_2; apply Signatures.binds_cons_2; reflexivity]].
    + assert (HmS : LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l' v' s).
      { eapply LabelMapImpl.add_3; [exact Hne | exact Hm]. }
      destruct (proj2 (Hst l') v' HmS) as [T' [Hval' [Hty' Hb']]].
      exists T'. split; [exact Hval' | split; [apply HtyTgt; exact Hty' | apply Signatures.binds_app_3; exact Hb']].
Qed.

Lemma typing_store_update : forall E R s l v T,
  typing_store E R s -> wf_sig E R ->
  typing E R v T -> value v ->
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
  typing_store E R (LabelMapImpl.add l v s).
Proof.
  intros E R s l v T Hst Hsig Hty Hval Hb.
  intros l'. split.
  - intros T' Hb'. destruct (LabelMapFacts.eq_dec l l') as [Heq | Hne].
    + subst l'.
      assert (HeqT : T' = T).
      { symmetry. exact (wf_sig_binds_fun E R Hsig l T T' Hb Hb'). }
      subst T'. exists v. split; [apply LabelMapImpl.add_1; reflexivity |].
      split; [exact Hty | exact Hval].
    + destruct (proj1 (Hst l') T' Hb') as [v' [Hm [Hty' Hval']]].
      exists v'. split.
      * apply LabelMapImpl.add_2; [exact Hne | exact Hm].
      * split; [exact Hty' | exact Hval'].
  - intros v' Hm. destruct (LabelMapFacts.eq_dec l l') as [Heq | Hne].
    + subst l'.
      assert (Hvv : v' = v).
      { eapply LabelMapFacts.MapsTo_fun; [exact Hm | apply LabelMapImpl.add_1; reflexivity]. }
      subst v'. exists T. split; [exact Hval | split; [exact Hty | exact Hb]].
    + assert (HmS : LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l' v' s).
      { eapply LabelMapImpl.add_3; [exact Hne | exact Hm]. }
      destruct (proj2 (Hst l') v' HmS) as [T' [Hval' [Hty' Hb']]].
      exists T'. split; [exact Hval' | split; [exact Hty' | exact Hb']].
Qed.

Lemma sealcomp_two_record_cases : forall e r,

From Stdlib Require Import Lia.
From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.
Load "/tmp/dev/dev.v".

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Spine lookup / head atoms for the nested-int record shape.   *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Fixpoint rec_field (a : atom) (T : typ) : option typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_record b C => if (a === b) then Some C else None
  | typ_int U W =>
      match rec_field a U with
      | Some C => Some C
      | None => rec_field a W
      end
  | _ => None
  end.

Fixpoint rec_heads (T : typ) : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_int U W => union (rec_heads U) (rec_heads W)
  | typ_record a _ => singleton a
  | _ => AtomSetImpl.empty
  end.

Inductive nested_rec : typ -> Prop :=
  | nested_rec_top : nested_rec typ_top
  | nested_rec_int : forall a C R,
      nested_rec R ->
      a `notin` rec_heads R ->
      nested_rec (typ_int (typ_record a C) R).

(* field lookup or absence is exactly membership in the head set *)
Lemma rec_field_heads : forall T a,
  match rec_field a T with
  | Some C => a `in` rec_heads T
  | None => ~ a `in` rec_heads T
  end.
Proof.
  intros T. induction T; intros x; simpl.
  - (* top *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H).
  - (* bvar *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H).
  - (* fvar *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H).
  - (* arrow *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H).
  - (* all *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H).
  - (* box *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H).
  - (* mut *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H).
  - (* int *)
    destruct (rec_field x T1) as [C|] eqn:E1.
    + specialize (IHT1 x) as H1. rewrite E1 in H1. simpl in H1.
      simpl. apply AtomSetImpl.union_2. exact H1.
    + specialize (IHT1 x) as H1. rewrite E1 in H1. simpl in H1.
      simpl. destruct (rec_field x T2) as [C|] eqn:E2.
      * specialize (IHT2 x) as H2. rewrite E2 in H2. simpl in H2.
        apply AtomSetImpl.union_3. exact H2.
      * intro H. apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in H. destruct H as [H|H].
        -- exact (H1 H).
        -- specialize (IHT2 x) as H2. rewrite E2 in H2. simpl in H2. exact (H2 H).
  - (* record *)
    destruct (x === a) as [e|ne].
    + simpl. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. symmetry. exact e.
    + simpl. intro H. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_1 in H. exact (ne (symmetry H)).
Qed.

Lemma rec_field_None_iff : forall T a,
  rec_field a T = None <-> ~ a `in` rec_heads T.
Proof.
  intros T a. pose proof (rec_field_heads T a) as H.
  destruct (rec_field a T) as [C|] eqn:E; simpl in H; split.
  - intro Hnone. discriminate Hnone.
  - intro Hnot. exfalso. exact (Hnot H).
  - intros _ Hc. exact (H Hc).
  - intros _. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma rec_field_None_of_notin : forall T a,
  ~ a `in` rec_heads T -> rec_field a T = None.
Proof. intros. apply rec_field_None_iff. exact H. Qed.

Lemma rec_field_Some_of_in : forall T a,
  a `in` rec_heads T -> exists C, rec_field a T = Some C.
Proof.
  intros T a H. destruct (rec_field a T) as [C|] eqn:E.
  - exists C. reflexivity.
  - exfalso. apply (rec_field_None_iff T a) in E. exact (E H).
Qed.

(* field of a nested record, unfolded on the head *)
Lemma rec_field_nested_head : forall a0 C0 R a,
  rec_field a (typ_int (typ_record a0 C0) R) =
    match (a === a0) with
    | left _ => Some C0
    | right _ => rec_field a R
    end.
Proof. intros. simpl. destruct (a === a0); reflexivity. Qed.

(* normal form commutes with spine lookup on nested records *)
Lemma rec_field_nf : forall T, nested_rec T ->
  forall a, rec_field a (normal_form_typing T) = option_map (normal_form_typing) (rec_field a T).
Proof.
  intros T H. induction H as [| a0 C0 R Hnr IH]; intros a.
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (a === a0) as [e|ne].
    + reflexivity.
    + simpl. apply IH.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma typing_seal_any_not_box : forall E R e T,
  typing E R (exp_seal e) (typ_box T) -> False.
Proof. intros. eapply typing_seal_not_box; eauto. Qed.

Lemma typing_seal_any_not_record : forall E R e a T,
  typing E R (exp_seal e) (typ_record a T) -> False.
Proof. intros. eapply typing_seal_not_record; eauto. Qed.

(* If g1 is a sealing of a reference and g1 is typed at box T, then g1 is
   literally the reference (no extra seal). *)
Lemma sealcomp_ref_typed_box :
  forall E R l g1 T,
    sealcomp (exp_ref l) g1 ->
    typing E R g1 (typ_box T) ->
    g1 = exp_ref l.
Proof.
  intros E R l g1 T Hsc Hty.
  destruct (ref_shape l g1 Hsc) as [k Heq]. subst g1.
  destruct k as [|k'].
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso. eapply typing_seal_any_not_box; [exact Hty].
Qed.

(* Same for a record at a record type. *)
Lemma sealcomp_record_typed_record :
  forall E R r g1 a T,
    sealcomp (exp_record r) g1 ->
    typing E R g1 (typ_record a T) ->
    exists r1, g1 = exp_record r1 /\ sealcomp_rec_comp r r1.
Proof.
  intros E R r g1 a T Hsc Hty.
  destruct (record_shape r g1 Hsc) as [k [r1 [Heq Hrc]]]. subst g1.
  destruct k as [|k'].
  - exists r1. split; [reflexivity | exact Hrc].
  - exfalso. eapply typing_seal_any_not_record; [exact Hty].
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* red_set_box_ref is simulable whenever the first argument of  *)
(* the typed set_box is the reference (the only possible case   *)
(* under typing) and the stripped e-argument is a value.        *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma set_box_ref_reduces :
  forall E R ns l e2 g1 g2 T,
    typing E R (exp_set_box g1 g2) T ->
    typing_store E R ns ->
    sealcomp (exp_ref l) g1 ->
    sealcomp e2 g2 ->
    value e2 ->
    expr g2 ->
    exists f' ns', redm (exp_set_box g1 g2) ns f' ns'.
Proof.
  intros E R ns l e2 g1 g2 T Hty Hst Hsc1 Hsc2 Hv2 Hexpr2.
  destruct (typing_set_box_inv E R g1 g2 T Hty) as [T1 [Hg1 [Hg2 _]]].
  assert (Hg1ref : g1 = exp_ref l).
  { eapply sealcomp_ref_typed_box; [exact Hsc1 | exact Hg1]. }
  subst g1.
  destruct (typing_ref_inv E R l (typ_box T1) Hg1) as [T0 [Hb _]].
  destruct (proj1 (Hst l) T0 Hb) as [v [Hm [Htyv Hvalv]]].
  pose proof (typing_store_wf_store E R ns Hst) as Hwfns.
  destruct (value_seal_redm e2 g2 ns Hv2 Hsc2 Hexpr2 Hwfns)
    as [g2' [Hred [Hval' Hsc']]].
  exists v, (LabelMapImpl.add l g2' ns).

(* ============================================================ *)

(* of the typed record_write is the record (no extra seal).     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma record_write_ref_reduces :
  forall E R ns a l r e2 g1 g2 v T,
    typing E R (exp_record_write g1 a g2) T ->
    well_formed_store ns ->
    sealcomp (exp_record r) g1 ->
    value_record_comp r ->
    record_lookup_ref a r = Some l ->
    LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v ns ->
    sealcomp e2 g2 ->
    value e2 ->
    expr g2 ->
    exists f' ns', redm (exp_record_write g1 a g2) ns f' ns'.
Proof.
  intros E R ns a l r e2 g1 g2 v T Hty Hwf Hsc1 Hvrc Hlook Hmap Hsc2 Hv2 Hexpr2.
  destruct (typing_record_write_inv E R g1 a g2 T Hty) as [T1 [Hg1 [Hg2 _]]].
  destruct (sealcomp_record_typed_record E R r g1 a T1 Hsc1 Hg1) as [r1 [Heq Hrc]].
  subst g1.
  assert (Hlook' : record_lookup_ref a r1 = Some l).
  { rewrite <- (record_lookup_ref_sealcomp a r r1 Hrc). exact Hlook. }
  pose proof (value_record_comp_sealcomp_up r r1 Hrc Hvrc) as Hvrc1.
  pose proof (Hwf l v Hmap) as Hval.
  destruct (value_seal_redm e2 g2 ns Hv2 Hsc2 Hexpr2 Hwf)
    as [g2' [Hred [Hval' Hsc']]].

    + apply redm_eq; reflexivity.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Unboxing a (possibly multiply sealed) reference: the extra   *)
(* seals never block the step; they are just peeled first.      *)
(* The result is the target-side spelling of the source result. *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma unbox_ref_reduces :
  forall ns l j w w',
    well_formed_store ns ->
    LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l w' ns ->
    sealcomp w w' ->
    exists f', redm (exp_unbox (seal_pow j (exp_ref l))) ns f' ns /\
      sealcomp (seal_pow (min1 j) w) f'.
Proof.
  intros ns l j w w' Hwf Hmap Hsc.
  pose proof (Hwf l w' Hmap) as Hval'.
  destruct j as [|j'].

    + eapply redm_step with (e'':=w') (s'':=ns).

      * apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
    + exact Hsc.

        -- eapply red_unbox_sealed_ref; assumption.
        -- apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
    + apply sealcomp_seal. exact Hsc.
Qed.

Lemma record_read_ref_reduces :
  forall ns a j r l w w',
    well_formed_store ns ->
    value_record_comp r ->
    record_lookup_ref a r = Some l ->
    LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l w' ns ->
    sealcomp w w' ->
    exists f', redm (exp_record_read (seal_pow j (exp_record r)) a) ns f' ns /\
      sealcomp (seal_pow (min1 j) w) f'.
Proof.
  intros ns a j r l w w' Hwf Hvrc Hlook Hmap Hsc.
  pose proof (Hwf l w' Hmap) as Hval'.
  destruct j as [|j'].
  - simpl. exists w'. split.
    + eapply redm_step with (e'':=w') (s'':=ns).

        -- apply redm_eq; reflexivity.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Iterated readonly and typing-root stripping.                 *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Fixpoint ro_pow (k : nat) (T : typ) : typ :=
  match k with
  | 0 => T
  | S k' => typ_mut mut_readonly (ro_pow k' T)
  end.

Lemma wf_typ_ro_pow : forall E T, wf_typ E T -> forall k, wf_typ E (ro_pow k T).
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction k; simpl.
  - exact H.
  - apply wf_typ_readonly. exact IHk.
Qed.

Lemma typing_seal_pow : forall E R e T,
  typing E R e T -> forall k, typing E R (seal_pow k e) (ro_pow k T).
Proof.
  intros E R e T H. induction k; simpl.
  - exact H.
  - apply typing_seal. exact IHk.
Qed.

Lemma sub_ro_pow_self : forall E T,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> forall k, sub E T (ro_pow k T).
Proof.
  intros E T Hwe Hwt. induction k; simpl.
  - apply sub_refl_wf; assumption.
  - apply sub_readonly_mutable. exact IHk.
Qed.

Lemma sub_ro_pow : forall E A B, sub E A B ->
  forall k, sub E (ro_pow k A) (ro_pow k B).
Proof.
  intros E A B H. induction k; simpl.
  - exact H.
  - apply sub_readonly. exact IHk.
Qed.

Lemma typing_root_strip : forall E R k f0 T,
  typing E R (seal_pow k f0) T -> wf_sig E R ->
  exists T0, typing E R f0 T0 /\ sub E (ro_pow k T0) T.
Proof.
  intros E R k. induction k as [|k IH]; simpl; intros f0 T Hty Hsig.
  - exists T. split; [exact Hty |].
    apply sub_refl_wf.

=== /tmp/th1/testrec.v
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.
From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.
Load "/tmp/th1/base.v".
Lemma test_record_pred_sub_record : forall E a A B T,
  record_pred E a A T -> sub E T (typ_record a B) -> sub E A B /\ sub E B A.
Proof.
  intros E a A B T Hp Hsub.
  inversion Hsub; subst.
  - (* record *) simpl in Hp. destruct (a === a0) eqn:Eab.
    + inversion Eab; subst. exact Hp.
    + inversion Hp.
  - (* trans *) clear Hsub H0 H1. admit.
  - (* inter_left *) admit.
  - (* inter_right *) admit.
  - (* denormalize *) admit.
Admitted.
=== /tmp/th1/testrec2.v
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.
From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.
Load "/tmp/th1/base.v".
Lemma rps : forall E a A B T,
  record_pred E a A T -> sub E T (typ_record a B) -> sub E A B /\ sub E B A.
Proof.
  intros E a A B T Hp Hsub.
  dependent induction Hsub.
  all: try (repeat match goal with H:?T |- _ => idtac "HYP:" H T; clear H end).
Abort.
=== /tmp/th1/testrec3.v
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.
From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.

Lemma rpsa : forall E a A T U,
  record_pred E a A T -> sub E T U ->
  forall B, sub E U (typ_record a B) -> sub E A B /\ sub E B A.
Proof.
  intros E a A T U Hp Hsub B HUB.
  revert B HUB.
  dependent induction Hsub.
  all: try (repeat match goal with H:?T |- _ => idtac "HYP:" H T; clear H end).

  forall l,
    (forall T, Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
        exists v,

            typing E R v T /\ value v)

  redm e s e' s' -> exists n, redm_n n e s e' s'.
Proof.

  - destruct IHredm as [n Hn]. exists (S n).

Qed.

Lemma redm_n_zero_inv : forall e s e' s',
  redm_n 0 e s e' s' -> e = e' /\ s = s'.
Proof. intros. inversion H. split; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma redm_n_succ_inv : forall n e s e' s',
  redm_n (S n) e s e' s' ->
  exists e'' s'', red e s e'' s'' /\ redm_n n e'' s'' e' s'.
Proof.
  intros n e s e' s' H. inversion H. eexists. eexists. split; eassumption.
Qed.

(* Prefix decomposition along the unique deterministic path to a value. *)
Lemma redm_n_prefix : forall n e s e' s',
  redm_n n e s e' s' -> value e' ->
  forall j e1 s1, redm_n j e s e1 s1 ->
    (j = 0 /\ e1 = e /\ s1 = s) \/
    (exists m, redm_n m e1 s1 e' s' /\ j + m = n).
Proof.
  intros n e s e' s' H. induction H as [e0 s0 | n e0 s0 e'' s'' e1 s1 Hred Htail IH];
    intros Hval j e2 s2 H2.
  - destruct j as [|j'].
    + destruct (redm_n_zero_inv e0 s0 e2 s2 H2) as [He Hs]. subst e2. subst s2.
      left. split; [reflexivity | split; reflexivity].
    + destruct (redm_n_succ_inv j' e0 s0 e2 s2 H2) as [eb [sb [Hred2 _]]].
      exfalso. eapply value_no_red; [exact Hval | exact Hred2].
  - destruct j as [|j'].
    + destruct (redm_n_zero_inv e0 s0 e2 s2 H2) as [He Hs]. subst e2. subst s2.
      left. split; [reflexivity | split; reflexivity].
    + destruct (redm_n_succ_inv j' e0 s0 e2 s2 H2) as [eb [sb [Hred2 Htail2]]].
      destruct (red_det e0 s0 e'' s'' Hred eb sb Hred2) as [He Hs]. subst eb. subst sb.
      destruct (IH Hval j' e2 s2 Htail2) as [[Hj [Heq Hs2]] | [m [Hmn Hsum]]].
      * subst j'. subst e2. subst s2.
        right. exists n. split.
        -- exact Htail.
        -- lia.
      * right. exists m. split; [exact Hmn | lia].
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Local exclusion lemmas for the destructive steps.            *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma typing_seal_any_not_box : forall E R e T,
  typing E R (exp_seal e) (typ_box T) -> False.
Proof. intros. eapply typing_seal_not_box; eauto. Qed.

Lemma typing_seal_any_not_record : forall E R e a T,
  typing E R (exp_seal e) (typ_record a T) -> False.
Proof. intros. eapply typing_seal_not_record; eauto. Qed.

(* If g1 is a sealing of a reference and g1 is typed at box T, then g1 is
   literally the reference (no extra seal). *)
Lemma sealcomp_ref_typed_box :
  forall E R l g1 T,
    sealcomp (exp_ref l) g1 ->
    typing E R g1 (typ_box T) ->
    g1 = exp_ref l.
Proof.
  intros E R l g1 T Hsc Hty.
  destruct (ref_shape l g1 Hsc) as [k Heq]. subst g1.
  destruct k as [|k'].
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso. eapply typing_seal_any_not_box; [exact Hty].
Qed.

(* Same for a record at a record type. *)
Lemma sealcomp_record_typed_record :
  forall E R r g1 a T,
    sealcomp (exp_record r) g1 ->
    typing E R g1 (typ_record a T) ->
    exists r1, g1 = exp_record r1 /\ sealcomp_rec_comp r r1.
Proof.
  intros E R r g1 a T Hsc Hty.
  destruct (record_shape r g1 Hsc) as [k [r1 [Heq Hrc]]]. subst g1.
  destruct k as [|k'].
  - exists r1. split; [reflexivity | exact Hrc].
  - exfalso. eapply typing_seal_any_not_record; [exact Hty].
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* red_set_box_ref is simulable whenever the first argument of  *)
(* the typed set_box is the reference (the only possible case   *)
(* under typing) and the stripped e-argument is a value.        *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma set_box_ref_reduces :
  forall E R ns l e2 g1 g2 T,
    typing E R (exp_set_box g1 g2) T ->
    typing_store E R ns ->
    sealcomp (exp_ref l) g1 ->
    sealcomp e2 g2 ->
    value e2 ->
    expr g2 ->
    exists f' ns', redm (exp_set_box g1 g2) ns f' ns'.
Proof.
  intros E R ns l e2 g1 g2 T Hty Hst Hsc1 Hsc2 Hv2 Hexpr2.
  destruct (typing_set_box_inv E R g1 g2 T Hty) as [T1 [Hg1 [Hg2 _]]].
  assert (Hg1ref : g1 = exp_ref l).
  { eapply sealcomp_ref_typed_box; [exact Hsc1 | exact Hg1]. }
  subst g1.
  destruct (typing_ref_inv E R l (typ_box T1) Hg1) as [T0 [Hb _]].
  destruct (proj1 (Hst l) T0 Hb) as [v [Hm [Htyv Hvalv]]].
  pose proof (typing_store_wf_store E R ns Hst) as Hwfns.
  destruct (value_seal_redm e2 g2 ns Hv2 Hsc2 Hexpr2 Hwfns)
    as [g2' [Hred [Hval' Hsc']]].
  exists v, (LabelMapImpl.add l g2' ns).
  eapply redm_trans with (e':=exp_set_box (exp_ref l) g2') (s':=ns).
  - eapply redm_set_box_2; [apply value_ref | exact Hred].
  - eapply redm_step with (e'':=v) (s'':=LabelMapImpl.add l g2' ns).
    + eapply red_set_box_ref; [exact Hwfns | exact Hvalv | exact Hval' | exact Hm].
    + apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* red_record_write_ref is simulable whenever the first argument *)
(* of the typed record_write is the record (no extra seal).     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma record_write_ref_reduces :
  forall E R ns a l r e2 g1 g2 v T,
    typing E R (exp_record_write g1 a g2) T ->
    well_formed_store ns ->
    sealcomp (exp_record r) g1 ->
    value_record_comp r ->

    sealcomp e2 g2 ->
    value e2 ->

Proof.

  destruct (typing_record_write_inv E R g1 a g2 T Hty) as [T1 [Hg1 [Hg2 _]]].
  destruct (sealcomp_record_typed_record E R r g1 a T1 Hsc1 Hg1) as [r1 [Heq Hrc]].
  subst g1.
  assert (Hlook' : record_lookup_ref a r1 = Some l).

  pose proof (value_record_comp_sealcomp_up r r1 Hrc Hvrc) as Hvrc1.

Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Unboxing a (possibly multiply sealed) reference: the extra   *)
(* seals never block the step; they are just peeled first.      *)
(* The result is the target-side spelling of the source result. *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma unbox_ref_reduces :

    well_formed_store ns ->
    LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l w' ns ->
    sealcomp w w' ->
    exists f', redm (exp_unbox (seal_pow j (exp_ref l))) ns f' ns /\

Lemma record_read_ref_reduces :

    well_formed_store ns ->

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Iterated readonly and typing-root stripping.                 *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Fixpoint ro_pow (k : nat) (T : typ) : typ :=
  match k with
  | 0 => T
  | S k' => typ_mut mut_readonly (ro_pow k' T)
  end.

Lemma wf_typ_ro_pow : forall E T, wf_typ E T -> forall k, wf_typ E (ro_pow k T).
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction k; simpl.
  - exact H.
  - apply wf_typ_readonly. exact IHk.
Qed.

Lemma typing_seal_pow : forall E R e T,
  typing E R e T -> forall k, typing E R (seal_pow k e) (ro_pow k T).
Proof.
  intros E R e T H. induction k; simpl.
  - exact H.
  - apply typing_seal. exact IHk.
Qed.

Lemma sub_ro_pow_self : forall E T,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> forall k, sub E T (ro_pow k T).
Proof.
  intros E T Hwe Hwt. induction k; simpl.
  - apply sub_refl_wf; assumption.
  - apply sub_readonly_mutable. exact IHk.
Qed.

Lemma sub_ro_pow : forall E A B, sub E A B ->
  forall k, sub E (ro_pow k A) (ro_pow k B).
Proof.
  intros E A B H. induction k; simpl.
  - exact H.
  - apply sub_readonly. exact IHk.
Qed.

Lemma typing_root_strip : forall E R k f0 T,
  typing E R (seal_pow k f0) T -> wf_sig E R ->
  exists T0, typing E R f0 T0 /\ sub E (ro_pow k T0) T.
Proof.
  intros E R k. induction k as [|k IH]; simpl; intros f0 T Hty Hsig.
  - exists T. split; [exact Hty |].
    apply sub_refl_wf.
    + exact (wf_sig_wf_env E R Hsig).
    + eapply typing_wf_typ; eassumption.
  - destruct (typing_seal_inv E R (seal_pow k f0) T Hty) as [S [Hinner [Heq | Hsub]]].
    + subst T.
      destruct (IH f0 S Hinner Hsig) as [T0 [Hf0 Hsub0]].
      exists T0. split; [exact Hf0 |].
      eapply sub_trans.
      * apply sub_readonly. exact Hsub0.
      * apply sub_refl_wf.
        -- exact (wf_sig_wf_env E R Hsig).
        -- apply wf_typ_readonly. eapply typing_wf_typ; eassumption.
    + destruct (IH f0 S Hinner Hsig) as [T0 [Hf0 Hsub0]].
      exists T0. split; [exact Hf0 |].
      eapply sub_trans.
      * apply sub_readonly. exact Hsub0.
      * exact Hsub.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Typing-preserving peel of the extra seals on a value.        *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma value_seal_redm_typed : forall E R v g T ns,
  value v -> sealcomp v g -> typing E R g T -> wf_sig E R ->
  well_formed_store ns ->
  exists g', redm g ns g' ns /\ value g' /\ sealcomp v g' /\ typing E R g' T.
Proof.
  intros E R v g T ns Hv Hsc Hty Hsig Hwf.
  pose proof (wf_sig_wf_env E R Hsig) as Hwe.
  destruct Hv as [T0 body Hexpr_body | T0 body Hexpr_body | l | l | r Hvrc | r Hvrc].
  - (* abs *)
    destruct (abs_shape T0 body g Hsc) as [k [f1 [Heq Hsc1]]]. subst g.
    destruct (typing_root_strip E R k (exp_abs T0 f1) T Hty Hsig) as [T1 [Hcore Hsub]].
    exists (exp_abs T0 f1). split; [| split; [| split]].
    + apply abs_strip; [exact Hwf | eapply typing_expr; eassumption].
    + apply value_abs. eapply typing_expr; eassumption.
    + apply sealcomp_abs; exact Hsc1.
    + eapply typing_sub; [exact Hsig | exact Hcore |].
      eapply sub_trans.
      * apply sub_ro_pow_self; [exact Hwe |].
        eapply typing_wf_typ; eassumption.
      * exact Hsub.
  - (* tabs *)
    destruct (tabs_shape T0 body g Hsc) as [k [f1 [Heq Hsc1]]]. subst g.
    destruct (typing_root_strip E R k (exp_tabs T0 f1) T Hty Hsig) as [T1 [Hcore Hsub]].
    exists (exp_tabs T0 f1). split; [| split; [| split]].
    + apply tabs_strip; [exact Hwf | eapply typing_expr; eassumption].
    + apply value_tabs. eapply typing_expr; eassumption.
    + apply sealcomp_tabs; exact Hsc1.
    + eapply typing_sub; [exact Hsig | exact Hcore |].
      eapply sub_trans.
      * apply sub_ro_pow_self; [exact Hwe |].
        eapply typing_wf_typ; eassumption.
      * exact Hsub.
  - (* ref *)
    destruct (ref_shape l g Hsc) as [k Heq]. subst g.
    destruct (typing_root_strip E R k (exp_ref l) T Hty Hsig) as [T1 [Hcore Hsub]].
    exists (seal_pow (min1 k) (exp_ref l)). split; [| split; [| split]].
    + apply ref_strip; exact Hwf.
    + destruct k as [|k']; simpl. apply value_ref. apply value_sealed_ref.
    + apply sealcomp_pow_right with (k:=min1 k). apply sealcomp_refl.
    + destruct k as [|k'].
      * simpl in Hsub. eapply typing_sub; [exact Hsig | exact Hcore | exact Hsub].
      * simpl. eapply typing_sub.
        -- exact Hsig.
        -- eapply typing_seal. exact Hcore.
        -- eapply sub_trans.
           ++ apply sub_readonly. apply sub_ro_pow_self; [exact Hwe |].
              eapply typing_wf_typ; eassumption.
           ++ simpl in Hsub. exact Hsub.
  - (* sealed ref *)
    destruct (seal_lhs_shape (exp_ref l) g Hsc) as [k [f0 [Heq Hsc0]]]. subst g.
    destruct (ref_shape l f0 Hsc0) as [k0 Heq0]. subst f0.
    rewrite <- (seal_pow_add (S k) k0 (exp_ref l)) in Hty.
    destruct (typing_root_strip E R (S k + k0) (exp_ref l) T Hty Hsig)
      as [T1 [Hcore Hsub]].
    exists (exp_seal (exp_ref l)). split; [| split; [| split]].
    + rewrite <- (seal_pow_add (S k) k0 (exp_ref l)). apply ref_strip; exact Hwf.
    + apply value_sealed_ref.
    + apply sealcomp_refl.
    + simpl. eapply typing_sub.
      * exact Hsig.
      * eapply typing_seal. exact Hcore.
      * eapply sub_trans.
        -- apply sub_readonly. apply sub_ro_pow_self; [exact Hwe |].
           eapply typing_wf_typ; eassumption.
        -- simpl in Hsub. exact Hsub.
  - (* record *)
    destruct (record_shape r g Hsc) as [k [r1 [Heq Hsc1]]]. subst g.
    destruct (typing_root_strip E R k (exp_record r1) T Hty Hsig) as [T1 [Hcore Hsub]].
    pose proof (value_record_comp_sealcomp_up r r1 Hsc1 Hvrc) as Hvrc1.
    exists (seal_pow (min1 k) (exp_record r1)). split; [| split; [| split]].
    + apply record_strip; [exact Hwf | exact Hvrc1].
    + destruct k as [|k']; simpl. apply value_record; exact Hvrc1.
      apply value_sealed_record; exact Hvrc1.
    + apply sealcomp_pow_right with (k:=min1 k). apply sealcomp_record; exact Hsc1.
    + destruct k as [|k'].
      * simpl in Hsub. eapply typing_sub; [exact Hsig | exact Hcore | exact Hsub].
      * simpl. eapply typing_sub.
        -- exact Hsig.
        -- eapply typing_seal. exact Hcore.
        -- eapply sub_trans.
           ++ apply sub_readonly. apply sub_ro_pow_self; [exact Hwe |].

  - (* sealed record *)

    destruct (record_shape r f0 Hsc0) as [k0 [r1 [Heq0 Hsc1]]]. subst f0.
    rewrite <- (seal_pow_add (S k) k0 (exp_record r1)) in Hty.
    destruct (typing_root_strip E R (S k + k0) (exp_record r1) T Hty Hsig)
      as [T1 [Hcore Hsub]].
    pose proof (value_record_comp_sealcomp_up r r1 Hsc1 Hvrc) as Hvrc1.
    exists (exp_seal (exp_record r1)). split; [| split; [| split]].
    + rewrite <- (seal_pow_add (S k) k0 (exp_record r1)). apply record_strip; assumption.
    + apply value_sealed_record; exact Hvrc1.
    + apply sealcomp_seal. apply sealcomp_record; exact Hsc1.
    + simpl. eapply typing_sub.
      * exact Hsig.
      * eapply typing_seal. exact Hcore.
      * eapply sub_trans.
        -- apply sub_readonly. apply sub_ro_pow_self; [exact Hwe |].
           eapply typing_wf_typ; eassumption.
        -- simpl in Hsub. exact Hsub.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Forward simulation architecture.                             *)
(*                                                              *)
(* The whole theorem reduces to [fwd_step] below.  The assembly *)
(* is verified; [fwd_step] is the single remaining obligation.  *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Section ForwardAssembly.

(* Single source step simulated by the target, preserving a typed  *)
(* invariant.  [T'] is the type of the new target term, related   *)
(* to the old type [T] by subtyping.  The signature [R] may be    *)
(* extended (fresh reference allocation).                         *)
Variable fwd_step : forall e s e1 s1,
  red e s e1 s1 ->
  forall f ns R T,
    expr e -> expr f ->
    well_formed_store s -> sealcomp_store s ns -> s <s= ns ->
    sealcomp e f ->
    wf_sig empty R -> typing_store empty R ns -> typing empty R f T ->
    exists f1 ns1 R' T',
      redm f ns f1 ns1 /\
      sealcomp e1 f1 /\
      well_formed_store s1 /\ s1 <s= ns1 /\
      wf_sig empty R' /\ typing_store empty R' ns1 /\
      typing empty R' f1 T' /\ sub empty T' T /\
      expr e1 /\ expr f1.

Lemma fwd_multi : forall e s e' s', redm e s e' s' ->
  forall f ns R T,
    expr e -> expr f ->
    well_formed_store s -> sealcomp_store s ns -> s <s= ns ->
    sealcomp e f ->
    wf_sig empty R -> typing_store empty R ns -> typing empty R f T ->
    exists f' ns' R' T',
      redm f ns f' ns' /\
      sealcomp e' f' /\

Fixpoint app_shape (e1' e2' : exp) (f : exp) (H : sealcomp (exp_app e1' e2') f) {struct f} :
  exists k f1 f2, f = seal_pow k (exp_app f1 f2) /\ sealcomp e1' f1 /\ sealcomp e2' f2.
Proof.
  destruct_f f; try (inversion H).
  destruct (sealcomp_app_inv _ _ _ H) as [ea1 [ea2 [Heq [Hsc1 Hsc2]]]].
  injection Heq as Heq1 Heq2. subst. exists 0, f1, f2. split; [reflexivity | split; assumption].
  destruct (sealcomp_seal_inv _ _ H) as [[e0 [Heq Hsc]] | Hsc].
  - inversion Heq.
  - destruct (app_shape e1' e2' f1 Hsc) as [k [f0 [f2 [Heq [Hs1 Hs2]]]]]. subst.
    exists (S k), f0, f2. split; [reflexivity | split; assumption].
Defined.

Fixpoint typing_record_inv (E:env) (R:sig) (rg:rec_comp) (T:typ)
  (H : typing E R (exp_record rg) T) {struct H} :
  exists Tr, typing_record_comp E R rg Tr /\ (T = Tr \/ sub E Tr T).
Proof.
  inversion H; subst.
  - match goal with
    | H' : typing E R (exp_record rg) ?S, Hsub : sub E S T |- _ =>
      pose proof Hsub as Hsubkeep;
      destruct (typing_record_inv E R rg S H') as [Tr [G [Heq | Hsub2]]]
    end.
    + subst S. exists Tr. split; [exact G | right; exact Hsubkeep].
    + exists Tr. split; [exact G | right; eapply sub_trans; eauto].
  - exists T. split; [assumption | left; reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma red_expr_preserve : forall e s e' s',
  red e s e' s' -> expr e -> expr e'.
Proof.
  intros e s e' s' H He.
  apply (redm_expr e s e' s').
  - apply redm_step with (e'':=e') (s'':=s').
    + exact H.
    + apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
  - exact He.
Qed.

Fixpoint typing_ref_sub_inv (E:env) (R:sig) (l:label) (T:typ)
  (H : typing E R (exp_ref l) T) {struct H} :
  exists T1, Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T1) R /\ sub E (typ_box T1) T.
Proof.
  inversion H; subst.
  - match goal with
    | H' : typing E R (exp_ref l) ?S, Hsub : sub E S T |- _ =>
      pose proof Hsub as Hsubkeep;
      destruct (typing_ref_sub_inv E R l S H') as [T1 [Hb Hsub2]]
    end.
    + exists T1. split; [exact Hb | eapply sub_trans; eassumption].
  - match goal with
    | Hb : Signatures.binds l (bind_sig ?X) R |- _ =>
      exists X; split; [exact Hb |]
    end.
    apply sub_refl_wf.
    + eapply wf_sig_wf_env; eassumption.
    + eapply typing_wf_typ; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma sim2_multi : forall f ns f' ns', redm f ns f' ns' -> forall e s,
  expr f -> expr e -> well_formed_store s -> s <s= ns -> sealcomp e f ->
  exists e' s', redm e s e' s' /\ s' <s= ns' /\ sealcomp e' f' /\
  well_formed_store s' /\ expr f' /\ expr e'.
Proof.
  intros f ns f' ns' H. induction H as
    [ f0 s0 f1 s1 Heq Hseq | f0 s0 f2 s2 f1 s1 Hred Hredm IHredm ]; intros e s Hf He Hwf Hst Hsc.
  - subst. exists e, s. split.
    + apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
    + split; [exact Hst | split; [exact Hsc | split; [exact Hwf | split; [exact Hf | exact He]]]].
  - destruct (sim2_step f0 s0 f2 s2 Hred e s Hf He Hwf Hst Hsc)
      as [e1 [s1' [Hred1 [Hst1 [Hsc1 [Hwf1 [Hf1 He1]]]]]]].
    destruct (IHredm e1 s1' Hf1 He1 Hwf1 Hst1 Hsc1)
      as [e' [s' [Hred2 [Hst2 [Hsc2 [Hwf2 [Hf2 He2]]]]]]].
    exists e', s'. split.
    + apply redm_trans with (e':=e1) (s':=s1'); assumption.
    + split; [exact Hst2 | split; [exact Hsc2 | split; [exact Hwf2 | split; [exact Hf2 | exact He2]]]].
Qed.

Lemma safety_value_multistep'_proof : forall e s f ns f' ns',
  expr f ->
  expr e ->
  well_formed_store s ->
  sealcomp_store s ns ->
  sealcomp e f ->
  redm f ns f' ns' ->
  value f' ->
  (exists e' s', redm e s e' s' /\ sealcomp_store s' ns' /\ sealcomp e' f' /\ value e').
Proof.
  intros e s f ns f' ns' Hf He Hwf Hst Hsc Hred Hvf.
  destruct (sim2_multi f ns f' ns' Hred e s Hf He Hwf Hst Hsc)
    as [e' [s' [Hred' [Hst' [Hsc' [Hwf' [Hf' He']]]]]]].
  exists e', s'. split; [exact Hred' | split; [exact Hst' | split; [exact Hsc' | apply value_sealcomp_down with (f:=f'); assumption]]].
Qed.


(* ================= typing inversion (equality-or-sub form) ================= *)
Fixpoint typing_app_inv (E:env) (R:sig) (e1 e2:exp) (T:typ)
  (H : typing E R (exp_app e1 e2) T) {struct H} :
  exists T1 T2, typing E R e1 (typ_arrow T1 T2) /\ typing E R e2 T1 /\
    (T = T2 \/ sub E T2 T).
Proof.
  inversion H; subst.
  - exists T1, T. split; [exact H5 | split; [exact H7 | left; reflexivity]].
  - destruct (typing_app_inv E R e1 e2 S H1) as [T1 [T2 [G1 [G2 [Heq | Hsub]]]]].
    + exists T1, T2. split; [exact G1 | split; [exact G2 |]]. subst S. right. exact H2.
    + exists T1, T2. split; [exact G1 | split; [exact G2 |]]. right. eapply sub_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma wf_sig_wf_env : forall E R, wf_sig E R -> wf_env E.
Proof. intros E R H. induction H; assumption. Qed.
Scheme typing_mut := Induction for typing Sort Prop
  with typing_rc_mut := Induction for typing_record_comp Sort Prop.
Lemma typing_wf_env : forall E R e T, typing E R e T -> wf_env E.
Proof.
  intros E R e T H.
  induction H using typing_mut with (P0 := fun E R r T (h:typing_record_comp E R r T) => wf_env E).
  all: eauto using wf_sig_wf_env.
Qed.

Lemma wf_typ_weaken_binds : forall E T, wf_typ E T ->
  forall E', (forall X b, binds X b E -> binds X b E') -> wf_typ E' T.
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction H; intros E' Hb.
  - apply wf_typ_top.
  - apply wf_typ_var with (U:=U). apply Hb. exact H.
  - apply wf_typ_arrow; [apply IHwf_typ1 | apply IHwf_typ2]; assumption.
  - apply wf_typ_all with (L:=L).
    + apply IHwf_typ. exact Hb.
    + intros X HX. apply H1 with (E':=X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E'); [exact HX |].
      intros Y b HY. destruct (binds_cons_1 _ _ _ _ _ _ HY) as [[Heq1 Heq2] | HE].
      * subst. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity.
      * apply binds_cons. apply Hb. exact HE.
  - apply wf_typ_box. apply IHwf_typ. exact Hb.
  - apply wf_typ_readonly. apply IHwf_typ. exact Hb.
  - apply wf_typ_intersect; [apply IHwf_typ1 | apply IHwf_typ2]; assumption.
  - apply wf_typ_record. apply IHwf_typ. exact Hb.
Qed.

Fixpoint typing_tapp_inv (E:env) (R:sig) (e1:exp) (T T2:typ)
  (H : typing E R (exp_tapp e1 T) T2) {struct H} :
  exists T1 T3, typing E R e1 (typ_all T1 T3) /\ sub E T T1 /\
    (T2 = open_tt T3 T \/ sub E (open_tt T3 T) T2).
Proof.
  inversion H; subst.
  - eexists. eexists. split; [eassumption | split; [eassumption | left; reflexivity]].
  - match goal with
    | H' : typing E R (exp_tapp e1 T) ?S |- _ =>
      destruct (typing_tapp_inv E R e1 T S H') as [T1 [T3 [G1 [G2 [Heq | Hsub]]]]]
    end.
    + eexists. eexists. split; [exact G1 | split; [exact G2 |]]. subst S. right. assumption.
    + eexists. eexists. split; [exact G1 | split; [exact G2 |]]. right. eapply sub_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Fixpoint typing_unbox_inv (E:env) (R:sig) (e:exp) (T:typ)
  (H : typing E R (exp_unbox e) T) {struct H} :
  (exists T1, typing E R e (typ_box T1) /\ (T = T1 \/ sub E T1 T)) \/
  (exists T1, typing E R e (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box T1)) /\
     (T = typ_mut mut_readonly T1 \/ sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly T1) T)).
Proof.
  inversion H; subst.
  all: first [
    match goal with
    | H' : typing ?E0 ?R0 (exp_unbox ?e0) ?S |- _ =>
      destruct (typing_unbox_inv E0 R0 e0 S H') as [[T1 [G1 [Heq | Hsub]]] | [T1 [G1 [Heq | Hsub]]]];
      [ (left; eexists; split; [exact G1 | subst S; right; assumption])
      | (left; eexists; split; [exact G1 | right; eapply sub_trans; eauto])
      | (right; eexists; split; [exact G1 | subst S; right; assumption])
      | (right; eexists; split; [exact G1 | right; eapply sub_trans; eauto]) ]
    end
  | match goal with H' : typing ?E0 ?R0 ?e0 (typ_box ?T1) |- _ =>
      left; eexists; split; [exact H' | left; reflexivity] end
  | match goal with H' : typing ?E0 ?R0 ?e0 (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box ?T1)) |- _ =>
      right; eexists; split; [exact H' | left; reflexivity] end ].
Qed.

  arrow_pred E A B T2 -> sub E T2 T3 -> arrow_pred E A B T3.
Proof.
  intros E A B T2 T3 Hp Hs.
  pose proof (sub_wf_env E T2 T3 Hs) as Hwe.
  dependent induction Hs.
  - (* top *) exact I.
  - (* refl_tvar *) inversion Hp.
  - (* trans_tvar *) inversion Hp.
  - (* arrow *) simpl in Hp. destruct Hp as [Hpa Hpb]. simpl.
    split.
    + eapply sub_trans; eassumption.
    + eapply sub_trans; eassumption.
  - (* all *) inversion Hp.
  - (* box *) inversion Hp.
  - (* readonly *) simpl in Hp. simpl. apply IHHs; [exact Hp | exact Hwe].
  - (* readonly_mutable *) simpl. apply IHHs; [exact Hp | exact Hwe].
  - (* trans *) simpl. apply IHHs2; [apply IHHs1; [exact Hp | exact Hwe] | exact Hwe].

Inductive typing : env -> sig -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
  | typing_var : forall E R x T,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_sig E R ->
      binds x (bind_typ T) E ->
      typing E R (exp_fvar x) T
  | typing_abs : forall L E R V e1 T1,
      wf_sig E R ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) R (open_ee e1 x) T1) ->
      typing E R (exp_abs V e1) (typ_arrow V T1)
  | typing_app : forall T1 E R e1 e2 T2,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 (typ_arrow T1 T2) ->
      typing E R e2 T1 ->
      typing E R (exp_app e1 e2) T2
  | typing_tabs : forall L E R V e1 T1,
      wf_sig E R ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        typing (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) R (open_te e1 X) (open_tt T1 X)) ->
      typing E R (exp_tabs V e1) (typ_all V T1)
  | typing_tapp : forall T1 E R e1 T T2,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 (typ_all T1 T2) ->
      sub E T T1 ->
      typing E R (exp_tapp e1 T) (open_tt T2 T)
  | typing_sub : forall S E R e T,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e S ->
      sub E S T ->
      typing E R e T
  | typing_let : forall L T1 T2 e1 e2 E R,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 T1 ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E) R (open_ee e2 x) T2) ->
      typing E R (exp_let e1 e2) T2
  | typing_box : forall E R e T,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e T ->
      typing E R (exp_box e) (typ_box T)
  | typing_unbox : forall E R e T,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e (typ_box T) ->
      typing E R (exp_unbox e) T

  | typing_set_box : forall E R e1 e2 T,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 (typ_box T) ->
      typing E R e2 T ->
      typing E R (exp_set_box e1 e2) T
  | typing_ref : forall E R l T,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_sig E R ->
      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
      typing E R (exp_ref l) (typ_box T)

  | typing_seal : forall E R e T,

  | typing_record : forall E R r T,

Lemma wf_env_binds_fun : forall E, wf_env E ->
  forall z b1 b2, binds z b1 E -> binds z b2 E -> b1 = b2.
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H; intros z b1 b2 K1 K2.
  - apply binds_nil_iff in K1. destruct K1.
  - apply binds_cons_iff in K1. apply binds_cons_iff in K2.
    destruct K1 as [[Heq1 Hb1] | K1]; destruct K2 as [[Heq2 Hb2] | K2].
    + subst. reflexivity.
    + subst. exfalso. eapply binds_dom_contradiction; eauto.
    + subst. exfalso. eapply binds_dom_contradiction; eauto.
    + exact (IHwf_env z b1 b2 K1 K2).
  - apply binds_cons_iff in K1. apply binds_cons_iff in K2.
    destruct K1 as [[Heq1 Hb1] | K1]; destruct K2 as [[Heq2 Hb2] | K2].
    + subst. reflexivity.
    + subst. exfalso. eapply binds_dom_contradiction; eauto.
    + subst. exfalso. eapply binds_dom_contradiction; eauto.
    + exact (IHwf_env z b1 b2 K1 K2).
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_cons_inv : forall y b D', wf_env ((y,b) :: D') ->
  wf_env D' /\
  (forall T, b = bind_sub T -> wf_typ D' T) /\
  (forall T, b = bind_typ T -> wf_typ D' T) /\
  y `notin` dom D'.
Proof.
  intros y b D' H. inversion H; subst.
  - split; [exact H3 | split; [intros T0 Heq; inversion Heq; subst T0; exact H4 |
      split; [intros T0 Heq; inversion Heq | exact H5]]].
  - split; [exact H3 | split; [intros T0 Heq; inversion Heq |
      split; [intros T0 Heq; inversion Heq; subst T0; exact H4 | exact H5]]].
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_notin_tail : forall D X b E0,
  wf_env (D ++ X ~ b ++ E0) -> X `notin` dom E0.
Proof.
  induction D as [|[y b'] D IH]; intros X b E0 H.
  - simpl in H. pose proof (wf_env_cons_inv X b E0 H) as [_ [_ [_ Hnotin]]]. exact Hnotin.
  - simpl in H. pose proof (wf_env_cons_inv y b' (D ++ X ~ b ++ E0) H) as [Htail _].
    apply (IH X b E0 Htail).
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_wf_tail : forall D X U E0,
  wf_env (D ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E0) -> wf_typ E0 U.
Proof.
  induction D as [|[y b'] D IH]; intros X U E0 H.
  - simpl in H. pose proof (wf_env_cons_inv X (bind_sub U) E0 H) as [_ [Hsub _]].
    apply (Hsub U eq_refl).
  - simpl in H. pose proof (wf_env_cons_inv y b' (D ++ X ~ bind_sub U ++ E0) H) as [Htail _].
    apply (IH X U E0 Htail).
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_notin_prefix : forall D X b E0,
  wf_env (D ++ X ~ b ++ E0) -> X `notin` dom D.
Proof.
  induction D as [|[y b'] D IH]; intros X b E0 H.
  - simpl. apply notin_empty.
  - simpl in H. pose proof (wf_env_cons_inv y b' (D ++ X ~ b ++ E0) H) as [Htail [_ [_ Hfresh]]].
    pose proof (IH X b E0 Htail) as HXD.
    simpl. apply notin_add.
    + intro Heq.
      assert (Hin : X `in` dom (D ++ X ~ b ++ E0)).
      { apply binds_In with (A:=binding) (x:=X) (a:=b).
        apply binds_app_3. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity. }
      apply Hfresh. rewrite Heq. exact Hin.
    + exact HXD.
Qed.
