Inductive expr : exp -> Prop :=
  | expr_var : forall x,
      expr (exp_fvar x)
  | expr_abs : forall L T e1,
      type T ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e1 x)) ->
      expr (exp_abs T e1)
  | expr_app : forall e1 e2,
      expr e1 ->
      expr e2 ->
      expr (exp_app e1 e2)
  | expr_tabs : forall L T e1,
      type T ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> expr (open_te e1 X)) ->
      expr (exp_tabs T e1)
  | expr_tapp : forall e1 V,
      expr e1 ->
      type V ->
      expr (exp_tapp e1 V)
  | expr_let : forall L e1 e2,
      expr e1 ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e2 x)) ->
      expr (exp_let e1 e2)
  | expr_box : forall e,
      expr e ->
      expr (exp_box e)
  | expr_unbox : forall e,
      expr e ->
      expr (exp_unbox e)
  | expr_set_box : forall e1 e2,
      expr e1 ->
      expr e2 ->
      expr (exp_set_box e1 e2)
  | expr_ref : forall l,
      expr (exp_ref l)
  | expr_seal : forall e,
      expr e ->
      expr (exp_seal e)
  | expr_record : forall r,
      record_comp r ->
      expr (exp_record r)
  | expr_record_read : forall e a,
      expr e ->
      expr (exp_record_read e a)
  | expr_record_write : forall e1 a e2,
      expr e1 ->
      expr e2 ->
      expr (exp_record_write e1 a e2)
with record_comp : rec_comp -> Prop :=
  | record_comp_empty :
      record_comp (rec_empty)
  | record_comp_exp : forall a e r,
      expr e ->
      record_comp r ->
      record_comp (rec_exp a e r)
  | record_comp_ref : forall a e r,
      record_comp r ->
      record_comp (rec_ref a e r)
.

Definition body_e (e : exp) :=
  exists L, forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e x).

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : typ -> binding

From Stdlib Require Import Lia.
From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Spine lookup / head atoms for the nested-int record shape.   *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Fixpoint rec_field (a : atom) (T : typ) : option typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_record b C => if (a === b) then Some C else None
  | typ_int U W =>
      match rec_field a U with
      | Some C => Some C
      | None => rec_field a W
      end
  | _ => None
  end.

Fixpoint rec_heads (T : typ) : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_int U W => union (rec_heads U) (rec_heads W)
  | typ_record a _ => singleton a
  | _ => AtomSetImpl.empty
  end.

Inductive nested_rec : typ -> Prop :=
  | nested_rec_top : nested_rec typ_top
  | nested_rec_int : forall a C R,
      nested_rec R ->
      a `notin` rec_heads R ->
      nested_rec (typ_int (typ_record a C) R).

Lemma rec_field_heads : forall T a,
  match rec_field a T with
  | Some C => a `in` rec_heads T
  | None => ~ a `in` rec_heads T
  end.
Proof.
  intros T. induction T; intros x; simpl.
  - (* top *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H).
  - (* bvar *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H).
  - (* fvar *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H).
  - (* arrow *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H).
  - (* all *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H).
  - (* box *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H).
  - (* mut *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H).
  - (* int *)
    destruct (rec_field x T1) as [C|] eqn:E1.
    + specialize (IHT1 x) as H1. rewrite E1 in H1. simpl in H1.
      simpl. apply AtomSetImpl.union_2. exact H1.
    + specialize (IHT1 x) as H1. rewrite E1 in H1. simpl in H1.
      simpl. destruct (rec_field x T2) as [C|] eqn:E2.
      * specialize (IHT2 x) as H2. rewrite E2 in H2. simpl in H2.
        apply AtomSetImpl.union_3. exact H2.
      * intro H. apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in H. destruct H as [H|H].
        -- exact (H1 H).
        -- specialize (IHT2 x) as H2. rewrite E2 in H2. simpl in H2. exact (H2 H).
  - (* record *)
    destruct (x === a) as [e|ne].
    + simpl. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. symmetry. exact e.
    + simpl. intro H. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_1 in H. exact (ne (symmetry H)).
Qed.

Lemma rec_field_None_iff : forall T a,
  rec_field a T = None <-> ~ a `in` rec_heads T.
Proof.
  intros T a. pose proof (rec_field_heads T a) as H.
  destruct (rec_field a T) as [C|] eqn:E; simpl in H; split.
  - intro Hnone. discriminate Hnone.
  - intro Hnot. exfalso. exact (Hnot H).
  - intros _ Hc. exact (H Hc).
  - intros _. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma rec_field_Some_of_in : forall T a,
  a `in` rec_heads T -> exists C, rec_field a T = Some C.
Proof.
  intros T a H. destruct (rec_field a T) as [C|] eqn:E.
  - exists C. reflexivity.
  - exfalso. apply (rec_field_None_iff T a) in E. exact (E H).
Qed.

Lemma rec_field_nested_head : forall a0 C0 R a,

    | left _ => Some C0
    | right _ => rec_field a R
    end.
Proof. intros. simpl. destruct (a === a0); reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma rec_field_nf : forall T, nested_rec T ->
  forall a, rec_field a (normal_form_typing T) = option_map (normal_form_typing) (rec_field a T).
Proof.
  intros T H. induction H as [| a0 C0 R Hnr IH]; intros a.
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (a === a0) as [e|ne].
    + reflexivity.
    + simpl. apply IH.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Label-vacuous predicates on targets.                          *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Inductive Gf (E : env) (a : atom) (A : typ) : typ -> Prop :=
  | gf_top : Gf E a A typ_top
  | gf_bvar : forall n, Gf E a A (typ_bvar n)
  | gf_fvar : forall X U, binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      Gf E a A U -> Gf E a A (typ_fvar X)
  | gf_arrow : forall T1 T2, Gf E a A (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | gf_all : forall T1 T2, Gf E a A (typ_all T1 T2)
  | gf_box : forall T, Gf E a A (typ_box T)
  | gf_mut : forall m T, Gf E a A (typ_mut m T)
  | gf_int : forall T1 T2, Gf E a A T1 -> Gf E a A T2 ->
      Gf E a A (typ_int T1 T2)
  | gf_rec_eq : forall b C, a = b -> sub E A C ->
      Gf E a A (typ_record b C)
  | gf_rec_neq : forall b C, a <> b ->
      Gf E a A (typ_record b C).

Inductive Gb (E : env) (a : atom) (A : typ) : typ -> Prop :=
  | gb_top : Gb E a A typ_top
  | gb_bvar : forall n, Gb E a A (typ_bvar n)
  | gb_fvar : forall X U, binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      Gb E a A U -> Gb E a A (typ_fvar X)
  | gb_arrow : forall T1 T2, Gb E a A (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | gb_all : forall T1 T2, Gb E a A (typ_all T1 T2)
  | gb_box : forall T, Gb E a A (typ_box T)
  | gb_mut : forall m T, Gb E a A (typ_mut m T)
  | gb_int : forall T1 T2, Gb E a A T1 -> Gb E a A T2 ->
      Gb E a A (typ_int T1 T2)
  | gb_rec_eq : forall b C, a = b -> sub E C A ->
      Gb E a A (typ_record b C)
  | gb_rec_neq : forall b C, a <> b ->
      Gb E a A (typ_record b C).

(* merge_mutability always yields a label-vacuous target *)
Lemma gf_merge : forall E a A U m,
  Gf E a A (merge_mutability U m).
Proof.
  intros E a A U. induction U; intros m; simpl.
  - apply gf_top.
  - apply gf_mut.
  - apply gf_mut.
  - apply gf_arrow.
  - apply gf_all.
  - apply gf_mut.
  - apply gf_mut.
  - apply gf_int; [exact IHU1 | exact IHU2].
  - apply gf_mut.
Qed.

Lemma gb_merge : forall E a A U m,
  Gb E a A (merge_mutability U m).
Proof.
  intros E a A U. induction U; intros m; simpl.
  - apply gb_top.
  - apply gb_mut.
  - apply gb_mut.
  - apply gb_arrow.
  - apply gb_all.
  - apply gb_mut.
  - apply gb_mut.
  - apply gb_int; [exact IHU1 | exact IHU2].
  - apply gb_mut.
Qed.

Lemma gf_nf : forall E a A T, wf_env E -> wf_typ E T ->

  - split; intros _; apply gf_bvar.
  - split; intros H; exact H.
  - split; intros _; apply gf_arrow.
  - split; intros _; apply gf_all.
  - split; intros _; apply gf_box.
  - split; intros _; apply gf_merge.
  - assert (Hw1 : wf_typ E T1) by (apply (wf_typ_int_l E T1 T2); exact Hwt).
    assert (Hw2 : wf_typ E T2) by (apply (wf_typ_int_r E T1 T2); exact Hwt).
    split; intros H; inversion H; subst; apply gf_int.
    + apply (proj1 (IH T1 Hwe Hw1)). assumption.
    + apply (proj1 (IH T2 Hwe Hw2)). assumption.
    + apply (proj2 (IH T1 Hwe Hw1)). assumption.
    + apply (proj2 (IH T2 Hwe Hw2)). assumption.
  - assert (Hw1 : wf_typ E T1) by (apply (wf_typ_record_inv E b T1); exact Hwt).

    + split; intros H.
      * inversion H; subst.
        -- apply gf_rec_eq with (b:=b) eq_refl.

    + split; intros H; inversion H; subst.
      * exfalso. exact (Eab H2).
      * apply gf_rec_neq. exact Eab.
      * exfalso. exact (Eab H2).
      * apply gf_rec_neq. exact Eab.
Qed.

  (Gb E a A T <-> Gb E a A (normal_form_typing T)).
Proof.

  - split; intros _; apply gb_bvar.
  - split; intros H; exact H.
  - split; intros _; apply gb_arrow.
  - split; intros _; apply gb_all.
  - split; intros _; apply gb_box.
  - split; intros _; apply gb_merge.

      * apply gb_rec_neq. exact Eab.

      * apply gb_rec_neq. exact Eab.

Inductive Gf (E : env) (a : atom) (A : typ) : typ -> Prop :=
  | gf_top : Gf E a A typ_top
  | gf_bvar : forall n, Gf E a A (typ_bvar n)

Lemma rec_field_None_iff : forall T a,
  rec_field a T = None <-> ~ a `in` rec_heads T.
Proof.
  intros T a. pose proof (rec_field_heads T a) as H.
  destruct (rec_field a T) as [C|] eqn:E; simpl in H; split.
  - intro Hnone. discriminate Hnone.
  - intro Hnot. exfalso. exact (Hnot H).
  - intros _ Hc. exact (H Hc).
  - intros _. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma rec_field_Some_of_in : forall T a,
  a `in` rec_heads T -> exists C, rec_field a T = Some C.
Proof.
  intros T a H. destruct (rec_field a T) as [C|] eqn:E.
  - exists C. reflexivity.
  - exfalso. apply (rec_field_None_iff T a) in E. exact (E H).
Qed.

Lemma rec_field_nested_head : forall a0 C0 R a,
  rec_field a (typ_int (typ_record a0 C0) R) =

Lemma rec_field_nf : forall T, nested_rec T ->

Proof.

(* Label-vacuous predicates on targets.                          *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Inductive Gf (E : env) (a : atom) (A : typ) : typ -> Prop :=
  | gf_top : Gf E a A typ_top
  | gf_bvar : forall n, Gf E a A (typ_bvar n)
  | gf_fvar : forall X U, binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      Gf E a A U -> Gf E a A (typ_fvar X)
  | gf_arrow : forall T1 T2, Gf E a A (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | gf_all : forall T1 T2, Gf E a A (typ_all T1 T2)
  | gf_box : forall T, Gf E a A (typ_box T)
  | gf_mut : forall m T, Gf E a A (typ_mut m T)
  | gf_int : forall T1 T2, Gf E a A T1 -> Gf E a A T2 ->
      Gf E a A (typ_int T1 T2)
  | gf_rec_eq : forall b C, a = b -> sub E A C ->
      Gf E a A (typ_record b C)
  | gf_rec_neq : forall b C, a <> b ->
      Gf E a A (typ_record b C).

Inductive Gb (E : env) (a : atom) (A : typ) : typ -> Prop :=
  | gb_top : Gb E a A typ_top
  | gb_bvar : forall n, Gb E a A (typ_bvar n)
  | gb_fvar : forall X U, binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      Gb E a A U -> Gb E a A (typ_fvar X)
  | gb_arrow : forall T1 T2, Gb E a A (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | gb_all : forall T1 T2, Gb E a A (typ_all T1 T2)
  | gb_box : forall T, Gb E a A (typ_box T)
  | gb_mut : forall m T, Gb E a A (typ_mut m T)
  | gb_int : forall T1 T2, Gb E a A T1 -> Gb E a A T2 ->
      Gb E a A (typ_int T1 T2)
  | gb_rec_eq : forall b C, a = b -> sub E C A ->
      Gb E a A (typ_record b C)
  | gb_rec_neq : forall b C, a <> b ->
      Gb E a A (typ_record b C).


Lemma Gf_record_inv : forall E a A b C,

      * apply IH; [exact Hwt2 | exact Hfield].
Qed.

Definition Reach (E : env) (T : typ) : Prop :=
  exists S, nested_rec S /\ sub E S T.

Lemma Reach_sub : forall E T U,
  Reach E T -> sub E T U -> Reach E U.
Proof.
  intros E T U [S [Hn Hs]] Hsub.
  exists S. split; [exact Hn |].
  eapply sub_trans; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma Reach_nf : forall E T,
  Reach E T -> wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> Reach E (normal_form_typing T).
Proof.
  intros E T [S [Hn Hs]] Hwe Hwt.
  exists S. split; [exact Hn |].
  eapply sub_trans; [exact Hs |].
  apply sub_normal_form_typing_right; assumption.
Qed.

(* well-formed type bound for a type variable *)
Lemma wf_env_binds_sub_wf : forall E, wf_env E ->
  forall x U, binds x (bind_sub U) E -> wf_typ E U.
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H; intros xs Us Hb.
  - apply binds_nil_iff in Hb. destruct Hb.
  - simpl in Hb. apply binds_cons_iff in Hb.
    destruct Hb as [[Heq1 Heq2] | Hb].
    + inversion Heq2; subst.
      apply (wf_typ_env_sub_shape _ _ H0).
      apply env_sub_shape_prefix.
    + apply (wf_typ_weaken_binds E Us (IHwf_env xs Us Hb)
               (X ~ bind_sub T ++ E)).
      intros Y b HY. apply binds_cons_3. exact HY.
  - simpl in Hb. apply binds_cons_iff in Hb.
    destruct Hb as [[Heq1 Heq2] | Hb].
    + inversion Heq2.
    + apply (wf_typ_weaken_binds E Us (IHwf_env xs Us Hb)
               (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E)).
      intros Y b HY. apply binds_cons_3. exact HY.
Qed.

Lemma gf_pres : forall E a A T U,
  sub E T U -> Reach E T -> Gf E a A T -> Gf E a A U.
Proof.
  intros E a A T U Hsub.
  dependent induction Hsub; intros Hreach Hgf.
  - (* sub_top *) apply gf_top.
  - (* sub_refl_tvar *) exact Hgf.
  - (* sub_trans_tvar *)
    inversion Hgf; subst.
    pose proof (sub_wf_env E U T Hsub) as Hwe.
    pose proof (wf_env_binds_fun E Hwe X (bind_sub U0) (bind_sub U) H1 H) as Heq.
    inversion Heq; subst U0.
    assert (HwfU : wf_typ E U) by (apply (wf_env_binds_sub_wf E Hwe X U H)).
    assert (HreachU : Reach E U).
    { destruct Hreach as [S [Hn Hs]].
      exists S. split; [exact Hn |].
      eapply sub_trans; [exact Hs |].
      eapply sub_trans_tvar; [exact H |].
      apply sub_refl_wf; assumption. }
    apply IHHsub; assumption.
  - (* sub_arrow *) apply gf_arrow.
  - (* sub_all *) apply gf_all.
  - (* sub_box *) apply gf_box.
  - (* sub_readonly *) apply gf_mut.
  - (* sub_readonly_mutable *) apply gf_mut.
  - (* sub_trans *)
    apply IHHsub2.
    + eapply Reach_sub; [exact Hreach | exact Hsub1].
    + apply IHHsub1; [exact Hreach | exact Hgf].
  - (* sub_inter_left *) inversion Hgf; subst; assumption.
  - (* sub_inter_right *) inversion Hgf; subst; assumption.
  - (* sub_inter *)
    apply gf_int.
    + apply IHHsub1; [exact Hreach | exact Hgf].
    + apply IHHsub2; [exact Hreach | exact Hgf].
  - (* sub_record *)
    destruct (Gf_record_inv E a A a0 T1 Hgf) as [[Hab Hs]|Hne].
    + eapply gf_rec_eq; [exact Hab |].
      eapply sub_trans; [exact Hs | exact Hsub1].
    + apply gf_rec_neq; exact Hne.
  - (* sub_readonly_record *) apply gf_mut.
  - (* sub_denormalize *)
    pose proof (sub_wf_env E (normal_form_typing T1) (normal_form_typing T2) Hsub) as Hwe.
    assert (Hgf_nf : Gf E a A (normal_form_typing T1)).
    { apply (proj1 (gf_nf E a A T1 Hwe H)). exact Hgf. }
    assert (Hreach_nf : Reach E (normal_form_typing T1)).
    { apply Reach_nf; [exact Hreach | exact Hwe | exact H]. }
    specialize (IHHsub Hreach_nf Hgf_nf).
    apply (proj2 (gf_nf E a A T2 Hwe H0)). exact IHHsub.
Qed.

Lemma gb_pres : forall E a A T U,
  sub E T U -> Reach E T -> Gb E a A T -> Gb E a A U.

      apply sub_refl_wf; assumption. }
    apply IHHsub; assumption.

  - (* sub_all *) apply gb_all.
  - (* sub_box *) apply gb_box.
  - (* sub_readonly *) apply gb_mut.
  - (* sub_readonly_mutable *) apply gb_mut.
  - (* sub_trans *)
    apply IHHsub2.
    + eapply Reach_sub; [exact Hreach | exact Hsub1].
    + apply IHHsub1; [exact Hreach | exact Hgf].
  - (* sub_inter_left *) inversion Hgf; subst; assumption.
  - (* sub_inter_right *) inversion Hgf; subst; assumption.

(* Typing inversion for record components (no subtyping rule). *)
Lemma typing_rec_empty_inv : forall E R Tr,
  typing_record_comp E R rec_empty Tr -> Tr = typ_top.
Proof.
  intros E R Tr H. inversion H; subst. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma typing_rec_ref_inv : forall E R a l r Tr,
  typing_record_comp E R (rec_ref a l r) Tr ->
  exists T Tr', a `notin` record_dom r /\
    typing_record_comp E R r Tr' /\
    Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R /\
    Tr = typ_int (typ_record a T) Tr'.
Proof.
  intros E R a l r Tr H. inversion H; subst.
  repeat eexists; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma typing_record_comp_wf_env : forall E R r Tr,
  typing_record_comp E R r Tr -> wf_env E.
Proof.
  intros E R r Tr H. induction H.
  - exact H.
  - exact IHtyping_record_comp.
  - exact IHtyping_record_comp.
Qed.

Lemma typing_record_comp_wf_sig : forall E R r Tr,
  typing_record_comp E R r Tr -> wf_sig E R.
Proof.
  intros E R r Tr H. induction H.
  - exact H0.
  - exact IHtyping_record_comp.
  - exact IHtyping_record_comp.
Qed.

Lemma typing_record_comp_wf_typ : forall E R r Tr,
  wf_sig E R -> typing_record_comp E R r Tr -> wf_typ E Tr.
Proof.
  intros E R r Tr Hs H. induction H.
  - apply wf_typ_top.
  - apply wf_typ_intersect.
    + apply wf_typ_record. apply (typing_wf_typ E R e T H1 Hs).
    + exact (IHtyping_record_comp Hs).
  - apply wf_typ_intersect.
    + apply wf_typ_record. apply (wf_sig_binds_wf E R Hs l T H1).
    + exact (IHtyping_record_comp Hs).
Qed.

Lemma rec_heads_record_dom : forall E R r Tr,
  value_record_comp r -> typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
  rec_heads Tr = record_dom r.
Proof.
  intros E R r Tr Hv. revert Tr. induction Hv; intros Tr Hty.
  - apply typing_rec_empty_inv in Hty. subst Tr. reflexivity.
  - apply typing_rec_ref_inv in Hty.
    destruct Hty as (T & Tr' & Hnotin & Hty' & Hb & Heq). subst Tr.
    simpl. pose proof (IHHv Tr' Hty') as Hdom.
    rewrite Hdom. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma value_typing_nested : forall E R r Tr,
  value_record_comp r -> typing_record_comp E R r Tr -> nested_rec Tr.
Proof.
  intros E R r Tr Hv. revert Tr. induction Hv; intros Tr Hty.
  - apply typing_rec_empty_inv in Hty. subst Tr. apply nested_rec_top.
  - apply typing_rec_ref_inv in Hty.
    destruct Hty as (T & Tr' & Hnotin & Hty' & Hb & Heq). subst Tr.
    apply nested_rec_int.
    + apply IHHv. exact Hty'.
    + pose proof (rec_heads_record_dom E R r Tr' Hv Hty') as Hdom.
      rewrite Hdom. exact Hnotin.
Qed.

Lemma lookup_field_binds : forall E R r Tr a l,
  value_record_comp r -> typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
  record_lookup_ref a r = Some l ->
  exists A, rec_field a Tr = Some A /\ Signatures.binds l (bind_sig A) R.
Proof.
  intros E R r Tr a l Hv. revert Tr a l.
  induction Hv; intros Tr0 aa ll Hty Hlook.
  - simpl in Hlook. discriminate Hlook.
  - apply typing_rec_ref_inv in Hty.
    destruct Hty as (T & Tr' & Hnotin & Hty' & Hb & Heq). subst Tr0.
    simpl in Hlook.
    destruct (aa === a) as [e|ne] eqn:Eaa.
    + inversion Hlook; subst ll.
      exists T. split.
      * rewrite rec_field_nested_head. rewrite Eaa. reflexivity.
      * exact Hb.
    + destruct (IHHv Tr' aa ll Hty' Hlook) as (A & Hf & HbA).
      exists A. split; [| exact HbA].
      rewrite rec_field_nested_head. rewrite Eaa. exact Hf.
Qed.

(* Main metatheorem: the component type at a record field label *)
(* is equivalent (both sub directions) to the target field type *)
(* of any record supertype.                                      *)

Lemma record_component_sub_record :
  forall E R rg Tr a l C B,
    typing_record_comp E R rg Tr ->
    value_record_comp rg ->
    record_lookup_ref a rg = Some l ->
    Signatures.binds l (bind_sig C) R ->
    sub E Tr (typ_record a B) ->
    sub E C B /\ sub E B C.
Proof.
  intros E R rg Tr a l C B Hty Hv Hlook HbC Hsub.
  pose proof (typing_record_comp_wf_sig E R rg Tr Hty) as Hsig.
  pose proof (typing_record_comp_wf_env E R rg Tr Hty) as Hwe.
  pose proof (typing_record_comp_wf_typ E R rg Tr Hsig Hty) as HwtTr.
  pose proof (value_typing_nested E R rg Tr Hv Hty) as Hnested.
  destruct (lookup_field_binds E R rg Tr a l Hv Hty Hlook)
    as (A & Hfield & HbA).
  assert (Hreach : Reach E Tr).
  { exists Tr. split; [exact Hnested | apply sub_refl_wf; assumption]. }
  assert (Hgf : Gf E a A Tr) by (eapply nested_gf; eassumption).
  assert (Hgb : Gb E a A Tr) by (eapply nested_gb; eassumption).
  assert (Hgf_rec : Gf E a A (typ_record a B)).
  { eapply gf_pres; eassumption. }
  assert (Hgb_rec : Gb E a A (typ_record a B)).
  { eapply gb_pres; eassumption. }

Lemma typing_seal_any_not_box : forall E R e T,
  typing E R (exp_seal e) (typ_box T) -> False.
Proof. intros. eapply typing_seal_not_box; eauto. Qed.

Lemma typing_seal_any_not_record : forall E R e a T,
  typing E R (exp_seal e) (typ_record a T) -> False.
Proof. intros. eapply typing_seal_not_record; eauto. Qed.

(* If g1 is a sealing of a reference and g1 is typed at box T, then g1 is
   literally the reference (no extra seal). *)
Lemma sealcomp_ref_typed_box :
  forall E R l g1 T,
    sealcomp (exp_ref l) g1 ->
    typing E R g1 (typ_box T) ->
    g1 = exp_ref l.
Proof.
  intros E R l g1 T Hsc Hty.
  destruct (ref_shape l g1 Hsc) as [k Heq]. subst g1.
  destruct k as [|k'].
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso. eapply typing_seal_any_not_box; [exact Hty].
Qed.

(* Same for a record at a record type. *)
Lemma sealcomp_record_typed_record :
  forall E R r g1 a T,
    sealcomp (exp_record r) g1 ->
    typing E R g1 (typ_record a T) ->
    exists r1, g1 = exp_record r1 /\ sealcomp_rec_comp r r1.
Proof.
  intros E R r g1 a T Hsc Hty.
  destruct (record_shape r g1 Hsc) as [k [r1 [Heq Hrc]]]. subst g1.
  destruct k as [|k'].
  - exists r1. split; [reflexivity | exact Hrc].
  - exfalso. eapply typing_seal_any_not_record; [exact Hty].
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* red_set_box_ref is simulable whenever the first argument of  *)
(* the typed set_box is the reference (the only possible case   *)
(* under typing) and the stripped e-argument is a value.        *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma set_box_ref_reduces :
  forall E R ns l e2 g1 g2 T,
    typing E R (exp_set_box g1 g2) T ->
    typing_store E R ns ->
    sealcomp (exp_ref l) g1 ->
    sealcomp e2 g2 ->
    value e2 ->
    expr g2 ->
    exists f' ns', redm (exp_set_box g1 g2) ns f' ns'.
Proof.
  intros E R ns l e2 g1 g2 T Hty Hst Hsc1 Hsc2 Hv2 Hexpr2.
  destruct (typing_set_box_inv E R g1 g2 T Hty) as [T1 [Hg1 [Hg2 _]]].
  assert (Hg1ref : g1 = exp_ref l).
  { eapply sealcomp_ref_typed_box; [exact Hsc1 | exact Hg1]. }
  subst g1.
  destruct (typing_ref_inv E R l (typ_box T1) Hg1) as [T0 [Hb _]].
  destruct (proj1 (Hst l) T0 Hb) as [v [Hm [Htyv Hvalv]]].
  pose proof (typing_store_wf_store E R ns Hst) as Hwfns.
  destruct (value_seal_redm e2 g2 ns Hv2 Hsc2 Hexpr2 Hwfns)
    as [g2' [Hred [Hval' Hsc']]].
  exists v, (LabelMapImpl.add l g2' ns).
  eapply redm_trans with (e':=exp_set_box (exp_ref l) g2') (s':=ns).
  - eapply redm_set_box_2; [apply value_ref | exact Hred].
  - eapply redm_step with (e'':=v) (s'':=LabelMapImpl.add l g2' ns).
    + eapply red_set_box_ref; [exact Hwfns | exact Hvalv | exact Hval' | exact Hm].
    + apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* red_record_write_ref is simulable whenever the first argument *)
(* of the typed record_write is the record (no extra seal).     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma record_write_ref_reduces :
  forall E R ns a l r e2 g1 g2 v T,
    typing E R (exp_record_write g1 a g2) T ->
    well_formed_store ns ->
    sealcomp (exp_record r) g1 ->
    value_record_comp r ->
    record_lookup_ref a r = Some l ->
    LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v ns ->
    sealcomp e2 g2 ->
    value e2 ->
    expr g2 ->
    exists f' ns', redm (exp_record_write g1 a g2) ns f' ns'.
Proof.
  intros E R ns a l r e2 g1 g2 v T Hty Hwf Hsc1 Hvrc Hlook Hmap Hsc2 Hv2 Hexpr2.
  destruct (typing_record_write_inv E R g1 a g2 T Hty) as [T1 [Hg1 [Hg2 _]]].
  destruct (sealcomp_record_typed_record E R r g1 a T1 Hsc1 Hg1) as [r1 [Heq Hrc]].
  subst g1.
  assert (Hlook' : record_lookup_ref a r1 = Some l).
  { rewrite <- (record_lookup_ref_sealcomp a r r1 Hrc). exact Hlook. }
  pose proof (value_record_comp_sealcomp_up r r1 Hrc Hvrc) as Hvrc1.
  pose proof (Hwf l v Hmap) as Hval.
  destruct (value_seal_redm e2 g2 ns Hv2 Hsc2 Hexpr2 Hwf)
    as [g2' [Hred [Hval' Hsc']]].
  exists v, (LabelMapImpl.add l g2' ns).
  eapply redm_trans with (e':=exp_record_write (exp_record r1) a g2') (s':=ns).
  - eapply redm_record_write_2; [apply value_record; exact Hvrc1 | exact Hred].
  - eapply redm_step with (e'':=v) (s'':=LabelMapImpl.add l g2' ns).
    + eapply red_record_write_ref; eauto.
    + apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Unboxing a (possibly multiply sealed) reference: the extra   *)
(* seals never block the step; they are just peeled first.      *)
(* The result is the target-side spelling of the source result. *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma unbox_ref_reduces :
  forall ns l j w w',
    well_formed_store ns ->

Fixpoint ro_pow (k : nat) (T : typ) : typ :=
  match k with
  | 0 => T
  | S k' => typ_mut mut_readonly (ro_pow k' T)
  end.

Lemma wf_typ_ro_pow : forall E T, wf_typ E T -> forall k, wf_typ E (ro_pow k T).
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction k; simpl.
  - exact H.
  - apply wf_typ_readonly. exact IHk.
Qed.

Lemma typing_seal_pow : forall E R e T,
  typing E R e T -> forall k, typing E R (seal_pow k e) (ro_pow k T).
Proof.
  intros E R e T H. induction k; simpl.
  - exact H.
  - apply typing_seal. exact IHk.
Qed.

Lemma sub_ro_pow_self : forall E T,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T -> forall k, sub E T (ro_pow k T).
Proof.
  intros E T Hwe Hwt. induction k; simpl.
  - apply sub_refl_wf; assumption.
  - apply sub_readonly_mutable. exact IHk.
Qed.

Lemma sub_ro_pow : forall E A B, sub E A B ->
  forall k, sub E (ro_pow k A) (ro_pow k B).
Proof.
  intros E A B H. induction k; simpl.
  - exact H.
  - apply sub_readonly. exact IHk.
Qed.

Lemma typing_root_strip : forall E R k f0 T,
  typing E R (seal_pow k f0) T -> wf_sig E R ->
  exists T0, typing E R f0 T0 /\ sub E (ro_pow k T0) T.
Proof.

  - exists T. split; [exact Hty |].
    apply sub_refl_wf.

    + eapply typing_wf_typ; eassumption.
  - destruct (typing_seal_inv E R (seal_pow k f0) T Hty) as [S [Hinner [Heq | Hsub]]].
    + subst T.
      destruct (IH f0 S Hinner Hsig) as [T0 [Hf0 Hsub0]].
      exists T0. split; [exact Hf0 |].
      eapply sub_trans.
      * apply sub_readonly. exact Hsub0.
      * apply sub_refl_wf.
        -- exact (wf_sig_wf_env E R Hsig).
        -- apply wf_typ_readonly. eapply typing_wf_typ; eassumption.
    + destruct (IH f0 S Hinner Hsig) as [T0 [Hf0 Hsub0]].
      exists T0. split; [exact Hf0 |].
      eapply sub_trans.
      * apply sub_readonly. exact Hsub0.
      * exact Hsub.
Qed.

  red e s e1 s1 ->
  forall f ns R T,
    expr e -> expr f ->
    well_formed_store s -> sealcomp_store s ns -> s <s= ns ->
    sealcomp e f ->

    exists f1 ns1 R' T',
      redm f ns f1 ns1 /\
      sealcomp e1 f1 /\
      well_formed_store s1 /\ s1 <s= ns1 /\
      wf_sig empty R' /\ typing_store empty R' ns1 /\
      typing empty R' f1 T' /\ sub empty T' T /\
      expr e1 /\ expr f1.

      typing empty R' f' T' /\ expr e' /\ expr f'.

    split; [exact Hty |].
    split; [exact He | exact Hf].
  - destruct (fwd_step e0 s0 e2 s2 Hred f ns R T He Hf Hwf Hscst Hle Hsc

      value_record_comp r ->

      value v1 ->
      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v1 s1 ->

      well_formed_store s1 ->
      value_record_comp r ->
      record_lookup_ref a r = Some l ->
      value v1 ->
      LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v1 s1 ->
      red (exp_record_read (exp_seal (exp_record r)) a) s1 (exp_seal v1) s1
  | red_record_write_1 : forall a e1 s1 e1' s1' e2,
      expr e2 ->
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_record_write e1 a e2) s1 (exp_record_write e1' a e2) s1'
  | red_record_write_2 : forall a v1 e2 s2 e2' s2',
      value v1 ->

      well_formed_store s1 ->
      record_comp r1 ->
      value v ->
      l = fresh_label_for_store s1 ->
      red_record_comp (rec_exp a v r1) s1 (rec_ref a l r1) (LabelMapImpl.add l v s1)

      red_record_comp r1 s1 r1' s1' ->

Lemma typing_store_add : forall E R s l v T,
  typing_store E R s -> wf_sig E R ->
  typing E R v T -> value v ->
  LabelSetImpl.notin l (Signatures.dom R) ->
  typing_store E (l ~ bind_sig T ++ R) (LabelMapImpl.add l v s).
Proof.
  intros E R s l v T Hst Hsig Hty Hval Hfresh.
  pose proof (typing_wf_typ _ _ _ _ Hty Hsig) as Hwt.
  intros l'.
  assert (HtyTgt : forall e T0, typing E R e T0 -> typing E (l ~ bind_sig T ++ R) e T0).
  { intros e T0 He. eapply typing_sig_add; [exact He | exact Hsig | exact Hwt | exact Hfresh]. }
  split.
  - intros T' Hb. simpl in Hb.
    destruct Hb as [Heq | Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. exists v. split; [apply LabelMapImpl.add_1; reflexivity |].
      split; [apply HtyTgt; exact Hty | exact Hval].
    + destruct (proj1 (Hst l') T' Hin) as [v' [Hm [Hty' Hval']]].
      exists v'. split.
      * destruct (LabelMapFacts.eq_dec l l') as [Heq | Hne].
        -- subst l'. exfalso. eapply Signatures.binds_dom_contradiction; [exact Hin | exact Hfresh].
        -- apply LabelMapImpl.add_2; assumption.
      * split; [apply HtyTgt; exact Hty' | exact Hval'].
  - intros v' Hm.
    destruct (LabelMapFacts.eq_dec l l') as [Heq | Hne].
    + subst l'.
      assert (Hvv : v' = v).
      { eapply LabelMapFacts.MapsTo_fun; [exact Hm | apply LabelMapImpl.add_1; reflexivity]. }
      subst v'.
      exists T. split; [exact Hval | split; [apply HtyTgt; exact Hty | apply Signatures.binds_app_2; apply Signatures.binds_cons_2; reflexivity]].
    + assert (HmS : LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l' v' s).
      { eapply LabelMapImpl.add_3; [exact Hne | exact Hm]. }
      destruct (proj2 (Hst l') v' HmS) as [T' [Hval' [Hty' Hb']]].
      exists T'. split; [exact Hval' | split; [apply HtyTgt; exact Hty' | apply Signatures.binds_app_3; exact Hb']].
Qed.

Lemma typing_store_update : forall E R s l v T,
  typing_store E R s -> wf_sig E R ->
  typing E R v T -> value v ->
  Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
  typing_store E R (LabelMapImpl.add l v s).
Proof.
  intros E R s l v T Hst Hsig Hty Hval Hb.
  intros l'. split.
  - intros T' Hb'. destruct (LabelMapFacts.eq_dec l l') as [Heq | Hne].
    + subst l'.
      assert (HeqT : T' = T).
      { symmetry. exact (wf_sig_binds_fun E R Hsig l T T' Hb Hb'). }
      subst T'. exists v. split; [apply LabelMapImpl.add_1; reflexivity |].
      split; [exact Hty | exact Hval].
    + destruct (proj1 (Hst l') T' Hb') as [v' [Hm [Hty' Hval']]].
      exists v'. split.
      * apply LabelMapImpl.add_2; [exact Hne | exact Hm].
      * split; [exact Hty' | exact Hval'].
  - intros v' Hm. destruct (LabelMapFacts.eq_dec l l') as [Heq | Hne].
    + subst l'.
      assert (Hvv : v' = v).
      { eapply LabelMapFacts.MapsTo_fun; [exact Hm | apply LabelMapImpl.add_1; reflexivity]. }
      subst v'. exists T. split; [exact Hval | split; [exact Hty | exact Hb]].
    + assert (HmS : LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l' v' s).
      { eapply LabelMapImpl.add_3; [exact Hne | exact Hm]. }
      destruct (proj2 (Hst l') v' HmS) as [T' [Hval' [Hty' Hb']]].
      exists T'. split; [exact Hval' | split; [exact Hty' | exact Hb']].
Qed.

Lemma in_dom_elements : forall (s:store) l,
  In l (List.map fst (LabelMapImpl.elements s)) <-> exists v, LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s.
Proof.
  intros s l. split.
  - intros H. apply List.in_map_iff in H. destruct H as [p [Hfst Hin]].
    destruct p as [l' v]. simpl in Hfst. subst l'.
    exists v. apply (@LabelMapImpl.elements_2 exp s l v).
    apply InA_alt. exists (l, v). split.
    * simpl. split; reflexivity.
    * exact Hin.
  - intros [v Hmap].
    pose proof (@LabelMapImpl.elements_1 exp s l v Hmap) as HmapA.
    apply InA_alt in HmapA. destruct HmapA as [y [Heq Hiny]].
    destruct y as [l2 v2]. simpl in Heq. destruct Heq as [Hl Hv]. simpl in Hl, Hv. subst.
    apply List.in_map_iff. exists (l2, v2). split; [reflexivity | exact Hiny].
Qed.

Lemma fresh_label_sealcomp_store : forall s ns,
  s <s= ns -> fresh_label_for_store s = fresh_label_for_store ns.

Lemma sealcomp_store_add : forall s ns l v w,

Fixpoint typ_size (T : typ) : nat :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => 1
  | typ_bvar _ => 1
  | typ_fvar _ => 1
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => S (typ_size T1 + typ_size T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => S (typ_size T1 + typ_size T2)
  | typ_box T => S (typ_size T)
  | typ_mut _ T => S (typ_size T)
  | typ_int T1 T2 => S (typ_size T1 + typ_size T2)
  | typ_record _ T => S (typ_size T)
  end.

Fixpoint exp_size (e : exp) : nat :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar _ => 1
  | exp_fvar _ => 1
  | exp_abs T e1 => S (typ_size T + exp_size e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => S (exp_size e1 + exp_size e2)
  | exp_tabs T e1 => S (typ_size T + exp_size e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 T => S (exp_size e1 + typ_size T)
  | exp_let e1 e2 => S (exp_size e1 + exp_size e2)
  | exp_box e1 => S (exp_size e1)
  | exp_unbox e1 => S (exp_size e1)
  | exp_set_box e1 e2 => S (exp_size e1 + exp_size e2)
  | exp_ref _ => 1

Lemma wf_sig_binds_fun : forall E R, wf_sig E R ->
  forall lb T1 T2,
    Signatures.binds lb (bind_sig T1) R ->
    Signatures.binds lb (bind_sig T2) R -> T1 = T2.
Proof.
  intros E R H. induction H; intros lb T1 T2 Hb1 Hb2.
  - inversion Hb1.
  - simpl in Hb1, Hb2.
    destruct Hb1 as [Heq1 | Hin1]; destruct Hb2 as [Heq2 | Hin2].
    + inversion Heq1; inversion Heq2; subst; reflexivity.
    + inversion Heq1. subst.
      exfalso. eapply Signatures.binds_dom_contradiction; [exact Hin2 | exact H1].
    + inversion Heq2. subst.
      exfalso. eapply Signatures.binds_dom_contradiction; [exact Hin1 | exact H1].
    + apply (IHwf_sig lb T1 T2 Hin1 Hin2).
Qed.

(* Spine lookup / head atoms for the nested-int record shape.   *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Fixpoint rec_field (a : atom) (T : typ) : option typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_record b C => if (a === b) then Some C else None
  | typ_int U W =>
      match rec_field a U with
      | Some C => Some C
      | None => rec_field a W
      end
  | _ => None
  end.

Fixpoint rec_heads (T : typ) : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_int U W => union (rec_heads U) (rec_heads W)
  | typ_record a _ => singleton a
  | _ => AtomSetImpl.empty
  end.

Inductive nested_rec : typ -> Prop :=
  | nested_rec_top : nested_rec typ_top
  | nested_rec_int : forall a C R,
      nested_rec R ->
      a `notin` rec_heads R ->
      nested_rec (typ_int (typ_record a C) R).

Lemma rec_field_heads : forall T a,
  match rec_field a T with
  | Some C => a `in` rec_heads T
  | None => ~ a `in` rec_heads T
  end.
Proof.
  intros T. induction T; intros x; simpl.

(* Based on the System F-sub development by Brian Aydemir and Arthur
   Charguéraud, with Aaron Bohannon, Jeffrey Vaughan, and Dimitrios Vytiniotis. *)

Require Export Fsub.FmMeta.Metatheory.

Require Export String.

Require Export Fsub.Label.

Require Export Fsub.Signatures.

Require Export Fsub.LabelMap.

Require Export Coq.Program.Equality.


Inductive mut : Set :=
  | mut_readonly : mut
.

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_top : typ
  | typ_bvar : nat -> typ
  | typ_fvar : atom -> typ
  | typ_arrow : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_all : typ -> typ -> typ

  | typ_box : typ -> typ

  | typ_mut : mut -> typ -> typ

  | typ_int : typ -> typ -> typ

  | typ_record : atom -> typ -> typ
.

Inductive exp : Set :=
  | exp_bvar : nat -> exp
  | exp_fvar : atom -> exp
  | exp_abs : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_app : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tabs : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tapp : exp -> typ -> exp
  | exp_let : exp -> exp -> exp

  | exp_box : exp -> exp
  | exp_unbox : exp -> exp
  | exp_set_box : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_ref : label -> exp

  | exp_seal : exp -> exp

  | exp_record : rec_comp -> exp
  | exp_record_read : exp -> atom -> exp
  | exp_record_write: exp -> atom -> exp -> exp
with rec_comp : Set :=


  | rec_empty : rec_comp
  | rec_exp : atom -> exp -> rec_comp -> rec_comp
  | rec_ref : atom -> label -> rec_comp -> rec_comp
.

Coercion typ_bvar : nat >-> typ.

Coercion typ_fvar : atom >-> typ.

Coercion exp_bvar : nat >-> exp.

Coercion exp_fvar : atom >-> exp.

Fixpoint open_tt_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (T : typ)  {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_bvar J => if K == J then U else (typ_bvar J)
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec (S K) U T2)
  | typ_box T => typ_box (open_tt_rec K U T)
  | typ_mut M T => typ_mut M (open_tt_rec K U T)
  | typ_int T1 T2 => typ_int (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_record a T1 => typ_record a (open_tt_rec K U T1)
  end.

Fixpoint open_te_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs  (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec K U e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app  (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec (S K) U e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_tt_rec K U V)
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_box e => exp_box (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_unbox e => exp_unbox (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_set_box b e => exp_set_box (open_te_rec K U b) (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_ref l => exp_ref l
  | exp_seal e => exp_seal (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_record r => exp_record (open_te_record_rec K U r)
  | exp_record_read e a => exp_record_read (open_te_rec K U e) a
  | exp_record_write e1 a e2 => exp_record_write (open_te_rec K U e1) a (open_te_rec K U e2)
  end
with
  open_te_record_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (r : rec_comp) {struct r} : rec_comp :=
  match r with
  | rec_empty => rec_empty
  | rec_exp a e r => rec_exp a (open_te_rec K U e) (open_te_record_rec K U r)
  | rec_ref a l r => rec_ref a l (open_te_record_rec K U r)
  end.

Fixpoint open_ee_rec (k : nat) (f : exp) (e : exp)  {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => if k == i then f else (exp_bvar i)
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs V (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs V (open_ee_rec k f e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_ee_rec k f e1) V
  | exp_let e1 e2 => exp_let (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec (S k) f e2)
  | exp_box e => exp_box (open_ee_rec k f e)
  | exp_unbox e => exp_unbox (open_ee_rec k f  e)
  | exp_set_box b e => exp_set_box (open_ee_rec k f b) (open_ee_rec k f e)
  | exp_ref l => exp_ref l
  | exp_seal e => exp_seal (open_ee_rec k f e)
  | exp_record r => exp_record (open_ee_record_rec k f r)
  | exp_record_read e a => exp_record_read (open_ee_rec k f e) a
  | exp_record_write e1 a e2 => exp_record_write (open_ee_rec k f e1) a (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  end
with
  open_ee_record_rec (k : nat) (f : exp) (r : rec_comp)  {struct r} : rec_comp :=
  match r with
  | rec_empty => rec_empty
  | rec_exp a e r => rec_exp a (open_ee_rec k f e) (open_ee_record_rec k f r)
  | rec_ref a l r => rec_ref a l (open_ee_record_rec k f r)
  end.

Definition open_tt T U := open_tt_rec 0 U T.

Definition open_te e U := open_te_rec 0 U e.

typing (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) R (open_te e1 X) (open_tt T1 X)) ->
      typing E R (exp_tabs V e1) (typ_all V T1)
  | typing_tapp : forall T1 E R e1 T T2,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 (typ_all T1 T2) ->
      sub E T T1 ->
      typing E R (exp_tapp e1 T) (open_tt T2 T)
  | typing_sub : forall S E R e T,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e S ->
      sub E S T ->
      typing E R e T
  | typing_let : forall L T1 T2 e1 e2 E R,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 T1 ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ T1 ++ E) R (open_ee e2 x) T2) ->
      typing E R (exp_let e1 e2) T2
  | typing_box : forall E R e T,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e T ->
      typing E R (exp_box e) (typ_box T)
  | typing_unbox : forall E R e T,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e (typ_box T) ->
      typing E R (exp_unbox e) T

  | typing_set_box : forall E R e1 e2 T,
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing E R e1 (typ_box T) ->
      typing E R e2 T ->
      typing E R (exp_set_box e1 e2) T
  | typing_ref : forall E R l T,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_sig E R ->
      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
      typing E R (exp_ref l) (typ_box T)

  | typing_seal : forall E R e T,
      typing E R e T ->
      typing E R (exp_seal e) (typ_mut mut_readonly T)

  | typing_unbox_readonly : forall E R e T,
      typing E R e (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box T)) ->
      typing E R (exp_unbox e) (typ_mut mut_readonly T)
  | typing_record : forall E R r T,
      typing_record_comp E R r T ->
      typing E R (exp_record r) T

  | typing_record_read : forall E R e a T,
      typing E R e (typ_record a T) ->
      typing E R (exp_record_read e a) T
  | typing_record_read_readonly : forall E R e a T,
      typing E R e (typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_record a T)) ->
      typing E R (exp_record_read e a) (typ_mut mut_readonly T)

  | typing_record_write : forall E R e1 a e2 T,
      typing E R e1 (typ_record a T) ->
      typing E R e2 T ->
      typing E R (exp_record_write e1 a e2) T
with typing_record_comp : env -> sig -> rec_comp -> typ -> Prop :=
  | typing_record_empty : forall E R,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_sig E R ->
      typing_record_comp E R rec_empty typ_top
  | typing_record_exp : forall E R a e r T Tr,
      a `notin` record_dom r ->
      typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
      typing E R e T ->
      typing_record_comp E R (rec_exp a e r) (typ_int (typ_record a T) Tr)
  | typing_record_ref : forall E R a l r T Tr,
      a `notin` record_dom r ->
      typing_record_comp E R r Tr ->
      Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
      typing_record_comp E R (rec_ref a l r) (typ_int (typ_record a T) Tr)
.

Notation "E @ R |- e T" := (typing E R e T) (at level 70).

Notation "E @ R |-r r T" := (typing_record_comp E R r T) (at level 70).

Inductive value : exp -> Prop :=
  | value_abs : forall T e1,
      expr (exp_abs T e1) ->
      value (exp_abs T e1)
  | value_tabs : forall T e1,
      expr (exp_tabs T e1) ->
      value (exp_tabs T e1)
  | value_ref : forall l,
      value (exp_ref l)
  | value_sealed_ref : forall l,
      value (exp_seal (exp_ref l))
  | value_record : forall r,
      value_record_comp r ->
      value (exp_record r)
  | value_sealed_record : forall r,
      value_record_comp r ->
      value (exp_seal (exp_record r))
with value_record_comp : rec_comp -> Prop :=
  | value_rec_empty :
      value_record_comp rec_empty
  | value_rec_ref : forall a l r,
      value_record_comp r ->
      value_record_comp (rec_ref a l r)
.

Notation store := (LabelMap exp).

Notation empty_store := (LabelMapImpl.empty store).

Definition well_formed_store (s : store) :=
  forall l v, LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s -> value v.

(* The original dependent pair uses this same witness. *)
Definition fresh_label_for_store (s : store) :=
  Label.fresh (List.map fst (LabelMapImpl.elements s)).

Definition typing_store (E: env) (R : sig) (s : store) :=
  forall l,
    (forall T, Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R ->
        exists v,
            (LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s) /\
            typing E R v T /\ value v)
    /\
    (forall v, (LabelMapImpl.MapsTo l v s) ->
        exists T, (value v /\ typing E R v T /\ Signatures.binds l (bind_sig T) R)).

Notation "E |-st s @ R" := (typing_store E R s) (at level 70).

Fixpoint record_lookup_ref (a : atom) (r : rec_comp) : option label :=
    match r with
    | rec_ref a' l r => if (a === a') then Some l else record_lookup_ref a r
    | _ => None
    end.

Notation "r # a" := (record_lookup_ref a r) (at level 70).

Inductive red : exp -> store -> exp -> store -> Prop :=
  | red_app_1 : forall e1 e1' s1 s1' e2,
      expr e2 ->
      red e1 s1 e1' s1' ->
      red (exp_app e1 e2) s1 (exp_app e1' e2) s1'
  | red_app_2 : forall e1 e2 s2 e2' s2',
      value e1 ->

Lemma arrow_pred_sub_aux : forall E A B T2 T3,
  arrow_pred E A B T2 -> sub E T2 T3 -> arrow_pred E A B T3.
Proof.

  pose proof (sub_wf_env E T2 T3 Hs) as Hwe.
  dependent induction Hs.
  - (* top *) exact I.
  - (* refl_tvar *) inversion Hp.
  - (* trans_tvar *) inversion Hp.
  - (* arrow *) simpl in Hp. destruct Hp as [Hpa Hpb]. simpl.
    split.
    + eapply sub_trans; eassumption.
    + eapply sub_trans; eassumption.
  - (* all *) inversion Hp.
  - (* box *) inversion Hp.
  - (* readonly *) simpl in Hp. simpl. apply IHHs; [exact Hp | exact Hwe].
  - (* readonly_mutable *) simpl. apply IHHs; [exact Hp | exact Hwe].
  - (* trans *) simpl. apply IHHs2; [apply IHHs1; [exact Hp | exact Hwe] | exact Hwe].

  - (* inter *) simpl. split.
    + apply IHHs1; [exact Hp | exact Hwe].
    + apply IHHs2; [exact Hp | exact Hwe].
  - (* record *) inversion Hp.
  - (* readonly_record *) inversion Hp.
  - (* denormalize *) simpl in *.
    pose proof (proj1 (arrow_pred_nf E A B T1 Hwe H) Hp) as Hpn.
    pose proof (IHHs Hpn Hwe) as Hqn.
    exact (proj2 (arrow_pred_nf E A B T2 Hwe H0) Hqn).

(* ============ box inversion ============ *)
Fixpoint box_pred (E : env) (A T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_box C => sub E A C /\ sub E C A
  | typ_int U W => box_pred E A U /\ box_pred E A W
  | typ_mut _ U => box_pred E A U
  | _ => False
  end.

Lemma box_pred_merge : forall E A U M,
  box_pred E A (merge_mutability U M) <-> box_pred E A U.
Proof.
  intros E A U. induction U; intros M; simpl; try reflexivity.
  all: try (split; intro Hh; exact Hh).
  - (* int *) rewrite IHU1, IHU2. tauto.
Qed.

Lemma box_pred_nf_params : forall E A U,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E A ->
  (box_pred E (normal_form_typing A) U <-> box_pred E A U).
Proof.
  intros E A U Hwe Hwa.
  induction U; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - (* box *) split; intros [H1 H2]; split.
    + eapply sub_trans; [apply sub_normal_form_typing_right; [exact Hwe | exact Hwa] | exact H1].
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact H2 | apply sub_normal_form_typing_left; [exact Hwe | exact Hwa]].
    + eapply sub_trans; [apply sub_normal_form_typing_left; [exact Hwe | exact Hwa] | exact H1].
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact H2 | apply sub_normal_form_typing_right; [exact Hwe | exact Hwa]].
  - (* mut *) apply IHU.
  - (* int *) rewrite IHU1, IHU2. tauto.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

  (box_pred E A T <-> box_pred E A (normal_form_typing T)).
Proof.

  fix IH 1. intros T Hwe Hwt.
  destruct T as [|n|X|T1 T2|T1 T2|T1|M T1|T1 T2|a T1]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - (* box *) pose proof (wf_typ_box_inv E T1 Hwt) as Hwt1. split; intros [H1 H2]; split.
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact H1 | apply sub_normal_form_typing_right; [exact Hwe | exact Hwt1]].
    + eapply sub_trans; [apply sub_normal_form_typing_left; [exact Hwe | exact Hwt1] | exact H2].
    + eapply sub_trans; [exact H1 | apply sub_normal_form_typing_left; [exact Hwe | exact Hwt1]].

  - (* mut *) rewrite box_pred_merge. destruct M. apply (IH T1 Hwe (wf_typ_readonly_inv _ _ Hwt)).
  - (* int *) split; intros [H1 H2]; split.
    + apply (proj1 (IH T1 Hwe (wf_typ_int_l _ _ _ Hwt))) in H1. exact H1.
    + apply (proj1 (IH T2 Hwe (wf_typ_int_r _ _ _ Hwt))) in H2. exact H2.
    + apply (proj2 (IH T1 Hwe (wf_typ_int_l _ _ _ Hwt))). exact H1.
    + apply (proj2 (IH T2 Hwe (wf_typ_int_r _ _ _ Hwt))). exact H2.
  - (* record *) reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma box_pred_sub_aux : forall E A T2 T3,
  box_pred E A T2 -> sub E T2 T3 -> box_pred E A T3.
Proof.
  intros E A T2 T3 Hp Hs.
  pose proof (sub_wf_env E T2 T3 Hs) as Hwe.
  dependent induction Hs.
  - (* top *) exact I.
  - (* refl_tvar *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.

  - (* arrow *) simpl in Hp. inversion Hp.

    + eapply sub_trans; eassumption.
    + eapply sub_trans; eassumption.
  - (* readonly *) simpl in Hp. simpl. apply IHHs; [exact Hp | exact Hwe].

  - (* trans *) simpl. apply IHHs2; [apply IHHs1; [exact Hp | exact Hwe] | exact Hwe].
  - (* inter_left *) simpl in Hp. destruct Hp as [Hp _]. exact Hp.
  - (* inter_right *) simpl in Hp. destruct Hp as [_ Hp]. exact Hp.
  - (* inter *) simpl. split.
    + apply IHHs1; [exact Hp | exact Hwe].

    + apply (IHsub1 A eq_refl).
    + exact H0.
  - (* inter *) simpl. split.
    + apply (IHsub1 A eq_refl).
    + apply (IHsub2 A eq_refl).
  - (* denormalize *) simpl in H1.
    pose proof (IHsub (normal_form_typing A) eq_refl) as Hpred.
    pose proof (sub_wf_env E _ _ H1) as Hwe.
    pose proof (wf_typ_box_inv E A H) as Hwa.
    apply (proj1 (box_pred_nf_params E A (normal_form_typing T2) Hwe Hwa)) in Hpred.

Qed.

Lemma sub_box_inv_l : forall E A B, sub E (typ_box A) (typ_box B) -> sub E A B.
Proof.

9	Fixpoint rec_field (a : atom) (T : typ) : option typ :=
10	  match T with
11	  | typ_record b C => if (a === b) then Some C else None
12	  | typ_int U W =>
13	      match rec_field a U with
14	      | Some C => Some C
15	      | None => rec_field a W
16	      end
17	  | _ => None
18	  end.

20	Fixpoint rec_heads (T : typ) : atoms :=
21	  match T with
22	  | typ_int U W => union (rec_heads U) (rec_heads W)
23	  | typ_record a _ => singleton a
24	  | _ => AtomSetImpl.empty
25	  end.

27	Inductive nested_rec : typ -> Prop :=
28	  | nested_rec_top : nested_rec typ_top
29	  | nested_rec_int : forall a C R,
30	      nested_rec R ->
31	      a `notin` rec_heads R ->
32	      nested_rec (typ_int (typ_record a C) R).

34	Lemma rec_field_heads : forall T a,
35	  match rec_field a T with
36	  | Some C => a `in` rec_heads T
37	  | None => ~ a `in` rec_heads T
38	  end.
39	Proof.
40	  intros T. induction T; intros x; simpl.
41	  - (* top *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H).
42	  - (* bvar *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H).
43	  - (* fvar *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H).
44	  - (* arrow *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H).
45	  - (* all *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H).
46	  - (* box *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H).
47	  - (* mut *) intro H; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H).
48	  - (* int *)
49	    destruct (rec_field x T1) as [C|] eqn:E1.
50	    + specialize (IHT1 x) as H1. rewrite E1 in H1. simpl in H1.
51	      simpl. apply AtomSetImpl.union_2. exact H1.
52	    + specialize (IHT1 x) as H1. rewrite E1 in H1. simpl in H1.
53	      simpl. destruct (rec_field x T2) as [C|] eqn:E2.
54	      * specialize (IHT2 x) as H2. rewrite E2 in H2. simpl in H2.
55	        apply AtomSetImpl.union_3. exact H2.

66	  rec_field a T = None <-> ~ a `in` rec_heads T.

Fixpoint typing_tabs_inv (E:env) (R:sig) (V:typ) (body:exp) (T:typ)
  (H : typing E R (exp_tabs V body) T) {struct H} :
  exists L T1, (forall X:atom, X `notin` L ->

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Honest step-counting version of redm (redm is in Prop, so we   *)
(* cannot eliminate it to Set; we use an indexed relation).       *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Inductive redm_n : nat -> exp -> store -> exp -> store -> Prop :=
  | redm_n_zero : forall e s,
      redm_n 0 e s e s
  | redm_n_succ : forall n e s e'' s'' e' s',
      red e s e'' s'' ->
      redm_n n e'' s'' e' s' ->
      redm_n (S n) e s e' s'.

Lemma redm_n_redm : forall n e s e' s',
  redm_n n e s e' s' -> redm e s e' s'.
Proof.
  intros n e s e' s' H. induction H.
  - apply redm_eq; reflexivity.
  - apply redm_step with (e'':=e'') (s'':=s''); assumption.
Qed.

Lemma redm_redm_n : forall e s e' s',
  redm e s e' s' -> exists n, redm_n n e s e' s'.
Proof.
  intros e s e' s' H. induction H.
  - subst. exists 0. apply redm_n_zero.
  - destruct IHredm as [n Hn]. exists (S n).
    apply redm_n_succ with (e'':=e'') (s'':=s''); assumption.
Qed.

  redm_n 0 e s e' s' -> e = e' /\ s = s'.

  redm_n (S n) e s e' s' ->

Proof.

From Stdlib Require Import Lia.
From Fsub Require Import Fm_Definitions.
Load "/tmp/th1/record_comp.v".

Definition RB (A : typ) : typ := typ_mut mut_readonly (typ_box A).

Fixpoint ro_pred (E : env) (A T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_box B => sub E A B
  | typ_mut _ C => ro_pred E A C
  | typ_int U W => ro_pred E A U /\ ro_pred E A W
  | _ => False
  end.

Lemma ro_pred_merge : forall E A U M,
  ro_pred E A (merge_mutability U M) <-> ro_pred E A U.
Proof.
  intros E A U. induction U; intros M; simpl; try reflexivity.
  all: try (split; intro Hh; exact Hh).
  - (* int *) rewrite IHU1, IHU2. tauto.
Qed.

Lemma ro_pred_nf : forall E A T,
  wf_env E -> wf_typ E T ->
  (ro_pred E A T <-> ro_pred E A (normal_form_typing T)).
Proof.
  intros E A T Hwe Hwt. revert T Hwt.
  fix IH 1. intros T Hwt.
  destruct T as [|n|X|T1 T2|T1 T2|T1|M T1|T1 T2|a T1]; simpl.
  - tauto.

    + eapply sub_trans; [exact Hh | apply sub_normal_form_typing_left; [exact Hwe | apply wf_typ_box_inv; exact Hwt]].
  - (* mut *) rewrite ro_pred_merge. destruct M. apply (IH T1). apply wf_typ_readonly_inv. exact Hwt.
  - (* int *) split; intros [H1 H2]; split;
      [ apply (proj1 (IH T1 (wf_typ_int_l E T1 T2 Hwt))) in H1; exact H1
      | apply (proj1 (IH T2 (wf_typ_int_r E T1 T2 Hwt))) in H2; exact H2

      | apply (proj2 (IH T2 (wf_typ_int_r E T1 T2 Hwt))); exact H2 ].
  - (* record *) tauto.

Lemma ro_pred_merge : forall E A U M,
  ro_pred E A (merge_mutability U M) <-> ro_pred E A U.
Proof.

  all: try (split; intro Hh; exact Hh).
  - (* int *) rewrite IHU1, IHU2. tauto.
Qed.

Lemma ro_pred_nf : forall E A T,

Proof.
  intros E A T Hwe Hwt. revert T Hwt.
  fix IH 1. intros T Hwt.

Proof.
  intros e s e' s' H. induction H; intros Hwf.

Qed.

Fixpoint sealcomp_refl (e : exp) : sealcomp e e
with sealcomp_rec_refl (r : rec_comp) : sealcomp_rec_comp r r.
Proof.
  - destruct e; try constructor; auto;
      try apply sealcomp_refl; try apply sealcomp_rec_refl.
  - destruct r; try constructor; auto;
      try apply sealcomp_refl; try apply sealcomp_rec_refl.
Qed.

Inductive sub : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | sub_top : forall E S,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E S ->
      sub E S typ_top
  | sub_refl_tvar : forall E X,
      wf_env E ->
      wf_typ E (typ_fvar X) ->

  | sub_trans_tvar : forall U E T X,
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      sub E U T ->
      sub E (typ_fvar X) T
  | sub_arrow : forall E S1 S2 T1 T2,
      sub E T1 S1 ->
      sub E S2 T2 ->
      sub E (typ_arrow S1 S2) (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | sub_all : forall L E S1 S2 T1 T2,
      sub E T1 S1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
          sub (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt S2 X) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      sub E (typ_all S1 S2) (typ_all T1 T2)
  | sub_box : forall E T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E T2 T1 ->
      sub E (typ_box T1) (typ_box T2)

  | sub_readonly : forall E T1 T2,
      sub E T1 T2 ->
      sub E (typ_mut mut_readonly T1) (typ_mut mut_readonly T2)

  | sub_inter_left : forall E T1 T2,

  | sub_inter_right : forall E T1 T2,
